## Response:

Saya akan susun sebagai peta onboarding praktis untuk aplikasi Jersey/JAX-RS, bukan sekadar daftar library. Fokusnya: boundary REST, DTO/domain mapping, validasi, format JSON/XML, dan failure mode serialization.

## Introduction

Topik ini adalah **data boundary layer** untuk aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**: bagaimana request/response JSON/XML masuk ke resource, divalidasi, dikonversi ke DTO/domain model, diproses, lalu diserialisasi kembali secara aman dan konsisten.

Secara praktis, area ini bukan hanya “pakai Jackson atau JAXB”, tetapi mencakup:

1. **Media negotiation**: `Content-Type`, `Accept`, `MessageBodyReader`, `MessageBodyWriter`.
2. **Serialization / deserialization**: JSON/XML ⇄ Java object.
3. **Binding model**: JSON-B, JSON-P, Jackson, JAXB/Jakarta XML Binding.
4. **DTO/domain/entity mapping**: MapStruct, manual mapper, mapping policy.
5. **Validation boundary**: Jakarta Validation + Hibernate Validator.
6. **Error contract**: bagaimana invalid JSON, invalid XML, invalid field, dan domain violation dikembalikan sebagai API error.
7. **Compatibility governance**: `javax.*` vs `jakarta.*`, Jersey 2 vs Jersey 3/4/5, Jakarta EE 9+ namespace migration.

Untuk baseline modern, gunakan **Jakarta namespace** (`jakarta.*`) bila aplikasi sudah berbasis Jersey 3+ / Jakarta EE 9+. Jakarta JSON-B adalah binding layer standar Java object ⇄ JSON; Jakarta JSON-P adalah API standar untuk parse/generate/transform/query JSON dengan model streaming dan object model; Jakarta XML Binding menyediakan mapping XML document ⇄ Java object; Jakarta Validation menyediakan object-level constraint declaration dan validation facility. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/jsonb/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang perlu dikuasai | Pitfall umum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | REST data boundary | Menentukan bagaimana payload masuk/keluar dari JAX-RS resource | `@Consumes`, `@Produces`, `Content-Type`, `Accept`, DTO request/response | Resource langsung menerima entity/database model |
| 2 | Jersey entity provider | Menghubungkan Java object dengan body HTTP | `MessageBodyReader`, `MessageBodyWriter`, Jersey media modules, feature registration | Provider bentrok: JSON-B dan Jackson sama-sama aktif tanpa policy jelas |
| 3 | JSON-B | Binding standar Jakarta untuk Java object ⇄ JSON | `Jsonb`, `JsonbConfig`, naming strategy, date format, adapters, visibility | Cocok untuk standar/portability, tapi customization kompleks bisa lebih terbatas dibanding Jackson |
| 4 | JSON-P | Low-level JSON processing | `JsonObject`, `JsonArray`, `JsonReader`, `JsonWriter`, streaming parser/generator | Dipakai untuk semua use case padahal DTO binding lebih sederhana dengan JSON-B/Jackson |
| 5 | Jackson JSON | De facto high-control JSON databinding | `ObjectMapper`, modules, annotations, custom serializer/deserializer, `JsonNode` | `ObjectMapper` dikonfigurasi berbeda antar service sehingga contract tidak konsisten |
| 6 | Jackson tree model | Manipulasi JSON dinamis/semi-structured | `JsonNode`, `ObjectNode`, `ArrayNode`, partial extraction | Terlalu banyak logic bisnis di tree manipulation |
| 7 | Jackson streaming model | Payload besar/performance-sensitive | `JsonParser`, `JsonGenerator` | Membaca payload besar ke object penuh tanpa perlu |
| 8 | XML boundary | Support XML request/response | `application/xml`, `@Consumes`, `@Produces`, schema awareness | XML diterima tanpa hardening security |
| 9 | JAXB / Jakarta XML Binding | Mapping XML ⇄ Java object standar | `@XmlRootElement`, `@XmlElement`, `@XmlAttribute`, `JAXBContext`, marshaller/unmarshaller | Lupa bahwa Jakarta XML Binding sekarang bukan bagian dari Jakarta EE 11 platform; dependency/runtime perlu dicek eksplisit |
| 10 | Jackson XML | XML binding memakai model Jackson | `XmlMapper`, `@JacksonXmlProperty`, `@JacksonXmlElementWrapper` | Menganggap XML selalu sama dengan JSON; attribute, namespace, wrapper semantics berbeda |
| 11 | Serialization policy | Mengontrol bentuk output | null handling, field ordering, naming, enum format, temporal format, BigDecimal precision | Output berubah karena default serializer berubah saat upgrade dependency |
| 12 | Deserialization policy | Mengontrol input payload | unknown properties, required fields, coercion, enum fallback, empty string/null policy | Input longgar tanpa sadar: string kosong menjadi null, angka ke string, enum invalid lolos |
| 13 | Custom adapter/converter | Mapping tipe non-trivial | JSON-B adapter, Jackson serializer/deserializer, JAXB adapter | Adapter berisi business rule berat yang seharusnya di service/domain layer |
| 14 | DTO design | Kontrak API eksplisit | request DTO, response DTO, command DTO, query DTO, versioned DTO | Reuse DTO untuk create/update/patch/response sehingga constraint kacau |
| 15 | Java records untuk DTO | DTO immutable dan ringkas | records, canonical constructor, validation compatibility | Beberapa framework lama belum mulus dengan records |
| 16 | MapStruct | Compile-time bean mapper | mapper interface, `@Mapping`, nested mapping, enum mapping, collection mapping | Annotation processor tidak aktif di Maven/IDE, hasil mapper tidak tergenerate |
| 17 | Manual mapper | Mapping eksplisit untuk logic kompleks | static factory, assembler, mapper class | Boilerplate tinggi, rawan field tertinggal |
| 18 | Update/Patch mapper | Partial update ke existing object | `@MappingTarget`, null ignore strategy, JSON Merge Patch/JSON Patch policy | Null ambigu: “clear value” vs “field tidak dikirim” |
| 19 | Domain/entity separation | Menjaga boundary bersih | DTO ≠ domain ≠ persistence entity | Entity langsung diekspos ke REST; lazy loading dan field sensitif bocor |
| 20 | Jakarta Validation | Validasi object graph | `@NotNull`, `@Size`, `@Pattern`, `@Email`, `@Valid`, container element constraints | Validasi hanya di service, bukan di boundary, sehingga error terlambat |
| 21 | Hibernate Validator | Implementasi Jakarta Validation + fitur tambahan | custom constraint, message interpolation, fail fast, method validation | Constraint message tidak distandarkan sebagai API error contract |
| 22 | Validation group | Constraint berbeda per use case | `Create`, `Update`, `Patch`, `Admin`, group sequence | Terlalu banyak group sampai sulit diaudit |
| 23 | Class-level validation | Cross-field invariant | custom annotation, `ConstraintValidator` | Field-level constraint dipaksa untuk rule lintas field |
| 24 | Method validation | Validasi parameter dan return service/resource | parameter constraint, return constraint, executable validation | Tidak aktif karena integrasi runtime belum dikonfigurasi |
| 25 | Error mapping | Kontrak error API | `ExceptionMapper`, validation error response, parse error response | Semua error jadi HTTP 500 atau pesan framework mentah bocor |
| 26 | Security hardening JSON | Mencegah unsafe deserialization | disable unsafe polymorphic default typing, whitelist subtype, payload size limit | Mengaktifkan polymorphic deserialization global |
| 27 | Security hardening XML | Mencegah XXE/entity attack | disable external entity, secure parser factory, size/depth limit | XML parser default dibiarkan tanpa konfigurasi security |
| 28 | Compatibility governance | Menjaga stack tidak campur aduk | `javax.*` vs `jakarta.*`, Jersey 2 vs 3+, Jakarta EE version, dependency BOM | Dependency transitive membawa API namespace lama |
| 29 | Test strategy | Menjamin contract stabil | golden file test, round-trip serialization test, invalid payload test, mapper test | Hanya unit test service, tidak test wire-format |
| 30 | Observability | Mendiagnosis payload/mapping error | correlation ID, sanitized payload logging, validation metrics | Logging payload penuh berisi PII/secret |
| 31 | Performance | Optimasi payload processing | singleton `ObjectMapper`, reuse `Jsonb`, streaming untuk payload besar, avoid reflection-heavy mapping | Membuat mapper/serializer baru per request |
| 32 | API evolution | Perubahan contract aman | backward compatibility, default value, deprecation, versioned DTO | Mengubah nama field/enum tanpa compatibility plan |

Jersey menyediakan dukungan JSON melalui extension modules yang mengintegrasikan framework JSON ke server/client dan biasanya perlu diregistrasikan sebagai `Feature`; Jersey juga memiliki dukungan Bean Validation melalui modul `jersey-bean-validation`. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/media.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

MapStruct sendiri adalah annotation processor yang menghasilkan mapper type-safe pada compile time dan menggunakan plain Java method invocation, bukan reflection runtime. Ini cocok untuk boundary DTO/domain/entity mapping yang perlu eksplisit, cepat, dan mudah diuji. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Hibernate Validator saat ini adalah implementasi referensi Jakarta Validation 3.1; dokumentasinya membagi constraint ke field constraints, property constraints, container element constraints, dan class constraints. Jakarta Validation 3.1 juga mengklarifikasi dukungan Java Records. ([GitHub](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-validator?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Mental Model Praktis

Untuk aplikasi Jersey/JAX-RS, pikirkan pipeline seperti ini:

```text
wire format
  ↓
JSON/XML parser
  ↓
DTO deserialization
  ↓
syntactic validation
  ↓
semantic mapping
  ↓
domain invariant
  ↓
application service
  ↓
response mapper
  ↓
serialization
  ↓
wire contract
```

Yang penting: **validasi DTO bukan pengganti domain invariant**.

Contoh pembagian responsibility:

| Layer | Boleh dilakukan | Jangan dilakukan |
|---|---|---|
| DTO | shape payload, field required, format dasar | business decision |
| Validator | constraint input, cross-field rule sederhana | query database berat |
| Mapper | transform DTO ↔ domain/entity | side effect, persistence |
| Domain/service | invariant bisnis, workflow, state transition | parsing JSON/XML |
| Serializer | format output | menentukan business result |

---

## JSON-B vs JSON-P vs Jackson

| Pilihan | Cocok untuk | Kelebihan | Kelemahan |
|---|---|---|---|
| JSON-B | Standard Jakarta POJO binding | Portable, standar, bersih untuk DTO sederhana | Customization ecosystem tidak seluas Jackson |
| JSON-P | Low-level JSON tree/stream | Bagus untuk payload dinamis, streaming, transform ringan | Verbose untuk DTO normal |
| Jackson Databind | Enterprise JSON customization | Fitur luas, modules banyak, mature | Perlu policy ketat agar tidak “liar” |
| Jackson Tree | JSON semi-structured | Fleksibel untuk dynamic attributes | Type safety rendah |
| Jackson Streaming | Payload besar | Memory lebih efisien | Lebih kompleks |

Rekomendasi praktis:

```text
Default REST DTO biasa       → Jackson atau JSON-B
Standar Jakarta portability  → JSON-B
Payload dinamis              → JSON-P atau Jackson JsonNode
Payload besar                → JSON-P streaming atau Jackson streaming
Butuh custom behavior berat  → Jackson
```

---

## JAXB vs Jackson XML

| Pilihan | Cocok untuk | Kelebihan | Risiko |
|---|---|---|---|
| JAXB / Jakarta XML Binding | XML contract formal, schema-oriented, enterprise integration | Standar Jakarta, kuat untuk XML object mapping | Perlu dependency eksplisit, namespace XML bisa kompleks |
| Jackson XML | Ingin model Jackson konsisten untuk JSON dan XML | Familiar jika sudah pakai Jackson | XML semantics tidak identik dengan JSON |
| Manual XML/StAX | XML besar/streaming | Kontrol tinggi | Boilerplate besar |

Jakarta XML Binding 4.0 adalah release untuk Jakarta EE 10, sedangkan Jakarta XML Binding 4.1 masih under development untuk Jakarta EE 12. Jakarta EE 11 menghapus Jakarta XML Binding dari platform, sehingga aplikasi yang masih butuh JAXB harus mengelola dependency/runtime secara eksplisit. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/xml-binding/4.0/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Version / Compatibility Watchlist

| Concern | Yang dicek |
|---|---|
| Jersey version | Jersey 2 umumnya `javax.*`; Jersey 3+ memakai `jakarta.*` |
| Validation API | `jakarta.validation.*` vs `javax.validation.*` |
| JAXB API | `jakarta.xml.bind.*` vs `javax.xml.bind.*` |
| JSON-B API | `jakarta.json.bind.*` |
| JSON-P API | `jakarta.json.*` |
| Hibernate Validator | Cocokkan major version dengan Jakarta Validation API |
| Jackson modules | Cocokkan `jackson-databind`, `jackson-core`, `jackson-annotations`, `jackson-dataformat-xml` |
| Maven annotation processing | MapStruct processor harus masuk `maven-compiler-plugin` annotation processor path |
| Runtime provider | Jangan register JSON-B dan Jackson tanpa prioritas/policy eksplisit |
| Jakarta EE 11 | XML Binding tidak lagi bagian dari platform; perlu dependency terpisah bila dipakai |

Saya lanjutkan ke pipeline serialization/deserialization di Jersey/JAX-RS. Saya akan fokus pada titik ekstensi yang benar-benar dipakai di production: provider selection, konfigurasi mapper, validasi, dan error mapping.

# Cheatsheet - Jersey/JAX-RS Serialization & Deserialization Pipeline

## 1. Introduction

Dalam aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, serialization/deserialization adalah pipeline yang mengubah:

```text
HTTP request body → Java object → validated DTO → domain command/model
domain result → response DTO → HTTP response body
```

Titik pusatnya adalah **Entity Provider**. Jakarta REST mendefinisikan dua provider utama: `MessageBodyReader` untuk membaca HTTP entity body menjadi Java type, dan `MessageBodyWriter` untuk menulis Java object menjadi HTTP response body. Provider dipilih berdasarkan media type, Java type, dan priority. Jika tidak ada reader yang cocok untuk request body, runtime server menghasilkan `NotSupportedException` / HTTP 415. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html))

Di Jersey, provider JSON/XML biasanya berasal dari modul seperti:

- `jersey-media-json-jackson`
- `jersey-media-json-binding`
- `jersey-media-json-processing`
- JAXB / Jakarta XML Binding provider
- custom `MessageBodyReader`
- custom `MessageBodyWriter`

Untuk Jackson, Jersey mendokumentasikan bahwa aplikasi perlu mendaftarkan `JacksonFeature`, dan bila butuh konfigurasi khusus, menyediakan `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>`. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest31x/media.html))

# 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Skill / Domain | Fungsi praktis | Yang perlu dikuasai | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Media negotiation | Menentukan format input/output | `@Consumes`, `@Produces`, `Content-Type`, `Accept` | Client kirim JSON tapi resource hanya consume XML |
| 2 | Resource method binding | Mengikat request body ke parameter Java | `public Response create(@Valid OrderRequest req)` | DTO tidak tervalidasi karena lupa `@Valid` |
| 3 | `MessageBodyReader` | Deserialize body ke Java object | `isReadable`, `readFrom`, media type matching | Provider tidak terpilih, hasil HTTP 415 |
| 4 | `MessageBodyWriter` | Serialize Java object ke body response | `isWriteable`, `writeTo`, response headers | Response gagal serialize lalu menjadi 500 |
| 5 | Provider priority | Mengontrol provider yang menang | `@Priority`, app provider vs built-in provider | Dua provider bisa membaca type yang sama |
| 6 | `ContextResolver<T>` | Menyediakan konfigurasi serializer | `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>`, `ContextResolver<Jsonb>`, `ContextResolver<JAXBContext>` | Config mapper tidak pernah dipakai runtime |
| 7 | Jackson provider | JSON POJO binding high-control | `JacksonFeature`, `ObjectMapper`, modules | ObjectMapper berbeda antara app dan test |
| 8 | JSON-B provider | Standard Jakarta JSON binding | `Jsonb`, `JsonbConfig`, adapters | Kurang cocok untuk custom behavior sangat kompleks |
| 9 | JSON-P provider | JSON tree/stream processing | `JsonObject`, `JsonArray`, parser/generator | Terlalu verbose untuk DTO biasa |
| 10 | JAXB / XML Binding | XML ⇄ Java object | `JAXBContext`, JAXB annotations | XML namespace/wrapper salah |
| 11 | Jackson XML | XML binding gaya Jackson | `XmlMapper`, XML annotations | XML dianggap sama seperti JSON |
| 12 | Bean Validation | Validasi object setelah deserialization | `@Valid`, `@NotNull`, group, custom constraint | Input invalid masuk ke service |
| 13 | ExceptionMapper | Mengubah exception ke API error | `ExceptionMapper<T>`, error DTO | Error framework bocor ke client |
| 14 | Parse error handling | Menangani invalid JSON/XML | mapping `JsonParseException`, `JsonMappingException`, JAXB exception | Semua parse error jadi 500 |
| 15 | Validation error handling | Menormalkan constraint violation | field path, message code, rejected value policy | Response error tidak stabil |
| 16 | DTO boundary | Memisahkan wire contract dari domain | request DTO, response DTO, command | Entity persistence terekspos ke API |
| 17 | Mapper layer | DTO ⇄ domain/entity | MapStruct, manual mapper, update mapper | Mapping diam-diam salah/null |
| 18 | Null policy | Mengontrol null input/output | required vs optional vs explicit null | PATCH ambigu: field absent vs null |
| 19 | Unknown field policy | Mengontrol backward/forward compatibility | strict vs tolerant deserialization | Client kirim typo field tapi diterima |
| 20 | Enum policy | Mengontrol enum invalid/unknown | strict enum, fallback enum, custom deserializer | Enum baru dari client merusak service lama |
| 21 | Temporal policy | Format tanggal/waktu | ISO-8601, timezone, `Instant`, `OffsetDateTime` | Local time tanpa timezone |
| 22 | Numeric policy | Menjaga presisi | `BigDecimal`, integer bounds, coercion policy | Money masuk sebagai `double` |
| 23 | Security hardening | Mencegah unsafe parsing/deserialization | disable unsafe polymorphism, XML XXE hardening, payload limit | RCE/deserialization gadget, XXE, memory blowup |
| 24 | Test contract | Menjaga wire format stabil | golden file, invalid payload test, provider integration test | Upgrade library mengubah JSON output |
| 25 | Observability | Debug error serialization aman | correlation ID, sanitized payload logging | PII/secret bocor ke log |

---

# 4. Provider Selection Mental Model

JAX-RS memilih provider bukan secara “magic”, tetapi kira-kira dengan urutan ini:

```text
Request masuk
  ↓
Ambil Content-Type
  ↓
Tentukan target Java type dari resource method
  ↓
Cari MessageBodyReader yang support media type
  ↓
Cek isReadable(...)
  ↓
Pilih provider dengan priority tertinggi
  ↓
readFrom(...)
```

Untuk response:

```text
Resource return value
  ↓
Ambil Accept / @Produces
  ↓
Tentukan Java type response entity
  ↓
Cari MessageBodyWriter yang support media type
  ↓
Cek isWriteable(...)
  ↓
Pilih provider dengan priority tertinggi
  ↓
writeTo(...)
```

Jakarta REST menyatakan bahwa application-supplied provider diprioritaskan dibanding pre-packaged provider jika keduanya dapat menangani request/response yang sama, dan provider juga dapat dibatasi dengan `@Consumes` atau `@Produces`. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html))

---

# 5. Minimal Jersey Resource Example

```java
@Path("/orders")
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class OrderResource {

    private final OrderService orderService;
    private final OrderMapper orderMapper;

    public OrderResource(OrderService orderService, OrderMapper orderMapper) {
        this.orderService = orderService;
        this.orderMapper = orderMapper;
    }

    @POST
    public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request) {
        CreateOrderCommand command = orderMapper.toCommand(request);

        OrderResult result = orderService.create(command);

        OrderResponse response = orderMapper.toResponse(result);

        return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
                .entity(response)
                .build();
    }
}
```

Pipeline-nya:

```text
JSON request
  ↓
Jackson / JSON-B MessageBodyReader
  ↓
CreateOrderRequest
  ↓
Bean Validation
  ↓
MapStruct/manual mapper
  ↓
CreateOrderCommand
  ↓
Service
  ↓
OrderResponse
  ↓
Jackson / JSON-B MessageBodyWriter
  ↓
JSON response
```

---

# 6. Jackson Configuration in Jersey

## Maven dependency

Untuk Jackson sebagai provider JSON di Jersey, modul yang umum dipakai adalah:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.glassfish.jersey.media</groupId>
    <artifactId>jersey-media-json-jackson</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

Jersey mendokumentasikan penggunaan `jersey-media-json-jackson`, `JacksonFeature`, dan optional `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>` untuk mengontrol perilaku Jackson. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest31x/media.html))

## ResourceConfig

```java
public class ApiApplication extends ResourceConfig {

    public ApiApplication() {
        packages("com.example.api");

        register(JacksonFeature.class);
        register(ObjectMapperProvider.class);
        register(ApiExceptionMapper.class);
        register(ValidationExceptionMapper.class);
    }
}
```

## `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>`

```java
@Provider
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class ObjectMapperProvider implements ContextResolver<ObjectMapper> {

    private final ObjectMapper mapper;

    public ObjectMapperProvider() {
        this.mapper = new ObjectMapper();

        mapper.registerModule(new JavaTimeModule());

        mapper.disable(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS);
        mapper.disable(DeserializationFeature.ADJUST_DATES_TO_CONTEXT_TIME_ZONE);

        mapper.enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES);
        mapper.enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_NUMBERS_FOR_ENUMS);

        mapper.setSerializationInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
    }

    @Override
    public ObjectMapper getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return mapper;
    }
}
```

Prinsip production:

| Setting | Rekomendasi awal | Alasan |
|---|---|---|
| Unknown fields | strict untuk internal APIs | Menangkap typo field lebih cepat |
| Date format | ISO-8601 | Konsisten lintas service |
| Enum | strict by default | Menghindari silent data corruption |
| Null output | policy eksplisit | Jangan biarkan default berubah saat upgrade |
| ObjectMapper lifecycle | singleton/reused | `ObjectMapper` mahal jika dibuat per request |
| Polymorphic typing | jangan global default typing | Risiko unsafe deserialization |

---

# 7. JSON-B Configuration in Jersey

Untuk stack yang ingin lebih “Jakarta-standard”, JSON-B bisa dipakai sebagai binding layer.

```java
@Provider
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class JsonbProvider implements ContextResolver<Jsonb> {

    private final Jsonb jsonb;

    public JsonbProvider() {
        JsonbConfig config = new JsonbConfig()
                .withNullValues(false)
                .withDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX", Locale.ROOT);

        this.jsonb = JsonbBuilder.create(config);
    }

    @Override
    public Jsonb getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return jsonb;
    }
}
```

Jersey mendokumentasikan bahwa custom preconfigured JSON-B dapat diregistrasikan melalui `ContextResolver<Jsonb>` dan `JsonbConfig`. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest31x/media.html))

Gunakan JSON-B ketika:

| Kondisi | JSON-B cocok? |
|---|---|
| Butuh Jakarta standard portability | Ya |
| DTO sederhana | Ya |
| Butuh custom module ecosystem luas | Biasanya Jackson lebih kuat |
| Butuh custom serializer/deserializer kompleks | Bisa, tapi Jackson sering lebih praktis |
| Ingin minimize vendor-specific behavior | Ya |

---

# 8. JAXB / Jakarta XML Binding Configuration

Untuk XML, `ContextResolver<JAXBContext>` berguna ketika ingin mengontrol JAXB context yang dipakai provider.

```java
@Provider
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_XML)
public class JaxbContextProvider implements ContextResolver<JAXBContext> {

    private final JAXBContext context;
    private final Set<Class<?>> supportedTypes;

    public JaxbContextProvider() {
        try {
            Class<?>[] types = {
                    CreateOrderRequest.class,
                    OrderResponse.class
            };

            this.context = JAXBContext.newInstance(types);
            this.supportedTypes = Set.of(types);
        } catch (JAXBException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to initialize JAXBContext", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public JAXBContext getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return supportedTypes.contains(type) ? context : null;
    }
}
```

JAX-RS `ContextResolver<T>` memang ditujukan untuk menyediakan context ke resource/provider; contoh eksplisit di spesifikasi adalah menyediakan custom `JAXBContext` ke default JAXB entity provider. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html))

---

# 9. Custom `MessageBodyReader`

Custom reader dipakai jika format input tidak cocok dengan JSON-B/Jackson/JAXB default.

Contoh use case:

- encrypted JSON body
- compressed custom payload
- line-delimited JSON
- vendor-specific media type
- legacy XML/JSON format
- input harus diparsing streaming karena besar

```java
@Provider
@Consumes("application/vnd.example.order+json")
public class OrderCommandReader implements MessageBodyReader<CreateOrderCommand> {

    private final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper()
            .registerModule(new JavaTimeModule());

    @Override
    public boolean isReadable(
            Class<?> type,
            Type genericType,
            Annotation[] annotations,
            MediaType mediaType
    ) {
        return CreateOrderCommand.class.isAssignableFrom(type);
    }

    @Override
    public CreateOrderCommand readFrom(
            Class<CreateOrderCommand> type,
            Type genericType,
            Annotation[] annotations,
            MediaType mediaType,
            MultivaluedMap<String, String> httpHeaders,
            InputStream entityStream
    ) throws IOException {
        return mapper.readValue(entityStream, CreateOrderCommand.class);
    }
}
```

Rule of thumb:

```text
DTO normal JSON/XML       → pakai provider bawaan
Custom media type         → custom reader/writer boleh
Payload besar             → streaming reader
Security-sensitive format → custom reader dengan limit/hardening
```

---

# 10. Custom `MessageBodyWriter`

Custom writer dipakai jika output tidak cukup hanya serialize DTO.

Contoh:

- CSV export
- NDJSON stream
- custom envelope
- binary response
- signed payload
- vendor-specific media type

```java
@Provider
@Produces("application/vnd.example.order+json")
public class OrderResponseWriter implements MessageBodyWriter<OrderResponse> {

    private final ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper()
            .registerModule(new JavaTimeModule());

    @Override
    public boolean isWriteable(
            Class<?> type,
            Type genericType,
            Annotation[] annotations,
            MediaType mediaType
    ) {
        return OrderResponse.class.isAssignableFrom(type);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeTo(
            OrderResponse response,
            Class<?> type,
            Type genericType,
            Annotation[] annotations,
            MediaType mediaType,
            MultivaluedMap<String, Object> httpHeaders,
            OutputStream entityStream
    ) throws IOException {
        mapper.writeValue(entityStream, response);
    }
}
```

Jangan membuat writer hanya untuk membungkus semua response dengan envelope. Untuk itu biasanya lebih baik gunakan response DTO eksplisit atau `ContainerResponseFilter`, tergantung kebutuhan.

---

# 11. Exception Mapping Strategy

## Error contract yang disarankan

```java
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldError> errors
) {}

public record FieldError(
        String field,
        String code,
        String message
) {}
```

## Validation exception mapper

```java
@Provider
public class ConstraintViolationMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<ConstraintViolationException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(ConstraintViolationException exception) {
        List<FieldError> fieldErrors = exception.getConstraintViolations()
                .stream()
                .map(v -> new FieldError(
                        v.getPropertyPath().toString(),
                        v.getConstraintDescriptor()
                                .getAnnotation()
                                .annotationType()
                                .getSimpleName(),
                        v.getMessage()
                ))
                .toList();

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                "Request validation failed",
                null,
                fieldErrors
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }
}
```

Jakarta Bean Validation menyediakan fasilitas validasi untuk object, members, methods, dan constructors; di Jakarta EE, validasi juga terintegrasi dengan container dan service terkait. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/learn/docs/jakartaee-tutorial/current/beanvalidation/bean-validation/bean-validation.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## JSON parse/mapping error mapper

Jackson parse/mapping error sering perlu dinormalisasi menjadi HTTP 400.

```java
@Provider
public class JsonProcessingExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<JsonProcessingException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(JsonProcessingException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "INVALID_JSON",
                "Malformed or incompatible JSON payload",
                null,
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }
}
```

Catatan penting: jangan return raw exception message penuh ke client untuk sistem production, karena bisa membocorkan nama class, field internal, atau struktur domain.

---

# 12. Bean Validation Placement

Contoh DTO:

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID customerId,

        @NotEmpty
        List<@Valid CreateOrderItemRequest> items,

        @Size(max = 500)
        String note
) {}
```

Nested DTO:

```java
public record CreateOrderItemRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID productId,

        @Min(1)
        int quantity
) {}
```

Resource:

```java
@POST
public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request) {
    CreateOrderCommand command = mapper.toCommand(request);
    OrderResult result = service.create(command);

    return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
            .entity(mapper.toResponse(result))
            .build();
}
```

Jersey menyediakan modul `jersey-bean-validation` untuk dukungan Bean Validation di Jersey, termasuk dependency, konfigurasi, registration, dan usage. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 13. DTO vs Domain vs Entity

Jangan pakai satu class untuk semua layer.

```text
CreateOrderRequest       → API input shape
CreateOrderCommand       → application/service command
Order                    → domain model
OrderEntity              → persistence model
OrderResponse            → API output shape
```

Mapping flow:

```text
CreateOrderRequest
  ↓
CreateOrderCommand
  ↓
OrderService
  ↓
Order / OrderEntity
  ↓
OrderResult
  ↓
OrderResponse
```

Kenapa dipisah:

| Model | Stabil terhadap | Berubah karena |
|---|---|---|
| Request DTO | API contract | client requirement |
| Command | application use case | service behavior |
| Domain | business invariant | domain rule |
| Entity | database schema | persistence optimization |
| Response DTO | API contract | frontend/integration need |

---

# 14. MapStruct Position in Pipeline

MapStruct sebaiknya berada **setelah deserialization + validation**, bukan menggantikan keduanya.

```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "jakarta")
public interface OrderMapper {

    CreateOrderCommand toCommand(CreateOrderRequest request);

    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

Untuk update/patch:

```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "jakarta")
public interface OrderPatchMapper {

    @BeanMapping(nullValuePropertyMappingStrategy = NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE)
    void updateCommandFromPatch(
            PatchOrderRequest request,
            @MappingTarget UpdateOrderCommand command
    );
}
```

Mental model:

```text
Deserializer:
  "JSON shape valid?" → Java DTO

Validator:
  "DTO constraint valid?" → valid request

Mapper:
  "DTO fields become command/domain fields" → application input

Service:
  "Business invariant valid?" → domain result
```

---

# 15. Error Taxonomy

| Failure | Example | Recommended HTTP | Error code |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Unsupported media type | `Content-Type: text/plain` | 415 | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` |
| Not acceptable | `Accept: application/pdf` | 406 | `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` |
| Malformed JSON | `{ "id": }` | 400 | `INVALID_JSON` |
| Malformed XML | broken XML document | 400 | `INVALID_XML` |
| Mapping failure | invalid enum, invalid date | 400 | `INVALID_PAYLOAD` |
| Constraint violation | `customerId=null` | 400 or 422 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Domain rule violation | order cannot be cancelled | 409 or 422 | `DOMAIN_RULE_VIOLATION` |
| Missing resource | order not found | 404 | `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| Unexpected serialization failure | response DTO cannot serialize | 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` |

Untuk exception mapping, Jakarta REST menyatakan bahwa runtime menggunakan exception mapping provider dengan generic type yang merupakan nearest superclass dari exception untuk membuat `Response`. Jika mapper sendiri gagal, runtime mengembalikan server error. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/3.1/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-3.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 16. Production Checklist

## Provider registration

```text
[ ] Hanya satu default JSON provider aktif: Jackson atau JSON-B.
[ ] Jika pakai Jackson, register JacksonFeature.
[ ] Jika pakai custom ObjectMapper, register ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>.
[ ] Jika pakai JSON-B custom config, register ContextResolver<Jsonb>.
[ ] Jika pakai JAXB custom config, register ContextResolver<JAXBContext>.
[ ] Jangan mengandalkan auto-discovery tanpa audit dependency.
```

## Serialization policy

```text
[ ] Date/time format eksplisit.
[ ] Enum policy eksplisit.
[ ] Null output policy eksplisit.
[ ] BigDecimal tidak dikonversi ke double.
[ ] Unknown field policy diputuskan: strict atau tolerant.
[ ] Sensitive fields tidak bisa terserialize.
```

## Validation policy

```text
[ ] Request DTO diberi @Valid.
[ ] Nested collection diberi element validation.
[ ] Create/update/patch punya DTO atau validation group terpisah.
[ ] Cross-field invariant memakai class-level constraint atau domain validation.
[ ] Validation error response stabil.
```

## Security policy

```text
[ ] Limit request body size.
[ ] Jangan aktifkan unsafe polymorphic deserialization global.
[ ] XML parser hardened terhadap external entity.
[ ] Payload logging disanitasi.
[ ] Error response tidak membocorkan class/package/internal stack trace.
```

## Testing policy

```text
[ ] Serialization golden file test.
[ ] Deserialization invalid payload test.
[ ] Unknown field test.
[ ] Enum invalid test.
[ ] Date/time timezone test.
[ ] Validation error contract test.
[ ] XML namespace/wrapper test jika XML didukung.
[ ] Provider integration test via JerseyTest atau integration test.
```

---

# 17. Anti-Pattern yang Sering Terjadi

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| Resource menerima entity JPA langsung | Field DB bocor, lazy loading error | Request/response DTO |
| ObjectMapper dibuat per request | Overhead besar | Singleton via provider |
| Jackson dan JSON-B sama-sama aktif tanpa policy | Provider selection tidak jelas | Pilih satu default |
| `Map<String,Object>` untuk semua request | Hilang type safety | DTO eksplisit |
| Semua error mapping jadi 500 | Client sulit recovery | ExceptionMapper per kategori |
| Raw validation message jadi API contract | Sulit i18n/versioning | Error code + field path |
| PATCH pakai DTO create | Null/absent ambigu | Patch DTO atau JSON Merge Patch |
| XML diterima tanpa hardening | XXE / payload attack risk | Secure parser + limit |
| DTO sama untuk create/update/response | Constraint konflik | DTO per use case |
| Mengandalkan default serializer | Output berubah saat upgrade | Centralized config |

---

# 18. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Kuasai @Consumes / @Produces / Content-Type / Accept
   ↓
2. Pahami MessageBodyReader dan MessageBodyWriter
   ↓
3. Konfigurasi JacksonFeature + ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>
   ↓
4. Bandingkan JSON-B dan Jackson untuk DTO API
   ↓
5. Tambahkan Bean Validation di request DTO
   ↓
6. Normalisasi ExceptionMapper untuk parse + validation error
   ↓
7. Tambahkan MapStruct untuk DTO ↔ command/response mapping
   ↓
8. Buat test contract untuk serialization/deserialization
   ↓
9. Harden security: unknown field, enum, polymorphism, XML parser
   ↓
10. Standardisasi error response lintas service
```

## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:26:38 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke desain kontrak DTO dan evolusi API. Bagian ini akan lebih banyak membahas keputusan arsitektural: kapan membuat DTO terpisah, bagaimana validasi create/update/patch, dan bagaimana error contract tetap stabil.

# Cheatsheet - DTO, Request/Response Contract Design, Validation Group, Error Response Model & API Evolution di Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Dalam aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, DTO adalah **kontrak eksternal API**, bukan sekadar class Java untuk menampung JSON/XML. DTO harus menjawab:

```text
Apa bentuk request yang diterima?
Apa bentuk response yang dijanjikan?
Field mana yang wajib?
Field mana yang boleh null?
Apa format tanggal, angka, enum, ID?
Bagaimana error dikembalikan?
Bagaimana kontrak berubah tanpa merusak client lama?
```

Di JAX-RS, request/response body dipetakan oleh **entity providers** seperti `MessageBodyReader` dan `MessageBodyWriter`; exception dapat dinormalisasi lewat `ExceptionMapper`; dan validasi Bean Validation/Jakarta Validation dapat dijalankan pada parameter resource, return value, atau secara eksplisit melalui `Validator`. Jakarta REST 4.0 juga mendefinisikan default mapping untuk `ConstraintViolationException`: violation pada input umumnya menjadi HTTP 400, sedangkan violation pada return value diperlakukan sebagai server error. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Jakarta Validation mendukung **validation groups**, yaitu mekanisme untuk memilih subset constraint yang dijalankan pada konteks tertentu, misalnya create, update, patch, atau admin operation. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/bean-validation/3.1/jakarta-validation-spec-3.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Diagram Mental Model

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         API Contract Layer                         │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

HTTP Request
   │
   ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Request DTO           │
│ - JSON/XML shape      │
│ - field names         │
│ - nullability         │
│ - basic constraints   │
└──────────────────────┘
   │
   ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Validation Layer      │
│ - Default group       │
│ - Create group        │
│ - Update group        │
│ - Patch group         │
│ - Cross-field rules   │
└──────────────────────┘
   │
   ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Mapper Layer          │
│ - MapStruct           │
│ - manual mapper       │
│ - enum/value mapping  │
│ - patch merge policy  │
└──────────────────────┘
   │
   ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Application Command   │
│ / Query / Domain      │
└──────────────────────┘
   │
   ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Service / Domain      │
│ - invariant           │
│ - state transition    │
│ - persistence         │
└──────────────────────┘
   │
   ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Response DTO          │
│ - stable output       │
│ - no internal fields  │
│ - explicit format     │
└──────────────────────┘
   │
   ▼
HTTP Response

Failure path:
Deserializer error
   │
   ├─ invalid JSON/XML       → 400 INVALID_PAYLOAD
   ├─ unsupported media type → 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE
   ├─ validation failed      → 400/422 VALIDATION_FAILED
   ├─ domain conflict        → 409 DOMAIN_CONFLICT
   └─ unexpected error       → 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
```

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang harus dikuasai | Pitfall umum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | DTO boundary design | Memisahkan wire contract dari domain/entity | Request DTO, response DTO, command DTO | Entity database langsung diekspos sebagai response |
| 2 | Request DTO | Mendefinisikan input client | Required field, optional field, enum, format date/time | Satu DTO dipakai untuk create/update/patch |
| 3 | Response DTO | Mendefinisikan output stabil | Public fields, computed field, link/reference, status | Response berubah karena domain/entity berubah |
| 4 | Command DTO | Input untuk application service | Use-case oriented command | Request DTO langsung masuk ke service/domain |
| 5 | Query DTO | Input pencarian/filter/pagination | `page`, `size`, `sort`, filter object | Query parameter tersebar tanpa model |
| 6 | Patch DTO | Partial update | absent vs null vs explicit clear | Null ambigu |
| 7 | Validation group | Constraint berbeda per use case | `Default`, `Create`, `Update`, `Patch` | Semua constraint ditaruh di satu group |
| 8 | Cross-field validation | Validasi antar field | Class-level constraint | Business rule kompleks dipaksa masuk validator |
| 9 | Nested validation | Validasi object graph | `@Valid`, container element constraint | List item tidak divalidasi |
| 10 | Error response model | Kontrak error API | `code`, `message`, `fieldErrors`, `correlationId` | Mengembalikan raw exception message |
| 11 | Exception mapping | Normalisasi exception ke HTTP response | `ExceptionMapper<T>` | Semua exception jadi 500 |
| 12 | Backward compatibility | Evolusi API aman | additive change, deprecation, versioning | Rename/remove field tanpa transisi |
| 13 | Mapper strategy | DTO ⇄ command/domain/response | MapStruct/manual mapper | Mapping implisit, field tertinggal |
| 14 | Enum contract | Stabilitas enum di API | strict enum, unknown enum policy | Enum domain diekspos langsung |
| 15 | Temporal contract | Format waktu konsisten | `Instant`, `OffsetDateTime`, ISO-8601 | `LocalDateTime` tanpa timezone untuk event absolut |
| 16 | Numeric contract | Presisi angka | `BigDecimal` untuk money/amount | `double` untuk monetary value |
| 17 | Nullability policy | Arti `null` jelas | absent, null, default value | Null dipakai untuk terlalu banyak makna |
| 18 | Error taxonomy | Klasifikasi failure | parse, validation, domain, infra | Client tidak bisa membedakan error |
| 19 | Contract testing | Menjaga wire format | golden file, JSON schema, integration test | Test hanya service, bukan payload |
| 20 | API versioning | Mengelola breaking changes | URI/header/media-type versioning | Versioning baru dibuat setelah client rusak |

---

## 4. DTO Taxonomy untuk Jersey/JAX-RS

Pisahkan DTO berdasarkan **arah data** dan **use case**.

```text
CreateOrderRequest
UpdateOrderRequest
PatchOrderRequest
SearchOrderQuery
OrderResponse
OrderDetailResponse
OrderSummaryResponse
CreateOrderCommand
UpdateOrderCommand
OrderResult
```

| DTO type | Dipakai di | Contoh | Karakter |
|---|---|---|---|
| Request DTO | Resource input body | `CreateOrderRequest` | Bentuk mengikuti API contract |
| Response DTO | Resource output body | `OrderResponse` | Stabil untuk client |
| Command | Service input | `CreateOrderCommand` | Bentuk mengikuti use case |
| Query | Search/filter input | `SearchOrderQuery` | Bisa berasal dari query param |
| Result | Service output | `OrderResult` | Tidak harus sama dengan response |
| Patch DTO | Partial update | `PatchOrderRequest` | Harus membedakan absent/null |
| Error DTO | Failure response | `ApiErrorResponse` | Harus konsisten lintas endpoint |

Prinsip utama:

```text
Request DTO != Domain Model != Persistence Entity != Response DTO
```

---

## 5. Request DTO Design

Contoh create request:

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID customerId,

        @NotEmpty
        List<@Valid CreateOrderItemRequest> items,

        @Size(max = 500)
        String note

) {}
```

Nested DTO:

```java
public record CreateOrderItemRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID productId,

        @Min(1)
        int quantity

) {}
```

Resource:

```java
@Path("/orders")
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class OrderResource {

    private final OrderService service;
    private final OrderMapper mapper;

    public OrderResource(OrderService service, OrderMapper mapper) {
        this.service = service;
        this.mapper = mapper;
    }

    @POST
    public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request) {
        CreateOrderCommand command = mapper.toCommand(request);
        OrderResult result = service.create(command);

        return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
                .entity(mapper.toResponse(result))
                .build();
    }
}
```

Hibernate Validator membagi constraint menjadi beberapa bentuk utama: field constraint, property constraint, container element constraint, dan class constraint. Untuk DTO modern, container element constraint penting karena field seperti `List<@Valid ItemRequest>` atau `List<@NotNull UUID>` sering muncul di request body. ([Hibernate Documentation](https://docs.hibernate.org/stable/validator/reference/en-US/html_single/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 6. Response DTO Design

Response DTO jangan sekadar mirror domain/entity.

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        List<OrderItemResponse> items
) {}
```

Contoh response summary:

```java
public record OrderSummaryResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        Instant submittedAt
) {}
```

Bedakan response:

| Use case | DTO |
|---|---|
| List page | `OrderSummaryResponse` |
| Detail page | `OrderDetailResponse` |
| Create result | `CreateOrderResponse` atau `OrderResponse` |
| Async accepted | `AcceptedJobResponse` |
| Error | `ApiErrorResponse` |

Anti-pattern:

```java
// Buruk: entity persistence langsung jadi response
return Response.ok(orderEntity).build();
```

Risiko:

```text
- field internal bocor
- lazy loading error
- circular reference
- database schema memengaruhi API
- field sensitif ikut terserialisasi
- API contract sulit distabilkan
```

---

## 7. Validation Group

Gunakan validation group ketika **class DTO sama memang perlu dipakai untuk beberapa operasi**, tetapi constraint-nya berbeda.

```java
public interface Create {}
public interface Update {}
public interface Patch {}
```

Contoh:

```java
public record OrderMutationRequest(

        @NotNull(groups = Update.class)
        UUID id,

        @NotNull(groups = Create.class)
        UUID customerId,

        @NotEmpty(groups = Create.class)
        List<@Valid OrderItemRequest> items,

        @Size(max = 500, groups = {Create.class, Update.class, Patch.class})
        String note

) {}
```

Namun untuk maintainability, sering kali lebih baik membuat DTO berbeda:

```text
CreateOrderRequest
UpdateOrderRequest
PatchOrderRequest
```

daripada memaksa satu class dengan banyak group.

### Kapan pakai validation group?

| Situasi | Gunakan group? | Alternatif |
|---|---:|---|
| Create dan update beda sedikit | Bisa | DTO terpisah |
| Create dan patch sangat berbeda | Jangan | DTO patch khusus |
| Admin dan user punya constraint beda | Bisa | Endpoint/DTO terpisah |
| Banyak field punya group berbeda-beda | Hati-hati | Pisahkan DTO |
| Rule butuh database lookup | Jangan di Bean Validation sederhana | Service/domain validation |

### Manual validation group di resource/service

Di plain JAX-RS, `@Valid` biasanya menjalankan constraint default. Untuk group eksplisit per endpoint, pendekatan yang mudah diaudit adalah memanggil `Validator` secara eksplisit.

```java
public class OrderResource {

    private final Validator validator;
    private final OrderService service;
    private final OrderMapper mapper;

    public OrderResource(
            Validator validator,
            OrderService service,
            OrderMapper mapper
    ) {
        this.validator = validator;
        this.service = service;
        this.mapper = mapper;
    }

    @POST
    public Response create(OrderMutationRequest request) {
        validate(request, Create.class);

        CreateOrderCommand command = mapper.toCreateCommand(request);
        OrderResult result = service.create(command);

        return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
                .entity(mapper.toResponse(result))
                .build();
    }

    private <T> void validate(T object, Class<?> group) {
        Set<ConstraintViolation<T>> violations =
                validator.validate(object, group);

        if (!violations.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ConstraintViolationException(violations);
        }
    }
}
```

Jakarta Validation mendefinisikan groups sebagai parameter yang dapat diberikan ke operasi validasi agar hanya constraint tertentu yang dijalankan. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/bean-validation/3.1/jakarta-validation-spec-3.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 8. Create vs Update vs Patch

### Create

Create biasanya butuh field minimum lengkap.

```java
public record CreateCustomerRequest(

        @NotBlank
        String name,

        @Email
        @NotBlank
        String email,

        @Pattern(regexp = "ACTIVE|PENDING")
        String initialStatus

) {}
```

Karakter create:

```text
- ID biasanya belum ada atau di-generate server
- required field lebih banyak
- default value boleh diberikan server
- idempotency key bisa penting
```

---

### Update / Replace

Update penuh biasanya berarti client mengirim state baru yang lengkap.

```java
public record UpdateCustomerRequest(

        @NotBlank
        String name,

        @Email
        @NotBlank
        String email,

        @NotNull
        CustomerStatusDto status

) {}
```

Karakter update:

```text
- biasanya PUT
- field wajib lengkap
- missing field dianggap error
- cocok untuk replace semantics
```

---

### Patch

Patch berarti partial mutation.

```java
public record PatchCustomerRequest(
        Optional<String> name,
        Optional<String> email,
        Optional<CustomerStatusDto> status
) {}
```

Masalah utama patch:

```text
field absent  → jangan ubah
field null    → clear value? atau invalid?
field value   → update value
```

Tentukan policy secara eksplisit.

| Input | Arti yang disarankan |
|---|---|
| Field tidak dikirim | Tidak mengubah field |
| Field dikirim `null` | Clear field, jika field nullable |
| Field dikirim value | Update value |
| Field dikirim `null` untuk non-nullable field | Validation error |

Kalau memakai MapStruct untuk update object existing, `@MappingTarget` dipakai untuk mengubah target yang sudah ada. `NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy` berlaku pada update method dengan `@MappingTarget` dan dapat dikonfigurasi di level `@MapperConfig`, `@Mapper`, `@BeanMapping`, atau `@Mapping`. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/1.4/api/org/mapstruct/NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Contoh:

```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "jakarta")
public interface CustomerPatchMapper {

    @BeanMapping(
        nullValuePropertyMappingStrategy =
                NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE
    )
    void applyPatch(
            PatchCustomerRequest request,
            @MappingTarget Customer customer
    );
}
```

Catatan penting: `NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE` cocok untuk “null berarti jangan ubah”, tetapi tidak cocok jika API Anda ingin mendukung “null berarti clear value”.

---

## 9. Error Response Model

Buat satu model error yang konsisten lintas endpoint.

```java
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors
) {}

public record FieldErrorResponse(
        String field,
        String code,
        String message
) {}
```

Contoh validation error:

```json
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "message": "Request validation failed",
  "correlationId": "req-7df6b2",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field": "customerId",
      "code": "NotNull",
      "message": "must not be null"
    },
    {
      "field": "items[0].quantity",
      "code": "Min",
      "message": "must be greater than or equal to 1"
    }
  ]
}
```

Contoh domain error:

```json
{
  "code": "ORDER_ALREADY_CANCELLED",
  "message": "Order is already cancelled",
  "correlationId": "req-7df6b2",
  "errors": []
}
```

Jakarta REST mendefinisikan `ExceptionMapper<T>` sebagai provider untuk mengubah checked/runtime exception menjadi `Response`; jika beberapa mapper cocok, mapper dengan generic type terdekat terhadap exception dipakai. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 10. Error Taxonomy

| Category | Example | HTTP | Code |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Malformed payload | JSON syntax rusak | 400 | `INVALID_JSON` |
| XML parse error | XML tidak well-formed | 400 | `INVALID_XML` |
| Unsupported media type | `Content-Type: text/plain` | 415 | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` |
| Not acceptable | Client minta format tidak didukung | 406 | `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` |
| Validation failed | `@NotNull`, `@Size`, `@Pattern` gagal | 400 / 422 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Domain invariant failed | State transition tidak valid | 409 / 422 | `DOMAIN_RULE_VIOLATION` |
| Resource not found | Order tidak ditemukan | 404 | `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| Duplicate resource | Unique constraint/business duplicate | 409 | `DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` |
| Authorization failed | Tidak punya permission | 403 | `FORBIDDEN` |
| Authentication failed | Token invalid/expired | 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| Serialization failure | Response gagal ditulis | 500 | `SERIALIZATION_FAILED` |
| Unexpected failure | Null pointer, infra error | 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` |

Rekomendasi praktis:

```text
400 → request structurally invalid
401 → belum/ gagal authenticated
403 → authenticated tapi tidak authorized
404 → resource tidak ada / tidak terlihat
409 → konflik state/resource
422 → request syntactically valid, semantic/business invalid
500 → bug/server failure
```

---

## 11. ExceptionMapper Pattern

### Constraint violation mapper

```java
@Provider
public class ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<ConstraintViolationException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(ConstraintViolationException exception) {
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors = exception.getConstraintViolations()
                .stream()
                .map(v -> new FieldErrorResponse(
                        v.getPropertyPath().toString(),
                        v.getConstraintDescriptor()
                                .getAnnotation()
                                .annotationType()
                                .getSimpleName(),
                        v.getMessage()
                ))
                .toList();

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                "Request validation failed",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                errors
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

### Domain exception mapper

```java
@Provider
public class DomainExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<DomainException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(DomainException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                exception.code(),
                exception.publicMessage(),
                MDC.get("correlationId"),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(toStatus(exception))
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private Response.Status toStatus(DomainException exception) {
        return switch (exception.category()) {
            case NOT_FOUND -> Response.Status.NOT_FOUND;
            case CONFLICT -> Response.Status.CONFLICT;
            case INVALID_STATE -> Response.Status.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY;
            case FORBIDDEN -> Response.Status.FORBIDDEN;
        };
    }
}
```

### Raw exception mapper

```java
@Provider
public class UnhandledExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<Throwable> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(Throwable exception) {
        String correlationId = MDC.get("correlationId");

        // log full exception internally
        log.error("Unhandled API error. correlationId={}", correlationId, exception);

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "INTERNAL_ERROR",
                "Unexpected server error",
                correlationId,
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }
}
```

Jangan kirim stack trace, package name, SQL detail, atau raw parser exception ke client production.

---

## 12. Mapper Layer dengan MapStruct

MapStruct berguna untuk mapping DTO secara eksplisit dan compile-time. Dokumentasi MapStruct menyebutnya sebagai annotation processor untuk menghasilkan mapper type-safe, performant, dan dependency-free. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java
@Mapper(componentModel = "jakarta")
public interface OrderMapper {

    @Mapping(target = "requestedBy", source = "actorUserId")
    CreateOrderCommand toCommand(
            CreateOrderRequest request,
            UUID actorUserId
    );

    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);

    List<OrderItemResponse> toItemResponses(List<OrderItemResult> items);
}
```

Pattern yang baik:

```text
Resource
  ↓
validasi DTO
  ↓
MapStruct mapper
  ↓
Command
  ↓
Service
  ↓
Result
  ↓
MapStruct mapper
  ↓
Response DTO
```

Jangan taruh side effect di mapper:

```text
Buruk:
- query database di mapper
- call external service di mapper
- generate audit event di mapper
- validasi business rule di mapper

Baik:
- field rename
- enum conversion
- nested object mapping
- value object construction ringan
- format response
```

---

## 13. API Evolution Rules

Backward-compatible changes:

| Change | Aman? | Catatan |
|---|---:|---|
| Menambah optional response field | Biasanya aman | Client harus ignore unknown field |
| Menambah optional request field | Aman | Server punya default behavior |
| Menambah enum value di response | Hati-hati | Client lama bisa gagal |
| Menambah endpoint baru | Aman | Tidak mengubah kontrak lama |
| Menambah error code baru | Hati-hati | Client harus punya fallback |
| Menambah validation lebih ketat | Bisa breaking | Client lama mungkin mulai gagal |
| Mengubah field dari nullable ke non-null | Bisa breaking | Terutama response |
| Mengubah format tanggal | Breaking | Harus versi baru |
| Rename field | Breaking | Perlu alias/deprecation |
| Remove field | Breaking | Perlu versi baru |
| Mengubah tipe number/string | Breaking | Perlu versi baru |
| Mengubah semantic status code | Breaking | Client flow bisa rusak |

Prinsip evolusi:

```text
Add, don’t mutate.
Deprecate before remove.
Keep old meaning stable.
Version only when compatibility cannot be preserved.
Document error codes as part of contract.
```

---

## 14. Versioning Strategy

| Strategy | Contoh | Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|---|---|
| URI version | `/api/v1/orders` | Jelas, mudah routing | Banyak duplicate endpoint |
| Header version | `X-API-Version: 2` | URI bersih | Client/proxy/debug lebih kompleks |
| Media type version | `application/vnd.company.order.v2+json` | REST-purist, cocok vendor media type | Lebih kompleks untuk tim |
| Field-level evolution | optional/deprecated fields | Minim endpoint baru | Perlu governance kuat |
| Consumer-specific contract | contract per client | Cocok enterprise integration | Biaya maintenance tinggi |

Rekomendasi praktis untuk microservice internal/enterprise:

```text
Default:
- pakai URI version untuk breaking contract besar
- pakai additive field untuk perubahan kecil
- dokumentasikan deprecation window
- jangan versioning hanya karena tambah optional field
```

---

## 15. Contract Testing

Minimal test yang harus ada:

```text
[ ] valid create request dapat deserialize
[ ] invalid JSON menjadi INVALID_JSON
[ ] missing required field menjadi VALIDATION_FAILED
[ ] invalid enum menjadi INVALID_PAYLOAD
[ ] invalid date/time menjadi INVALID_PAYLOAD
[ ] nested item invalid menghasilkan field path jelas
[ ] response JSON sesuai golden file
[ ] deprecated field masih diterima selama transition window
[ ] unknown field behavior sesuai policy
[ ] error response selalu punya code/message/correlationId/errors
```

Contoh golden file mindset:

```text
src/test/resources/contracts/order-response.created.json
src/test/resources/contracts/order-response.cancelled.json
src/test/resources/contracts/error.validation-failed.json
src/test/resources/contracts/error.domain-conflict.json
```

Test bukan hanya “service berhasil”, tetapi juga:

```text
wire input  → DTO
DTO         → validation
exception   → error response
domain      → response DTO
response DTO → JSON output
```

---

## 16. Production Checklist

### DTO

```text
[ ] DTO tidak sama dengan entity persistence.
[ ] DTO tidak mengekspos field internal.
[ ] DTO create/update/patch dipisahkan bila semantiknya berbeda.
[ ] Enum DTO dipisahkan dari enum domain bila domain sering berubah.
[ ] Temporal field memakai format eksplisit.
[ ] Monetary/amount field memakai BigDecimal.
```

### Validation

```text
[ ] Semua request body penting divalidasi.
[ ] Nested DTO memakai @Valid.
[ ] Collection element divalidasi.
[ ] Validation group tidak berlebihan.
[ ] Cross-field validation dipisahkan dari domain invariant berat.
[ ] Error validation distandarkan.
```

### Error contract

```text
[ ] Semua error punya code stabil.
[ ] Semua error punya correlationId.
[ ] Field error punya path, code, message.
[ ] Raw exception tidak dikirim ke client.
[ ] Domain error dibedakan dari validation error.
[ ] HTTP status konsisten lintas endpoint.
```

### Evolution

```text
[ ] Breaking change tidak dilakukan diam-diam.
[ ] Field lama diberi deprecation window.
[ ] Client lama masih bisa jalan selama transisi.
[ ] Enum baru tidak merusak client lama.
[ ] Contract test dijalankan di CI.
```

---

## 17. Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Kenapa buruk | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| Satu DTO untuk create/update/patch/response | Constraint dan semantic bercampur | DTO per use case |
| Entity sebagai response | Bocor internal dan lazy loading risk | Response DTO |
| Raw exception message ke client | Security leak | Error code + public message |
| Validation semua di service | Error terlambat dan tidak konsisten | Boundary validation + domain validation |
| Business rule berat di Bean Validation | Validator jadi sulit dites dan lambat | Domain service/invariant |
| PATCH pakai `null` tanpa policy | Ambigu | Definisikan absent/null/value |
| Enum domain langsung diekspos | Perubahan domain merusak API | Enum DTO/contract enum |
| Contract hanya didokumentasikan manual | Drift dengan implementasi | Contract/golden tests |
| Mengubah response field tanpa versioning | Client rusak diam-diam | Additive/deprecated/versioned change |

---

## 18. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Pisahkan Request DTO, Response DTO, Command, Domain, Entity
   ↓
2. Rancang create/update/patch semantics
   ↓
3. Tambahkan Jakarta Validation untuk field, nested object, dan collection
   ↓
4. Pelajari validation group, tapi gunakan secukupnya
   ↓
5. Buat error response model standar
   ↓
6. Implementasikan ExceptionMapper untuk validation/domain/unhandled error
   ↓
7. Tambahkan MapStruct untuk DTO ↔ command/result mapping
   ↓
8. Buat contract test untuk success dan error payload
   ↓
9. Definisikan backward compatibility rules
   ↓
10. Baru tentukan API versioning strategy
```
