## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:28:21 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke MapStruct deep dive. Fokusnya bukan syntax dasar saja, tetapi bagaimana mapping dipakai aman di boundary Jersey/JAX-RS: DTO, command, domain, entity, patch, enum, dan failure mode saat build/runtime.

# Cheatsheet - MapStruct Deep Dive untuk Jersey/JAX-RS Applications

## 1. Introduction

**MapStruct** adalah library mapping Java yang bekerja sebagai **annotation processor**. Mapper implementation dibuat saat compile-time, memakai plain Java method invocation, bukan reflection runtime. Ini membuat MapStruct cocok untuk boundary mapping di aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, terutama untuk mapping:

```text
Request DTO  → Command
Domain Model → Response DTO
Entity       → DTO
Patch DTO    → Existing Domain/Entity
Enum DTO     ↔ Domain Enum
Value Object ↔ Primitive/String/API field
```

MapStruct menghasilkan error/warning saat build jika mapping tidak lengkap atau tidak valid, sehingga banyak bug mapping bisa tertangkap sebelum runtime. Dokumentasi resmi MapStruct menyebut mapper yang dihasilkan bersifat stateless dan thread-safe. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

---

## 2. Diagram Posisi MapStruct di Jersey/JAX-RS

```text
HTTP JSON/XML Request
   │
   ▼
Jersey MessageBodyReader
Jackson / JSON-B / JAXB
   │
   ▼
Request DTO
   │
   ▼
Jakarta Bean Validation
@Valid, @NotNull, @Size, custom constraint
   │
   ▼
MapStruct Mapper
DTO → Command / Query / Domain Input
   │
   ▼
Application Service
Domain Logic / Workflow / Persistence
   │
   ▼
Domain Result / Entity
   │
   ▼
MapStruct Mapper
Domain Result / Entity → Response DTO
   │
   ▼
Jersey MessageBodyWriter
Jackson / JSON-B / JAXB
   │
   ▼
HTTP JSON/XML Response
```

MapStruct **bukan pengganti validation**, **bukan pengganti serializer**, dan **bukan tempat business rule berat**. Ia paling cocok untuk transformasi struktur data antar-layer.

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang perlu dikuasai | Pitfall umum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mapper boundary | Menentukan layer mana yang boleh dimapping | DTO, command, domain, entity, response | Mapper langsung query DB / external service |
| 2 | Basic bean mapping | Mapping field nama sama | `@Mapper`, method mapping | Terlalu percaya implicit mapping |
| 3 | Explicit field mapping | Mapping beda nama | `@Mapping(source, target)` | Field baru tidak dimapping tapi tidak ketahuan |
| 4 | Central config | Standarisasi semua mapper | `@MapperConfig` | Tiap mapper punya policy sendiri |
| 5 | Component model | Integrasi DI | `default`, `jakarta`, `jakarta-cdi`, `cdi` | Salah pilih component model untuk Jersey/HK2/CDI |
| 6 | Constructor injection | Mapper dependency injection | `InjectionStrategy.CONSTRUCTOR` | Field injection sulit dites |
| 7 | Nested mapping | Mapping object graph | `uses`, nested mapper method | Circular graph / lazy loading |
| 8 | Collection mapping | Mapping list/set/map | `List<A> → List<B>` | Null collection policy tidak jelas |
| 9 | Enum mapping | Mapping enum API ↔ domain | `@ValueMapping`, fallback enum | Enum domain diekspos langsung |
| 10 | Value object mapping | Mapping ID/money/status/code | default method, custom mapper | Business invariant masuk mapper |
| 11 | Update mapping | Update target existing | `@MappingTarget` | Null menimpa data existing tanpa sengaja |
| 12 | Patch mapping | Partial update | `NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE` | Tidak bisa bedakan absent/null/clear |
| 13 | Null strategy | Policy null mapping | null value check, null property strategy | Default null behavior tidak diaudit |
| 14 | Before/After hook | Custom step ringan | `@BeforeMapping`, `@AfterMapping` | Hook jadi hidden business logic |
| 15 | Context parameter | Membawa state tambahan | `@Context` | Context null tidak dicek otomatis |
| 16 | Object factory | Membuat target khusus | `@ObjectFactory` | Factory terlalu pintar |
| 17 | Inverse mapping | Mapping dua arah | `@InheritInverseConfiguration` | Reverse mapping tidak selalu aman secara semantic |
| 18 | Reporting policy | Build-time guardrail | `ReportingPolicy.ERROR` | Warning diabaikan di CI |
| 19 | Record/immutable DTO | Mapping ke Java records | constructor mapping | Builder/constructor ambiguity |
| 20 | Testing mapper | Menjamin transformasi benar | unit test mapper, golden case | Hanya test happy path |

---

## 4. Maven Setup

Versi terbaru yang terlihat dari rilis resmi MapStruct saat pengecekan adalah **1.6.3**, dirilis sebagai bug-fix release pada 9 November 2024. GitHub resmi MapStruct juga menandai 1.6.3 sebagai latest release pada hasil yang tersedia. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/news/2024-11-09-mapstruct-1_6_3_bug-fix-released/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```xml
<properties>
    <mapstruct.version>1.6.3</mapstruct.version>
</properties>

<dependencies>
    <dependency>
        <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId>
        <artifactId>mapstruct</artifactId>
        <version>${mapstruct.version}</version>
    </dependency>
</dependencies>

<build>
    <plugins>
        <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>3.13.0</version>
            <configuration>
                <source>17</source>
                <target>17</target>
                <annotationProcessorPaths>
                    <path>
                        <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId>
                        <artifactId>mapstruct-processor</artifactId>
                        <version>${mapstruct.version}</version>
                    </path>
                </annotationProcessorPaths>
            </configuration>
        </plugin>
    </plugins>
</build>
```

MapStruct terdiri dari artifact `org.mapstruct:mapstruct` untuk annotations dan `org.mapstruct:mapstruct-processor` sebagai annotation processor yang menghasilkan mapper implementation saat compile-time. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

---

## 5. Component Model untuk Jersey/JAX-RS

Ini bagian yang sering membingungkan.

MapStruct mendukung beberapa `componentModel`, termasuk `default`, `cdi`, `spring`, `jsr330`, `jakarta`, dan `jakarta-cdi`. Secara khusus, `jakarta` menghasilkan mapper dengan `jakarta.inject`, sedangkan `jakarta-cdi` menghasilkan mapper sebagai CDI bean berbasis `jakarta.enterprise.context`. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

| Runtime aplikasi | Rekomendasi |
|---|---|
| Jersey plain + HK2, tanpa CDI | Pakai `default`, lalu bind mapper ke HK2 secara manual |
| Jersey + Weld/CDI Jakarta | Pakai `jakarta-cdi` |
| Runtime memakai `jakarta.inject` tapi bukan full CDI | Pakai `jakarta` |
| Legacy Java EE / Jersey 2 `javax.*` | Biasanya `cdi` atau `jsr330`, tergantung dependency |
| Spring Boot | `spring`, tapi bukan fokus stack ini |

Untuk aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS modern Jakarta**, pilihan yang umum:

```java
@Mapper(componentModel = MappingConstants.ComponentModel.JAKARTA_CDI)
public interface OrderMapper {
    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

Kalau belum memakai CDI/Weld dan masih dominan HK2, jangan asal pakai `jakarta-cdi`. Gunakan `Mappers.getMapper(...)` atau register generated mapper ke HK2.

---

## 6. Central `@MapperConfig`

Gunakan config terpusat supaya semua mapper punya policy yang sama.

```java
import org.mapstruct.InjectionStrategy;
import org.mapstruct.MapperConfig;
import org.mapstruct.MappingConstants;
import org.mapstruct.NullValueCheckStrategy;
import org.mapstruct.ReportingPolicy;

@MapperConfig(
        componentModel = MappingConstants.ComponentModel.JAKARTA_CDI,
        injectionStrategy = InjectionStrategy.CONSTRUCTOR,
        unmappedTargetPolicy = ReportingPolicy.ERROR,
        unmappedSourcePolicy = ReportingPolicy.WARN,
        typeConversionPolicy = ReportingPolicy.ERROR,
        nullValueCheckStrategy = NullValueCheckStrategy.ALWAYS
)
public interface ApiMapperConfig {
}
```

Lalu gunakan:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderMapper {
    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

MapStruct mendukung shared configuration lewat `@MapperConfig`, dan mapper dapat menunjuk config tersebut melalui `@Mapper#config`. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

### Policy yang saya rekomendasikan untuk onboarding enterprise

| Policy | Rekomendasi | Alasan |
|---|---|---|
| `unmappedTargetPolicy` | `ERROR` | Field response/command baru wajib disadari |
| `unmappedSourcePolicy` | `WARN` | Source field yang tidak dipakai tetap terlihat |
| `typeConversionPolicy` | `ERROR` | Hindari narrowing conversion diam-diam |
| `injectionStrategy` | `CONSTRUCTOR` | Lebih mudah dites |
| `nullValueCheckStrategy` | `ALWAYS` | Null handling eksplisit |

MapStruct docs juga menyebut constructor injection direkomendasikan untuk mempermudah testing ketika memakai dependency injection. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

---

## 7. Basic DTO → Command Mapping

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(
        UUID customerId,
        List<CreateOrderItemRequest> items,
        String note
) {}

public record CreateOrderCommand(
        UUID customerId,
        List<CreateOrderItemCommand> items,
        String note,
        UUID requestedBy
) {}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class, uses = OrderItemMapper.class)
public interface OrderMapper {

    @Mapping(target = "requestedBy", source = "actorUserId")
    CreateOrderCommand toCommand(
            CreateOrderRequest request,
            UUID actorUserId
    );
}
```

Resource:

```java
@POST
public Response create(
        @Valid CreateOrderRequest request,
        @Context SecurityContext securityContext
) {
    UUID actorUserId = resolveActor(securityContext);

    CreateOrderCommand command = orderMapper.toCommand(request, actorUserId);

    OrderResult result = orderService.create(command);

    return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
            .entity(orderMapper.toResponse(result))
            .build();
}
```

Pola yang sehat:

```text
Resource:
  - ambil request
  - validasi
  - ambil contextual input: actor, tenant, correlation
  - panggil mapper
  - panggil service

Mapper:
  - transformasi field
  - tidak call database
  - tidak membuat keputusan authorization
  - tidak menjalankan workflow
```

---

## 8. Response Mapping

Domain/service result:

```java
public record OrderResult(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatus status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        Currency currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        List<OrderItemResult> items
) {}
```

Response DTO:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        List<OrderItemResponse> items
) {}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class, uses = {
        OrderItemMapper.class,
        OrderStatusMapper.class,
        CurrencyMapper.class
})
public interface OrderMapper {

    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

Custom small mapper:

```java
public class CurrencyMapper {

    public String toCurrencyCode(Currency currency) {
        return currency == null ? null : currency.getCurrencyCode();
    }

    public Currency toCurrency(String code) {
        return code == null ? null : Currency.getInstance(code);
    }
}
```

Catatan: mapping `Currency` ke `String` masih aman di mapper. Tetapi validasi apakah currency boleh dipakai untuk tenant tertentu sebaiknya tetap di service/domain.

---

## 9. Nested Mapping

MapStruct dapat memanggil mapper lain jika method mapping source-target tersedia. Untuk object reference, MapStruct akan mencari method mapping yang cocok atau built-in conversion. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderItemMapper {

    CreateOrderItemCommand toCommand(CreateOrderItemRequest request);

    OrderItemResponse toResponse(OrderItemResult result);
}
```

Dipakai oleh mapper utama:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class, uses = OrderItemMapper.class)
public interface OrderMapper {

    CreateOrderCommand toCommand(CreateOrderRequest request);

    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

Mental model:

```text
OrderMapper
  ├─ maps scalar fields
  ├─ sees List<OrderItemResult> → List<OrderItemResponse>
  └─ delegates each item to OrderItemMapper
```

Anti-pattern:

```text
OrderMapper melakukan mapping terlalu dalam:
Order → Customer → Account → Subscription → Product → PricePlan
```

Untuk response API, sering lebih aman memotong graph:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        CustomerRefResponse customer
) {}

public record CustomerRefResponse(
        UUID id,
        String displayName
) {}
```

---

## 10. Collection Mapping

Contoh:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderItemMapper {

    OrderItemResponse toResponse(OrderItemResult item);

    List<OrderItemResponse> toResponses(List<OrderItemResult> items);
}
```

MapStruct akan menghasilkan loop mapping collection. Untuk collection/map yang null, tentukan policy agar contract jelas.

```java
@MapperConfig(
        nullValueIterableMappingStrategy = NullValueMappingStrategy.RETURN_DEFAULT,
        nullValueMapMappingStrategy = NullValueMappingStrategy.RETURN_DEFAULT
)
public interface ApiMapperConfig {
}
```

Rekomendasi:

| Context | Null collection output |
|---|---|
| Response DTO list | Biasanya empty list |
| Optional nested object | Boleh null |
| Patch request field | Harus dibedakan absent/null/value |
| Domain aggregate collection | Biasanya non-null invariant |

---

## 11. Enum Mapping

Jangan selalu expose enum domain langsung ke API.

```java
public enum OrderStatus {
    DRAFT,
    SUBMITTED,
    APPROVED,
    REJECTED,
    CANCELLED
}

public enum OrderStatusDto {
    DRAFT,
    SUBMITTED,
    APPROVED,
    REJECTED,
    CANCELLED,
    UNKNOWN
}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderStatusMapper {

    @ValueMapping(source = "DRAFT", target = "DRAFT")
    @ValueMapping(source = "SUBMITTED", target = "SUBMITTED")
    @ValueMapping(source = "APPROVED", target = "APPROVED")
    @ValueMapping(source = "REJECTED", target = "REJECTED")
    @ValueMapping(source = "CANCELLED", target = "CANCELLED")
    OrderStatusDto toDto(OrderStatus status);

    @ValueMapping(source = "UNKNOWN", target = MappingConstants.THROW_EXCEPTION)
    OrderStatus toDomain(OrderStatusDto status);
}
```

MapStruct secara default memetakan enum constant dengan nama yang sama, dan `@ValueMapping` dapat dipakai untuk memetakan constant yang berbeda atau beberapa constant ke target yang sama. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

### Rule praktis enum

| Situasi | Rekomendasi |
|---|---|
| Domain enum stabil dan memang public | Boleh expose langsung |
| Domain enum sering berubah | Buat enum DTO |
| Ada status internal | Jangan expose |
| Client lama harus tahan enum baru | Pertimbangkan `UNKNOWN` di response |
| Input enum invalid | Fail fast, jangan fallback diam-diam |

---

## 12. Update Mapping dengan `@MappingTarget`

Untuk update existing object, gunakan `@MappingTarget`.

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface CustomerUpdateMapper {

    void updateCustomerFromRequest(
            UpdateCustomerRequest request,
            @MappingTarget Customer customer
    );
}
```

MapStruct mendukung update existing bean dengan parameter target yang diberi `@MappingTarget`; generated code akan memperbarui instance target yang diberikan, dan hanya boleh ada satu parameter `@MappingTarget`. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

Contoh service:

```java
public CustomerResult update(UUID id, UpdateCustomerRequest request) {
    Customer customer = customerRepository.getRequired(id);

    updateMapper.updateCustomerFromRequest(request, customer);

    customer.validateForUpdate();

    customerRepository.save(customer);

    return CustomerResult.from(customer);
}
```

Catatan penting:

```text
Update mapper boleh mengubah object existing.
Tetapi decision apakah update valid tetap di domain/service.
```

---

## 13. Patch Mapping

Patch adalah area paling rawan.

### Problem utama

```json
{
  "name": null
}
```

Apakah artinya:

```text
1. field tidak diubah?
2. field dikosongkan?
3. invalid?
```

MapStruct tidak bisa membaca niat API kalau DTO tidak membedakan **absent** dan **explicit null**.

### Simple patch: null berarti tidak diubah

```java
public record PatchCustomerRequest(
        String name,
        String email,
        String phone
) {}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface CustomerPatchMapper {

    @BeanMapping(
            nullValuePropertyMappingStrategy =
                    NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE
    )
    void applyPatch(
            PatchCustomerRequest request,
            @MappingTarget Customer customer
    );
}
```

`NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE` membuat target mempertahankan nilai lama ketika source property bernilai null pada update mapping. Strategy ini berlaku hierarkis di level `@Mapping`, `@BeanMapping`, `@Mapper`, dan `@MapperConfig`. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

### Patch yang butuh clear value

Kalau API butuh membedakan absent vs null, gunakan wrapper.

```java
public record PatchField<T>(
        boolean present,
        T value
) {}
```

DTO:

```java
public record PatchCustomerRequest(
        PatchField<String> name,
        PatchField<String> email,
        PatchField<String> phone
) {}
```

Untuk kasus ini, MapStruct biasanya tidak cukup otomatis. Pakai method manual kecil:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public abstract class CustomerPatchMapper {

    public void applyPatch(PatchCustomerRequest request, Customer customer) {
        if (request.name() != null && request.name().present()) {
            customer.setName(request.name().value());
        }

        if (request.email() != null && request.email().present()) {
            customer.setEmail(request.email().value());
        }

        if (request.phone() != null && request.phone().present()) {
            customer.setPhone(request.phone().value());
        }
    }
}
```

Kesimpulan:

| Patch semantic | Cocok dengan MapStruct auto? |
|---|---:|
| Null berarti ignore | Ya |
| Null berarti clear | Butuh hati-hati |
| Absent vs null harus dibedakan | Perlu wrapper / JSON Merge Patch / custom logic |
| Patch punya rule kompleks | Manual mapper lebih aman |

---

## 14. Custom Mapping Method

Untuk mapping kecil yang deterministic, gunakan default method.

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface MoneyMapper {

    default BigDecimal toAmount(Money money) {
        return money == null ? null : money.amount();
    }

    default String toCurrency(Money money) {
        return money == null ? null : money.currency().getCurrencyCode();
    }

    default Money toMoney(BigDecimal amount, String currency) {
        if (amount == null || currency == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return new Money(amount, Currency.getInstance(currency));
    }
}
```

Gunakan untuk:

```text
- enum mapping
- value object mapping
- UUID/String conversion
- Money/Currency flattening
- code/displayName projection
```

Jangan gunakan untuk:

```text
- authorization
- database lookup berat
- workflow transition
- validation yang perlu repository
- HTTP call
- audit write
```

---

## 15. `@Context` untuk Contextual Mapping

`@Context` berguna untuk membawa informasi tambahan ke mapping method.

```java
public record MappingContext(
        UUID actorUserId,
        String tenantId,
        Locale locale
) {}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderMapper {

    @Mapping(target = "requestedBy", expression = "java(context.actorUserId())")
    @Mapping(target = "tenantId", expression = "java(context.tenantId())")
    CreateOrderCommand toCommand(
            CreateOrderRequest request,
            @Context MappingContext context
    );
}
```

MapStruct dapat meneruskan parameter `@Context` ke custom methods, `@ObjectFactory`, `@BeforeMapping`, dan `@AfterMapping`. Namun dokumentasi juga menegaskan bahwa MapStruct tidak melakukan null-check sebelum memanggil before/after mapping pada context parameter; caller harus memastikan context tidak null. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

Rekomendasi:

```text
Gunakan @Context untuk data ringan:
- actor user id
- tenant id
- locale
- timezone
- formatting mode

Jangan gunakan @Context untuk menyelundupkan:
- repository
- service besar
- HTTP client
- transaction object
```

---

## 16. `@BeforeMapping` dan `@AfterMapping`

Hook cocok untuk enrichment ringan atau normalization.

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public abstract class OrderResponseMapper {

    public abstract OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);

    @AfterMapping
    protected void normalize(
            OrderResult source,
            @MappingTarget OrderResponseBuilder target
    ) {
        // contoh jika target memakai builder
    }
}
```

Urutan invocation penting: `@BeforeMapping` tertentu dapat dipanggil sebelum null-check source, `@BeforeMapping` dengan `@MappingTarget` dipanggil setelah target dibuat, dan `@AfterMapping` dipanggil di akhir sebelum return. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

Gunakan hook dengan disiplin:

| Cocok | Tidak cocok |
|---|---|
| trim string output ringan | menjalankan business workflow |
| set derived display label | call repository |
| normalize code format | authorization |
| attach metadata mapping | audit write |

---

## 17. `@BeanMapping(ignoreByDefault = true)`

Untuk response DTO publik, saya sering merekomendasikan explicit mapping.

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderSummaryMapper {

    @BeanMapping(ignoreByDefault = true)
    @Mapping(target = "id", source = "id")
    @Mapping(target = "orderNumber", source = "orderNumber")
    @Mapping(target = "status", source = "status")
    @Mapping(target = "submittedAt", source = "submittedAt")
    OrderSummaryResponse toSummary(OrderResult result);
}
```

MapStruct mendukung `@BeanMapping(ignoreByDefault = true)` agar semua mapping harus dispesifikkan secara eksplisit dan tidak muncul warning untuk target properties yang sengaja tidak dimapping. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

Cocok untuk:

```text
- summary response
- public API response
- security-sensitive DTO
- DTO yang tidak boleh otomatis ikut field domain baru
```

---

## 18. DTO Record Mapping

Java records cocok untuk DTO immutable.

```java
public record CustomerResponse(
        UUID id,
        String name,
        String email
) {}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface CustomerMapper {

    CustomerResponse toResponse(CustomerResult result);
}
```

Untuk record, target tidak punya setter. MapStruct akan memakai constructor/canonical constructor bila parameter cocok. Secara umum ini cocok untuk response DTO.

Yang perlu dicek:

```text
[ ] Nama record component sesuai source atau diberi @Mapping
[ ] Semua required component tersedia
[ ] Tidak ada field internal ikut masuk
[ ] Test compile mapper berjalan di CI
```

---

## 19. Mapping Entity → Response DTO

Contoh entity:

```java
public class OrderEntity {
    private UUID id;
    private String orderNumber;
    private UUID customerId;
    private String statusCode;
    private BigDecimal totalAmount;
    private String currencyCode;
    private Instant submittedAt;

    // internal fields
    private Integer version;
    private Instant deletedAt;
    private String internalNote;
}
```

Response:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt
) {}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class, uses = OrderStatusMapper.class)
public interface OrderEntityMapper {

    @Mapping(target = "status", source = "statusCode")
    @Mapping(target = "currency", source = "currencyCode")
    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderEntity entity);
}
```

Anti-pattern:

```java
return Response.ok(orderEntity).build();
```

Risiko:

```text
- internal field bocor
- lazy relation ter-serialize
- circular reference
- API berubah saat schema berubah
- PII/security leak
```

---

## 20. MapStruct dengan Jersey/HK2 tanpa CDI

Jika aplikasi Jersey menggunakan HK2 dan belum memakai CDI/Weld, ada beberapa opsi.

### Opsi A - static mapper instance

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderMapper {

    OrderMapper INSTANCE = Mappers.getMapper(OrderMapper.class);

    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

Lalu:

```java
public class OrderResource {

    private final OrderMapper orderMapper = OrderMapper.INSTANCE;
}
```

Sederhana, tetapi kurang ideal untuk dependency injection kompleks.

### Opsi B - bind mapper ke HK2

```java
public class ApplicationBinder extends AbstractBinder {

    @Override
    protected void configure() {
        bind(OrderMapperImpl.class)
                .to(OrderMapper.class)
                .in(Singleton.class);
    }
}
```

Lalu register binder:

```java
public class ApiApplication extends ResourceConfig {

    public ApiApplication() {
        packages("com.example.api");
        register(new ApplicationBinder());
    }
}
```

Dengan MapStruct, generated mapper stateless dan thread-safe, jadi aman dijadikan singleton. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

---

## 21. Common Failure Modes

| Failure | Gejala | Penyebab | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mapper impl tidak tergenerate | `OrderMapperImpl not found` | annotation processor tidak aktif | cek `maven-compiler-plugin` |
| DI gagal inject mapper | `UnsatisfiedDependencyException` | salah `componentModel` | cocokkan dengan CDI/HK2 |
| Field baru tidak termapping | response missing data | implicit/warning diabaikan | `unmappedTargetPolicy = ERROR` |
| Patch menghapus data | null source overwrite target | null strategy salah | gunakan `IGNORE` atau wrapper |
| Enum mapping pecah | build fail / runtime exception | enum baru belum dimapping | explicit `@ValueMapping` |
| Lazy loading saat mapping | exception saat response | entity graph terlalu dalam | map projection/result DTO |
| Circular mapping | stack overflow / huge object graph | entity relation bolak-balik | potong graph, response ref |
| Mapper jadi service | sulit test, side effect | mapper call DB/API | pindahkan ke service/domain |
| Build beda IDE vs CI | compile lokal OK, CI fail | annotation processor IDE/CI beda | standardisasi Maven config |
| Lombok + MapStruct error | getter tidak dikenali | processor order/config | cek annotation processor paths |

---

## 22. Testing Strategy

Mapper tetap harus dites, terutama mapping yang menyentuh contract.

```java
class OrderMapperTest {

    private final OrderMapper mapper = Mappers.getMapper(OrderMapper.class);

    @Test
    void shouldMapOrderResultToResponse() {
        OrderResult result = new OrderResult(
                UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
                "ORD-001",
                UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"),
                OrderStatus.SUBMITTED,
                new BigDecimal("100.00"),
                Currency.getInstance("USD"),
                Instant.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
                List.of()
        );

        OrderResponse response = mapper.toResponse(result);

        assertEquals("ORD-001", response.orderNumber());
        assertEquals(OrderStatusDto.SUBMITTED, response.status());
        assertEquals("USD", response.currency());
    }
}
```

Test minimal:

```text
[ ] DTO → command happy path
[ ] command contextual field: actor/tenant
[ ] domain result → response
[ ] enum mapping semua value
[ ] null behavior
[ ] patch behavior
[ ] nested mapping
[ ] collection mapping
[ ] field baru gagal compile kalau belum dimapping
```

---

## 23. Production Checklist

```text
[ ] Semua mapper memakai @MapperConfig terpusat.
[ ] unmappedTargetPolicy = ERROR untuk mapper contract penting.
[ ] Tidak ada repository/service berat di mapper.
[ ] Mapping DTO/domain/entity dipisahkan.
[ ] Patch semantics terdokumentasi.
[ ] Enum API tidak sembarang expose enum domain.
[ ] Money/amount/currency dimapping eksplisit.
[ ] Response summary memakai explicit mapping.
[ ] Mapper tests ada untuk contract penting.
[ ] Annotation processor aktif di Maven dan IDE.
[ ] Component model cocok dengan runtime: HK2/CDI/Weld/Jakarta.
```

---

## 24. Kapan Jangan Pakai MapStruct

| Situasi | Lebih baik |
|---|---|
| Mapping hanya 2-3 field dan sangat lokal | Manual constructor |
| Mapping butuh banyak conditional business rule | Application/domain service |
| Mapping butuh DB lookup wajib | Service layer |
| Patch butuh absent/null/clear kompleks | Manual patch applier |
| Data shape sangat dinamis | Jackson `JsonNode`, JSON-P, atau manual parser |
| Response adalah aggregate projection dari query SQL | Query projection / result mapper |

MapStruct kuat, tapi jangan jadikan semua transformasi sebagai mapper. Untuk sistem regulatory/workflow, pemisahan rule dan transformasi penting agar lifecycle, audit, dan state transition tetap defensible.

---


## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:31:46 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke Bean Validation/Hibernate Validator deep dive. Saya akan cek rujukan resmi terbaru dulu agar versi, namespace, dan integrasi Jersey tidak keliru.

# Cheatsheet - Jakarta Bean Validation & Hibernate Validator Deep Dive di Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Di aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, Bean Validation adalah lapisan untuk memastikan **object yang masuk/keluar boundary API memenuhi constraint deklaratif** sebelum masuk ke service/domain logic.

Mental model-nya:

```text
JSON/XML/Form/Query Param
   ↓
Jersey deserialization / parameter binding
   ↓
Request DTO / method parameter
   ↓
Jakarta Bean Validation
   ↓
Mapper DTO → Command
   ↓
Application Service / Domain Invariant
```

Yang penting: **Bean Validation bukan pengganti domain invariant**. Ia cocok untuk validasi bentuk data, constraint lokal, constraint lintas field ringan, dan method contract. Rule yang butuh state database, workflow state, authorization, atau side effect sebaiknya berada di service/domain layer.

Jakarta Validation menyediakan object-level constraint declaration, validation API, metadata, serta method/constructor validation; Hibernate Validator adalah implementasi populer dan reference implementation untuk Jakarta Validation. Versi dokumentasi stable Hibernate Validator yang tersedia saat pengecekan mengarah ke **Hibernate Validator 9.1.2.Final**. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/bean-validation/4.0/jakarta-validation-spec-4.0.0-m1))

---

## 2. Diagram Pipeline Validasi di Jersey/JAX-RS

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        HTTP Request                          │
│  POST /orders                                                │
│  Content-Type: application/json                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Jersey Resource Matching                    │
│  @POST                                                       │
│  @Consumes(APPLICATION_JSON)                                 │
│  public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request)   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Deserialization Layer                       │
│  Jackson / JSON-B / JAXB                                      │
│  JSON/XML → Java DTO                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Bean Validation Layer                       │
│                                                              │
│  Field constraints:       @NotNull, @Size, @Pattern           │
│  Nested validation:       @Valid                              │
│  Collection item:         List<@Valid ItemRequest>            │
│  Container element:       List<@NotNull UUID>                 │
│  Class-level constraint:  cross-field validation              │
│  Method validation:       params / return value               │
│  Validation group:        Create / Update / Patch             │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
               ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
               ▼                             ▼
      Valid request                  ConstraintViolationException
               │                             │
               ▼                             ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ Mapper DTO → Command         │     │ ExceptionMapper               │
│ Service / Domain             │     │ ApiErrorResponse              │
└─────────────────────────────┘     └──────────────────────────────┘
               │                             │
               ▼                             ▼
       Normal response                400 / 422 validation error
```

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang perlu dikuasai | Pitfall umum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Constraint placement | Menentukan constraint diletakkan di mana | Field, getter, record component, parameter, return value | Constraint tersebar tanpa policy |
| 2 | Field constraint | Validasi properti sederhana | `@NotNull`, `@Size`, `@Min`, `@Pattern` | Salah pakai `@NotNull` untuk string kosong |
| 3 | String constraint | Validasi teks | `@NotBlank`, `@NotEmpty`, `@Size`, `@Pattern`, `@Email` | Email dianggap validasi identitas final |
| 4 | Numeric constraint | Validasi angka | `@Min`, `@Max`, `@DecimalMin`, `@Digits`, `@Positive` | Money memakai `double` |
| 5 | Temporal constraint | Validasi waktu | `@Past`, `@Future`, clock provider | Timezone tidak jelas |
| 6 | Nested validation | Validasi object graph | `@Valid` | DTO nested tidak ikut tervalidasi |
| 7 | Container element validation | Validasi isi collection/map/optional | `List<@NotNull UUID>`, `Map<@NotBlank String, @Valid Item>` | Hanya list-nya divalidasi, item-nya tidak |
| 8 | Class-level validation | Validasi lintas field | Custom annotation + `ConstraintValidator` | Business rule berat masuk validator |
| 9 | Custom constraint | Constraint reusable | Annotation, validator, message, groups, payload | Validator melakukan DB call tanpa kontrol |
| 10 | Validation group | Constraint per use case | `Create`, `Update`, `Patch`, group sequence | Group terlalu banyak sampai tidak auditable |
| 11 | Cascaded validation | Validasi object terkait | `@Valid` pada field/collection | Circular graph atau terlalu dalam |
| 12 | Method validation | Validasi resource/service method | Parameter constraint, return constraint | Tidak aktif karena integrasi runtime belum benar |
| 13 | Error mapping | Normalisasi violation ke API error | `ExceptionMapper<ConstraintViolationException>` | Raw framework error bocor ke client |
| 14 | Message interpolation | Pesan error | message bundle, locale, code | Pesan manusia dijadikan machine contract |
| 15 | Fail fast | Berhenti di violation pertama | Hibernate Validator config | Tidak cocok jika client butuh semua field error |
| 16 | Validator lifecycle | Reuse validator | `ValidatorFactory`, `Validator` | Membuat factory per request |
| 17 | Jersey integration | Validasi otomatis di JAX-RS | `jersey-bean-validation`, `ValidationFeature`, `ValidationConfig` | Dependency ada tapi auto-discovery dimatikan |
| 18 | CDI/HK2 injection | Dependency untuk validator/custom validator | `ConstraintValidatorFactory`, CDI extension | Validator butuh service tapi injection tidak jalan |
| 19 | Testing | Menjamin constraint dan error contract | unit test validator, JerseyTest, contract test | Hanya happy path service test |
| 20 | Governance | Konsistensi lintas service | standard error code, DTO policy, group naming | Tiap endpoint punya gaya validasi sendiri |

---

## 4. Dependency & Compatibility Watchlist

Untuk Jersey, modul **`jersey-bean-validation`** menyediakan dukungan Bean Validation dan didokumentasikan sebagai extension module yang perlu ada di classpath/Maven dependency; dokumentasi Jersey juga menyebut modul ini bergantung langsung pada Hibernate Validator sebagai implementasi umum Bean Validation. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html))

Contoh dependency konseptual:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.glassfish.jersey.ext</groupId>
    <artifactId>jersey-bean-validation</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

Watchlist versi:

| Stack | Yang dicek |
|---|---|
| Jersey 2.x | Biasanya legacy `javax.*` ecosystem |
| Jersey 3.x+ | Jakarta namespace `jakarta.*` |
| Jakarta Validation 3.x | Package `jakarta.validation.*` |
| Hibernate Validator 8.x | Umumnya Jakarta EE 10 era |
| Hibernate Validator 9.x | Menargetkan Jakarta EE 11 dan Jakarta Validation 3.1 menurut rilis resmi Hibernate Validator |
| CDI/Weld | Perlu dicek bila custom validator butuh injection |
| Plain Jersey + HK2 | Injection ke validator bisa butuh konfigurasi tambahan |

Hibernate Validator release page menyebut seri **9.0** menargetkan Jakarta EE 11 dan mengimplementasikan Jakarta Validation 3.1; dokumentasi stable yang terbuka saat pengecekan menampilkan **9.1.2.Final**. ([Hibernate](https://hibernate.org/validator/releases/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 5. Constraint Placement

### 5.1 Field / Record Component Constraint

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID customerId,

        @NotEmpty
        List<@Valid CreateOrderItemRequest> items,

        @Size(max = 500)
        String note

) {}
```

Untuk DTO berbasis Java record, constraint biasanya paling jelas ditaruh di record component.

### 5.2 Nested DTO

```java
public record CreateOrderItemRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID productId,

        @Min(1)
        int quantity

) {}
```

Agar `items` ikut divalidasi sampai ke item-nya, gunakan:

```java
@NotEmpty
List<@Valid CreateOrderItemRequest> items
```

Bukan hanya:

```java
@NotEmpty
List<CreateOrderItemRequest> items
```

---

## 6. Constraint yang Sering Dipakai

| Constraint | Cocok untuk | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| `@NotNull` | Field wajib ada dan tidak null | Tidak melarang string kosong |
| `@NotEmpty` | String/collection/map tidak kosong | String `"   "` masih dianggap tidak kosong |
| `@NotBlank` | String wajib berisi non-whitespace | Pilihan umum untuk nama/kode |
| `@Size` | Panjang string / ukuran collection | Cocok untuk API boundary |
| `@Min`, `@Max` | Integer/long numeric bound | Tidak ideal untuk decimal money |
| `@DecimalMin`, `@DecimalMax` | Decimal numeric bound | Cocok untuk `BigDecimal` |
| `@Digits` | Jumlah digit integer/fraction | Bagus untuk monetary/amount precision |
| `@Positive`, `@PositiveOrZero` | Angka positif | Cocok quantity/amount |
| `@Pattern` | Format string | Jangan terlalu kompleks |
| `@Email` | Bentuk email dasar | Bukan bukti email valid/aktif |
| `@Past`, `@Future` | Temporal rule | Perhatikan timezone/clock |
| `@Valid` | Cascaded/nested validation | Wajib untuk nested DTO |

Hibernate Validator mendokumentasikan constraint declaration pada object model menggunakan annotation seperti `@NotNull`, `@Size`, dan `@Min`, serta validasi dilakukan melalui `Validator`. Dokumentasinya juga menyebut `Validator` thread-safe dan dapat digunakan ulang. ([JBoss Documentation](https://docs.jboss.org/hibernate/stable/validator/reference/en-US/html_single/))

---

## 7. DTO Validation Pattern

### Request DTO

```java
public record RegisterCustomerRequest(

        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 120)
        String fullName,

        @NotBlank
        @Email
        @Size(max = 254)
        String email,

        @NotBlank
        @Pattern(regexp = "INDIVIDUAL|BUSINESS")
        String customerType,

        @Valid
        AddressRequest address

) {}
```

### Nested DTO

```java
public record AddressRequest(

        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 200)
        String street,

        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 100)
        String city,

        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 20)
        String postalCode

) {}
```

### Resource Method

```java
@POST
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public Response register(@Valid RegisterCustomerRequest request) {
    RegisterCustomerCommand command = mapper.toCommand(request);
    CustomerResult result = service.register(command);

    return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
            .entity(mapper.toResponse(result))
            .build();
}
```

Rule praktis:

```text
Deserializer memastikan JSON/XML bisa jadi object.
Bean Validation memastikan object memenuhi constraint input.
Service/domain memastikan operasi valid secara bisnis.
```

---

## 8. Container Element Validation

Container element validation penting untuk API modern karena banyak field berupa collection.

```java
public record BulkCancelRequest(

        @NotEmpty
        List<@NotNull UUID> orderIds,

        @Size(max = 50)
        Map<@NotBlank String, @NotBlank String> metadata

) {}
```

Untuk nested object:

```java
public record BulkCreateOrderRequest(

        @NotEmpty
        List<@Valid CreateOrderRequest> orders

) {}
```

Kesalahan umum:

```java
@NotEmpty
List<CreateOrderRequest> orders;
```

Ini hanya memastikan list tidak kosong, tapi tidak otomatis memvalidasi setiap `CreateOrderRequest`.

---

## 9. Create / Update / Patch Validation

### Rekomendasi utama: DTO terpisah

```text
CreateCustomerRequest
UpdateCustomerRequest
PatchCustomerRequest
```

Ini biasanya lebih mudah diaudit dibanding satu DTO dengan terlalu banyak group.

### Create

```java
public record CreateCustomerRequest(

        @NotBlank
        String name,

        @NotBlank
        @Email
        String email,

        @NotNull
        CustomerType type

) {}
```

### Update penuh

```java
public record UpdateCustomerRequest(

        @NotBlank
        String name,

        @NotBlank
        @Email
        String email,

        @NotNull
        CustomerStatus status

) {}
```

### Patch

```java
public record PatchCustomerRequest(

        @Size(max = 120)
        String name,

        @Email
        String email,

        CustomerStatus status

) {}
```

Untuk patch, tentukan dulu semantics:

| Kondisi | Makna |
|---|---|
| Field absent | Tidak mengubah field |
| Field null | Clear field atau invalid, harus diputuskan |
| Field value | Update field |
| Field invalid format | Validation error |

Bean Validation saja tidak cukup untuk membedakan **absent** vs **explicit null** jika DTO biasa sudah terbentuk dari deserializer. Untuk kebutuhan patch yang strict, pertimbangkan wrapper field, JSON Merge Patch, atau custom deserialization policy.

---

## 10. Validation Group

Validation group berguna jika satu DTO memang harus dipakai untuk beberapa konteks.

```java
public interface Create {}
public interface Update {}
public interface Patch {}
```

```java
public record CustomerMutationRequest(

        @NotNull(groups = Update.class)
        UUID id,

        @NotBlank(groups = Create.class)
        String name,

        @Email(groups = {Create.class, Update.class, Patch.class})
        String email,

        @NotNull(groups = {Create.class, Update.class})
        CustomerStatus status

) {}
```

Manual validation group:

```java
public final class RequestValidator {

    private final Validator validator;

    public RequestValidator(Validator validator) {
        this.validator = validator;
    }

    public <T> void validate(T request, Class<?> group) {
        Set<ConstraintViolation<T>> violations =
                validator.validate(request, group);

        if (!violations.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ConstraintViolationException(violations);
        }
    }
}
```

Resource:

```java
@POST
public Response create(CustomerMutationRequest request) {
    requestValidator.validate(request, Create.class);

    CreateCustomerCommand command = mapper.toCreateCommand(request);
    CustomerResult result = service.create(command);

    return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
            .entity(mapper.toResponse(result))
            .build();
}
```

Jakarta Validation mendefinisikan groups sebagai cara membatasi subset constraint yang dijalankan; jika group tidak diberikan, group `Default` diasumsikan. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/bean-validation/3.1/jakarta-validation-spec-3.1.html))

Gunakan group secara disiplin:

| Situasi | Saran |
|---|---|
| Beda kecil antara create/update | Group masih masuk akal |
| Create/update/patch beda besar | DTO terpisah lebih jelas |
| Banyak group di setiap field | Desain mulai sulit diaudit |
| Rule butuh database/state workflow | Jangan taruh di group validation |

---

## 11. Group Sequence

Group sequence dipakai jika validasi harus bertahap.

Contoh konsep:

```java
public interface BasicChecks {}
public interface BusinessShapeChecks {}

@GroupSequence({BasicChecks.class, BusinessShapeChecks.class})
public interface CreateOrderChecks {}
```

Use case:

```text
1. Jalankan constraint dasar dulu:
   - not null
   - format
   - size

2. Baru jalankan constraint lebih mahal:
   - cross-field
   - conditional shape
```

Namun hati-hati: group sequence bisa membuat validasi lebih sulit dipahami. Untuk API boundary biasa, DTO terpisah + constraint sederhana sering lebih maintainable.

---

## 12. Class-Level Constraint / Cross-Field Validation

Contoh problem:

```text
Jika customerType = BUSINESS, maka companyRegistrationNumber wajib ada.
Jika customerType = INDIVIDUAL, maka nationalId wajib ada.
```

Annotation:

```java
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = ValidCustomerIdentityValidator.class)
public @interface ValidCustomerIdentity {

    String message() default "Invalid customer identity";

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

DTO:

```java
@ValidCustomerIdentity
public record CreateCustomerRequest(
        @NotNull CustomerType customerType,
        String nationalId,
        String companyRegistrationNumber
) {}
```

Validator:

```java
public class ValidCustomerIdentityValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidCustomerIdentity, CreateCustomerRequest> {

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            CreateCustomerRequest value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.customerType() == null) {
            return true; // biarkan @NotNull yang melaporkan
        }

        boolean valid = switch (value.customerType()) {
            case INDIVIDUAL -> hasText(value.nationalId());
            case BUSINESS -> hasText(value.companyRegistrationNumber());
        };

        if (!valid) {
            context.disableDefaultConstraintViolation();

            String field = value.customerType() == CustomerType.INDIVIDUAL
                    ? "nationalId"
                    : "companyRegistrationNumber";

            context.buildConstraintViolationWithTemplate(
                    "Required for customer type " + value.customerType()
            ).addPropertyNode(field).addConstraintViolation();
        }

        return valid;
    }

    private boolean hasText(String value) {
        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
    }
}
```

Pakai class-level constraint untuk rule lintas field yang **lokal pada DTO**. Jangan gunakan untuk rule seperti “order boleh cancel hanya jika state saat ini SUBMITTED”, karena itu domain/state transition rule.

---

## 13. Method Validation

Method validation memvalidasi parameter dan return value method.

Contoh di resource:

```java
@GET
@Path("/{id}")
public Response getById(
        @PathParam("id") @NotNull UUID id
) {
    OrderResult result = service.getById(id);
    return Response.ok(mapper.toResponse(result)).build();
}
```

Contoh di service:

```java
public class OrderService {

    public @NotNull OrderResult getById(@NotNull UUID id) {
        return repository.findRequired(id);
    }
}
```

Jakarta Validation menyediakan method dan constructor validation; Jersey juga mendokumentasikan dukungan untuk validasi JAX-RS resources/methods melalui modul Bean Validation. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/bean-validation/4.0/jakarta-validation-spec-4.0.0-m1))

Prinsip:

```text
Resource method validation:
- path/query/header/form parameter
- request DTO

Service method validation:
- internal contract
- return value guarantee
```

Tetapi untuk service layer, jangan hanya mengandalkan method validation. Tetap perlu domain exception yang jelas untuk invariant bisnis.

---

## 14. Jersey Integration

Jersey mendokumentasikan bahwa Bean Validation support berada di module `jersey-bean-validation`; module ini dapat auto-discover feature-nya ketika ada di classpath, kecuali auto-discovery atau BV feature dinonaktifkan melalui properti Jersey. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html))

Contoh konfigurasi:

```java
public class ApiApplication extends ResourceConfig {

    public ApiApplication() {
        packages("com.example.api");

        register(ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper.class);
        register(DomainExceptionMapper.class);

        // Optional: custom validation config resolver
        register(ValidationConfigResolver.class);
    }
}
```

Custom `ValidationConfig`:

```java
@Provider
public class ValidationConfigResolver
        implements ContextResolver<ValidationConfig> {

    @Override
    public ValidationConfig getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return new ValidationConfig()
                .messageInterpolator(new ApiMessageInterpolator())
                .constraintValidatorFactory(new ApiConstraintValidatorFactory());
    }
}
```

Jersey menyediakan `ValidationConfig` untuk mengonfigurasi validator yang dipakai resource validation, dan dapat diekspos melalui mekanisme `ContextResolver`. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html))

---

## 15. Error Response Model

Buat error response yang stabil.

```java
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors
) {}

public record FieldErrorResponse(
        String field,
        String code,
        String message
) {}
```

Contoh output:

```json
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "message": "Request validation failed",
  "correlationId": "req-9fc21a",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field": "items[0].quantity",
      "code": "Min",
      "message": "must be greater than or equal to 1"
    },
    {
      "field": "customerId",
      "code": "NotNull",
      "message": "must not be null"
    }
  ]
}
```

Machine contract sebaiknya `code`, bukan `message`.

```text
code    → stabil untuk client logic
message → bisa berubah / localized / human-readable
field   → membantu client highlight input
```

---

## 16. ExceptionMapper untuk Validation Error

```java
@Provider
public class ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<ConstraintViolationException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(ConstraintViolationException exception) {
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors = exception.getConstraintViolations()
                .stream()
                .map(this::toFieldError)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(FieldErrorResponse::field))
                .toList();

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                "Request validation failed",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                errors
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private FieldErrorResponse toFieldError(ConstraintViolation<?> violation) {
        String fieldPath = normalizePath(violation.getPropertyPath());

        String constraintCode = violation.getConstraintDescriptor()
                .getAnnotation()
                .annotationType()
                .getSimpleName();

        return new FieldErrorResponse(
                fieldPath,
                constraintCode,
                violation.getMessage()
        );
    }

    private String normalizePath(Path path) {
        return path.toString()
                .replace("create.arg0.", "")
                .replace("register.arg0.", "");
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Catatan status code:

| Jenis violation | Status umum |
|---|---:|
| Request shape/input validation | 400 |
| Semantic validation tapi syntactically valid | 422 |
| Conflict dengan state/resource | 409 |
| Return value validation gagal | 500, karena bug server/contract violation |

Jangan mengembalikan raw `ConstraintViolationException` langsung ke client production.

---

## 17. Message Interpolation & Localization

Constraint message bisa ditulis seperti ini:

```java
@NotBlank(message = "{customer.name.required}")
String name
```

Lalu di resource bundle:

```properties
customer.name.required=Customer name is required
customer.email.invalid=Customer email is invalid
```

Tetapi untuk API enterprise, jangan jadikan message sebagai contract utama.

Lebih baik:

```json
{
  "field": "email",
  "code": "Email",
  "message": "Customer email is invalid"
}
```

Atau gunakan custom error code:

```json
{
  "field": "email",
  "code": "CUSTOMER_EMAIL_INVALID",
  "message": "Customer email is invalid"
}
```

---

## 18. Hibernate Validator Specific Features

Hibernate Validator menyediakan fitur di luar spesifikasi Jakarta Validation; dokumentasi resminya mengingatkan bahwa fitur spesifik Hibernate Validator dapat mengurangi portability antar provider. ([JBoss Documentation](https://docs.jboss.org/hibernate/stable/validator/reference/en-US/html_single/))

Fitur yang sering berguna:

| Fitur | Fungsi | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| Fail fast | Stop setelah violation pertama | Cepat, tapi client tidak dapat semua error |
| Programmatic constraint mapping | Constraint via code | Berguna untuk dynamic/module config |
| Additional constraints | Constraint ekstra dari Hibernate Validator | Cek compatibility |
| CDI extension | Integrasi CDI jika environment belum menyediakan | Tidak selalu perlu di app server |
| Annotation processor | Compile-time check penggunaan constraint | Bagus untuk CI guardrail |

Hibernate Validator docs menyebut CDI portable extension tersedia melalui artifact `hibernate-validator-cdi`; dokumentasi yang sama juga menyebut annotation processor dapat mendeteksi kesalahan penggunaan constraint annotations saat build. ([JBoss Documentation](https://docs.jboss.org/hibernate/stable/validator/reference/en-US/html_single/))

---

## 19. Fail Fast Mode

Fail fast berarti validasi berhenti pada violation pertama.

Cocok untuk:

```text
- internal service validation
- performance-sensitive path
- command validation yang tidak perlu semua error
```

Kurang cocok untuk:

```text
- public API form validation
- frontend butuh semua field error sekaligus
- batch import yang ingin laporan lengkap
```

Contoh konfigurasi konseptual:

```java
ValidatorFactory factory = Validation.byProvider(HibernateValidator.class)
        .configure()
        .failFast(true)
        .buildValidatorFactory();

Validator validator = factory.getValidator();
```

Untuk REST API, default yang biasanya lebih user-friendly adalah **kumpulkan semua field violation**, bukan fail fast.

---

## 20. ConstraintValidator dengan Dependency

Kadang custom validator butuh dependency, misalnya reference data checker. Tetapi ini area rawan.

```java
public class ValidCountryCodeValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidCountryCode, String> {

    private final CountryCatalog countryCatalog;

    public ValidCountryCodeValidator(CountryCatalog countryCatalog) {
        this.countryCatalog = countryCatalog;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(String value, ConstraintValidatorContext context) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return true;
        }

        return countryCatalog.exists(value);
    }
}
```

Hati-hati:

```text
Validator yang melakukan DB/API call:
- bisa memperlambat request
- bisa gagal karena dependency/injection
- bisa membuat validation layer punya side effect
- bisa sulit dites
```

Rekomendasi:

| Rule | Tempat |
|---|---|
| Format country code valid | Bean Validation |
| Country code ada di static reference list lokal | Bean Validation masih masuk akal |
| Country aktif untuk tenant tertentu | Service/domain |
| Customer boleh pakai country tertentu menurut policy | Service/domain |
| Country harus dicek ke external service | Service/domain, bukan validator |

---

## 21. Validation vs Domain Invariant

Pisahkan dengan tegas.

| Pertanyaan | Bean Validation | Domain/Service |
|---|---:|---:|
| Field wajib tidak null? | Ya | Bisa redundant guard |
| String max 100 char? | Ya | Tidak utama |
| Quantity minimal 1? | Ya | Bisa juga domain invariant |
| Order boleh cancelled? | Tidak | Ya |
| User boleh approve case ini? | Tidak | Ya |
| Status transition valid? | Tidak | Ya |
| Record masih aktif di database? | Tidak ideal | Ya |
| Tenant punya feature ini? | Tidak | Ya |
| Amount sesuai pricing engine? | Tidak | Ya |

Mental model:

```text
Bean Validation:
"Apakah request ini berbentuk valid?"

Domain Validation:
"Apakah aksi ini sah dalam konteks bisnis saat ini?"
```

---

## 22. Common Pitfalls

| Pitfall | Dampak | Solusi |
|---|---|---|
| Lupa `@Valid` di nested object | Child DTO tidak divalidasi | Tambahkan `@Valid` |
| Pakai primitive `int` untuk required field | Missing value bisa jadi `0` | Gunakan `Integer` + `@NotNull` |
| `@NotNull` untuk string input | `""` tetap lolos | Gunakan `@NotBlank` |
| `@Email` dianggap cukup | Email belum tentu verified | Pisahkan format vs verification |
| Satu DTO untuk semua operasi | Constraint kacau | DTO per use case |
| Terlalu banyak validation group | Sulit audit | Pisahkan DTO |
| Validator query database | Lambat dan hidden coupling | Pindahkan ke service |
| Error message mentah dikirim | Contract tidak stabil | Error code + normalized field path |
| Return value validation gagal dikirim sebagai 400 | Salah blame ke client | Treat sebagai 500/internal defect |
| DTO entity langsung divalidasi | API tergantung schema DB | Pisahkan DTO/entity |
| Field path framework mentah | Client sulit pakai | Normalize path |
| Fail fast di public API | Client harus retry berkali-kali | Kumpulkan semua error |

---

## 23. Testing Strategy

### Unit test validator

```java
class CreateOrderRequestValidationTest {

    private static Validator validator;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setup() {
        validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory()
                .getValidator();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectMissingCustomerId() {
        CreateOrderRequest request = new CreateOrderRequest(
                null,
                List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(UUID.randomUUID(), 1)),
                null
        );

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CreateOrderRequest>> violations =
                validator.validate(request);

        assertTrue(violations.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath().toString().equals("customerId")));
    }
}
```

### Test nested validation

```java
@Test
void shouldRejectInvalidItemQuantity() {
    CreateOrderRequest request = new CreateOrderRequest(
            UUID.randomUUID(),
            List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(UUID.randomUUID(), 0)),
            null
    );

    Set<ConstraintViolation<CreateOrderRequest>> violations =
            validator.validate(request);

    assertTrue(violations.stream()
            .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath().toString().contains("items")));
}
```

### Test error contract via JerseyTest / integration test

```text
POST /orders with invalid payload
  ↓
expect HTTP 400
  ↓
expect code = VALIDATION_FAILED
  ↓
expect errors[].field contains customerId/items[0].quantity
  ↓
expect correlationId exists
```

Minimal checklist:

```text
[ ] Missing required field
[ ] Blank string
[ ] Invalid nested item
[ ] Invalid collection element
[ ] Invalid enum / invalid format
[ ] Cross-field validation
[ ] Validation group create/update
[ ] Error response schema
[ ] Field path normalization
[ ] No raw stack trace / package name in response
```

---

## 24. Production Checklist

```text
[ ] Semua request body penting memakai @Valid.
[ ] Nested DTO memakai @Valid.
[ ] Collection item memakai container element validation.
[ ] DTO create/update/patch dipisahkan kecuali group benar-benar sederhana.
[ ] Primitive diganti wrapper jika missing/null harus dibedakan.
[ ] Error response punya code/message/correlationId/errors.
[ ] ConstraintViolationException dimap ke response standar.
[ ] Domain exception dipisahkan dari validation exception.
[ ] Validator tidak melakukan side effect.
[ ] Message bukan machine contract utama.
[ ] Validation tests masuk CI.
[ ] Jersey bean validation module dan auto-discovery dicek.
[ ] Namespace jakarta/javax tidak tercampur.
```

---

## 25. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Field constraints:
   @NotNull, @NotBlank, @Size, @Min, @Pattern
   ↓
2. Nested validation:
   @Valid pada object dan collection
   ↓
3. Container element validation:
   List<@NotNull UUID>, List<@Valid Item>
   ↓
4. DTO design:
   Create vs Update vs Patch
   ↓
5. Validation group:
   gunakan secukupnya
   ↓
6. Class-level custom constraint:
   cross-field validation
   ↓
7. Method validation:
   resource parameter dan service contract
   ↓
8. Jersey integration:
   jersey-bean-validation, ValidationConfig
   ↓
9. ExceptionMapper:
   normalized validation error response
   ↓
10. Testing:
   validator unit test + API contract test
```
