## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:33:47 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke arsitektur custom constraint dan batas validasi vs domain rule. Bagian ini penting supaya validator tidak berubah menjadi “mini service layer” yang sulit diaudit.

# Cheatsheet - Custom Constraint & Validation Architecture di Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Custom constraint dipakai ketika constraint bawaan seperti `@NotNull`, `@NotBlank`, `@Size`, `@Pattern`, `@Email`, `@Min`, atau `@Past` tidak cukup untuk menyatakan aturan validasi lokal pada DTO.

Contoh kebutuhan yang cocok:

```text
- Field A wajib jika field B bernilai tertentu
- Tanggal akhir harus setelah tanggal mulai
- Kode harus mengikuti format internal
- Minimal salah satu dari beberapa field harus diisi
- Collection tidak boleh punya item duplikat
- Pair field harus konsisten, misalnya amount + currency
```

Jakarta Validation memang mendukung custom constraint, validasi object graph, serta validasi parameter dan return value method/constructor. Constraint juga dapat dikendalikan dengan `groups`, misalnya untuk create/update/patch flow. ([Bean Validation](https://beanvalidation.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Hal yang perlu dijaga: **custom validator bukan tempat business workflow**.

```text
Bean Validation:
"Apakah bentuk/request object ini valid?"

Domain/service:
"Apakah aksi ini sah dalam state bisnis saat ini?"
```

---

## 2. Diagram Arsitektur

```text
HTTP Request
   │
   ▼
Jersey Resource Method
   │
   ▼
Deserializer
Jackson / JSON-B / JAXB
   │
   ▼
Request DTO
   │
   ▼
Jakarta Bean Validation
   │
   ├─ Built-in constraints
   │  ├─ @NotNull
   │  ├─ @NotBlank
   │  ├─ @Size
   │  ├─ @Pattern
   │  └─ @Valid
   │
   ├─ Custom field constraint
   │  ├─ @ValidCode
   │  ├─ @ValidCurrency
   │  └─ @NoDuplicateItems
   │
   ├─ Class-level constraint
   │  ├─ @ValidDateRange
   │  ├─ @ValidCustomerIdentity
   │  └─ @AtLeastOneFieldRequired
   │
   ├─ Validation group
   │  ├─ Create
   │  ├─ Update
   │  └─ Patch
   │
   └─ Method validation
      ├─ resource parameter
      └─ service return value

Valid
   │
   ▼
Mapper DTO → Command
   │
   ▼
Application Service / Domain
   │
   ├─ state transition
   ├─ authorization-sensitive rule
   ├─ database-backed rule
   └─ workflow rule

Invalid
   │
   ▼
ConstraintViolationException
   │
   ▼
ExceptionMapper
   │
   ▼
ApiErrorResponse
```

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang perlu dikuasai | Pitfall umum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Custom constraint anatomy | Membuat constraint reusable | annotation + `ConstraintValidator` + message | Annotation tidak punya `message`, `groups`, `payload` |
| 2 | Field constraint | Validasi satu field | `ConstraintValidator<A, String>` / `UUID` / `BigDecimal` | Memaksa rule lintas field ke field validator |
| 3 | Class-level constraint | Validasi kombinasi field | `ConstraintValidator<A, DTO>` | Error path tidak diarahkan ke field spesifik |
| 4 | Container constraint | Validasi collection/map item | `List<@Valid X>`, `List<@NotNull UUID>` | Hanya list divalidasi, item tidak |
| 5 | Conditional validation | Field wajib berdasarkan field lain | class-level validator | Terlalu banyak `if` di DTO validator |
| 6 | Validation group | Constraint per use case | `Create`, `Update`, `Patch` | Group terlalu banyak dan sulit diaudit |
| 7 | Group sequence | Validasi bertahap | basic → advanced checks | Flow validasi jadi tersembunyi |
| 8 | Error path building | Menentukan field error | `ConstraintValidatorContext` | Semua error muncul di object root |
| 9 | Message interpolation | Pesan error manusiawi | `{message.key}` bundle | Message dijadikan machine contract |
| 10 | Error code mapping | Stabilitas API error | annotation name → code | Client bergantung pada teks message |
| 11 | Validator dependency | Validator butuh dependency | `ConstraintValidatorFactory`, CDI/HK2 bridge | Validator query DB/API sembarangan |
| 12 | Jersey integration | Validasi otomatis di resource | `jersey-bean-validation`, `ValidationConfig` | Modul ada tapi konfigurasi tidak aktif |
| 13 | ExceptionMapper | Response error standar | `ConstraintViolationException` mapping | Raw violation dikirim ke client |
| 14 | Domain boundary | Memisahkan validation vs business rule | service/domain exception | Domain rule bocor ke Bean Validation |
| 15 | Testing | Menjamin custom validator benar | unit test + API contract test | Validator tidak dites edge case |

Jakarta Validation mewajibkan constraint annotation memiliki atribut standar seperti `message`, `groups`, dan `payload`; Hibernate Validator documentation juga menekankan atribut tersebut sebagai bagian dari constraint metadata. ([Hibernate Documentation](https://docs.hibernate.org/stable/validator/reference/en-US/html_single/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 4. Anatomy of Custom Constraint

Custom constraint biasanya terdiri dari:

```text
1. Annotation
   @ValidDateRange

2. Validator class
   ValidDateRangeValidator implements ConstraintValidator<ValidDateRange, RequestDto>

3. Message key
   {order.dateRange.invalid}

4. Usage di DTO
   @ValidDateRange
   public record CreateOrderRequest(...)

5. ExceptionMapper
   ConstraintViolationException → ApiErrorResponse
```

Jakarta Validation menyediakan `ConstraintValidator` sebagai mekanisme implementasi constraint; Hibernate Validator documentation menjelaskan bahwa generic type pertama adalah annotation constraint, sedangkan generic type kedua adalah tipe object yang divalidasi. ([Hibernate Documentation](https://docs.hibernate.org/validator/5.1/reference/en-US/html/validator-customconstraints.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 5. Field-Level Custom Constraint

### Use case

Validasi kode bisnis sederhana:

```text
customerCode harus:
- tidak null ditangani oleh @NotBlank
- uppercase
- prefix CUST-
- panjang maksimal 30
```

### Annotation

```java
@Target({
        ElementType.FIELD,
        ElementType.PARAMETER,
        ElementType.RECORD_COMPONENT
})
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = ValidCustomerCodeValidator.class)
public @interface ValidCustomerCode {

    String message() default "{customer.code.invalid}";

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

### Validator

```java
public class ValidCustomerCodeValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidCustomerCode, String> {

    private static final Pattern PATTERN =
            Pattern.compile("^CUST-[A-Z0-9]{4,25}$");

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            String value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return true; // biarkan @NotBlank yang melaporkan
        }

        return PATTERN.matcher(value).matches();
    }
}
```

### DTO

```java
public record CreateCustomerRequest(

        @NotBlank
        @ValidCustomerCode
        String customerCode,

        @NotBlank
        String name

) {}
```

Rule penting:

```text
Custom validator sebaiknya return true untuk null jika nullability sudah ditangani @NotNull/@NotBlank.
Ini mencegah error duplikat yang membingungkan.
```

---

## 6. Class-Level Constraint untuk Cross-Field Validation

### Use case

```text
Jika customerType = INDIVIDUAL:
  nationalId wajib ada

Jika customerType = BUSINESS:
  companyRegistrationNumber wajib ada
```

### Annotation

```java
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = ValidCustomerIdentityValidator.class)
public @interface ValidCustomerIdentity {

    String message() default "{customer.identity.invalid}";

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

### DTO

```java
@ValidCustomerIdentity
public record CreateCustomerRequest(

        @NotNull
        CustomerType customerType,

        String nationalId,

        String companyRegistrationNumber

) {}
```

### Validator

```java
public class ValidCustomerIdentityValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidCustomerIdentity, CreateCustomerRequest> {

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            CreateCustomerRequest value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.customerType() == null) {
            return true;
        }

        return switch (value.customerType()) {
            case INDIVIDUAL -> validateIndividual(value, context);
            case BUSINESS -> validateBusiness(value, context);
        };
    }

    private boolean validateIndividual(
            CreateCustomerRequest value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (hasText(value.nationalId())) {
            return true;
        }

        addFieldViolation(
                context,
                "nationalId",
                "nationalId is required for individual customer"
        );

        return false;
    }

    private boolean validateBusiness(
            CreateCustomerRequest value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (hasText(value.companyRegistrationNumber())) {
            return true;
        }

        addFieldViolation(
                context,
                "companyRegistrationNumber",
                "companyRegistrationNumber is required for business customer"
        );

        return false;
    }

    private void addFieldViolation(
            ConstraintValidatorContext context,
            String field,
            String message
    ) {
        context.disableDefaultConstraintViolation();
        context.buildConstraintViolationWithTemplate(message)
                .addPropertyNode(field)
                .addConstraintViolation();
    }

    private boolean hasText(String value) {
        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
    }
}
```

Kunci penting: class-level validator sebaiknya tetap mengarahkan violation ke field spesifik dengan `addPropertyNode(...)`, supaya response API bisa menunjuk field yang salah.

---

## 7. Date Range Constraint

### Use case

```text
effectiveFrom harus <= effectiveTo
```

### Annotation

```java
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = ValidDateRangeValidator.class)
public @interface ValidDateRange {

    String message() default "{date.range.invalid}";

    String from();

    String to();

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

### DTO

```java
@ValidDateRange(from = "effectiveFrom", to = "effectiveTo")
public record CreatePolicyRequest(

        @NotNull
        LocalDate effectiveFrom,

        @NotNull
        LocalDate effectiveTo

) {}
```

### Validator sederhana untuk DTO spesifik

Versi paling maintainable untuk onboarding biasanya **DTO-specific**, bukan reflection-based generic validator.

```java
public class ValidDateRangeValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidDateRange, CreatePolicyRequest> {

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            CreatePolicyRequest value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return true;
        }

        if (value.effectiveFrom() == null || value.effectiveTo() == null) {
            return true;
        }

        if (!value.effectiveFrom().isAfter(value.effectiveTo())) {
            return true;
        }

        context.disableDefaultConstraintViolation();
        context.buildConstraintViolationWithTemplate(
                "effectiveFrom must be before or equal to effectiveTo"
        ).addPropertyNode("effectiveFrom")
         .addConstraintViolation();

        return false;
    }
}
```

Reflection-based validator bisa terlihat reusable, tetapi sering lebih rapuh:

```text
Risiko reflection-based validator:
- field rename tidak tertangkap compile-time
- record accessor vs getter handling berbeda
- error muncul saat runtime
- sulit refactor
```

Untuk sistem enterprise yang butuh defensibility, validator eksplisit sering lebih aman.

---

## 8. At-Least-One Field Required

### Use case

Search endpoint boleh menerima salah satu filter:

```text
customerId OR email OR phoneNumber wajib ada minimal satu
```

### DTO

```java
@AtLeastOneCustomerSearchField
public record SearchCustomerRequest(

        UUID customerId,

        String email,

        String phoneNumber

) {}
```

### Annotation

```java
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = AtLeastOneCustomerSearchFieldValidator.class)
public @interface AtLeastOneCustomerSearchField {

    String message() default "{customer.search.atLeastOneRequired}";

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

### Validator

```java
public class AtLeastOneCustomerSearchFieldValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<
                AtLeastOneCustomerSearchField,
                SearchCustomerRequest
        > {

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            SearchCustomerRequest value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return true;
        }

        boolean hasAny =
                value.customerId() != null ||
                hasText(value.email()) ||
                hasText(value.phoneNumber());

        if (hasAny) {
            return true;
        }

        context.disableDefaultConstraintViolation();
        context.buildConstraintViolationWithTemplate(
                "At least one search field is required"
        ).addConstraintViolation();

        return false;
    }

    private boolean hasText(String value) {
        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
    }
}
```

Karena error ini bukan milik satu field tertentu, boleh muncul di object root. Tetapi untuk frontend form, kadang lebih membantu menambahkan error ke semua field candidate.

---

## 9. No Duplicate Items Constraint

### Use case

Bulk request tidak boleh punya duplicate `orderId`.

```java
public record BulkCancelOrderRequest(

        @NotEmpty
        @NoDuplicateOrderIds
        List<@NotNull UUID> orderIds

) {}
```

### Annotation

```java
@Target({
        ElementType.FIELD,
        ElementType.PARAMETER,
        ElementType.RECORD_COMPONENT
})
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = NoDuplicateOrderIdsValidator.class)
public @interface NoDuplicateOrderIds {

    String message() default "{order.ids.duplicate}";

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

### Validator

```java
public class NoDuplicateOrderIdsValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<NoDuplicateOrderIds, List<UUID>> {

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            List<UUID> value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }

        Set<UUID> seen = new HashSet<>();

        for (UUID id : value) {
            if (id == null) {
                continue; // biarkan List<@NotNull UUID> melaporkan
            }

            if (!seen.add(id)) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

Alternatif yang lebih reusable:

```java
@NoDuplicates
List<@NotNull UUID> orderIds
```

Tetapi generic duplicate validator untuk object kompleks perlu extractor/key function, dan itu sering lebih rumit daripada manfaatnya.

---

## 10. Conditional Validation dengan Groups

### Group marker

```java
public interface Create {}
public interface Update {}
public interface Patch {}
```

### DTO

```java
public record CustomerMutationRequest(

        @NotNull(groups = Update.class)
        UUID id,

        @NotBlank(groups = Create.class)
        String name,

        @Email(groups = {Create.class, Update.class, Patch.class})
        String email,

        @NotNull(groups = {Create.class, Update.class})
        CustomerStatus status

) {}
```

### Manual validation

```java
public final class RequestValidator {

    private final Validator validator;

    public RequestValidator(Validator validator) {
        this.validator = validator;
    }

    public <T> void validate(T request, Class<?> group) {
        Set<ConstraintViolation<T>> violations =
                validator.validate(request, group);

        if (!violations.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ConstraintViolationException(violations);
        }
    }
}
```

Jakarta Validation mendefinisikan groups sebagai cara menjalankan subset constraint tertentu; tanpa group eksplisit, constraint berada dalam `Default` group. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/bean-validation/3.1/jakarta-validation-spec-3.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Rule praktis:

| Kondisi | Pilihan lebih baik |
|---|---|
| Create/update beda sedikit | Validation group masih oke |
| Create/update/patch beda besar | DTO terpisah |
| Patch butuh absent/null/clear | DTO patch khusus / wrapper |
| Banyak field punya banyak group | Desain mulai tidak sehat |
| Rule tergantung database/state | Service/domain |

---

## 11. Group Sequence

Group sequence berguna kalau validasi harus bertahap.

```java
public interface BasicChecks {}
public interface CrossFieldChecks {}

@GroupSequence({
        BasicChecks.class,
        CrossFieldChecks.class
})
public interface CreateOrderChecks {}
```

Contoh DTO:

```java
@ValidDateRange(groups = CrossFieldChecks.class)
public record CreateOrderRequest(

        @NotNull(groups = BasicChecks.class)
        LocalDate effectiveFrom,

        @NotNull(groups = BasicChecks.class)
        LocalDate effectiveTo

) {}
```

Validasi:

```java
validator.validate(request, CreateOrderChecks.class);
```

Interpretasi:

```text
1. Jalankan BasicChecks.
2. Jika gagal, berhenti.
3. Jika lolos, lanjut CrossFieldChecks.
```

Gunakan group sequence untuk mencegah validator cross-field berjalan ketika field dasar belum valid.

---

## 12. Error Code Mapping

Jangan jadikan `message` sebagai machine contract.

Lebih baik:

```json
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "message": "Request validation failed",
  "correlationId": "req-123",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field": "effectiveFrom",
      "code": "DATE_RANGE_INVALID",
      "message": "effectiveFrom must be before or equal to effectiveTo"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Custom payload untuk severity atau code

Jakarta Validation constraint punya atribut `payload`, tetapi dalam praktik API sering lebih sederhana membuat mapping annotation → error code.

```java
public final class ValidationErrorCodeRegistry {

    private static final Map<String, String> CODES = Map.of(
            "NotNull", "FIELD_REQUIRED",
            "NotBlank", "FIELD_REQUIRED",
            "Size", "FIELD_SIZE_INVALID",
            "Email", "FIELD_EMAIL_INVALID",
            "ValidDateRange", "DATE_RANGE_INVALID",
            "ValidCustomerIdentity", "CUSTOMER_IDENTITY_INVALID",
            "NoDuplicateOrderIds", "DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID"
    );

    public String resolve(ConstraintViolation<?> violation) {
        String annotationName = violation.getConstraintDescriptor()
                .getAnnotation()
                .annotationType()
                .getSimpleName();

        return CODES.getOrDefault(annotationName, annotationName);
    }
}
```

### ExceptionMapper

```java
@Provider
public class ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<ConstraintViolationException> {

    private final ValidationErrorCodeRegistry codeRegistry =
            new ValidationErrorCodeRegistry();

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(ConstraintViolationException exception) {
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors = exception.getConstraintViolations()
                .stream()
                .map(this::toFieldError)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(FieldErrorResponse::field))
                .toList();

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                "Request validation failed",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                errors
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private FieldErrorResponse toFieldError(ConstraintViolation<?> violation) {
        return new FieldErrorResponse(
                normalizePath(violation.getPropertyPath()),
                codeRegistry.resolve(violation),
                violation.getMessage()
        );
    }

    private String normalizePath(Path path) {
        String raw = path.toString();

        return raw
                .replaceFirst("^create\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^update\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^patch\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^arg0\\.", "");
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Jersey mendukung Bean Validation melalui modul `jersey-bean-validation`, termasuk configuration, registration, dan usage; Jersey juga menyediakan `ValidationConfig` yang dapat dipasok melalui `ContextResolver` untuk menyesuaikan validasi. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 13. Custom Message Interpolation

### DTO

```java
public record CreateCustomerRequest(

        @NotBlank(message = "{customer.name.required}")
        String name,

        @Email(message = "{customer.email.invalid}")
        String email

) {}
```

### `ValidationMessages.properties`

```properties
customer.name.required=Customer name is required
customer.email.invalid=Customer email is invalid
date.range.invalid=Date range is invalid
order.ids.duplicate=Order IDs must not contain duplicate values
```

### Prinsip

| Elemen | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `code` | Machine-readable, stabil |
| `message` | Human-readable, bisa localized |
| `field` | Lokasi error di request |
| `correlationId` | Debugging/traceability |

Untuk API enterprise, jangan biarkan client mengambil keputusan dari message.

---

## 14. Validator dengan Dependency

Kadang validator butuh dependency. Contoh:

```text
@ValidCountryCode
```

Valid jika kode negara ada di catalog lokal.

### Annotation

```java
@Target({
        ElementType.FIELD,
        ElementType.PARAMETER,
        ElementType.RECORD_COMPONENT
})
@Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = ValidCountryCodeValidator.class)
public @interface ValidCountryCode {

    String message() default "{country.code.invalid}";

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

### Validator

```java
public class ValidCountryCodeValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidCountryCode, String> {

    private final CountryCatalog countryCatalog;

    public ValidCountryCodeValidator(CountryCatalog countryCatalog) {
        this.countryCatalog = countryCatalog;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            String value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return true;
        }

        return countryCatalog.exists(value);
    }
}
```

### Risiko

```text
Validator dengan dependency bisa bermasalah jika:
- dependency injection tidak aktif untuk validator
- validator melakukan query database berat
- validator memanggil external service
- validator punya side effect
- validator butuh tenant/user context
```

### Batas aman

| Rule | Cocok di validator? |
|---|---:|
| Format kode negara valid | Ya |
| Kode ada di in-memory/static catalog | Ya, hati-hati |
| Kode aktif untuk tenant tertentu | Lebih baik service |
| Kode boleh dipakai user ini | Service/domain |
| Harus cek database transaksional | Service/domain |
| Harus panggil external system | Service/domain |

Hibernate Validator menyediakan integrasi CDI dan constraint validator factory, tetapi fitur integrasi dependency perlu dipastikan cocok dengan runtime Jersey/HK2/CDI yang dipakai. ([Hibernate Documentation](https://docs.hibernate.org/stable/validator/reference/en-US/html_single/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 15. Validation Architecture Boundary

### Jangan begini

```java
public class ValidOrderCancellationValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidOrderCancellation, CancelOrderRequest> {

    private final OrderRepository repository;

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(CancelOrderRequest value, ConstraintValidatorContext ctx) {
        Order order = repository.findById(value.orderId());

        return order.status() == OrderStatus.SUBMITTED;
    }
}
```

Masalah:

```text
- validator melakukan database lookup
- status order bisa berubah antara validasi dan service execution
- transaction boundary tidak jelas
- authorization belum tentu tersedia
- race condition tersembunyi
- error lebih tepat sebagai domain conflict, bukan field validation
```

### Lebih baik

DTO validation:

```java
public record CancelOrderRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID orderId,

        @Size(max = 500)
        String reason

) {}
```

Service/domain validation:

```java
public OrderResult cancel(CancelOrderCommand command) {
    Order order = orderRepository.getRequired(command.orderId());

    if (!order.canBeCancelled()) {
        throw new DomainException(
                "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
                "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
                DomainErrorCategory.CONFLICT
        );
    }

    order.cancel(command.reason(), command.actorUserId());

    orderRepository.save(order);

    return OrderResult.from(order);
}
```

Response:

```json
{
  "code": "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
  "message": "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
  "correlationId": "req-123",
  "errors": []
}
```

---

## 16. Decision Matrix: Validator vs Service/Domain

| Rule | Bean Validation | Service/Domain |
|---|---:|---:|
| Field wajib | Ya | Guard optional |
| String max length | Ya | Tidak utama |
| Email format | Ya | Verification di service |
| Start date <= end date | Ya, jika lokal DTO | Bisa juga domain |
| Amount > 0 | Ya | Domain juga boleh enforce |
| Currency supported globally | Bisa | Bisa |
| Currency supported untuk tenant | Tidak ideal | Ya |
| User boleh melakukan action | Tidak | Ya |
| State transition valid | Tidak | Ya |
| Record exists | Tidak ideal | Ya |
| Duplicate berdasarkan DB unique key | Tidak | Ya + DB constraint |
| Rule butuh external system | Tidak | Ya |
| Rule berubah berdasarkan workflow | Tidak | Ya |
| Rule perlu audit trail | Tidak | Ya |

Rule of thumb:

```text
Jika rule hanya membutuhkan value di DTO → validator.
Jika rule membutuhkan state sistem → service/domain.
Jika rule menentukan lifecycle/state transition → domain.
Jika rule berkaitan dengan permission → authorization layer/service.
```

---

## 17. Validation Flow untuk Create/Update/Patch

```text
Create
  ↓
Request DTO constraint
  ↓
Cross-field validation
  ↓
MapStruct DTO → Command
  ↓
Domain/service rule
  ↓
Persist

Update
  ↓
Path param validation
  ↓
Request DTO constraint
  ↓
MapStruct DTO → Command
  ↓
Load existing aggregate
  ↓
Domain consistency/state validation
  ↓
Persist

Patch
  ↓
Patch shape validation
  ↓
Absent/null/value resolution
  ↓
Patch mapper/manual applier
  ↓
Domain invariant check
  ↓
Persist
```

Patch adalah case paling rawan karena Bean Validation tidak selalu tahu apakah suatu field **absent** atau **explicit null** setelah deserialization.

---

## 18. Pattern untuk Patch Field Wrapper

### Wrapper

```java
public record PatchField<T>(
        boolean present,
        T value
) {
    public static <T> PatchField<T> absent() {
        return new PatchField<>(false, null);
    }

    public static <T> PatchField<T> of(T value) {
        return new PatchField<>(true, value);
    }
}
```

### DTO

```java
public record PatchCustomerRequest(

        PatchField<String> name,

        PatchField<String> email,

        PatchField<String> phoneNumber

) {}
```

### Manual validator/applier

```java
public class CustomerPatchApplier {

    public void apply(PatchCustomerRequest request, Customer customer) {
        if (request.name() != null && request.name().present()) {
            customer.changeName(request.name().value());
        }

        if (request.email() != null && request.email().present()) {
            customer.changeEmail(request.email().value());
        }

        if (request.phoneNumber() != null && request.phoneNumber().present()) {
            customer.changePhoneNumber(request.phoneNumber().value());
        }
    }
}
```

Untuk patch kompleks, manual applier sering lebih jelas daripada mencoba memaksa semua logic ke MapStruct atau Bean Validation.

---

## 19. Method Validation di Resource dan Service

### Resource parameter validation

```java
@GET
@Path("/{id}")
public Response getById(
        @PathParam("id") @NotNull UUID id
) {
    OrderResult result = service.getById(id);
    return Response.ok(mapper.toResponse(result)).build();
}
```

### Service method validation

```java
public class OrderService {

    public @NotNull OrderResult getById(@NotNull UUID id) {
        return repository.findRequired(id);
    }
}
```

Jakarta Validation mendukung validasi method/constructor parameter dan return value; Jersey Bean Validation support juga mencakup validasi resource class dan method. ([Bean Validation](https://beanvalidation.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Praktisnya:

```text
Resource method validation:
- path param
- query param
- header param
- request DTO

Service method validation:
- internal contract
- defensive programming
- return value guarantee
```

Namun business failure tetap lebih baik dinyatakan sebagai domain exception.

## 20. Testing Custom Constraint

### Unit test field constraint

```java
class ValidCustomerCodeValidatorTest {

    private static Validator validator;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setup() {
        validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory()
                .getValidator();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidCustomerCode() {
        CreateCustomerRequest request =
                new CreateCustomerRequest("cust-abc", "Alice");

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CreateCustomerRequest>> violations =
                validator.validate(request);

        assertTrue(violations.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath().toString()
                        .equals("customerCode")));
    }
}
```

### Unit test class-level constraint

```java
class ValidCustomerIdentityValidatorTest {

    private static Validator validator;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setup() {
        validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory()
                .getValidator();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectBusinessCustomerWithoutRegistrationNumber() {
        CreateCustomerRequest request = new CreateCustomerRequest(
                CustomerType.BUSINESS,
                null,
                null
        );

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CreateCustomerRequest>> violations =
                validator.validate(request);

        assertTrue(violations.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath().toString()
                        .equals("companyRegistrationNumber")));
    }
}
```

### API contract test

```text
POST /customers
body invalid
  ↓
HTTP 400
  ↓
code = VALIDATION_FAILED
  ↓
errors[].field = companyRegistrationNumber
  ↓
errors[].code = CUSTOMER_IDENTITY_INVALID
  ↓
correlationId exists
```

---

## 21. Production Checklist

```text
[ ] Custom constraint annotation punya message, groups, payload.
[ ] Validator return true untuk null jika nullability ditangani constraint lain.
[ ] Class-level validator mengarahkan error ke field spesifik bila memungkinkan.
[ ] Message tidak dijadikan machine contract.
[ ] Error code mapping stabil.
[ ] ConstraintViolationException dinormalisasi lewat ExceptionMapper.
[ ] Validator tidak melakukan side effect.
[ ] Validator tidak melakukan DB/API call tanpa alasan kuat.
[ ] Rule state transition tetap di domain/service.
[ ] Patch absent/null semantics terdokumentasi.
[ ] Validation group tidak berlebihan.
[ ] Custom validator punya unit test.
[ ] Error response punya contract test.
[ ] Jersey bean validation module/config dicek di runtime.
```

---

## 22. Common Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| Validator query database untuk state transition | Race condition, transaction blur | Service/domain invariant |
| Semua custom rule jadi annotation | Validasi sulit dibaca | DTO/service split |
| Message jadi error code | Client rapuh | Explicit error code mapping |
| Class-level violation tidak punya field path | Frontend sulit highlight field | `addPropertyNode(...)` |
| Terlalu banyak validation group | Constraint sulit diaudit | DTO per use case |
| Validator punya side effect | Validasi tidak idempotent | Pure validator |
| Patch pakai null tanpa policy | Data bisa terhapus diam-diam | wrapper / manual patch applier |
| Raw violation path dikirim | `create.arg0.items[0]...` bocor | Normalize path |
| Domain error dikirim sebagai validation error | HTTP semantics kacau | DomainExceptionMapper |

---

## 23. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Pahami anatomy custom constraint:
   annotation + ConstraintValidator
   ↓
2. Buat field-level validator sederhana
   ↓
3. Buat class-level cross-field validator
   ↓
4. Pelajari ConstraintValidatorContext untuk field path
   ↓
5. Standarkan error response dan error code mapping
   ↓
6. Gunakan validation group hanya untuk use case sederhana
   ↓
7. Pisahkan DTO validation dari domain invariant
   ↓
8. Tangani patch absent/null/value secara eksplisit
   ↓
9. Test custom validator langsung dengan Validator
   ↓
10. Test error contract via Jersey integration test
```

## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:36:35 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke hardening JSON/XML serialization. Saya akan prioritaskan rujukan resmi/spec/docs supaya rekomendasi seperti unknown fields, enum handling, XML external entity, dan payload limit tidak berdasarkan asumsi.

# Cheatsheet - JSON/XML Serialization Hardening di Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Di aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, hardening serialization/deserialization berarti membuat aturan eksplisit untuk:

```text
HTTP body → JSON/XML parser → DTO → validation → mapper → service
service result → DTO → JSON/XML writer → HTTP response
```

Titik bahayanya ada di boundary: payload terlalu besar, unknown field, enum invalid, number overflow, unsafe polymorphic deserialization, XML external entity, schema external access, response field sensitif bocor, dan default serializer berubah saat upgrade.

Jakarta REST mendefinisikan entity provider sebagai mapping layer antara representasi HTTP dan Java type melalui `MessageBodyReader` dan `MessageBodyWriter`, jadi hardening harus dipasang di provider/configuration boundary, bukan tersebar di resource method. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         HTTP Boundary                            │
│                                                                  │
│  Request                                                         │
│  ├─ Content-Type                                                 │
│  ├─ Accept                                                       │
│  ├─ body size                                                    │
│  ├─ charset                                                      │
│  └─ correlation id                                               │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                               │
                               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Jersey Entity Provider                         │
│                                                                  │
│  MessageBodyReader / MessageBodyWriter                           │
│                                                                  │
│  JSON path:                                                      │
│  ├─ Jackson ObjectMapper                                         │
│  ├─ JSON-B JsonbConfig                                           │
│  └─ JSON-P streaming/object model                                │
│                                                                  │
│  XML path:                                                       │
│  ├─ JAXB / Jakarta XML Binding                                   │
│  ├─ Jackson XML XmlMapper                                        │
│  ├─ JAXP / StAX parser config                                    │
│  └─ XXE / DTD / external access controls                         │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                               │
                               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       DTO Contract Layer                          │
│                                                                  │
│  - strict field policy                                           │
│  - enum policy                                                   │
│  - temporal policy                                               │
│  - numeric precision policy                                      │
│  - null / absent policy                                          │
│  - validation annotations                                        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                               │
                               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Error Normalization                          │
│                                                                  │
│  JsonParseException / JsonMappingException → INVALID_JSON         │
│  JAXBException / XMLStreamException            → INVALID_XML      │
│  ConstraintViolationException                  → VALIDATION_FAILED│
│  PayloadTooLargeException                      → PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE│
│  DomainException                               → DOMAIN_ERROR     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang perlu dikuasai | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Provider selection | Menentukan JSON/XML provider yang aktif | Jackson vs JSON-B vs JAXB vs Jackson XML | Provider bentrok / config tidak kepakai |
| 2 | ObjectMapper governance | Satu policy JSON terpusat | `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>` | Tiap resource punya mapper berbeda |
| 3 | Unknown field policy | Menentukan strict/tolerant input | `FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES` | Typo field diterima diam-diam |
| 4 | Enum policy | Mencegah enum corrupt | reject number, reject unknown, DTO enum | Enum invalid jadi null/default |
| 5 | Temporal policy | Konsistensi waktu | `Instant`, `OffsetDateTime`, ISO-8601 | Timezone hilang |
| 6 | Numeric policy | Presisi angka | `BigDecimal`, number length, no double for money | Money/amount kehilangan presisi |
| 7 | Null/coercion policy | Mencegah silent conversion | null primitive, scalar coercion, empty string | `"123"` jadi number, `null` jadi `0` |
| 8 | Polymorphic deserialization | Mencegah unsafe subtype loading | avoid default typing, allow-list subtype | Gadget/RCE classpath risk |
| 9 | Payload constraints | Menahan payload terlalu besar/dalam | body limit, nesting, string length, number length | memory pressure / parser DoS |
| 10 | JSON-B config | Standard Jakarta JSON binding policy | `JsonbConfig`, adapter, naming/date/null | Default provider behavior tidak jelas |
| 11 | JSON-P streaming | Proses JSON besar/dinamis | `JsonParser`, `JsonGenerator` | Semua payload dibaca jadi object penuh |
| 12 | XML parser hardening | Mencegah XXE/SSRF/file disclosure | disable DTD, external entity, external access | XXE, SSRF, local file leak |
| 13 | JAXB hardening | XML binding aman | secure `XMLInputFactory`, secure `SchemaFactory` | JAXB unmarshal dari parser tidak aman |
| 14 | Jackson XML hardening | XML via Jackson aman | `XmlMapper`, `XmlFactory`, StAX config | XML dianggap sama dengan JSON |
| 15 | Response filtering | Mencegah field sensitif bocor | response DTO, explicit mapping | internal field serialized |
| 16 | Error contract | Normalisasi parser/mapping error | `ExceptionMapper` | raw stack trace/framework error |
| 17 | Contract tests | Menjaga format stabil | golden file, invalid payload test | upgrade library mengubah API |
| 18 | Upgrade governance | Menahan breaking default change | pinned config, BOM, release note review | default berubah saat major upgrade |

---

## 4. Baseline Policy yang Disarankan

Untuk aplikasi internal enterprise / regulatory system, default aman biasanya:

| Concern | Rekomendasi |
|---|---|
| JSON provider | Pilih satu default: Jackson **atau** JSON-B |
| Unknown field | Strict untuk command API internal; tolerant hanya jika contract memang backward-compatible |
| Enum input | Reject unknown dan reject numeric enum |
| Enum output | Pertimbangkan enum DTO, bukan domain enum langsung |
| Date/time | ISO-8601, prefer `Instant`/`OffsetDateTime` untuk event absolut |
| Money/amount | `BigDecimal`, jangan `double` |
| Null primitive | Fail, jangan `null → 0/false` |
| Polymorphic JSON | Jangan global default typing untuk untrusted input |
| Payload size | Batasi di ingress/proxy + app + parser constraints |
| XML | Disable DTD/external entity/external schema by default |
| Error response | Jangan expose raw parser/framework exception |
| Tests | Success payload + invalid payload + upgrade regression |

Catatan penting untuk upgrade: Jackson 3.0 mengubah sejumlah default, termasuk `FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES` menjadi `false`, dan Jackson 3.1 ditandai sebagai LTS line oleh FasterXML. Artinya, jangan pernah mengandalkan default serializer/deserializer untuk API contract penting; set policy eksplisit di konfigurasi. ([GitHub](https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson/wiki/Jackson-Release-3.0?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 5. Jackson ObjectMapper Hardening

### 5.1 Centralized `ObjectMapper`

Di Jersey, pasang konfigurasi Jackson melalui `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>` agar provider JSON memakai mapper yang sama.

```java
@Provider
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class ObjectMapperProvider implements ContextResolver<ObjectMapper> {

    private final ObjectMapper mapper;

    public ObjectMapperProvider() {
        JsonFactory jsonFactory = JsonFactory.builder()
                .streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder()
                        .maxNestingDepth(100)
                        .maxNumberLength(100)
                        .maxStringLength(1_000_000)
                        .build())
                .build();

        this.mapper = JsonMapper.builder(jsonFactory)
                .addModule(new JavaTimeModule())

                // Temporal policy
                .disable(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS)
                .disable(DeserializationFeature.ADJUST_DATES_TO_CONTEXT_TIME_ZONE)

                // Input strictness
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES)
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS)
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_NULL_FOR_PRIMITIVES)
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_NUMBERS_FOR_ENUMS)

                // Numeric precision
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS)

                // Output policy
                .serializationInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL)

                .build();

        // Optional, depending on Jackson version used:
        this.mapper.disable(MapperFeature.ALLOW_COERCION_OF_SCALARS);
    }

    @Override
    public ObjectMapper getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return mapper;
    }
}
```

Jackson `StreamReadConstraints` dirancang untuk membatasi input yang “terlalu besar” seperti nesting, string, dan number length; constraint ini didaftarkan pada `JsonFactory`/`TokenStreamFactory`. ([Javadoc](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core/latest/com/fasterxml/jackson/core/StreamReadConstraints.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### 5.2 Policy Table

| Setting | Rekomendasi | Kenapa |
|---|---|---|
| `FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES` | Enable untuk command API | Menangkap typo field dan contract drift |
| `FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS` | Enable | Mencegah payload ganda/terselip setelah JSON valid |
| `FAIL_ON_NULL_FOR_PRIMITIVES` | Enable | Mencegah `null` menjadi `0`/`false` |
| `FAIL_ON_NUMBERS_FOR_ENUMS` | Enable | Mencegah enum ordinal masuk dari client |
| `USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS` | Enable untuk untyped decimal | Menjaga presisi angka |
| `WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS` | Disable | Output waktu lebih terbaca dan interoperable |
| `ALLOW_COERCION_OF_SCALARS` | Disable jika kompatibel | Mencegah string/number/boolean saling konversi diam-diam |
| `setSerializationInclusion` | Eksplisit | Output null policy stabil |

Jackson `DeserializationFeature` menyediakan kontrol seperti unknown properties, enum numeric values, dan behavior deserialization lain; detail default dapat berbeda antar major version sehingga konfigurasi eksplisit lebih aman daripada bergantung pada default. ([Javadoc](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-databind/latest/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/DeserializationFeature.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 6. Unknown Field Strategy

Pilih policy per jenis API.

| API type | Unknown field policy | Alasan |
|---|---|---|
| Internal command API | Strict | Typo harus gagal cepat |
| Public backward-compatible API | Tolerant | Client lama/baru bisa overlap |
| Webhook receiver | Tolerant + audit | Provider eksternal bisa menambah field |
| Regulatory/enforcement command | Strict | Defensibility dan audit lebih penting |
| Analytics/event ingestion | Tolerant + schema registry | Evolusi event lebih sering |

Contoh strict:

```java
mapper.enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES);
```

Contoh tolerant untuk DTO tertentu:

```java
@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true)
public record ExternalWebhookRequest(
        String eventId,
        String eventType,
        JsonNode payload
) {}
```

Rekomendasi: jangan mencampur strict/tolerant secara tidak sadar. Tulis keputusan itu sebagai bagian dari API contract.

---

## 7. Enum Strategy

### 7.1 Jangan expose enum domain mentah jika domain sering berubah

```java
public enum CaseStatus {
    DRAFT,
    SUBMITTED,
    UNDER_REVIEW,
    ESCALATED,
    CLOSED,

    // internal only
    INTERNAL_REOPEN_PENDING
}
```

Response DTO sebaiknya punya enum publik:

```java
public enum CaseStatusDto {
    DRAFT,
    SUBMITTED,
    UNDER_REVIEW,
    ESCALATED,
    CLOSED,
    UNKNOWN
}
```

### 7.2 Input enum harus strict

```java
mapper.enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_NUMBERS_FOR_ENUMS);
```

Untuk input command, hindari fallback diam-diam:

```java
public record UpdateCaseStatusRequest(
        @NotNull CaseStatusDto status
) {}
```

Jackson 3 memindahkan beberapa fitur enum ke area konfigurasi baru dan mengubah sejumlah default enum/date behavior; ini memperkuat alasan untuk menguji semua enum contract saat upgrade major version. ([GitHub](https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson/wiki/Jackson-Release-3.0?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 8. Temporal Policy

Gunakan policy eksplisit:

| Use case | Java type | JSON format |
|---|---|---|
| Event timestamp absolut | `Instant` | `"2026-07-13T02:15:30Z"` |
| Timestamp dengan offset | `OffsetDateTime` | `"2026-07-13T09:15:30+07:00"` |
| Tanggal bisnis | `LocalDate` | `"2026-07-13"` |
| Jam lokal | `LocalTime` | `"09:15:30"` |
| Jadwal lokal tanpa zona | `LocalDateTime` | Hati-hati, butuh timezone context |

Konfigurasi Jackson 2.x umum:

```java
mapper.registerModule(new JavaTimeModule());
mapper.disable(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS);
mapper.disable(DeserializationFeature.ADJUST_DATES_TO_CONTEXT_TIME_ZONE);
```

Rule praktis:

```text
- Jangan pakai LocalDateTime untuk event absolut.
- Jangan kirim timestamp epoch jika client manusia/integrasi sulit audit.
- Jangan biarkan timezone implied oleh server.
- Test serialisasi/deserialisasi timezone di contract test.
```

---

## 9. Numeric Policy

Untuk sistem order, billing, pricing, enforcement penalty, fee, atau monetary value:

```java
public record PaymentRequest(
        @NotNull
        @Digits(integer = 18, fraction = 2)
        BigDecimal amount,

        @NotBlank
        String currency
) {}
```

Jangan:

```java
public record PaymentRequest(
        double amount,
        String currency
) {}
```

Tambahkan parser guard:

```java
JsonFactory jsonFactory = JsonFactory.builder()
        .streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder()
                .maxNumberLength(100)
                .build())
        .build();
```

Jackson `StreamReadConstraints` secara eksplisit mencakup batas untuk input construct seperti number/string/nesting, sehingga cocok sebagai guardrail tambahan selain validasi DTO. ([Javadoc](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core/latest/com/fasterxml/jackson/core/StreamReadConstraints.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 10. Polymorphic Deserialization Hardening

Polymorphic deserialization adalah area berisiko jika input tidak dipercaya.

Jangan aktifkan global default typing seperti ini untuk request publik/untrusted:

```java
// Hindari untuk untrusted input
mapper.activateDefaultTyping(
        BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator.builder()
                .allowIfSubType(Object.class)
                .build()
);
```

Lebih aman:

```java
@JsonTypeInfo(
        use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME,
        include = JsonTypeInfo.As.PROPERTY,
        property = "type"
)
@JsonSubTypes({
        @JsonSubTypes.Type(value = EmailNotificationRequest.class, name = "EMAIL"),
        @JsonSubTypes.Type(value = SmsNotificationRequest.class, name = "SMS")
})
public sealed interface NotificationRequest
        permits EmailNotificationRequest, SmsNotificationRequest {
}
```

Jackson mendokumentasikan polymorphic type handling sebagai cara agar deserializer bisa menentukan subtype dari supertype; untuk default typing, pilihan `PolymorphicTypeValidator` penting secara security karena allow-all subtype untuk untrusted content berisiko. ([GitHub](https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-docs/wiki/JacksonPolymorphicDeserialization?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Rule praktis:

| Situasi | Rekomendasi |
|---|---|
| Input public/untrusted | Hindari default typing |
| Butuh polymorphic DTO | Gunakan type name allow-list |
| Type id berisi FQCN class | Hindari |
| Sealed hierarchy Java 17+ | Baik untuk boundary yang tertutup |
| Event payload dinamis | Simpan sebagai `JsonNode` + validate envelope |

---

## 11. JSON-B Hardening

Jika stack memilih **JSON-B** sebagai standard Jakarta binding, hardening tetap harus eksplisit.

```java
@Provider
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class JsonbProvider implements ContextResolver<Jsonb> {

    private final Jsonb jsonb;

    public JsonbProvider() {
        JsonbConfig config = new JsonbConfig()
                .withNullValues(false)
                .withDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX", Locale.ROOT)
                .withFormatting(false)
                .withPropertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategy.IDENTITY);

        this.jsonb = JsonbBuilder.create(config);
    }

    @Override
    public Jsonb getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return jsonb;
    }
}
```

`JsonbConfig` adalah konfigurasi standar JSON-B untuk provider binding Java object ↔ JSON; spesifikasi/javadoc menyatakan provider JSON-B wajib mendukung sejumlah property standar, meskipun provider tertentu bisa menambah property tambahan. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/jsonb/3.0/apidocs/jakarta.json.bind/jakarta/json/bind/jsonbconfig?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Policy JSON-B:

| Concern | Rekomendasi |
|---|---|
| Null output | Eksplisit: include atau omit |
| Date format | Eksplisit |
| Naming strategy | Eksplisit |
| Adapter | Untuk value object sederhana |
| Unknown fields | Test provider behavior; jangan asumsi |
| Complex custom behavior | Pertimbangkan Jackson jika butuh kontrol luas |

---

## 12. JSON-P untuk Payload Besar/Dinamis

Gunakan **JSON-P streaming** kalau payload terlalu besar/dinamis untuk dibaca penuh sebagai DTO.

```java
public final class LargeEventReader {

    public void read(InputStream inputStream) {
        JsonParser parser = Json.createParser(inputStream);

        while (parser.hasNext()) {
            JsonParser.Event event = parser.next();

            if (event == JsonParser.Event.KEY_NAME) {
                String key = parser.getString();
                // process selected keys only
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Jakarta JSON Processing menyediakan object model dan streaming model untuk parse/generate/transform/query JSON; streaming API terdiri dari `JsonParser` dan `JsonGenerator`. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/learn/docs/jakartaee-tutorial/current/web/jsonp/jsonp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Gunakan JSON-P ketika:

| Kondisi | JSON-P cocok? |
|---|---:|
| Payload besar | Ya |
| Hanya perlu sebagian field | Ya |
| JSON sangat dinamis | Ya |
| DTO sederhana | Biasanya JSON-B/Jackson lebih praktis |
| Butuh typed validation dengan Bean Validation | DTO binding lebih praktis |

---

## 13. XML Hardening: XXE, DTD, External Access

XML harus diperlakukan lebih defensif daripada JSON karena fitur DTD, entity, external reference, schema, dan stylesheet bisa menjadi vektor XXE/SSRF/file disclosure.

OWASP menyarankan cara paling aman untuk mencegah XXE adalah menonaktifkan DTD/external entities sepenuhnya bila tidak diperlukan. Oracle JAXP security guide juga menjelaskan secure processing dan external access properties untuk membatasi resource eksternal seperti DTD, schema, dan stylesheet. ([OWASP Cheat Sheet Series](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/XML_External_Entity_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### 13.1 Secure `DocumentBuilderFactory`

```java
public final class SecureXml {

    public static DocumentBuilderFactory secureDocumentBuilderFactory()
            throws ParserConfigurationException {

        DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();

        factory.setNamespaceAware(true);
        factory.setXIncludeAware(false);
        factory.setExpandEntityReferences(false);

        factory.setFeature(XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, true);

        factory.setFeature(
                "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl",
                true
        );

        factory.setFeature(
                "http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities",
                false
        );

        factory.setFeature(
                "http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities",
                false
        );

        factory.setFeature(
                "http://apache.org/xml/features/nonvalidating/load-external-dtd",
                false
        );

        factory.setAttribute(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD, "");
        factory.setAttribute(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA, "");

        return factory;
    }
}
```

`XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING` meminta implementation memproses XML secara aman, sementara `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD`, `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA`, dan `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_STYLESHEET` adalah property standar untuk mengontrol external access. ([Oracle Docs](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/21/docs/api/java.xml/javax/xml/XMLConstants.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Catatan: beberapa feature URI bersifat parser-specific. Test di runtime container Anda, karena dependency XML parser transitive bisa mengubah behavior.

---

## 14. JAXB / Jakarta XML Binding Hardening

Untuk JAXB, jangan langsung unmarshal dari `InputStream` tanpa memastikan XML parser aman. Pola yang lebih aman: buat `XMLStreamReader` dari `XMLInputFactory` yang sudah dikunci.

```java
public final class SecureJaxbUnmarshaller {

    public static <T> T unmarshal(
            InputStream inputStream,
            Class<T> targetType
    ) throws JAXBException, XMLStreamException {

        XMLInputFactory xif = XMLInputFactory.newFactory();

        xif.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD, false);
        xif.setProperty("javax.xml.stream.isSupportingExternalEntities", false);
        xif.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_REPLACING_ENTITY_REFERENCES, false);

        XMLStreamReader xsr = xif.createXMLStreamReader(inputStream);

        JAXBContext context = JAXBContext.newInstance(targetType);
        Unmarshaller unmarshaller = context.createUnmarshaller();

        JAXBElement<T> result = unmarshaller.unmarshal(xsr, targetType);
        return result.getValue();
    }
}
```

Jika memakai XSD validation:

```java
public static Schema secureSchema(Source xsd)
        throws SAXException {

    SchemaFactory schemaFactory =
            SchemaFactory.newInstance(XMLConstants.W3C_XML_SCHEMA_NS_URI);

    schemaFactory.setFeature(XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, true);
    schemaFactory.setProperty(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD, "");
    schemaFactory.setProperty(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA, "");

    return schemaFactory.newSchema(xsd);
}
```

External access properties di JAXP 1.5 memang ditujukan untuk mengatur apakah XML processor boleh resolve external resource seperti DTD, schema, dan stylesheet. ([Oracle Docs](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/tutorial/jaxp/properties/properties.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 15. Jackson XML Hardening

Jackson XML berguna jika tim ingin model Jackson untuk XML juga, tetapi XML tetap punya risiko XML-specific.

```java
public final class XmlMapperProvider
        implements ContextResolver<XmlMapper> {

    private final XmlMapper xmlMapper;

    public XmlMapperProvider() {
        XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newFactory();
        inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD, false);
        inputFactory.setProperty(
                "javax.xml.stream.isSupportingExternalEntities",
                false
        );
        inputFactory.setProperty(
                XMLInputFactory.IS_REPLACING_ENTITY_REFERENCES,
                false
        );

        XmlFactory xmlFactory = XmlFactory.builder()
                .xmlInputFactory(inputFactory)
                .streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder()
                        .maxNestingDepth(100)
                        .maxStringLength(1_000_000)
                        .maxNumberLength(100)
                        .build())
                .build();

        this.xmlMapper = XmlMapper.builder(xmlFactory)
                .disable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES)
                .build();
    }

    @Override
    public XmlMapper getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return xmlMapper;
    }
}
```

Jackson XML adalah extension untuk membaca/menulis XML encoded data dan menyediakan `XmlParser`, `ToXmlGenerator`, dan `XmlFactory`; dokumentasi Jackson XML juga menekankan bahwa XML mapper menggunakan `XmlFactory` sebagai backend XML. ([GitHub](https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-dataformat-xml?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Prinsip penting:

```text
Jackson XML != JSON with angle brackets.

XML punya:
- attribute
- namespace
- wrapper element
- mixed content
- external entity
- DTD/schema access
```

---

## 16. Payload Limit Strategy

Jangan hanya mengandalkan parser. Buat limit berlapis.

```text
Client
  ↓
Ingress / Load balancer / Nginx
  ↓
Servlet container / Jersey runtime
  ↓
MessageBodyReader
  ↓
Jackson/JSON-B/JAXB parser constraint
  ↓
DTO validation
```

| Layer | Contoh limit |
|---|---|
| Nginx / ingress | max request body size |
| Servlet/container | request size / multipart size |
| Jersey filter | reject content-length terlalu besar |
| Jackson parser | nesting/string/number/document constraints |
| XML parser | secure processing + no DTD/external access |
| DTO validation | max list size, max string length |
| Service | batch item count, business quota |

Contoh Jersey request filter:

```java
@Provider
@Priority(Priorities.AUTHENTICATION)
public class PayloadSizeFilter implements ContainerRequestFilter {

    private static final long MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1_000_000;

    @Override
    public void filter(ContainerRequestContext requestContext) {
        String contentLength = requestContext.getHeaderString("Content-Length");

        if (contentLength == null) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            long size = Long.parseLong(contentLength);

            if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
                throw new PayloadTooLargeException("Payload too large");
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Invalid Content-Length");
        }
    }
}
```

Catatan: `Content-Length` bisa hilang pada chunked transfer, jadi filter ini bukan satu-satunya guard. Tetap pasang limit di ingress/container dan parser.

---

## 17. Error Mapping untuk Parser Failure

### Error DTO

```java
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors
) {}

public record FieldErrorResponse(
        String field,
        String code,
        String message
) {}
```

### Jackson error mapper

```java
@Provider
public class JsonProcessingExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<JsonProcessingException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(JsonProcessingException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "INVALID_JSON",
                "Malformed or incompatible JSON payload",
                MDC.get("correlationId"),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }
}
```

### XML error mapper

```java
@Provider
public class XmlExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<XMLStreamException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(XMLStreamException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "INVALID_XML",
                "Malformed or unsafe XML payload",
                MDC.get("correlationId"),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }
}
```

Jakarta REST uses `ExceptionMapper<T>` providers to convert exceptions into `Response`; mapper selection is based on the nearest superclass type match, so keep mapper specificity intentional. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 18. Response Serialization Safety

Response hardening sama pentingnya dengan request hardening.

Jangan:

```java
return Response.ok(orderEntity).build();
```

Lebih aman:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        String status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt
) {}
```

Gunakan MapStruct/manual mapper eksplisit:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderResponseMapper {

    @BeanMapping(ignoreByDefault = true)
    @Mapping(target = "id", source = "id")
    @Mapping(target = "orderNumber", source = "orderNumber")
    @Mapping(target = "status", source = "status")
    @Mapping(target = "totalAmount", source = "totalAmount")
    @Mapping(target = "currency", source = "currencyCode")
    @Mapping(target = "submittedAt", source = "submittedAt")
    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

Response safety checklist:

```text
[ ] Tidak serialize entity persistence langsung.
[ ] Tidak expose internal status.
[ ] Tidak expose audit/internal note kecuali memang public.
[ ] Tidak expose permission/role internal.
[ ] Tidak expose stack trace.
[ ] Tidak expose lazy relation graph.
[ ] Tidak expose PII tanpa policy.
```

---

## 19. Testing Strategy

Minimal test yang sebaiknya ada:

```text
JSON input:
[ ] malformed JSON → 400 INVALID_JSON
[ ] unknown field → 400 INVALID_JSON / INVALID_PAYLOAD
[ ] numeric enum → 400
[ ] unknown enum → 400
[ ] trailing token → 400
[ ] null primitive → 400
[ ] huge nesting → 400/413
[ ] huge string → 400/413
[ ] large number → 400

XML input:
[ ] malformed XML → 400 INVALID_XML
[ ] XML with DOCTYPE → rejected
[ ] XML external entity → rejected
[ ] XML external schema access → rejected
[ ] XML namespace/wrapper valid case → accepted
[ ] XML huge nesting/entity expansion → rejected

Response:
[ ] response golden file stable
[ ] no internal fields
[ ] date/time format stable
[ ] BigDecimal format stable
[ ] null policy stable
```

Contoh XXE test payload:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
  <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
]>
<order>
  <note>&xxe;</note>
</order>
```

Expected:

```text
HTTP 400
code = INVALID_XML
no file content in response
no file content in logs
```

---

## 20. Production Checklist

```text
Provider & config
[ ] Satu JSON provider default dipilih.
[ ] ObjectMapper/Jsonb/XmlMapper dikonfigurasi terpusat.
[ ] Config provider benar-benar dipakai Jersey.
[ ] Tidak ada mapper baru dibuat per request.

Jackson JSON
[ ] Unknown field policy eksplisit.
[ ] Enum numeric/unknown policy eksplisit.
[ ] Date/time policy eksplisit.
[ ] BigDecimal/numeric policy eksplisit.
[ ] Scalar coercion policy eksplisit.
[ ] StreamReadConstraints diset sesuai kebutuhan.
[ ] Default typing tidak aktif untuk untrusted input.

JSON-B / JSON-P
[ ] JsonbConfig null/date/naming eksplisit.
[ ] JSON-P dipakai untuk payload besar/dinamis.
[ ] Provider-specific behavior dites.

XML
[ ] DTD disabled.
[ ] External entity disabled.
[ ] ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD = "".
[ ] ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA = "".
[ ] FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING = true.
[ ] JAXB unmarshal lewat secure parser.
[ ] Jackson XML memakai secure XMLInputFactory.
[ ] XXE test ada di CI.

API contract
[ ] Error response distandarkan.
[ ] Parser error tidak bocor raw exception.
[ ] DTO bukan entity.
[ ] Sensitive field tidak terserialisasi.
[ ] Golden file test ada.
[ ] Upgrade dependency wajib menjalankan serialization regression test.
```

---

## 21. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Pahami Jersey MessageBodyReader/Writer
   ↓
2. Pilih JSON provider default: Jackson atau JSON-B
   ↓
3. Buat ObjectMapper/JsonbConfig terpusat
   ↓
4. Hardening unknown field, enum, temporal, numeric, null/coercion
   ↓
5. Pasang payload limits di ingress/container/parser/DTO
   ↓
6. Harden XML parser: no DTD, no external entity, no external schema
   ↓
7. Normalisasi parser exception via ExceptionMapper
   ↓
8. Buat golden file dan invalid payload tests
   ↓
9. Tambahkan XXE/security regression tests
   ↓
10. Masukkan serialization policy ke upgrade checklist
```

Saya lanjutkan ke exception mapping dan error contract. Fokusnya: taxonomy error yang konsisten, mapping exception → HTTP status, correlation ID, logging aman, dan membedakan parser/validation/domain/infrastructure failure.

# Cheatsheet - Jersey/JAX-RS Exception Mapping & Error Contract

## 1. Introduction

Dalam aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, error handling yang baik bukan sekadar `try-catch`. Yang dibutuhkan adalah **error contract** yang stabil, bisa diaudit, aman untuk client, dan tidak membocorkan detail internal.

Pipeline-nya:

```text id="s0gvdk"
Request
  ↓
Deserializer / MessageBodyReader
  ↓
Validation
  ↓
Mapper DTO → Command
  ↓
Service / Domain
  ↓
Persistence / External System
  ↓
Response / Exception
  ↓
ExceptionMapper
  ↓
API Error Response
```

Jakarta REST menyediakan `ExceptionMapper<T>` sebagai provider untuk mengubah exception menjadi `Response`; mapper dapat diregistrasikan secara programmatic atau diberi `@Provider` agar ditemukan runtime JAX-RS. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/apidocs/jakarta.ws.rs/jakarta/ws/rs/ext/exceptionmapper?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Jersey juga menyediakan dukungan Bean Validation melalui module `jersey-bean-validation`, termasuk konfigurasi, registrasi, dan integrasi validation error di resource JAX-RS. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang perlu dikuasai | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Error taxonomy | Mengelompokkan error | parser, validation, domain, infra, security | Semua error jadi 500 |
| 2 | `ExceptionMapper<T>` | Convert exception ke HTTP response | `@Provider`, nearest mapper, status mapping | Mapper terlalu umum menangkap semua error |
| 3 | Parser error mapping | Invalid JSON/XML | Jackson/JAXB/XML exception → 400 | Raw parser exception bocor |
| 4 | Validation error mapping | Constraint violation | `ConstraintViolationException` → error fields | Field path kacau |
| 5 | Domain error mapping | Business invariant failure | domain exception → 404/409/422 | Domain error dikira validation error |
| 6 | Security error mapping | AuthN/AuthZ failure | 401/403 | 401 vs 403 tertukar |
| 7 | Infrastructure error mapping | DB/external system failure | 503/504/500 | Detail DB/external service bocor |
| 8 | Error response model | Kontrak error standar | `code`, `message`, `correlationId`, `errors` | Message dijadikan machine contract |
| 9 | Field error model | Error per field | field path, error code, message | Client tidak bisa highlight field |
| 10 | Correlation ID | Trace request lintas log/service | request filter, response filter, MDC | ID tidak konsisten / tidak dibersihkan |
| 11 | Logging safety | Log internal tanpa bocor ke client | sanitized logging, severity, stack trace internal | PII/secret masuk log |
| 12 | HTTP semantics | Status code benar | 400/401/403/404/409/422/500/503 | Client recovery logic salah |
| 13 | Problem detail compatibility | Format error standar/portable | RFC-style error fields bila dibutuhkan | Format terlalu custom tanpa alasan |
| 14 | Test strategy | Error contract stabil | invalid payload, validation, domain, infra tests | Error berubah saat refactor |
| 15 | Governance | Konsistensi lintas service | error code registry, naming, deprecation | Tiap service punya error style sendiri |

---

## 4. Recommended Error Response Model

Gunakan satu model konsisten.

```java id="1mczep"
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors
) {}

public record FieldErrorResponse(
        String field,
        String code,
        String message
) {}
```

Contoh validation error:

```json id="im7p7v"
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "message": "Request validation failed",
  "correlationId": "req-2f8d7c9a",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field": "customerId",
      "code": "FIELD_REQUIRED",
      "message": "Customer ID is required"
    },
    {
      "field": "items[0].quantity",
      "code": "FIELD_MIN_VALUE",
      "message": "Quantity must be greater than or equal to 1"
    }
  ]
}
```

Contoh domain error:

```json id="5stzla"
{
  "code": "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
  "message": "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
  "correlationId": "req-2f8d7c9a",
  "errors": []
}
```

Prinsip:

```text id="gu3cay"
code          → machine-readable, stabil
message       → human-readable, boleh berubah/localized
correlationId → debugging dan audit trail
errors        → detail field-level untuk validation/parser semantic error
```

## 5. Error Taxonomy

| Category | Example | HTTP | Top-level code |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Malformed JSON | JSON syntax rusak | 400 | `INVALID_JSON` |
| Malformed XML | XML tidak well-formed / unsafe XML | 400 | `INVALID_XML` |
| Unsupported media type | `Content-Type: text/plain` | 415 | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` |
| Not acceptable | Client minta response format unsupported | 406 | `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` |
| Validation failed | `@NotNull`, `@Size`, `@Pattern` gagal | 400 / 422 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Resource not found | ID tidak ada / tidak visible | 404 | `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| Duplicate resource | Unique/business duplicate | 409 | `DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` |
| Invalid state transition | Cancel order yang sudah closed | 409 / 422 | `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` |
| Business rule violation | Syntactically valid tapi rule bisnis gagal | 422 | `BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION` |
| Unauthorized | Token missing/invalid | 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| Forbidden | Authenticated tapi tidak punya permission | 403 | `FORBIDDEN` |
| Rate limited | Terlalu banyak request | 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Timeout | External dependency timeout | 504 | `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` |
| Dependency unavailable | DB/broker/external service down | 503 | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| Unexpected server bug | NPE, serialization failure, unknown error | 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` |

Rule praktis:

```text id="d0byyt"
400 → request structurally invalid
401 → belum / gagal authenticated
403 → authenticated tapi tidak authorized
404 → resource tidak ditemukan / tidak boleh diketahui
409 → konflik state/resource saat ini
422 → request valid secara struktur, tapi gagal semantic/business rule
429 → rate limit
500 → bug internal / unexpected failure
503 → service/dependency temporarily unavailable
504 → timeout terhadap upstream
```

## 6. Domain Exception Model

Buat domain exception yang membawa kode stabil dan kategori.

```java id="7ldzfa"
public final class DomainException extends RuntimeException {

    private final String code;
    private final String publicMessage;
    private final DomainErrorCategory category;

    public DomainException(
            String code,
            String publicMessage,
            DomainErrorCategory category
    ) {
        super(publicMessage);
        this.code = code;
        this.publicMessage = publicMessage;
        this.category = category;
    }

    public String code() {
        return code;
    }

    public String publicMessage() {
        return publicMessage;
    }

    public DomainErrorCategory category() {
        return category;
    }
}
```

```java id="4dj4lo"
public enum DomainErrorCategory {
    NOT_FOUND,
    CONFLICT,
    INVALID_STATE,
    BUSINESS_RULE,
    FORBIDDEN
}
```

Contoh usage:

```java id="95jny6"
public OrderResult cancel(CancelOrderCommand command) {
    Order order = orderRepository.findById(command.orderId())
            .orElseThrow(() -> new DomainException(
                    "ORDER_NOT_FOUND",
                    "Order was not found",
                    DomainErrorCategory.NOT_FOUND
            ));

    if (!order.canBeCancelled()) {
        throw new DomainException(
                "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
                "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
                DomainErrorCategory.CONFLICT
        );
    }

    order.cancel(command.reason(), command.actorUserId());

    orderRepository.save(order);

    return OrderResult.from(order);
}
```

## 7. Domain Exception Mapper

```java id="mya9c6"
@Provider
public class DomainExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<DomainException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(DomainException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                exception.code(),
                exception.publicMessage(),
                currentCorrelationId(),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(toStatus(exception.category()))
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private Response.Status toStatus(DomainErrorCategory category) {
        return switch (category) {
            case NOT_FOUND -> Response.Status.NOT_FOUND;
            case CONFLICT -> Response.Status.CONFLICT;
            case INVALID_STATE -> Response.Status.CONFLICT;
            case BUSINESS_RULE -> Response.Status.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY;
            case FORBIDDEN -> Response.Status.FORBIDDEN;
        };
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Jangan lempar `BadRequestException`, `NotFoundException`, atau `WebApplicationException` langsung dari domain layer jika domain module ingin tetap bebas dari JAX-RS dependency. Simpan HTTP semantics di mapper/adaptor layer.
