## 8. Validation Exception Mapper

```java id="nnq7ii"
@Provider
public class ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<ConstraintViolationException> {

    private final ValidationErrorCodeRegistry codeRegistry =
            new ValidationErrorCodeRegistry();

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(ConstraintViolationException exception) {
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors = exception.getConstraintViolations()
                .stream()
                .map(this::toFieldError)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(FieldErrorResponse::field))
                .toList();

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                "Request validation failed",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                errors
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private FieldErrorResponse toFieldError(ConstraintViolation<?> violation) {
        return new FieldErrorResponse(
                normalizePath(violation.getPropertyPath()),
                codeRegistry.resolve(violation),
                violation.getMessage()
        );
    }

    private String normalizePath(Path path) {
        String raw = path.toString();

        return raw
                .replaceFirst("^create\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^update\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^patch\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^arg0\\.", "");
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Registry error code:

```java id="crzqu0"
public final class ValidationErrorCodeRegistry {

    private static final Map<String, String> CODES = Map.ofEntries(
            Map.entry("NotNull", "FIELD_REQUIRED"),
            Map.entry("NotBlank", "FIELD_REQUIRED"),
            Map.entry("NotEmpty", "FIELD_REQUIRED"),
            Map.entry("Size", "FIELD_SIZE_INVALID"),
            Map.entry("Min", "FIELD_MIN_VALUE"),
            Map.entry("Max", "FIELD_MAX_VALUE"),
            Map.entry("DecimalMin", "FIELD_DECIMAL_MIN_VALUE"),
            Map.entry("DecimalMax", "FIELD_DECIMAL_MAX_VALUE"),
            Map.entry("Pattern", "FIELD_PATTERN_INVALID"),
            Map.entry("Email", "FIELD_EMAIL_INVALID"),
            Map.entry("ValidDateRange", "DATE_RANGE_INVALID"),
            Map.entry("ValidCustomerIdentity", "CUSTOMER_IDENTITY_INVALID")
    );

    public String resolve(ConstraintViolation<?> violation) {
        String annotationName = violation.getConstraintDescriptor()
                .getAnnotation()
                .annotationType()
                .getSimpleName();

        return CODES.getOrDefault(annotationName, annotationName);
    }
}
```

## 9. Parser / Deserialization Error Mapper

Parser error sebaiknya menjadi 400, bukan 500.

### Jackson JSON

```java id="7r9nf7"
@Provider
public class JsonProcessingExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<JsonProcessingException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(JsonProcessingException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "INVALID_JSON",
                "Malformed or incompatible JSON payload",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

### Generic bad request mapping

Be careful with broad mappers. Only map known boundary exceptions.

```java id="77w0bz"
@Provider
public class BadRequestExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<BadRequestException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(BadRequestException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "BAD_REQUEST",
                "Request is invalid",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Prinsip:

```text id="tvcz8q"
Malformed syntax     → INVALID_JSON / INVALID_XML
Valid syntax, wrong type → INVALID_PAYLOAD
Valid payload, constraint failed → VALIDATION_FAILED
Valid request, business cannot proceed → DOMAIN_ERROR
```

## 10. Authentication & Authorization Error

Pisahkan **401** dan **403**.

| Situation | HTTP | Code |
|---|---:|---|
| Tidak ada token | 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| Token invalid | 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| Token expired | 401 | `TOKEN_EXPIRED` |
| Authenticated tapi role kurang | 403 | `FORBIDDEN` |
| Tidak boleh melihat resource | 403 atau 404 | `FORBIDDEN` / `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |

Contoh mapper:

```java id="qttno2"
@Provider
public class ForbiddenExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<ForbiddenException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(ForbiddenException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "FORBIDDEN",
                "You are not allowed to perform this action",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.FORBIDDEN)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Security note:

```text id="6j4quj"
Untuk resource sensitif, 404 bisa dipakai untuk menyembunyikan keberadaan resource.
Tapi gunakan policy ini secara konsisten dan terdokumentasi.
```

## 11. Infrastructure Error Mapper

Infrastructure failure jangan mengekspos detail internal seperti SQL, hostname, driver, stack trace, atau URL upstream.

```java id="45zbhf"
public final class InfrastructureException extends RuntimeException {

    private final String code;
    private final InfrastructureErrorCategory category;

    public InfrastructureException(
            String code,
            String message,
            InfrastructureErrorCategory category,
            Throwable cause
    ) {
        super(message, cause);
        this.code = code;
        this.category = category;
    }

    public String code() {
        return code;
    }

    public InfrastructureErrorCategory category() {
        return category;
    }
}
```

```java id="vskjv2"
public enum InfrastructureErrorCategory {
    DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE,
    UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE,
    UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT,
    MESSAGE_BROKER_UNAVAILABLE
}
```

Mapper:

```java id="wi3sua"
@Provider
public class InfrastructureExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<InfrastructureException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(InfrastructureException exception) {
        log.warn(
                "Infrastructure failure. code={}, category={}, correlationId={}",
                exception.code(),
                exception.category(),
                currentCorrelationId(),
                exception
        );

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                toPublicCode(exception.category()),
                "Service is temporarily unavailable",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(toStatus(exception.category()))
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private Response.Status toStatus(InfrastructureErrorCategory category) {
        return switch (category) {
            case DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE,
                 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE,
                 MESSAGE_BROKER_UNAVAILABLE -> Response.Status.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE;
            case UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT -> Response.Status.GATEWAY_TIMEOUT;
        };
    }

    private String toPublicCode(InfrastructureErrorCategory category) {
        return switch (category) {
            case DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE -> "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE";
            case UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE -> "UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE";
            case UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT -> "UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT";
            case MESSAGE_BROKER_UNAVAILABLE -> "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE";
        };
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

## 12. Catch-All Mapper

Catch-all mapper harus ada, tapi jangan sampai menutupi mapper spesifik.

```java id="p2v233"
@Provider
@Priority(Priorities.USER + 500)
public class UnhandledExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<Throwable> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(Throwable exception) {
        String correlationId = currentCorrelationId();

        log.error(
                "Unhandled API error. correlationId={}",
                correlationId,
                exception
        );

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "INTERNAL_ERROR",
                "Unexpected server error",
                correlationId,
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Warning:

```text id="x8x6xo"
Catch-all mapper:
- harus log full exception internal
- tidak boleh expose exception message mentah
- tidak boleh mengganti semua error menjadi 200
- tidak boleh membuat debugging mustahil
```

Jakarta REST menentukan provider dan filter/interceptor sebagai JAX-RS providers yang dapat diregistrasikan pada runtime/configurable types; desain error handling yang bersih biasanya memakai provider khusus, bukan try-catch tersebar di setiap resource method. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/4.0/jakarta-restful-ws-spec-4.0.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 13. Correlation ID Filter

Correlation ID membuat request bisa ditelusuri lintas log, service, dan response.

### Request filter

```java id="o8c0no"
@Provider
@Priority(Priorities.AUTHENTICATION)
public class CorrelationIdRequestFilter implements ContainerRequestFilter {

    public static final String HEADER = "X-Correlation-Id";
    public static final String PROPERTY = "correlationId";

    @Override
    public void filter(ContainerRequestContext requestContext) {
        String incoming = requestContext.getHeaderString(HEADER);

        String correlationId = isValid(incoming)
                ? incoming
                : generateCorrelationId();

        requestContext.setProperty(PROPERTY, correlationId);

        MDC.put("correlationId", correlationId);
    }

    private boolean isValid(String value) {
        return value != null
                && value.length() <= 100
                && value.matches("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+");
    }

    private String generateCorrelationId() {
        return "req-" + UUID.randomUUID();
    }
}
```

### Response filter

```java id="95i8uz"
@Provider
public class CorrelationIdResponseFilter implements ContainerResponseFilter {

    @Override
    public void filter(
            ContainerRequestContext requestContext,
            ContainerResponseContext responseContext
    ) {
        Object correlationId =
                requestContext.getProperty(CorrelationIdRequestFilter.PROPERTY);

        if (correlationId != null) {
            responseContext.getHeaders()
                    .putSingle(CorrelationIdRequestFilter.HEADER, correlationId);
        }

        MDC.remove("correlationId");
    }
}
```

Logback’s MDC stores contextual diagnostic information on a per-thread basis and is commonly used to put request-scoped values, such as client/request information, into logs; because MDC is thread-bound, cleanup is important in server thread pools. ([Logback](https://logback.qos.ch/manual/mdc.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 14. Logging Safety

### Apa yang boleh di-log

```text id="muim4s"
[OK] correlationId
[OK] endpoint path template
[OK] HTTP method
[OK] status code
[OK] error code
[OK] domain entity id, jika bukan sensitif
[OK] latency
[OK] exception stack trace internal untuk 5xx
```

### Apa yang harus dihindari

```text id="p2fp99"
[HINDARI] access token
[HINDARI] password/API key/secret
[HINDARI] full request body berisi PII
[HINDARI] raw SQL dengan parameter sensitif
[HINDARI] full XML/JSON payload production
[HINDARI] stack trace di response client
[HINDARI] internal package/class names di API error
```

### Logging severity

| Error type | Level |
|---|---|
| Validation failed | `DEBUG` / `INFO` tergantung volume |
| Malformed payload | `INFO` / `WARN` jika mencurigakan |
| Domain conflict expected | `INFO` |
| Auth failure biasa | `INFO` |
| Suspicious auth/security | `WARN` |
| Upstream timeout | `WARN` |
| DB unavailable | `ERROR` |
| Unhandled exception | `ERROR` |

---

## 15. HTTP Status Decision Matrix

| Condition | Status | Rationale |
|---|---:|---|
| JSON syntax invalid | 400 | Client request tidak bisa diparse |
| XML unsafe/malformed | 400 | Payload invalid |
| Missing required field | 400 | Input shape invalid |
| Field format invalid | 400 | Input shape invalid |
| Business semantic invalid | 422 | Payload valid tapi rule bisnis gagal |
| Resource state conflict | 409 | Konflik dengan state saat ini |
| Duplicate natural key | 409 | Konflik resource |
| Resource ID tidak ada | 404 | Resource missing |
| Resource ada tapi disembunyikan | 404 | Security policy opsional |
| Token tidak ada/invalid | 401 | Authentication gagal |
| Permission tidak cukup | 403 | Authorization gagal |
| Unsupported `Content-Type` | 415 | Media input tidak didukung |
| Unsupported `Accept` | 406 | Media output tidak didukung |
| Rate limit | 429 | Client terlalu sering |
| DB temporarily down | 503 | Service tidak siap sementara |
| Upstream timeout | 504 | Gateway/upstream timeout |
| Unexpected bug | 500 | Server defect |

---

## 16. Where to Throw What

| Layer | Exception type yang disarankan | Jangan |
|---|---|---|
| Resource/adaptor | `BadRequestException`, parser-specific, validation exception | Business logic berat |
| DTO validation | `ConstraintViolationException` | Query DB / call API |
| Mapper | Usually no domain exception; fail fast for programming error | Authorization / persistence |
| Service/domain | `DomainException` | JAX-RS `Response` |
| Repository | Repository-specific / infrastructure exception | Public API error response |
| External client | Upstream exception wrapped as infrastructure exception | Raw third-party exception ke resource |
| Catch-all | `Throwable` mapper | Swallow error tanpa log |

Prinsip dependency direction:

```text id="j6s1ro"
Domain layer tidak tahu HTTP.
HTTP layer tahu cara menerjemahkan domain error ke HTTP.
```

---

## 17. Example End-to-End

### Resource

```java id="kk0usm"
@Path("/orders")
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class OrderResource {

    private final OrderMapper mapper;
    private final OrderService service;

    public OrderResource(OrderMapper mapper, OrderService service) {
        this.mapper = mapper;
        this.service = service;
    }

    @POST
    public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request) {
        CreateOrderCommand command = mapper.toCommand(request);
        OrderResult result = service.create(command);

        return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
                .entity(mapper.toResponse(result))
                .build();
    }

    @POST
    @Path("/{id}/cancel")
    public Response cancel(
            @PathParam("id") UUID id,
            @Valid CancelOrderRequest request
    ) {
        CancelOrderCommand command = mapper.toCancelCommand(id, request);
        OrderResult result = service.cancel(command);

        return Response.ok(mapper.toResponse(result)).build();
    }
}
```

### Domain service

```java id="fju8x0"
public OrderResult cancel(CancelOrderCommand command) {
    Order order = orderRepository.findById(command.orderId())
            .orElseThrow(() -> new DomainException(
                    "ORDER_NOT_FOUND",
                    "Order was not found",
                    DomainErrorCategory.NOT_FOUND
            ));

    if (!order.canBeCancelled()) {
        throw new DomainException(
                "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
                "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
                DomainErrorCategory.CONFLICT
        );
    }

    order.cancel(command.reason());

    orderRepository.save(order);

    return OrderResult.from(order);
}
```

### Result mapping

```text id="j302c2"
Invalid JSON
  → JsonProcessingExceptionMapper
  → 400 INVALID_JSON

Missing reason field
  → ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
  → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED

Order not found
  → DomainExceptionMapper
  → 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND

Order already closed
  → DomainExceptionMapper
  → 409 ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED

Database unavailable
  → InfrastructureExceptionMapper
  → 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

Unexpected NullPointerException
  → UnhandledExceptionMapper
  → 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
```

---

## 18. Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| `try-catch` di setiap resource | Duplikasi, inkonsisten | Central `ExceptionMapper` |
| Return `200 OK` untuk error bisnis | Client logic kacau | HTTP status sesuai |
| Raw exception message ke client | Security leak | Public message + code |
| Stack trace di response | Bocor internal | Stack trace hanya di log |
| Semua error jadi `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Client tidak bisa recovery | Taxonomy |
| Domain layer throw `WebApplicationException` | Domain tergantung HTTP/JAX-RS | DomainException + mapper |
| Validation error jadi 500 | Salah blame ke server | 400/422 |
| DB error mentah ke client | Bocor schema/SQL | Infrastructure mapper |
| Tidak ada correlation ID | Debug sulit | request/response filter |
| Correlation ID tidak dibersihkan | Log contamination antar request | `MDC.remove` |
| Error code tidak distandarkan | Client rapuh | registry/governance |
| Field path mentah `arg0.items[0]` | Client sulit pakai | path normalization |

---

## 19. Testing Strategy

Minimal test:

```text id="67836x"
Parser
[ ] malformed JSON → 400 INVALID_JSON
[ ] invalid enum → 400 INVALID_PAYLOAD / INVALID_JSON
[ ] malformed XML → 400 INVALID_XML

Validation
[ ] missing required field → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED
[ ] nested item invalid → field path benar
[ ] custom constraint invalid → custom error code benar

Domain
[ ] not found → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND / domain-specific code
[ ] duplicate → 409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE
[ ] invalid state transition → 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION
[ ] business semantic error → 422 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION

Security
[ ] missing token → 401
[ ] insufficient permission → 403
[ ] hidden resource policy → 404 jika dipilih

Infrastructure
[ ] upstream timeout → 504
[ ] DB unavailable → 503
[ ] unexpected exception → 500 INTERNAL_ERROR

Contract
[ ] all error responses contain code/message/correlationId/errors
[ ] no response contains stack trace
[ ] no response contains package/class names
[ ] correlation ID echoed in response header
```

Contoh assertion contract:

```java id="d52zmt"
@Test
void invalidRequestShouldReturnValidationErrorContract() {
    Response response = target("/orders")
            .request()
            .post(Entity.json("""
                    {
                      "customerId": null,
                      "items": []
                    }
                    """));

    assertEquals(400, response.getStatus());

    ApiErrorResponse error = response.readEntity(ApiErrorResponse.class);

    assertEquals("VALIDATION_FAILED", error.code());
    assertNotNull(error.correlationId());
    assertFalse(error.errors().isEmpty());
}
```

---

## 20. Production Checklist

```text id="47qrnt"
ExceptionMapper
[ ] Parser error mapper ada.
[ ] ConstraintViolationException mapper ada.
[ ] DomainException mapper ada.
[ ] InfrastructureException mapper ada.
[ ] Security exception mapper ada.
[ ] Catch-all mapper ada.
[ ] Mapper spesifik tidak kalah oleh mapper umum.

Error response
[ ] Semua error punya code.
[ ] Semua error punya public message.
[ ] Semua error punya correlationId.
[ ] Field error punya field/code/message.
[ ] Tidak ada raw stack trace di response.
[ ] Tidak ada SQL/package/internal class di response.

HTTP semantics
[ ] 400/401/403/404/409/422/429/500/503/504 dipakai konsisten.
[ ] Domain conflict tidak dikirim sebagai 500.
[ ] Validation error tidak dikirim sebagai 500.
[ ] Infrastructure transient failure tidak selalu 500.

Logging
[ ] 5xx full exception logged internal.
[ ] 4xx expected tidak noisy.
[ ] Payload logging disanitasi.
[ ] Correlation ID ada di semua log.
[ ] MDC dibersihkan di akhir request.

Governance
[ ] Error code registry terdokumentasi.
[ ] Error code tidak berubah sembarangan.
[ ] Contract tests masuk CI.
[ ] Error response selaras dengan OpenAPI/API docs.
```

## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:43:05 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke testing strategy end-to-end untuk boundary layer. Saya akan pakai rujukan resmi Jersey/MapStruct/JUnit agar bagian seperti JerseyTest, provider test, dan annotation processor tidak meleset.

# Cheatsheet - Testing Strategy for JSON/XML, DTO Mapping, Validation & Error Contract di Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Untuk aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, testing boundary layer harus membuktikan bahwa kontrak API stabil dari sisi:

```text
HTTP request
  → deserialization JSON/XML
  → DTO
  → validation
  → mapper DTO → command/domain
  → service result
  → response DTO
  → serialization JSON/XML
  → error contract
```

Yang sering salah: test hanya fokus ke service/domain, tetapi tidak menguji **wire-format**. Akibatnya bug seperti invalid enum, unknown field, format tanggal berubah, validation path kacau, atau `ExceptionMapper` tidak aktif baru ketahuan saat integrasi.

Jersey menyediakan **Jersey Test Framework** untuk menjalankan resource/provider JAX-RS dalam test, dengan client preconfigured, beberapa pilihan container seperti Grizzly, in-memory, JDK HTTP, Simple, Jetty, dan opsi external container. Dokumentasi Jersey menyebut `JerseyTest` dipakai dengan cara subclass lalu override `configure()` untuk mengembalikan `ResourceConfig` test application. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/test-framework.html))

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang dites | Failure mode yang dicari |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | DTO validation test | Membuktikan constraint DTO benar | `@NotNull`, `@NotBlank`, `@Valid`, container element | Nested DTO tidak divalidasi |
| 2 | Custom validator test | Membuktikan custom constraint benar | class-level, cross-field, conditional rule | Validator salah field path |
| 3 | Mapper test | Membuktikan DTO/domain mapping benar | MapStruct, manual mapper, enum mapper | Field baru tidak termapping |
| 4 | Serialization test | Membuktikan output JSON/XML stabil | ObjectMapper, Jsonb, JAXB, XmlMapper | Format tanggal/null berubah |
| 5 | Deserialization test | Membuktikan input diparse sesuai policy | unknown field, invalid enum, invalid date | Input longgar tanpa sadar |
| 6 | Provider config test | Membuktikan provider runtime memakai config yang benar | `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>`, JSON-B config | Test pakai mapper beda dari runtime |
| 7 | ExceptionMapper test | Membuktikan exception → HTTP error benar | validation, parser, domain, infra | Semua error jadi 500 |
| 8 | JerseyTest resource test | Membuktikan resource/provider/filter aktif bersama | endpoint + provider + mapper + validation | Resource test terlalu mock-heavy |
| 9 | Error contract test | Membuktikan error response stabil | `code`, `message`, `correlationId`, `errors` | Raw exception bocor |
| 10 | Golden file test | Membuktikan wire contract tidak drift | expected JSON/XML snapshot | Upgrade library mengubah output |
| 11 | Security payload test | Membuktikan hardening aktif | XXE, huge payload, polymorphic JSON | Parser menerima payload berbahaya |
| 12 | Integration DB test | Membuktikan flow dengan dependency nyata | PostgreSQL, migration, repository | H2/test fake beda dari PostgreSQL |
| 13 | Regression suite | Membuktikan backward compatibility | deprecated field, old payload, old response | Client lama rusak |
| 14 | CI guardrail | Menangkap drift saat build | annotation processor, contract tests | Mapper generated beda lokal vs CI |

MapStruct menghasilkan mapper implementation saat compile-time melalui annotation processor, memakai plain Java method invocation, dan memberi error build-time jika mapping tidak lengkap atau tidak valid. Ini membuat mapper test dan compile-time guardrail penting untuk DTO/response contract. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/))

---

## 4. Testing Pyramid yang Disarankan

```text
Banyak:
  Unit test
  - validator
  - mapper
  - serializer config
  - error code registry

Sedang:
  JerseyTest
  - resource endpoint
  - provider registration
  - ExceptionMapper
  - filter
  - validation integration

Lebih sedikit tapi wajib:
  Integration test
  - PostgreSQL
  - migration
  - repository/service/resource path

Sedikit:
  End-to-end / deployed environment
  - real container
  - ingress/body limits
  - auth integration
  - observability/correlation
```

Rule praktis:

```text
Unit test membuktikan logic kecil benar.
JerseyTest membuktikan wiring JAX-RS benar.
Integration test membuktikan dependency nyata cocok.
Contract test membuktikan client tidak rusak.
```

## 5. DTO Validation Test

### DTO

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID customerId,

        @NotEmpty
        List<@Valid CreateOrderItemRequest> items,

        @Size(max = 500)
        String note

) {}

public record CreateOrderItemRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID productId,

        @Min(1)
        int quantity

) {}
```

### Test

```java
class CreateOrderRequestValidationTest {

    private static Validator validator;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setup() {
        validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory()
                .getValidator();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectMissingCustomerId() {
        CreateOrderRequest request = new CreateOrderRequest(
                null,
                List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(UUID.randomUUID(), 1)),
                null
        );

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CreateOrderRequest>> violations =
                validator.validate(request);

        assertTrue(violations.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath()
                        .toString()
                        .equals("customerId")));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidNestedItemQuantity() {
        CreateOrderRequest request = new CreateOrderRequest(
                UUID.randomUUID(),
                List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(UUID.randomUUID(), 0)),
                null
        );

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CreateOrderRequest>> violations =
                validator.validate(request);

        assertTrue(violations.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath()
                        .toString()
                        .contains("items")));
    }
}
```

Checklist DTO validation:

```text
[ ] Missing required field
[ ] Blank string
[ ] Empty list
[ ] Invalid nested object
[ ] Invalid collection element
[ ] Invalid numeric bound
[ ] Invalid date range
[ ] Invalid custom class-level constraint
[ ] Validation group create/update/patch
```

---

## 6. Custom Constraint Test

### Constraint example

```java
@ValidDateRange
public record CreatePolicyRequest(

        @NotNull
        LocalDate effectiveFrom,

        @NotNull
        LocalDate effectiveTo

) {}
```

### Test

```java
class ValidDateRangeTest {

    private static Validator validator;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setup() {
        validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory()
                .getValidator();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectWhenEffectiveFromAfterEffectiveTo() {
        CreatePolicyRequest request = new CreatePolicyRequest(
                LocalDate.parse("2026-08-01"),
                LocalDate.parse("2026-07-01")
        );

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CreatePolicyRequest>> violations =
                validator.validate(request);

        assertTrue(violations.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath()
                        .toString()
                        .equals("effectiveFrom")));
    }
}
```

Yang perlu diuji untuk custom validator:

| Case | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| `null` object | Validator tidak NPE |
| field dasar null | Biarkan `@NotNull` yang report |
| valid boundary | Tidak false positive |
| invalid cross-field | Violation muncul |
| field path | Mengarah ke field yang bisa dipakai client |
| message/code | Bisa dimap ke error contract |

## 7. MapStruct Mapper Test

### Mapper

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderMapper {

    @Mapping(target = "requestedBy", source = "actorUserId")
    CreateOrderCommand toCommand(
            CreateOrderRequest request,
            UUID actorUserId
    );

    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

### Test

```java
class OrderMapperTest {

    private final OrderMapper mapper = Mappers.getMapper(OrderMapper.class);

    @Test
    void shouldMapCreateRequestToCommand() {
        UUID customerId = UUID.randomUUID();
        UUID actorUserId = UUID.randomUUID();

        CreateOrderRequest request = new CreateOrderRequest(
                customerId,
                List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(UUID.randomUUID(), 2)),
                "urgent"
        );

        CreateOrderCommand command =
                mapper.toCommand(request, actorUserId);

        assertEquals(customerId, command.customerId());
        assertEquals(actorUserId, command.requestedBy());
        assertEquals("urgent", command.note());
        assertEquals(1, command.items().size());
    }

    @Test
    void shouldMapOrderResultToResponse() {
        OrderResult result = new OrderResult(
                UUID.randomUUID(),
                "ORD-001",
                OrderStatus.SUBMITTED,
                new BigDecimal("100.00"),
                "USD",
                Instant.parse("2026-07-13T00:00:00Z")
        );

        OrderResponse response = mapper.toResponse(result);

        assertEquals("ORD-001", response.orderNumber());
        assertEquals(OrderStatusDto.SUBMITTED, response.status());
        assertEquals(new BigDecimal("100.00"), response.totalAmount());
    }
}
```

Mapper test harus fokus ke **contract mapping**, bukan semua generated line. Test cases yang wajib:

```text
[ ] DTO → command happy path
[ ] contextual field: actor, tenant, correlation
[ ] domain result → response DTO
[ ] enum mapping semua value
[ ] money/currency mapping
[ ] null behavior
[ ] nested list mapping
[ ] patch/update mapping
[ ] sensitive/internal field tidak masuk response
```

---

## 8. Serialization Test: JSON Output Stabil

Gunakan `ObjectMapper` yang sama dengan runtime, bukan mapper baru asal-asalan.

```java
class OrderResponseSerializationTest {

    private final ObjectMapper mapper =
            new ObjectMapperProvider().getContext(OrderResponse.class);

    @Test
    void shouldSerializeOrderResponseWithStableContract()
            throws Exception {

        OrderResponse response = new OrderResponse(
                UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
                "ORD-001",
                OrderStatusDto.SUBMITTED,
                new BigDecimal("100.00"),
                "USD",
                Instant.parse("2026-07-13T00:00:00Z")
        );

        String json = mapper.writeValueAsString(response);

        JSONAssert.assertEquals("""
                {
                  "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
                  "orderNumber": "ORD-001",
                  "status": "SUBMITTED",
                  "totalAmount": 100.00,
                  "currency": "USD",
                  "submittedAt": "2026-07-13T00:00:00Z"
                }
                """, json, true);
    }
}
```

JSONAssert menyediakan assertion untuk membandingkan struktur JSON; ia mendukung mode strict dan non-strict. Strict mode menuntut semua elemen sesuai dan array dalam urutan yang sama, sedangkan non-strict lebih toleran terhadap urutan/field tambahan. ([JSONAssert](https://jsonassert.skyscreamer.org/apidocs/org/skyscreamer/jsonassert/JSONAssert.html))

Rekomendasi:

| Test type | JSONAssert mode |
|---|---|
| Public response contract | Strict |
| Partial assertion | Non-strict |
| Event payload evolutif | Non-strict + field penting eksplisit |
| Error response contract | Strict untuk top-level shape |
| Array order penting | Strict |
| Array order tidak penting | Non-strict atau compare set |

---

## 9. Deserialization Hardening Test

Test ini membuktikan `ObjectMapper` policy benar.

```java
class OrderRequestDeserializationTest {

    private final ObjectMapper mapper =
            new ObjectMapperProvider().getContext(CreateOrderRequest.class);

    @Test
    void shouldRejectUnknownField() {
        String json = """
                {
                  "customerId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
                  "items": [],
                  "unexpectedField": "boom"
                }
                """;

        assertThrows(JsonProcessingException.class,
                () -> mapper.readValue(json, CreateOrderRequest.class));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidEnum() {
        String json = """
                {
                  "status": "NOT_A_REAL_STATUS"
                }
                """;

        assertThrows(JsonProcessingException.class,
                () -> mapper.readValue(json, UpdateOrderStatusRequest.class));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectNumericEnum() {
        String json = """
                {
                  "status": 1
                }
                """;

        assertThrows(JsonProcessingException.class,
                () -> mapper.readValue(json, UpdateOrderStatusRequest.class));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidTimestamp() {
        String json = """
                {
                  "submittedAt": "13-07-2026"
                }
                """;

        assertThrows(JsonProcessingException.class,
                () -> mapper.readValue(json, SubmitOrderRequest.class));
    }
}
```

Checklist deserialization:

```text
[ ] Unknown field
[ ] Missing required field + validation
[ ] Invalid enum
[ ] Numeric enum
[ ] Invalid date/time
[ ] Invalid UUID
[ ] Big number overflow
[ ] Null primitive
[ ] Trailing token
[ ] Empty string coercion
```

---

## 10. XML Serialization / Deserialization Test

### XML output test

```java
class OrderXmlSerializationTest {

    private final XmlMapper xmlMapper =
            new XmlMapperProvider().getContext(OrderResponse.class);

    @Test
    void shouldSerializeXmlWithExpectedShape() throws Exception {
        OrderResponse response = new OrderResponse(
                UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
                "ORD-001",
                OrderStatusDto.SUBMITTED,
                new BigDecimal("100.00"),
                "USD",
                Instant.parse("2026-07-13T00:00:00Z")
        );

        String xml = xmlMapper.writeValueAsString(response);

        assertTrue(xml.contains("<orderNumber>ORD-001</orderNumber>"));
        assertTrue(xml.contains("<status>SUBMITTED</status>"));
    }
}
```

### XXE rejection test

```java
class SecureXmlTest {

    @Test
    void shouldRejectExternalEntityPayload() {
        String xml = """
                <?xml version="1.0"?>
                <!DOCTYPE foo [
                  <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
                ]>
                <order>
                  <note>&xxe;</note>
                </order>
                """;

        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> {
            SecureJaxbUnmarshaller.unmarshal(
                    new ByteArrayInputStream(xml.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)),
                    OrderXmlRequest.class
            );
        });
    }
}
```

XML test wajib masuk CI jika aplikasi menerima XML, karena XML punya risiko DTD, external entity, namespace, wrapper element, dan schema external access.

## 11. ExceptionMapper Unit Test

Untuk mapper murni, bisa dites tanpa Jersey runtime.

```java
class DomainExceptionMapperTest {

    private final DomainExceptionMapper mapper =
            new DomainExceptionMapper();

    @Test
    void shouldMapNotFoundDomainExceptionTo404() {
        DomainException exception = new DomainException(
                "ORDER_NOT_FOUND",
                "Order was not found",
                DomainErrorCategory.NOT_FOUND
        );

        Response response = mapper.toResponse(exception);

        assertEquals(404, response.getStatus());

        ApiErrorResponse body =
                (ApiErrorResponse) response.getEntity();

        assertEquals("ORDER_NOT_FOUND", body.code());
        assertEquals("Order was not found", body.message());
    }
}
```

Test per mapper:

```text
[ ] ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
[ ] DomainExceptionMapper
[ ] JsonProcessingExceptionMapper
[ ] XmlExceptionMapper
[ ] InfrastructureExceptionMapper
[ ] Security exception mapper
[ ] Catch-all mapper
```

Jakarta REST mendefinisikan `ExceptionMapper<E extends Throwable>` sebagai contract provider untuk mengubah exception menjadi `Response`; provider harus diregistrasikan secara programmatic atau diberi `@Provider` agar ditemukan runtime. ([Jakarta EE](https://jakarta.ee/specifications/restful-ws/3.1/apidocs/jakarta.ws.rs/jakarta/ws/rs/ext/exceptionmapper?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 12. JerseyTest untuk Resource + Provider + Validation + Error Contract

### ResourceConfig test

```java
class OrderResourceTest extends JerseyTest {

    private OrderService orderService;

    @Override
    protected Application configure() {
        orderService = mock(OrderService.class);

        return new ResourceConfig()
                .register(new OrderResource(
                        Mappers.getMapper(OrderMapper.class),
                        orderService
                ))
                .register(JacksonFeature.class)
                .register(ObjectMapperProvider.class)
                .register(ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper.class)
                .register(DomainExceptionMapper.class)
                .register(JsonProcessingExceptionMapper.class)
                .register(CorrelationIdRequestFilter.class)
                .register(CorrelationIdResponseFilter.class);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnValidationErrorForInvalidRequest() {
        Response response = target("/orders")
                .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .post(Entity.json("""
                        {
                          "customerId": null,
                          "items": []
                        }
                        """));

        assertEquals(400, response.getStatus());

        ApiErrorResponse error =
                response.readEntity(ApiErrorResponse.class);

        assertEquals("VALIDATION_FAILED", error.code());
        assertNotNull(error.correlationId());
        assertFalse(error.errors().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnDomainConflict() {
        when(orderService.cancel(any()))
                .thenThrow(new DomainException(
                        "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
                        "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
                        DomainErrorCategory.CONFLICT
                ));

        Response response = target("/orders/{id}/cancel")
                .resolveTemplate("id", UUID.randomUUID())
                .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .post(Entity.json("""
                        {
                          "reason": "duplicate request"
                        }
                        """));

        assertEquals(409, response.getStatus());

        ApiErrorResponse error =
                response.readEntity(ApiErrorResponse.class);

        assertEquals("ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED", error.code());
    }
}
```

JerseyTest cocok untuk membuktikan `ResourceConfig`, resource, provider, filters, validation, dan `ExceptionMapper` benar-benar aktif bersama. Dokumentasi Jersey mencontohkan subclass `JerseyTest`, override `configure()`, lalu memakai `target(...).request()` untuk mengirim request ke resource test application. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/test-framework.html))

---

## 13. Golden File Test

Golden file test menjaga response tetap stabil saat refactor/upgrade dependency.

Struktur file:

```text
src/test/resources/contracts/
  order-created.response.json
  order-cancelled.response.json
  error-validation-failed.response.json
  error-domain-conflict.response.json
  error-invalid-json.response.json
```

Helper:

```java
final class ContractFiles {

    static String read(String name) {
        try {
            return Files.readString(Path.of(
                    "src/test/resources/contracts/" + name
            ));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
        }
    }
}
```

Test:

```java
@Test
void shouldMatchOrderCreatedGoldenFile() throws Exception {
    OrderResponse response = new OrderResponse(
            UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
            "ORD-001",
            OrderStatusDto.SUBMITTED,
            new BigDecimal("100.00"),
            "USD",
            Instant.parse("2026-07-13T00:00:00Z")
    );

    String actual = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(response);
    String expected = ContractFiles.read("order-created.response.json");

    JSONAssert.assertEquals(expected, actual, true);
}
```

Gunakan golden file untuk:

```text
[ ] Response DTO public
[ ] Error response
[ ] XML payload
[ ] Deprecated compatibility payload
[ ] Event payload
[ ] External integration contract
```

Jangan pakai golden file untuk semua object internal karena akan membuat test brittle. Pakai untuk kontrak yang memang public/stable.

---

## 14. Error Contract Regression Test

Semua error harus punya shape yang sama.

```java
@Test
void allErrorResponsesShouldContainStandardFields() {
    Response response = target("/orders")
            .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .post(Entity.json("{ invalid json"));

    assertEquals(400, response.getStatus());

    JsonNode root = objectMapper.readTree(response.readEntity(String.class));

    assertTrue(root.hasNonNull("code"));
    assertTrue(root.hasNonNull("message"));
    assertTrue(root.has("correlationId"));
    assertTrue(root.has("errors"));
    assertTrue(root.get("errors").isArray());
}
```

Matrix minimal:

| Scenario | Expected |
|---|---|
| malformed JSON | `400 INVALID_JSON` |
| invalid XML | `400 INVALID_XML` |
| unsupported media type | `415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` |
| invalid DTO | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| domain not found | `404 ..._NOT_FOUND` |
| domain conflict | `409 ..._CONFLICT` |
| business semantic error | `422 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION` |
| infrastructure unavailable | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| unexpected exception | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` |

---

## 15. Correlation ID Test

```java
@Test
void shouldEchoCorrelationId() {
    String correlationId = "req-test-123";

    Response response = target("/orders")
            .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .header("X-Correlation-Id", correlationId)
            .post(Entity.json("""
                    {
                      "customerId": null,
                      "items": []
                    }
                    """));

    assertEquals(correlationId,
            response.getHeaderString("X-Correlation-Id"));

    ApiErrorResponse error =
            response.readEntity(ApiErrorResponse.class);

    assertEquals(correlationId, error.correlationId());
}
```

```text
[ ] terlalu panjang
[ ] berisi karakter aneh
[ ] missing header
[ ] generated ID tetap muncul di response
[ ] MDC dibersihkan antar request
```

## 16. Integration Test dengan PostgreSQL / Testcontainers

Untuk bagian repository/service/resource yang bergantung pada PostgreSQL, gunakan database nyata, bukan hanya mock atau H2. Testcontainers for Java menyediakan lightweight throwaway container untuk database seperti PostgreSQL dan dependency lain yang berjalan di Docker, dan mendukung JUnit/Jupiter. ([Testcontainers](https://java.testcontainers.org/))

Contoh konseptual:

```java
@Testcontainers
class OrderRepositoryIntegrationTest {

    @Container
    static PostgreSQLContainer<?> postgres =
            new PostgreSQLContainer<>("postgres:16")
                    .withDatabaseName("app_test")
                    .withUsername("test")
                    .withPassword("test");

    @BeforeAll
    static void migrate() {
        String jdbcUrl = postgres.getJdbcUrl();

        // Run Flyway/Liquibase migration here
        // Build DataSource here
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPersistAndLoadOrder() {
        OrderRepository repository = buildRepository();

        Order order = Order.create(...);

        repository.save(order);

        Optional<Order> loaded = repository.findById(order.id());

        assertTrue(loaded.isPresent());
        assertEquals(order.id(), loaded.get().id());
    }
}
```

Integration test cocok untuk:

```text
[ ] SQL/PLpgSQL behavior
[ ] transaction boundary
[ ] constraint violation
[ ] migration correctness
[ ] JSONB column behavior
[ ] timestamp/timezone behavior
[ ] repository query projection
[ ] pessimistic/optimistic locking
```

## 17. Test Data Strategy

Gunakan test data builder agar test readable.

```java
public final class OrderTestData {

    public static CreateOrderRequest validCreateOrderRequest() {
        return new CreateOrderRequest(
                UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
                List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(
                        UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"),
                        2
                )),
                "standard order"
        );
    }

    public static OrderResult submittedOrderResult() {
        return new OrderResult(
                UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"),
                "ORD-001",
                OrderStatus.SUBMITTED,
                new BigDecimal("100.00"),
                "USD",
                Instant.parse("2026-07-13T00:00:00Z")
        );
    }
}
```

Prinsip:

```text
- Pakai UUID/timestamp deterministic untuk contract test.
- Jangan pakai Instant.now() untuk golden file.
- Jangan generate random data kecuali property/fuzz test.
- Test data harus menyatakan intent.
```

## 19. CI Guardrail

Minimal pipeline:

```text
mvn clean verify
  ↓
compile
  - MapStruct annotation processor
  - unmapped target error
  ↓
unit tests
  - validator
  - mapper
  - serialization
  ↓
JerseyTest
  - resource + provider + exception mapper
  ↓
integration tests
  - PostgreSQL Testcontainers
  - migration
  ↓
contract tests
  - golden JSON/XML
  - error response
  ↓
security payload tests
  - XXE
  - invalid polymorphic JSON
  - payload limit
```

Pisahkan kategori test:

```text
src/test/java
  unit + JerseyTest ringan

src/integrationTest/java
  Testcontainers + database + external dependency

src/contractTest/java
  golden files + compatibility tests
```

Maven convention bisa memakai Surefire untuk unit test dan Failsafe untuk integration test:

```text
Surefire:
  *Test.java

Failsafe:
  *IT.java
```

---

## 20. Common Failure Modes yang Harus Ditangkap Test

| Failure | Test yang menangkap |
|---|---|
| Provider JSON salah aktif | JerseyTest provider registration |
| `ObjectMapper` runtime beda dari unit test | Provider config test |
| Unknown field diterima diam-diam | Deserialization hardening test |
| Invalid enum jadi null | Deserialization test |
| Date output berubah format | Golden file test |
| `BigDecimal` berubah jadi scientific notation | Serialization test |
| Nested DTO tidak divalidasi | Validation test |
| Custom constraint error di object root | Custom validator test |
| `ExceptionMapper` tidak registered | JerseyTest invalid request |
| Semua error jadi 500 | Error taxonomy test |
| Correlation ID tidak muncul | Filter test |
| Stack trace bocor ke response | Error contract test |
| Entity persistence terserialisasi | Response DTO golden test |
| XML external entity diterima | XXE regression test |
| Mapper field baru tidak termapping | MapStruct compile-time policy |
| PostgreSQL behavior beda dari mock | Testcontainers integration test |

## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:46:09 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke test matrix praktis supaya bisa langsung dipakai sebagai checklist onboarding/QA boundary layer. Saya akan susun per endpoint style: create, update, patch, list/search, error, JSON/XML, mapper, validation, dan PostgreSQL integration.

# Cheatsheet - Practical DTO / Serialization Test Matrix untuk Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Tujuan test matrix ini adalah memastikan **API boundary** benar-benar stabil, bukan hanya service logic-nya benar.

Yang diuji:

```text
HTTP request
  → JSON/XML parser
  → DTO
  → Jakarta Bean Validation
  → MapStruct/manual mapper
  → service/domain
  → response DTO
  → JSON/XML serializer
  → ExceptionMapper/error contract
```

Gunakan beberapa level test:

| Level | Fokus |
|---|---|
| Unit test | DTO validation, custom validator, MapStruct mapper, ObjectMapper/Jsonb/XML config |
| JerseyTest | Resource + provider + filter + validation + ExceptionMapper berjalan bersama |
| Contract/golden test | Response JSON/XML dan error response tidak drift |
| Integration test | PostgreSQL/migration/repository/service behavior nyata |
| Security regression | Invalid JSON/XML, XXE, payload terlalu besar, unsafe polymorphism |

Jersey Test Framework memang dirancang untuk testing RESTful/JAX-RS components dan umum dipakai dengan subclass `JerseyTest` yang mengembalikan `ResourceConfig` dari method `configure()`. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/test-framework.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) MapStruct relevan di sini karena generated mapper dibuat saat compile-time dan memakai plain method invocation, sehingga compile/test bisa menjadi guardrail untuk DTO/domain/response mapping. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 2. Matrix Ringkas per Layer

| Layer | Yang diuji | Teknik test | Prioritas |
|---|---|---|---|
| DTO | Required field, nullability, nested object, container element | Validator unit test | P0 |
| Custom constraint | Cross-field, conditional rule, field path | Validator unit test | P0 |
| JSON deserialization | Unknown field, enum, date, number, null primitive | ObjectMapper/Jsonb test | P0 |
| XML deserialization | XML shape, namespace, wrapper, XXE | JAXB/XmlMapper test | P0 jika XML aktif |
| MapStruct mapper | DTO → command, result/entity → response | Mapper unit test | P0 |
| Resource endpoint | HTTP status, provider registration, validation active | JerseyTest | P0 |
| ExceptionMapper | Exception → API error response | Unit + JerseyTest | P0 |
| Correlation ID | Header echo, error body, MDC cleanup | JerseyTest | P1 |
| Golden response | Stable success/error payload | Golden file test | P1 |
| PostgreSQL integration | Migration, constraint, transaction, query behavior | Testcontainers integration | P1/P0 for DB-heavy flows |
| Security payload | XXE, huge JSON, unsafe polymorphism | Negative regression test | P0 for exposed APIs |
| Compatibility | Old payload still accepted, old response shape stable | Contract regression | P1 |

Testcontainers for Java menyediakan throwaway container untuk database/dependency nyata yang cocok untuk integration tests, termasuk PostgreSQL module. ([Testcontainers](https://java.testcontainers.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) JSONAssert bisa dipakai untuk membandingkan struktur JSON dengan mode strict/non-strict; strict cocok untuk kontrak response yang harus stabil. ([JSONAssert](https://jsonassert.skyscreamer.org/apidocs/org/skyscreamer/jsonassert/JSONAssert.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 3. Matrix untuk Create Endpoint

Contoh endpoint:

```text
POST /orders
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
```

## 3.1 Happy Path

| Test case | Input | Expected | Level |
|---|---|---|---|
| Create valid order | Semua required field valid | `201 CREATED`, response punya `id`, `status`, `createdAt` | JerseyTest |
| Mapper creates command | DTO valid | `CreateOrderCommand` field lengkap | Unit mapper |
| Response contract stable | Domain result | JSON sama dengan golden file | Golden test |
| DB persist success | Request valid | Row masuk PostgreSQL, transaction commit | Integration |

## 3.2 Validation

| Test case | Input | Expected | Level |
|---|---|---|---|
| Missing `customerId` | `customerId: null` | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, field `customerId` | JerseyTest |
| Empty items | `items: []` | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, field `items` | Validator + JerseyTest |
| Invalid nested item | `items[0].quantity = 0` | field `items[0].quantity` | Validator + JerseyTest |
| Note too long | `note` > max | field `note`, code `FIELD_SIZE_INVALID` | Validator |
| Duplicate item ID | same `productId` repeated | custom error code | Custom validator |
| Unknown field | `unexpectedField` exists | `400 INVALID_JSON` atau `INVALID_PAYLOAD`, sesuai policy | Deserialization + JerseyTest |

## 3.3 Parser / Serialization

| Test case | Input | Expected | Level |
|---|---|---|---|
| Malformed JSON | `{ "customerId": }` | `400 INVALID_JSON` | JerseyTest |
| Invalid UUID | `customerId: "abc"` | `400 INVALID_JSON/INVALID_PAYLOAD` | JerseyTest |
| Invalid enum | `priority: "BOGUS"` | `400 INVALID_PAYLOAD` | Deserialization |
| Numeric enum | `priority: 1` | rejected | Deserialization |
| Invalid timestamp | non-ISO format | rejected | Deserialization |
| Trailing token | valid JSON + extra token | rejected | Deserialization |
| Null primitive | `quantity: null` if primitive target | rejected | Deserialization |

## 3.4 Domain / Infrastructure

| Test case | Condition | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Customer not found | Service/domain cannot find customer | `404 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` atau `422 CUSTOMER_INVALID`, sesuai rule |
| Duplicate order number | Unique/business duplicate | `409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` |
| Invalid state | Create not allowed in current account status | `409` atau `422` |
| DB unavailable | Repository throws infra exception | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| Unexpected exception | NPE/bug | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, no stack trace in response |

---

# 4. Matrix untuk Update Endpoint

Contoh:

```text
PUT /orders/{id}
```

Update penuh biasanya berarti **replace semantics**: missing field tidak dianggap “tidak berubah”, tetapi invalid request.

| Test case | Input/condition | Expected | Level |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valid full update | Semua required field ada | `200 OK` | JerseyTest |
| Missing required field | Field penting tidak dikirim/null | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` | JerseyTest |
| Path ID invalid | ID bukan UUID | `400` | JerseyTest |
| Body ID berbeda dari path ID | path `A`, body `B` | `400/409 ID_MISMATCH` | Unit/JerseyTest |
| Resource not found | ID valid tapi tidak ada | `404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND` | JerseyTest |
| Version conflict | optimistic lock mismatch | `409 VERSION_CONFLICT` | Integration |
| Mapper updates command | DTO + path ID | `UpdateOrderCommand` benar | Mapper unit |
| Response stable | Updated result | Golden response | Golden test |

Update full harus dites berbeda dari patch. Jangan membiarkan test update lolos padahal behavior sebenarnya patch-like.

---

# 5. Matrix untuk Patch Endpoint

Contoh:

```text
PATCH /orders/{id}
```

Patch paling rawan karena ada tiga makna:

```text
field absent  → jangan ubah
field null    → clear value atau invalid
field value   → update
```

## 5.1 Patch Semantic Matrix

| Test case | Input | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Field absent | `{}` | Tidak ada field berubah |
| Field value | `{ "note": "new note" }` | `note` berubah |
| Field null allowed | `{ "note": null }` | `note` clear |
| Field null not allowed | `{ "status": null }` | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Unknown field | `{ "bogus": "x" }` | rejected jika strict |
| Invalid field type | `{ "amount": "abc" }` | `400 INVALID_PAYLOAD` |
| Patch protected field | `{ "id": "..." }` | rejected / ignored sesuai policy |
| Patch invalid state transition | `{ "status": "CANCELLED" }` dari CLOSED | `409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` |

## 5.2 Mapper / Applier Matrix

| Test case | Fokus | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Null ignore strategy | MapStruct `IGNORE` | null tidak menimpa existing value |
| Explicit clear | Manual wrapper/applier | null value meng-clear hanya jika present |
| Nested patch | partial nested object | hanya nested field present berubah |
| Collection patch | replace vs append/remove | behavior sesuai kontrak |
| Domain invariant after patch | patched object invalid | domain exception |

Untuk patch kompleks, manual patch applier sering lebih aman daripada memaksa semua semantics ke MapStruct.

---

# 6. Matrix untuk List / Search Endpoint

Contoh:

```text
GET /orders?page=0&size=20&status=SUBMITTED&sort=createdAt,desc
```

| Test case | Input | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Default pagination | no page/size | default page/size dipakai |
| Page negative | `page=-1` | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Size too large | `size=10000` | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Invalid sort field | `sort=password,asc` | `400 INVALID_SORT_FIELD` |
| Invalid enum filter | `status=BOGUS` | `400 INVALID_QUERY_PARAM` |
| Empty result | valid query no rows | `200`, empty list, metadata benar |
| Stable list shape | valid query | response summary DTO, bukan detail/entity |
| DB query projection | filter/sort/paging | SQL benar di PostgreSQL |
| Tenant filter | user tenant A | tidak bocor tenant B |
| Authorization filter | user tidak boleh lihat data tertentu | hidden / filtered / 403 sesuai policy |

List/search test sebaiknya tidak hanya mengecek status `200`, tetapi juga memastikan **data leakage tidak terjadi**.

---

# 7. Matrix JSON Deserialization Hardening

| Test case | Payload | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Unknown field | extra field | rejected untuk strict API |
| Missing required | field absent | validation error |
| Explicit null required | `field: null` | validation error |
| Null primitive | `intField: null` | deserialization error |
| Empty string to number | `"amount": ""` | rejected |
| String to number coercion | `"amount": "100"` | rejected jika strict |
| Numeric enum | `"status": 1` | rejected |
| Unknown enum | `"status": "BOGUS"` | rejected |
| Very deep nesting | nested JSON > limit | rejected |
| Huge string | field > parser/string limit | rejected |
| Huge number | number length > limit | rejected |
| Trailing tokens | `{...} {...}` | rejected |
| Polymorphic type injection | `@class` / type metadata | rejected unless allow-listed |

---

# 8. Matrix XML Processing Hardening

Wajib jika endpoint menerima `application/xml`.

| Test case | Payload | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Valid XML | expected root/wrapper/namespace | accepted |
| Wrong root element | `<wrong>` | `400 INVALID_XML` |
| Missing required element | element absent | validation error |
| XML attribute vs element mismatch | wrong shape | rejected |
| Unknown element | extra element | strict/tolerant sesuai policy |
| Malformed XML | broken tag | `400 INVALID_XML` |
| DOCTYPE payload | DTD declared | rejected |
| External entity | `file:///etc/passwd` | rejected, no file content in response/log |
| External schema | schema location external | rejected |
| Billion laughs/entity expansion | entity expansion attack | rejected |
| Huge XML body | body over limit | `413` or `400/413` |
| Namespace mismatch | wrong namespace | rejected if contract requires namespace |

Test XML harus membuktikan parser aman, bukan hanya JAXB/Jackson XML berhasil parse happy path.

---

# 9. Matrix MapStruct / Data Mapper

| Test case | Source → target | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Create DTO → command | `CreateOrderRequest` | command lengkap |
| Update DTO + path ID → command | request + `id` | ID dari path dipakai |
| Patch DTO → existing object | partial request | hanya field intended berubah |
| Entity/result → summary response | domain/entity | field internal tidak masuk |
| Entity/result → detail response | domain/entity | nested DTO benar |
| Enum domain → DTO | semua enum value | mapping eksplisit |
| DTO enum → domain | invalid/UNKNOWN | throw/reject |
| Money mapping | amount + currency | `BigDecimal` preserved |
| Temporal mapping | `Instant` / `OffsetDateTime` | timezone preserved |
| Null source object | null input | behavior sesuai policy |
| Null collection | null list | empty/null sesuai contract |
| Unmapped target field | target field baru | compile fail jika `ReportingPolicy.ERROR` |

Test mapper bukan menggantikan compile-time MapStruct guardrail, tapi membuktikan mapping yang berdampak ke kontrak bisnis/API benar.

---

# 10. Matrix Bean Validation

| Test case | Constraint | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Required object | `@NotNull` | null rejected |
| Required string | `@NotBlank` | null/empty/blank rejected |
| Max length | `@Size(max=...)` | over length rejected |
| Collection not empty | `@NotEmpty` | empty rejected |
| Nested object | `@Valid` | child field violation muncul |
| Collection element | `List<@NotNull UUID>` | null item rejected |
| Nested collection item | `List<@Valid Item>` | item invalid rejected |
| Numeric min/max | `@Min`, `@Max` | out of range rejected |
| Decimal precision | `@Digits` | invalid precision rejected |
| Temporal | `@Past`, `@Future` | invalid date rejected |
| Cross-field | custom class constraint | field path tepat |
| Create group | group `Create` | create-only constraints aktif |
| Update group | group `Update` | update-only constraints aktif |
| Patch group | group `Patch` | patch optional constraints aktif |

Pastikan field path yang keluar adalah path yang bisa dipakai client, bukan path mentah seperti `create.arg0.items[0].quantity`.

---

# 11. Matrix ExceptionMapper / Error Contract

Semua error response minimal harus punya:

```json
{
  "code": "...",
  "message": "...",
  "correlationId": "...",
  "errors": []
}
```

| Scenario | Exception/source | Expected HTTP | Expected code |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Malformed JSON | Jackson parse exception | 400 | `INVALID_JSON` |
| Invalid JSON type | Jackson mapping exception | 400 | `INVALID_PAYLOAD` |
| Malformed XML | XML/JAXB exception | 400 | `INVALID_XML` |
| Validation failed | `ConstraintViolationException` | 400/422 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Domain not found | `DomainException` | 404 | domain-specific |
| Domain conflict | `DomainException` | 409 | domain-specific |
| Business semantic violation | `DomainException` | 422 | domain-specific |
| Forbidden | authz exception | 403 | `FORBIDDEN` |
| Unauthorized | authn exception | 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| DB unavailable | infra exception | 503 | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| Upstream timeout | infra exception | 504 | `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` |
| Unexpected exception | `Throwable` catch-all | 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` |

Additional assertions:

```text
[ ] no stack trace in response
[ ] no package/class name in response
[ ] no SQL details in response
[ ] no raw parser message if it leaks internals
[ ] correlationId exists
[ ] response Content-Type is JSON/XML as expected
```

---

# 12. Matrix Correlation ID & Logging Safety

| Test case | Input | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Missing correlation ID | no header | generated ID in response header and body |
| Valid correlation ID | `X-Correlation-Id: req-123` | same ID echoed |
| Invalid characters | weird header | rejected or regenerated |
| Too long ID | > max length | rejected or regenerated |
| Error path | validation/parser/domain error | ID still present |
| Success path | normal response | ID still present |
| Thread reuse | multiple sequential requests | MDC not contaminated |
| Sensitive payload | request contains secret | not logged raw |
| 5xx error | unexpected exception | full stack internal log only |

---

# 13. Matrix PostgreSQL Integration

Gunakan PostgreSQL nyata untuk behavior yang tidak aman dites dengan mock/in-memory DB.

| Area | Test case | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Migration | schema bootstraps clean | Flyway/Liquibase success |
| Constraint | unique key violation | mapped to `409` if business duplicate |
| Foreign key | invalid relation | handled as domain/integrity error |
| Transaction | service fails mid-way | rollback |
| Timestamp | `timestamptz` mapping | timezone/Instant correct |
| JSONB | JSON column query/update | behavior sesuai PostgreSQL |
| Numeric | `numeric` mapping | `BigDecimal` precision preserved |
| Locking | optimistic version conflict | `409 VERSION_CONFLICT` |
| Concurrency | two updates same resource | one succeeds, one conflicts |
| PL/pgSQL | function/procedure behavior | result/error mapped correctly |
| Pagination | limit/offset/keyset | ordering deterministic |
| Tenant filter | tenant isolation | no cross-tenant rows |

Testcontainers cocok untuk matrix ini karena test bisa memakai dependency nyata yang berjalan dalam Docker, bukan mock atau database in-memory yang behavior-nya berbeda dari PostgreSQL. ([Testcontainers](https://java.testcontainers.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 14. Prioritas Eksekusi Test

## P0 - wajib untuk endpoint penting

```text
[ ] Valid create/update/patch happy path
[ ] Missing required field
[ ] Invalid nested field
[ ] Malformed JSON
[ ] Unknown field sesuai policy
[ ] Invalid enum
[ ] Domain not found
[ ] Domain conflict
[ ] Error response shape
[ ] No stack trace/internal leak
[ ] Mapper DTO → command
[ ] Mapper result → response
```

## P1 - penting untuk stabilitas jangka menengah

```text
[ ] Golden file response
[ ] Correlation ID
[ ] Patch absent/null/value semantics
[ ] PostgreSQL integration for write flow
[ ] Unique constraint conflict
[ ] Date/time timezone
[ ] BigDecimal precision
[ ] XML happy path + XXE if XML enabled
```

## P2 - tambahan untuk sistem yang matang

```text
[ ] Property-based/fuzz invalid payload
[ ] Backward compatibility old payload
[ ] Deprecated field behavior
[ ] Load-ish payload size test
[ ] Contract comparison against OpenAPI
[ ] Mutation testing for validators/mappers
```

# 15. Naming Convention Test

Gunakan nama test yang menjelaskan behavior, bukan implementasi.

```text
shouldCreateOrderWhenRequestIsValid
shouldRejectCreateOrderWhenCustomerIdIsMissing
shouldRejectMalformedJson
shouldRejectUnknownFieldWhenApiIsStrict
shouldReturnConflictWhenOrderCannotBeCancelled
shouldPreserveBigDecimalPrecisionInPaymentResponse
shouldNotExposeInternalFieldsInOrderResponse
shouldRejectXmlExternalEntityPayload
shouldEchoCorrelationIdOnValidationError
```

Struktur file test yang rapi:

```text
src/test/java
  api/
    OrderResourceTest.java
    OrderErrorContractTest.java
  validation/
    CreateOrderRequestValidationTest.java
    ValidDateRangeValidatorTest.java
  mapper/
    OrderMapperTest.java
    OrderStatusMapperTest.java
  serialization/
    OrderJsonSerializationTest.java
    OrderXmlSerializationTest.java
  contract/
    OrderResponseGoldenFileTest.java

src/integrationTest/java
  repository/
    OrderRepositoryIT.java
  api/
    OrderApiPostgresIT.java

src/test/resources/contracts
  order-created.response.json
  order-validation-error.response.json
  order-conflict-error.response.json
```

# 16. Sample End-to-End Matrix: Cancel Order

Endpoint:

```text
POST /orders/{id}/cancel
```

| Test | Input/condition | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| Valid cancel | order SUBMITTED | `200 OK`, status `CANCELLED` |
| Invalid UUID path | `/orders/abc/cancel` | `400` |
| Missing reason | `{}` if reason required | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Reason too long | > max | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` |
| Order not found | ID valid no row | `404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND` |
| Already cancelled | order CANCELLED | `409 ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED` |
| Already closed | order CLOSED | `409 ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED` |
| Unauthorized | no token | `401 UNAUTHORIZED` |
| Forbidden | user lacks permission | `403 FORBIDDEN` |
| DB unavailable | repository throws | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| Response contract | success body | stable JSON |
| Audit side effect | cancellation logged | audit row/event exists |
| Transaction rollback | failure after state change | state not partially persisted |
| Concurrency | two cancel requests | one success, one conflict/idempotent according to policy |

Untuk regulatory/workflow-heavy system, cancellation/escalation/approval endpoint seperti ini harus punya test state transition yang eksplisit.

# 17. Minimal CI Gate

```text
mvn clean verify
  ↓
compile
  - MapStruct annotation processor
  - unmapped target policy
  ↓
unit tests
  - validation
  - mapper
  - serialization
  ↓
JerseyTest
  - resource/provider/filter/exception mapper
  ↓
contract tests
  - golden success/error payloads
  ↓
integration tests
  - PostgreSQL container
  - migration
  - repository/service behavior
```

Jangan biarkan test runtime memakai konfigurasi serializer yang berbeda dari production. Kesalahan paling umum adalah unit test memakai `new ObjectMapper()` sementara Jersey runtime memakai `ContextResolver<ObjectMapper>` yang berbeda.

# Cheatsheet - Practical Implementation Blueprint untuk Jersey/JAX-RS Boundary Layer

## 1. Introduction

Blueprint ini adalah kerangka implementasi praktis untuk menyatukan:

```text
Jersey/JAX-RS
  + Jackson / JSON-B / JAXB / Jackson XML
  + Jakarta Bean Validation / Hibernate Validator
  + MapStruct
  + ExceptionMapper
  + Correlation ID
  + DTO contract test
```

Targetnya: boundary layer yang **konsisten, testable, aman, dan mudah diaudit**.

Jersey menyediakan extension untuk JSON/Jackson, Bean Validation, provider registration, dan `ResourceConfig`; MapStruct menghasilkan mapper Java saat compile-time; Hibernate Validator adalah reference implementation Jakarta Validation 3.1; Jackson menyediakan `ObjectMapper`/`JsonMapper` dan parser constraints seperti `StreamReadConstraints`. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 3. Maven Dependency Blueprint

Gunakan version management / BOM project bila sudah ada. Contoh berikut sengaja memakai property agar versi bisa dikunci di parent POM.

```xml
<properties>
    <maven.compiler.release>17</maven.compiler.release>

    <jersey.version>${project.jersey.version}</jersey.version>
    <jackson.version>${project.jackson.version}</jackson.version>
    <mapstruct.version>${project.mapstruct.version}</mapstruct.version>
    <hibernate.validator.version>${project.hibernate.validator.version}</hibernate.validator.version>
</properties>
```

## 3.1 Jersey / JAX-RS

```xml
<dependencies>
    <!-- Jersey core server/container depends on deployment model -->
    <dependency>
        <groupId>org.glassfish.jersey.containers</groupId>
        <artifactId>jersey-container-servlet-core</artifactId>
        <version>${jersey.version}</version>
    </dependency>

    <!-- HK2 injection, if using Jersey/HK2 -->
    <dependency>
        <groupId>org.glassfish.jersey.inject</groupId>
        <artifactId>jersey-hk2</artifactId>
        <version>${jersey.version}</version>
    </dependency>

    <!-- Jackson JSON provider -->
    <dependency>
        <groupId>org.glassfish.jersey.media</groupId>
        <artifactId>jersey-media-json-jackson</artifactId>
        <version>${jersey.version}</version>
    </dependency>

    <!-- Bean Validation integration -->
    <dependency>
        <groupId>org.glassfish.jersey.ext</groupId>
        <artifactId>jersey-bean-validation</artifactId>
        <version>${jersey.version}</version>
    </dependency>
</dependencies>
```

Jersey documents `jersey-media-json-jackson` for Jackson support and `jersey-bean-validation` for Bean Validation integration. ([Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/20563640/using-jackson-objectmapper-with-jersey?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```xml
<dependencies>
```

MapStruct is a compile-time code generator for Java bean mapping; generated code uses plain method calls, making it type-safe and easy to inspect. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 4. `ApiApplication` / `ResourceConfig`

```java
package com.company.app.api;

import com.company.app.api.config.ObjectMapperProvider;
import com.company.app.api.error.ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper;
import com.company.app.api.error.DomainExceptionMapper;
import com.company.app.api.error.InfrastructureExceptionMapper;
import com.company.app.api.error.JsonExceptionMapper;
import com.company.app.api.error.UnhandledExceptionMapper;
import com.company.app.api.filter.CorrelationIdRequestFilter;
import com.company.app.api.filter.CorrelationIdResponseFilter;
import com.company.app.api.filter.PayloadSizeFilter;
import org.glassfish.jersey.jackson.JacksonFeature;
import org.glassfish.jersey.server.ResourceConfig;

public class ApiApplication extends ResourceConfig {

    public ApiApplication() {
        packages("com.company.app.api");

        // JSON provider
        register(JacksonFeature.class);
        register(ObjectMapperProvider.class);

        // Filters
        register(CorrelationIdRequestFilter.class);
        register(CorrelationIdResponseFilter.class);
        register(PayloadSizeFilter.class);

        // Exception mappers
        register(JsonExceptionMapper.class);
        register(ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper.class);
        register(DomainExceptionMapper.class);
        register(InfrastructureExceptionMapper.class);
        register(UnhandledExceptionMapper.class);
    }
}
```

Rule:

```text
[ ] Jangan mengandalkan auto-discovery tanpa audit.
[ ] Register provider/config eksplisit.
[ ] Pastikan test ResourceConfig semirip production.
[ ] Jangan register Jackson dan JSON-B sebagai default bersamaan tanpa policy.
```

---

# 5. ObjectMapper Provider

```java
package com.company.app.api.config;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.StreamReadConstraints;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.DeserializationFeature;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.MapperFeature;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.SerializationFeature;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.jsr310.JavaTimeModule;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Produces;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.ContextResolver;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;

@Provider
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class ObjectMapperProvider implements ContextResolver<JsonMapper> {

    private final JsonMapper mapper;

    public ObjectMapperProvider() {
        JsonFactory jsonFactory = JsonFactory.builder()
                .streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder()
                        .maxNestingDepth(100)
                        .maxNumberLength(100)
                        .maxStringLength(1_000_000)
                        .build())
                .build();

        this.mapper = JsonMapper.builder(jsonFactory)
                .addModule(new JavaTimeModule())

                // Date/time policy
                .disable(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS)
                .disable(DeserializationFeature.ADJUST_DATES_TO_CONTEXT_TIME_ZONE)

                // Deserialization hardening
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES)
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS)
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_NULL_FOR_PRIMITIVES)
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_NUMBERS_FOR_ENUMS)
                .enable(DeserializationFeature.USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS)

                // Coercion policy
                .disable(MapperFeature.ALLOW_COERCION_OF_SCALARS)

                // Output policy
                .serializationInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL)

                .build();
    }

    @Override
    public JsonMapper getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return mapper;
    }
}
```

`StreamReadConstraints` provides parser-level limits such as nesting depth, string length, and number length, which is useful for boundary hardening. ([Javadoc](https://javadoc.io/doc/com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core/latest/com/fasterxml/jackson/core/StreamReadConstraints.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java
package com.company.app.api.order.dto;
```

# 7. Resource Blueprint

```java
package com.company.app.api.order;

import com.company.app.api.order.dto.CreateOrderRequest;
import com.company.app.api.order.dto.OrderResponse;
import com.company.app.api.order.mapper.OrderApiMapper;
import com.company.app.application.order.OrderService;
import com.company.app.application.order.command.CreateOrderCommand;
import com.company.app.application.order.result.OrderResult;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Consumes;
import jakarta.ws.rs.POST;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Path;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Produces;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response;

@Path("/orders")
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class OrderResource {

    private final OrderService orderService;
    private final OrderApiMapper orderMapper;

    public OrderResource(
            OrderService orderService,
            OrderApiMapper orderMapper
    ) {
        this.orderService = orderService;
        this.orderMapper = orderMapper;
    }

    @POST
    public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request) {
        CreateOrderCommand command = orderMapper.toCommand(request);

        OrderResult result = orderService.create(command);

        OrderResponse response = orderMapper.toResponse(result);

        return Response.status(Response.Status.CREATED)
                .entity(response)
                .build();
    }
}
```

Resource responsibility:

```text
Resource boleh:
- menerima DTO
- memanggil validation otomatis
- resolve actor/tenant/correlation context
- mapping DTO → command
- panggil service
- mapping result → response

Resource jangan:
- parse JSON manual
- query database langsung
- menjalankan state transition detail
- membuat response error manual berulang-ulang
```
