## 9.2 Custom Constraint

```java
package com.company.app.api.validation;

import jakarta.validation.Constraint;
import jakarta.validation.Payload;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;

import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.TYPE;
import static java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME;

@Target(TYPE)
@Retention(RUNTIME)
@Constraint(validatedBy = ValidDateRangeValidator.class)
public @interface ValidDateRange {

    String message() default "{date.range.invalid}";

    Class<?>[] groups() default {};

    Class<? extends Payload>[] payload() default {};
}
```

```java
package com.company.app.api.validation;

import jakarta.validation.ConstraintValidator;
import jakarta.validation.ConstraintValidatorContext;

public class ValidDateRangeValidator
        implements ConstraintValidator<ValidDateRange, HasDateRange> {

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(
            HasDateRange value,
            ConstraintValidatorContext context
    ) {
        if (value == null ||
                value.effectiveFrom() == null ||
                value.effectiveTo() == null) {
            return true;
        }

        if (!value.effectiveFrom().isAfter(value.effectiveTo())) {
            return true;
        }

        context.disableDefaultConstraintViolation();
        context.buildConstraintViolationWithTemplate(
                "effectiveFrom must be before or equal to effectiveTo"
        ).addPropertyNode("effectiveFrom")
         .addConstraintViolation();

        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.company.app.api.validation;

import java.time.LocalDate;

public interface HasDateRange {
    LocalDate effectiveFrom();
    LocalDate effectiveTo();
}
```

Constraint annotations in Jakarta Validation conventionally expose `message`, `groups`, and `payload`; validators implement `ConstraintValidator<A,T>`. ([Hibernate Documentation](https://docs.hibernate.org/validator/8.0/reference/en-US/html_single/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 10.3 Validation Error Code Registry

```java
package com.company.app.api.error;

import jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolation;
import java.util.Map;

public final class ValidationErrorCodeRegistry {

    private static final Map<String, String> CODES = Map.ofEntries(
            Map.entry("NotNull", "FIELD_REQUIRED"),
            Map.entry("NotBlank", "FIELD_REQUIRED"),
            Map.entry("NotEmpty", "FIELD_REQUIRED"),
            Map.entry("Size", "FIELD_SIZE_INVALID"),
            Map.entry("Min", "FIELD_MIN_VALUE"),
            Map.entry("Max", "FIELD_MAX_VALUE"),
            Map.entry("Pattern", "FIELD_PATTERN_INVALID"),
            Map.entry("Email", "FIELD_EMAIL_INVALID"),
            Map.entry("ValidDateRange", "DATE_RANGE_INVALID")
    );

    public String resolve(ConstraintViolation<?> violation) {
        String annotationName = violation.getConstraintDescriptor()
                .getAnnotation()
                .annotationType()
                .getSimpleName();

        return CODES.getOrDefault(annotationName, annotationName);
    }
}
```

# 11. ExceptionMapper Blueprint

## 11.1 Constraint Violation Mapper

```java
package com.company.app.api.error;

import jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolation;
import jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolationException;
import jakarta.validation.Path;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.ExceptionMapper;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;
import org.slf4j.MDC;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;

@Provider
public class ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<ConstraintViolationException> {

    private final ValidationErrorCodeRegistry codeRegistry =
            new ValidationErrorCodeRegistry();

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(ConstraintViolationException exception) {
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors = exception.getConstraintViolations()
                .stream()
                .map(this::toFieldError)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(FieldErrorResponse::field))
                .toList();

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                "Request validation failed",
                currentCorrelationId(),
                errors
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private FieldErrorResponse toFieldError(ConstraintViolation<?> violation) {
        return new FieldErrorResponse(
                normalizePath(violation.getPropertyPath()),
                codeRegistry.resolve(violation),
                violation.getMessage()
        );
    }

    private String normalizePath(Path path) {
        return path.toString()
                .replaceFirst("^create\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^update\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^patch\\.arg0\\.", "")
                .replaceFirst("^arg0\\.", "");
    }

    private String currentCorrelationId() {
        return MDC.get("correlationId");
    }
}
```

## 11.2 Domain Exception Mapper

```java
package com.company.app.api.error;

import com.company.app.application.error.DomainErrorCategory;
import com.company.app.application.error.DomainException;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.ExceptionMapper;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;
import org.slf4j.MDC;

import java.util.List;

@Provider
public class DomainExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<DomainException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(DomainException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                exception.code(),
                exception.publicMessage(),
                MDC.get("correlationId"),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(toStatus(exception.category()))
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private Response.Status toStatus(DomainErrorCategory category) {
        return switch (category) {
            case NOT_FOUND -> Response.Status.NOT_FOUND;
            case CONFLICT, INVALID_STATE -> Response.Status.CONFLICT;
            case BUSINESS_RULE -> Response.Status.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY;
            case FORBIDDEN -> Response.Status.FORBIDDEN;
        };
    }
}
```

## 11.4 Catch-All Mapper

```java
package com.company.app.api.error;

import jakarta.annotation.Priority;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Priorities;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.ExceptionMapper;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.slf4j.MDC;

import java.util.List;

@Provider
@Priority(Priorities.USER + 500)
public class UnhandledExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<Throwable> {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(UnhandledExceptionMapper.class);

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(Throwable exception) {
        String correlationId = MDC.get("correlationId");

        log.error(
                "Unhandled API error. correlationId={}",
                correlationId,
                exception
        );

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                "INTERNAL_ERROR",
                "Unexpected server error",
                correlationId,
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(Response.Status.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }
}
```

`ExceptionMapper<T>` is the Jakarta REST extension point for converting exceptions to HTTP responses. ([Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/20563640/using-jackson-objectmapper-with-jersey?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 12. Correlation ID Filter Blueprint

## 12.1 Request Filter

```java
package com.company.app.api.filter;

import jakarta.annotation.Priority;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Priorities;
import jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerRequestContext;
import jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerRequestFilter;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;
import org.slf4j.MDC;

import java.util.UUID;

@Provider
@Priority(Priorities.AUTHENTICATION)
public class CorrelationIdRequestFilter implements ContainerRequestFilter {

    public static final String HEADER = "X-Correlation-Id";
    public static final String PROPERTY = "correlationId";

    @Override
    public void filter(ContainerRequestContext requestContext) {
        String incoming = requestContext.getHeaderString(HEADER);

        String correlationId = isValid(incoming)
                ? incoming
                : "req-" + UUID.randomUUID();

        requestContext.setProperty(PROPERTY, correlationId);
        MDC.put(PROPERTY, correlationId);
    }

    private boolean isValid(String value) {
        return value != null
                && value.length() <= 100
                && value.matches("[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+");
    }
}
```

## 12.2 Response Filter

```java
package com.company.app.api.filter;

import jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerRequestContext;
import jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerResponseContext;
import jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerResponseFilter;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;
import org.slf4j.MDC;

@Provider
public class CorrelationIdResponseFilter implements ContainerResponseFilter {

    @Override
    public void filter(
            ContainerRequestContext requestContext,
            ContainerResponseContext responseContext
    ) {
        Object correlationId =
                requestContext.getProperty(CorrelationIdRequestFilter.PROPERTY);

        if (correlationId != null) {
            responseContext.getHeaders().putSingle(
                    CorrelationIdRequestFilter.HEADER,
                    correlationId
            );
        }

        MDC.remove(CorrelationIdRequestFilter.PROPERTY);
    }
}
```

# 13. Payload Size Filter Blueprint

```java
package com.company.app.api.filter;

import com.company.app.application.error.DomainException;
import com.company.app.application.error.DomainErrorCategory;
import jakarta.annotation.Priority;
import jakarta.ws.rs.BadRequestException;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Priorities;
import jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerRequestContext;
import jakarta.ws.rs.container.ContainerRequestFilter;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;

@Provider
@Priority(Priorities.AUTHENTICATION)
public class PayloadSizeFilter implements ContainerRequestFilter {

    private static final long MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1_000_000;

    @Override
    public void filter(ContainerRequestContext requestContext) {
        String contentLength =
                requestContext.getHeaderString("Content-Length");

        if (contentLength == null) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            long size = Long.parseLong(contentLength);

            if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
                throw new DomainException(
                        "PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE",
                        "Payload is too large",
                        DomainErrorCategory.BUSINESS_RULE
                );
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Invalid Content-Length");
        }
    }
}
```

Catatan: `Content-Length` tidak cukup untuk semua skenario, terutama chunked transfer. Tetap pasang limit di ingress/container/parser.

# 14. XML Provider Blueprint

Gunakan hanya jika API memang menerima XML.

```java
package com.company.app.api.config;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.StreamReadConstraints;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.xml.XmlFactory;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.xml.XmlMapper;
import jakarta.ws.rs.Produces;
import jakarta.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.ContextResolver;
import jakarta.ws.rs.ext.Provider;

import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;

@Provider
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_XML)
public class XmlMapperProvider implements ContextResolver<XmlMapper> {

    private final XmlMapper xmlMapper;

    public XmlMapperProvider() {
        XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newFactory();
        inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD, false);
        inputFactory.setProperty(
                "javax.xml.stream.isSupportingExternalEntities",
                false
        );
        inputFactory.setProperty(
                XMLInputFactory.IS_REPLACING_ENTITY_REFERENCES,
                false
        );

        XmlFactory xmlFactory = XmlFactory.builder()
                .xmlInputFactory(inputFactory)
                .streamReadConstraints(StreamReadConstraints.builder()
                        .maxNestingDepth(100)
                        .maxStringLength(1_000_000)
                        .maxNumberLength(100)
                        .build())
                .build();

        this.xmlMapper = XmlMapper.builder(xmlFactory).build();
    }

    @Override
    public XmlMapper getContext(Class<?> type) {
        return xmlMapper;
    }
}
```

class OrderApiMapperTest {

    private final OrderApiMapper mapper =
            Mappers.getMapper(OrderApiMapper.class);

    @Test
    void shouldMapCreateRequestToCommand() {
        CreateOrderRequest request = new CreateOrderRequest(
                UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
                List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(

        );

        CreateOrderCommand command = mapper.toCommand(request);

class CreateOrderRequestValidationTest {

    private static Validator validator;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setup() {
        validator = Validation.buildDefaultValidatorFactory()
                .getValidator();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectMissingCustomerId() {
        CreateOrderRequest request = new CreateOrderRequest(
                null,
                List.of(new CreateOrderItemRequest(UUID.randomUUID(), 1)),
                null
        );

        Set<ConstraintViolation<CreateOrderRequest>> violations =
                validator.validate(request);

        assertTrue(violations.stream()
                .anyMatch(v -> v.getPropertyPath()
                        .toString()
                        .equals("customerId")));
    }
}

## 15.4 JerseyTest Skeleton

```java
class OrderResourceTest extends JerseyTest {

    private OrderService orderService;

    @Override
    protected Application configure() {
        orderService = mock(OrderService.class);

        return new ResourceConfig()
                .register(new OrderResource(
                        orderService,
                        Mappers.getMapper(OrderApiMapper.class)
                ))
                .register(JacksonFeature.class)
                .register(ObjectMapperProvider.class)
                .register(ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper.class)
                .register(DomainExceptionMapper.class)
                .register(JsonExceptionMapper.class)
                .register(UnhandledExceptionMapper.class)
                .register(CorrelationIdRequestFilter.class)
                .register(CorrelationIdResponseFilter.class);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnValidationError() {
        Response response = target("/orders")
                .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .post(Entity.json("""
                        {
                          "customerId": null,
                          "items": []
                        }
                        """));

        assertEquals(400, response.getStatus());

        ApiErrorResponse error =
                response.readEntity(ApiErrorResponse.class);

        assertEquals("VALIDATION_FAILED", error.code());
        assertNotNull(error.correlationId());
        assertFalse(error.errors().isEmpty());
    }
}
```

Jersey Test Framework is designed for JAX-RS resource testing and uses `JerseyTest` with `configure()` returning a test `Application`/`ResourceConfig`. ([Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/20563640/using-jackson-objectmapper-with-jersey?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 16. Implementation Checklist

## 16.1 Boundary

```text
[ ] Semua endpoint punya DTO request/response eksplisit.
[ ] Entity persistence tidak pernah langsung jadi response.
[ ] Create/update/patch DTO dipisah jika semantics berbeda.
[ ] Request DTO divalidasi dengan @Valid.
[ ] Nested DTO memakai @Valid.
[ ] Collection item memakai container element validation.
```

## 16.2 Serialization

```text
[ ] Hanya satu default JSON provider aktif.
[ ] ObjectMapper/JsonbConfig terpusat.
[ ] Unknown field policy eksplisit.
[ ] Enum policy eksplisit.
[ ] Temporal policy eksplisit.
[ ] BigDecimal/numeric policy eksplisit.
[ ] Payload/parser constraints aktif.
[ ] XML hardened jika XML aktif.
```

## 16.3 Mapping

```text
[ ] Semua mapper memakai ApiMapperConfig.
[ ] unmappedTargetPolicy = ERROR.
[ ] DTO enum tidak asal expose domain enum.
[ ] Patch semantics jelas.
[ ] Mapper tidak query database.
[ ] Mapper tidak call external service.
```

## 16.4 Error

```text
[ ] ApiErrorResponse standar.
[ ] ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper aktif.
[ ] DomainExceptionMapper aktif.
[ ] Parser exception mapper aktif.
[ ] Infrastructure mapper aktif.
[ ] Catch-all mapper aktif.
[ ] Response error tidak expose stack trace.
[ ] Correlation ID selalu ada.
```

## 16.5 Test

```text
[ ] DTO validation test.
[ ] Custom validator test.
[ ] MapStruct mapper test.
[ ] ObjectMapper/Jsonb/XML config test.
[ ] JerseyTest untuk endpoint penting.
[ ] Error contract test.
[ ] Golden file untuk response penting.
[ ] XXE test jika XML aktif.
[ ] PostgreSQL/Testcontainers integration test untuk write flow penting.
```

---

# 17. Blueprint Decision Table

| Keputusan | Default yang disarankan |
|---|---|
| JSON provider | Jackson untuk kontrol tinggi; JSON-B jika portability Jakarta lebih penting |
| XML provider | JAXB untuk XML formal/schema-oriented; Jackson XML jika tim ingin model Jackson |
| DTO style | Java records untuk request/response immutable |
| Mapper | MapStruct untuk DTO/command/response mapping |
| Validation | Jakarta Validation + Hibernate Validator |
| Error response | `code`, `message`, `correlationId`, `errors` |
| Unknown field | Strict untuk command API internal/regulatory |
| Enum input | Strict, no numeric enum |
| Date/time | ISO-8601, `Instant`/`OffsetDateTime` |
| Money | `BigDecimal`, never `double` |
| Patch | Manual/wrapper jika absent/null/value harus dibedakan |
| Correlation | `X-Correlation-Id` + MDC |
| Test | Unit + JerseyTest + golden file + integration |

# Cheatsheet - Production Review Checklist untuk DTO, Serialization, Validation, MapStruct, ExceptionMapper, Logging, Security, Test Coverage & Backward Compatibility di Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Checklist ini dipakai saat review PR yang menyentuh **Jersey/JAX-RS boundary layer**, terutama endpoint baru, perubahan DTO, perubahan serializer, validasi, mapper, error contract, atau behavior request/response.

Target review-nya sederhana:

```text
Apakah perubahan ini aman untuk client?
Apakah failure mode-nya jelas?
Apakah contract-nya stabil?
Apakah error-nya bisa diaudit?
Apakah test-nya benar-benar menguji wire-format?
Apakah tidak ada data internal/sensitif yang bocor?
```

Jersey menyediakan dukungan Bean Validation melalui `jersey-bean-validation`, termasuk dependency, configuration, registration, dan usage. MapStruct menghasilkan mapper implementation saat compile-time dengan plain method invocation, sehingga cocok sebagai guardrail mapping DTO/domain/response. Hibernate Validator adalah reference implementation Jakarta Validation, dan OWASP merekomendasikan disabling DTD/external entities sebagai baseline pencegahan XXE untuk XML parser. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Review Flow Diagram

```text
PR touches API boundary?
   │
   ├─ DTO changed?
   │    ├─ request compatibility
   │    ├─ response compatibility
   │    ├─ nullability
   │    ├─ enum/date/number format
   │    └─ validation impact
   │
   ├─ Serialization changed?
   │    ├─ Jackson / JSON-B / JAXB config
   │    ├─ unknown field policy
   │    ├─ enum policy
   │    ├─ temporal/numeric policy
   │    └─ XML hardening
   │
   ├─ Mapper changed?
   │    ├─ DTO → command
   │    ├─ result/entity → response
   │    ├─ patch/update behavior
   │    ├─ enum mapping
   │    └─ unmapped fields
   │
   ├─ Validation changed?
   │    ├─ field constraint
   │    ├─ nested validation
   │    ├─ container element validation
   │    ├─ custom constraint
   │    └─ group behavior
   │
   ├─ Error handling changed?
   │    ├─ ExceptionMapper
   │    ├─ HTTP status
   │    ├─ error code
   │    ├─ correlationId
   │    └─ logging safety
   │
   └─ Tests updated?
        ├─ unit
        ├─ mapper
        ├─ serialization
        ├─ JerseyTest
        ├─ golden file
        ├─ invalid payload
        └─ integration/security regression
```

# 3. P0 Checklist - Wajib Dicek Sebelum Merge

## 3.1 API Contract & DTO

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| Request DTO eksplisit | Endpoint menerima request DTO, bukan entity/domain object | `OrderEntity` langsung jadi parameter resource |
| Response DTO eksplisit | Response memakai DTO khusus | `Response.ok(entity)` |
| DTO per use case | Create/update/patch tidak dipaksa satu DTO jika semantiknya beda | Satu `OrderRequest` untuk semua operasi |
| Field baru | Apakah optional/required? Ada default? | Field required baru ditambahkan ke public API tanpa versioning |
| Field dihapus/rename | Apakah breaking change? | Rename field langsung tanpa compatibility plan |
| Nullability | Makna null jelas | Null bisa berarti “clear”, “ignore”, atau “invalid” tanpa dokumentasi |
| Enum | Input enum strict, output enum stabil | Domain enum internal bocor ke API |
| Date/time | Format dan timezone eksplisit | `LocalDateTime` untuk event absolut |
| Money/amount | Pakai `BigDecimal` | `double` untuk monetary value |
| Internal field | Tidak expose audit/internal/security field | `internalStatus`, `deletedAt`, `version`, `roleMask` bocor |

**Reject PR** jika entity persistence langsung diekspos sebagai response untuk endpoint non-trivial.

---

## 3.2 JSON Serialization / Deserialization

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| Provider default | Hanya satu default JSON provider aktif | Jackson dan JSON-B sama-sama aktif tanpa policy |
| `ObjectMapper` pusat | Jersey runtime memakai provider/config yang sama dengan test | Test pakai `new ObjectMapper()` |
| Unknown field policy | Strict/tolerant diputuskan eksplisit | Unknown field diterima diam-diam di command API |
| Enum policy | Numeric enum ditolak | `"status": 1` diterima |
| Invalid enum | Unknown enum gagal dengan error jelas | Unknown enum jadi `null` |
| Temporal format | ISO-8601 atau format eksplisit | Output berubah saat upgrade dependency |
| Numeric precision | Decimal tetap presisi | Amount berubah precision/scale |
| Coercion | String/number/boolean coercion sesuai policy | `"100"` diterima sebagai number tanpa sengaja |
| Payload constraint | Parser/body limit ada | Payload besar/deep bisa menyebabkan memory pressure |

Jackson menyediakan `DeserializationFeature` untuk mengontrol behavior seperti unknown properties dan enum deserialization, dan `StreamReadConstraints` untuk membatasi input seperti nesting depth, string length, dan number length. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 3.3 XML Serialization / Deserialization

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| XML memang perlu | Endpoint XML punya business/integration reason | XML aktif karena default module |
| DTD disabled | DTD/external entity dinonaktifkan | DOCTYPE payload diterima |
| External access | External DTD/schema/styling diblokir | Parser boleh akses file/URL eksternal |
| Namespace/wrapper | XML namespace dan wrapper element dites | XML dianggap sama dengan JSON |
| XXE regression test | Payload external entity ditolak | Tidak ada negative XML security test |
| XML error mapping | Invalid XML jadi error standar | Raw XML exception bocor |

OWASP menyebut cara paling aman mencegah XXE adalah menonaktifkan DTD/external entities sepenuhnya bila tidak diperlukan. ([OWASP Cheat Sheet Series](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/XML_External_Entity_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 3.4 Jakarta Bean Validation / Hibernate Validator

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| `@Valid` di request body | DTO divalidasi otomatis | Resource menerima DTO tanpa `@Valid` |
| Nested validation | Child object/collection item ikut divalidasi | `List<ItemRequest>` tanpa `List<@Valid ItemRequest>` |
| Required string | Pakai `@NotBlank`, bukan hanya `@NotNull` | String kosong lolos |
| Primitive field | Missing/null harus bisa dibedakan | `int quantity` padahal field required |
| Container element | `List<@NotNull UUID>` atau `List<@Valid X>` | Item null/invalid lolos |
| Custom constraint | Pure, deterministic, tanpa side effect | Validator query DB/external API |
| Class-level constraint | Error diarahkan ke field bila memungkinkan | Semua error muncul di root object |
| Validation group | Dipakai secukupnya | Banyak group di satu DTO sampai sulit diaudit |
| Error mapping | `ConstraintViolationException` jadi error response standar | Validation error jadi 500 |

Hibernate Validator documentation menekankan constraint declaration, custom constraints, dan validasi object model; Jersey menyediakan integrasi Bean Validation melalui modul khusus. ([JBoss Documentation](https://docs.jboss.org/hibernate/stable/validator/reference/en-US/html_single/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 3.5 MapStruct / Data Mapper

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| Central mapper config | Semua mapper pakai `@MapperConfig` | Tiap mapper punya policy sendiri |
| Unmapped target | `unmappedTargetPolicy = ERROR` untuk mapper contract penting | Field response baru tidak termapping tapi build tetap hijau |
| DTO → command | Mapping request ke command eksplisit | Resource/service ambil field manual tersebar |
| Result/entity → response | Field internal tidak ikut masuk | Entity graph terserialisasi |
| Enum mapping | Domain enum ↔ DTO enum jelas | Internal enum value bocor |
| Patch mapping | Null/absent/value semantics dites | Null menghapus data tanpa sengaja |
| Mapper purity | Tidak query DB/external service | Mapper menjadi service layer tersembunyi |
| Annotation processor | Maven/CI menghasilkan mapper | IDE jalan, CI gagal karena processor config |

MapStruct reference guide mendokumentasikan `@MapperConfig`, reporting policy seperti `unmappedTargetPolicy`, dan mapper generation berbasis annotation processing. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/documentation/stable/reference/html/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 3.6 ExceptionMapper & Error Contract

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| Error model standar | Semua error punya `code`, `message`, `correlationId`, `errors` | Tiap endpoint punya format error sendiri |
| Parser error | Invalid JSON/XML jadi 400 | Parser error jadi 500 |
| Validation error | Constraint violation jadi 400/422 | Raw violation framework dikirim |
| Domain error | Domain exception mapped ke 404/409/422/403 | Domain service throw `Response` |
| Infrastructure error | DB/upstream timeout jadi 503/504 | SQL/driver detail bocor |
| Catch-all mapper | Unexpected error jadi 500 aman | Stack trace di response |
| HTTP status | Status sesuai kategori error | Semua business error jadi 400 atau 500 |
| Error code stability | Code tidak berubah sembarangan | Client logic bergantung ke message |

**Reject PR** jika response error mengandung stack trace, SQL detail, package/class internal, token, secret, atau raw payload sensitif.

---

## 3.7 Logging, Correlation ID & Observability

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| Correlation ID | Request/response punya correlation ID | Error tidak bisa ditrace |
| Header validation | Incoming correlation ID divalidasi | Header arbitrary panjang/aneh masuk log |
| MDC cleanup | MDC dibersihkan setelah request | Log request lain tercemar |
| Log level | 4xx expected tidak noisy, 5xx logged | Validation error flood di `ERROR` |
| Payload logging | Sanitized / redacted | Full request body berisi PII/secret |
| Error logging | 5xx full exception internal | Tidak ada stack trace untuk debugging |
| Client response | Public message aman | Internal exception message dikirim ke client |

---

## 3.8 Test Coverage

| Review item | Harus dicek | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| DTO validation test | Missing/invalid field dites | Hanya happy path |
| Mapper test | DTO-command-response mapping dites | Mapper berubah tanpa test |
| Serialization test | JSON/XML output stabil | Tidak ada golden/contract test |
| Deserialization test | Unknown field, enum, date, number dites | ObjectMapper config tidak dites |
| JerseyTest | Resource + provider + validation + mapper + exception mapper dites bersama | Unit test tidak mencerminkan runtime |
| Error contract test | Semua error shape sama | Error response drift |
| Security payload test | XXE, malformed JSON/XML, oversized/deep payload | XML/JSON hardening tidak dites |
| Integration test | DB behavior penting dites dengan PostgreSQL nyata | Semua DB test pakai mock |
| Regression compatibility | Payload lama masih dites jika supported | Client lama bisa rusak diam-diam |

Jersey Test Framework mendukung testing resource/provider JAX-RS dengan `JerseyTest` dan `ResourceConfig`, sehingga cocok untuk membuktikan wiring runtime seperti provider, filter, validation, dan `ExceptionMapper`. ([Eclipse EE4J](https://eclipse-ee4j.github.io/jersey.github.io/documentation/latest/bean-validation.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 4. P1 Checklist - Sangat Dianjurkan untuk Endpoint Penting

## 4.1 Backward Compatibility

| Review question | Expected answer |
|---|---|
| Apakah ada field response yang dihapus? | Harus dianggap breaking |
| Apakah field response di-rename? | Breaking kecuali alias/transisi disediakan |
| Apakah field request baru wajib? | Breaking untuk client lama |
| Apakah enum value baru ditambahkan? | Cek client lama bisa handle atau tidak |
| Apakah validation menjadi lebih ketat? | Bisa breaking |
| Apakah HTTP status berubah? | Bisa breaking client flow |
| Apakah error code berubah? | Breaking jika client bergantung pada code |
| Apakah nullability berubah? | Bisa breaking |
| Apakah date/time format berubah? | Breaking |
| Apakah numeric format/scale berubah? | Bisa breaking, terutama money |

Aturan aman:

```text
Add optional fields, jangan mutate field lama.
Deprecate sebelum remove.
Version hanya untuk breaking contract besar.
Error code adalah contract, bukan detail internal.
```

---

## 4.2 Patch Review

Patch harus direview lebih keras daripada create/update.

| Review item | Harus jelas |
|---|---|
| Field absent | Tidak berubah? |
| Field null | Clear value atau invalid? |
| Field value | Update value? |
| Protected field | Boleh dipatch atau ditolak? |
| Nested object | Merge atau replace? |
| Collection | Replace whole list, append/remove, atau patch item? |
| Mapper behavior | MapStruct null ignore atau manual applier? |
| Domain invariant | Dicek setelah patch diterapkan? |
| Audit trail | Mencatat field yang berubah? |

**Reject PR** jika patch semantics tidak tertulis dan tidak dites.

---

## 4.3 Database / PostgreSQL Integration

| Review item | Harus dicek |
|---|---|
| Migration | Schema migration dijalankan di test/integration |
| Constraint | Unique/FK/check constraint dipetakan ke error yang benar |
| Transaction | Rollback saat gagal |
| Timestamp | `timestamptz` / timezone behavior benar |
| Numeric | `numeric` → `BigDecimal` presisi |
| JSONB | Query/update JSONB sesuai PostgreSQL nyata |
| Locking | Optimistic/pessimistic lock conflict jadi 409 |
| Concurrency | Race condition penting dites |
| PL/pgSQL | Function/procedure exception dipetakan aman |
| Tenant isolation | Query tidak bocor lintas tenant |

Gunakan PostgreSQL nyata untuk behavior yang PostgreSQL-specific. Mock atau database in-memory sering tidak cukup untuk locking, JSONB, timezone, numeric precision, dan PL/pgSQL.

---

# 5. P2 Checklist - Maturity / Hardening Lanjutan

| Area | Review item |
|---|---|
| OpenAPI | Spec sinkron dengan DTO dan error code |
| Contract diff | Perubahan API dibanding versi sebelumnya jelas |
| Consumer contract | Client penting punya regression payload |
| Fuzz/property test | Payload invalid acak untuk parser/validator |
| Mutation testing | Validator/mapper penting tidak hanya covered tapi meaningful |
| Load-ish boundary test | Payload size, list size, deep object |
| Security scan | Dependency, deserialization, XML parser config |
| Observability metrics | Count error by code/status/provider |
| Audit logging | State transition penting punya audit event |
| Deprecation governance | Field deprecated punya sunset plan |

# 6. PR Review “Reject Immediately” List

PR sebaiknya **tidak merge** jika salah satu terjadi:

```text
[ ] Entity persistence langsung diekspos sebagai API response.
[ ] Request DTO tidak divalidasi untuk endpoint write penting.
[ ] Error response mengandung stack trace / SQL / package internal.
[ ] Unknown field policy berubah tanpa test.
[ ] Enum input menerima numeric ordinal.
[ ] Money/amount memakai double/float.
[ ] Patch null behavior tidak jelas.
[ ] XML endpoint aktif tanpa XXE hardening.
[ ] Mapper melakukan DB query / HTTP call.
[ ] Domain layer tergantung JAX-RS Response/WebApplicationException.
[ ] ExceptionMapper catch-all mengubah semua error jadi 200/400.
[ ] Tidak ada test untuk perubahan contract.
[ ] Breaking change dilakukan tanpa versioning/deprecation/approval.
```

# 7. Review Questions per PR

Gunakan pertanyaan ini saat membaca diff.

## API Contract

```text
Apa client lama tetap bisa memakai endpoint ini?
Apa ada field baru yang wajib?
Apa ada field yang dihapus/rename?
Apa enum/status baru aman untuk client?
Apa error code/status berubah?
Apa response masih tidak mengandung field internal?
```

## Serialization

```text
Provider runtime yang aktif apa?
Apakah ObjectMapper/JsonbConfig test sama dengan production?
Apa unknown field behavior berubah?
Apa date/time format berubah?
Apa numeric precision berubah?
Apa payload invalid akan gagal dengan error standar?
```

## Validation

```text
Apakah semua input write divalidasi?
Apakah nested object divalidasi?
Apakah collection element divalidasi?
Apakah custom validator pure?
Apakah domain rule tidak bocor ke Bean Validation?
Apakah field path error usable untuk client?
```

## Mapping

```text
Apakah MapStruct compile-time policy menangkap field baru?
Apakah mapper tidak menyembunyikan business logic?
Apakah enum mapping eksplisit?
Apakah patch/update mapper tidak menghapus data tanpa sengaja?
Apakah field sensitif tidak ikut dimapping ke response?
```

## Error Handling

```text
Exception apa yang mungkin dilempar?
Mapper mana yang menangani?
HTTP status-nya tepat?
Error code-nya stabil?
Apakah correlationId muncul?
Apakah 5xx logged internal?
Apakah response aman untuk client?
```

## Tests

```text
Apa test membuktikan wire-format?
Apa invalid payload dites?
Apa error contract dites?
Apa golden file perlu diupdate?
Apa PostgreSQL behavior perlu integration test?
Apa security regression perlu ditambahkan?
```

# 8. Definition of Done untuk Endpoint Baru

Endpoint write baru minimal harus punya:

```text
[ ] Request DTO
[ ] Response DTO
[ ] MapStruct/manual mapper
[ ] Bean Validation
[ ] Service/domain command
[ ] Domain exception mapping
[ ] Parser/validation/domain error test
[ ] Happy path JerseyTest
[ ] Invalid payload JerseyTest
[ ] Mapper unit test
[ ] DTO validation unit test
[ ] Error response contract assertion
[ ] Correlation ID assertion
[ ] PostgreSQL integration test jika menyentuh persistence penting
```

Endpoint read/list/search baru minimal harus punya:

```text
[ ] Query parameter validation
[ ] Pagination/sort bounds
[ ] Response summary DTO
[ ] Authorization/tenant filter
[ ] Empty result behavior
[ ] Invalid filter behavior
[ ] Stable response shape test
[ ] DB query integration test jika query kompleks
```

Endpoint patch baru minimal harus punya:

```text
[ ] Patch semantics documented: absent/null/value
[ ] Patch DTO atau patch wrapper
[ ] Patch mapper/manual applier test
[ ] Protected field rejection test
[ ] Domain invariant after patch test
[ ] Audit/state transition test jika relevan
```

# Cheatsheet - Field-Level Policy Catalog untuk DTO API Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

Field-level policy adalah standar kecil tetapi penting untuk memastikan setiap DTO API punya aturan konsisten:

```text
ID field
enum/status field
date/time field
money/amount field
pagination/sorting field
metadata field
audit field
tenant field
correlation field
error code field
```

Masalah yang sering muncul bukan karena framework, tetapi karena tiap endpoint memakai keputusan berbeda:

```text
orderId kadang UUID, kadang String
status kadang enum domain, kadang string bebas
createdAt kadang local time, kadang UTC
amount kadang double, kadang BigDecimal
page size kadang tidak dibatasi
error code kadang machine-readable, kadang message text
tenantId kadang dari header, kadang dari body
```

Untuk API enterprise/regulatory, field policy harus eksplisit supaya kontrak bisa diaudit, backward-compatible, dan tidak berubah diam-diam.

Beberapa baseline eksternal yang relevan: UUID modern didefinisikan dalam RFC 9562 sebagai identifier 128-bit; timestamp internet profile banyak mengacu ke RFC 3339; HTTP status semantics didefinisikan di RFC 9110; dan format standar error HTTP modern dapat memakai Problem Details RFC 9457 bila tim ingin mengikuti format standar lintas API. ([RFC Editor](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9562.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

   ├─ Identity fields

# 3. Field-Level Policy Catalog

| Field category | Recommended type | Format / rule | Validation | Common pitfall |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Internal ID | `UUID` | UUID string canonical | `@NotNull` for request if required | Pakai `String` bebas tanpa validasi |
| Public business number | `String` | Stable, human-readable, e.g. `ORD-2026-000001` | `@NotBlank`, `@Size`, `@Pattern` | Business number dipakai sebagai DB primary key |
| External reference ID | `String` | Preserve external system format | `@Size`, maybe `@Pattern` | Dipaksa UUID padahal external format berbeda |
| Status | DTO enum | Public lifecycle state only | `@NotNull` for command | Expose enum domain internal |
| Reason code | DTO enum/string catalog | Stable code, not free text | `@NotNull`, allowed values | Reason text dijadikan machine rule |
| Date only | `LocalDate` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | `@Past`, `@Future` if needed | Dipakai untuk timestamp event absolut |
| Event timestamp | `Instant` / `OffsetDateTime` | RFC 3339-like ISO timestamp | `@NotNull` if required | `LocalDateTime` tanpa timezone |
| Money amount | `BigDecimal` | Decimal string/number with scale policy | `@Digits`, `@DecimalMin` | `double` / `float` untuk uang |
| Currency | `String` or enum | ISO currency code if applicable | `@Pattern`, `@Size(3)` | Currency optional tanpa rule |
| Quantity | `Integer` / `Long` | Whole number | `@NotNull`, `@Min(1)` | Primitive `int` membuat missing jadi `0` |
| Percentage/rate | `BigDecimal` | Define range: `0..1` or `0..100` | `@DecimalMin`, `@DecimalMax` | Tidak jelas 0.15 atau 15 |
| Boolean flag | `Boolean` | Use only if truly binary | `@NotNull` if required | Boolean dipakai untuk state multi-step |
| Pagination page | `Integer` | 0-based atau 1-based, pilih satu | `@Min(0)` or `@Min(1)` | Tiap endpoint beda basis |
| Pagination size | `Integer` | default + max size | `@Min(1)`, `@Max(n)` | Client bisa request jutaan row |
| Sort field | `String` / enum | Allow-list only | custom validator | Raw SQL/order by injection risk |
| Search query | `String` | Trimmed, bounded length | `@Size(max=...)` | Query bebas tanpa limit |
| Metadata | `Map<String,String>` / typed DTO | Size/key/value bounded | key/value constraints | Metadata jadi tempat data bisnis liar |
| Tenant ID | Usually from auth context | Not trusted from body | not from client body by default | TenantId diterima dari request body |
| Actor user ID | From security context | Server-derived | not client-controlled | Client bisa spoof actor |
| Correlation ID | `String` | Header/body echo; bounded characters | length/pattern | Arbitrary long header masuk log |
| Error code | `String` | Stable machine code | allow-list/registry | Client parse `message` |
| Error message | `String` | Human-readable | no internal detail | Message dijadikan machine contract |
| Field path | `String` | API field path, not framework path | normalized | `arg0.items[0].x` bocor |
| Audit fields | Response only, controlled | `createdAt`, `createdBy`, etc. | server-owned | Client boleh set audit fields |

---

# 4. Identity Field Policy

## 4.1 Internal Resource ID

Recommended:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber
) {}
```

Request path:

```java
@GET
@Path("/{id}")
public Response getById(@PathParam("id") UUID id) {
    ...
}
```

Policy:

```text
Use UUID for internal opaque resource identity.
Do not expose database sequence if enumeration risk matters.
Do not let client set server-owned ID unless API explicitly supports client-generated ID.
```

UUID secara standar adalah identifier 128-bit dan tidak membutuhkan central registration process, sehingga cocok untuk opaque identifier lintas sistem. ([RFC Editor](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9562.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Review checklist

```text
[ ] ID field memakai UUID atau opaque string yang tervalidasi.
[ ] ID tidak mengandung informasi internal seperti shard, DB table, sequence sensitif.
[ ] Client tidak bisa mengubah server-owned ID.
[ ] Path ID dan body ID tidak konflik.
[ ] Test invalid UUID/path ID ada.
```

---

## 4.2 Business Number / Human-Readable ID

Contoh:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber
) {}
```

Policy:

```text
id          → technical identity, stable opaque ID
orderNumber → business-readable reference, boleh ditampilkan ke user
```

Validation example:

```java
public record FindOrderRequest(

        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 40)
        @Pattern(regexp = "^ORD-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{6}$")
        String orderNumber

) {}
```

Pitfall:

```text
Jangan mengandalkan orderNumber sebagai satu-satunya technical key
jika formatnya mungkin berubah karena business requirement.
```

---

## 4.3 External Reference ID

External reference jangan dipaksa mengikuti format internal.

```java
public record ExternalOrderReference(
        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 100)
        String sourceSystem,

        @NotBlank
        @Size(max = 150)
        String externalReferenceId
) {}
```

Policy:

```text
External reference harus preserve format sumber.
Pasangkan dengan sourceSystem.
Jangan assume externalReferenceId globally unique tanpa sourceSystem.
```

---

# 5. Enum & Status Field Policy

## 5.1 DTO Enum vs Domain Enum

Recommended:

```java
public enum OrderStatusDto {
    DRAFT,
    SUBMITTED,
    APPROVED,
    REJECTED,
    CANCELLED,
    UNKNOWN
}
```

Domain enum boleh lebih detail:

```java
public enum OrderStatus {
    DRAFT,
    SUBMITTED,
    UNDER_RISK_REVIEW,
    APPROVED,
    REJECTED,
    CANCELLED,
    INTERNAL_REOPEN_PENDING
}
```

Policy:

```text
Expose only public lifecycle states.
Hide internal workflow states.
Map domain enum → DTO enum explicitly.
Reject unknown input enum by default.
```

## 5.2 Status vs Boolean

Jangan:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        boolean approved,
        boolean cancelled,
        boolean rejected
) {}
```

Lebih baik:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        OrderStatusDto status
) {}
```

Reason:

```text
Boolean combinations bisa invalid:
approved=true + rejected=true
cancelled=true + submitted=true
```

Status enum membuat state machine lebih jelas.

---

## 5.3 Reason Code

Gunakan reason code untuk machine-readable reason, dan text untuk manusia.

```java
public record CancelOrderRequest(

        @NotNull
        CancelReasonCode reasonCode,

        @Size(max = 500)
        String reasonText

) {}
```

```java
public enum CancelReasonCode {
    CUSTOMER_REQUEST,
    DUPLICATE_ORDER,
    FRAUD_SUSPECTED,
    PAYMENT_FAILED,
    OTHER
}
```

Policy:

```text
reasonCode → machine readable
reasonText → human explanation
```

---

# 6. Date & Time Field Policy

RFC 3339 mendefinisikan format timestamp untuk internet protocols sebagai profile dari ISO 8601 dan fokus pada timestamp untuk events; untuk API JSON, ini biasanya menjadi baseline praktis untuk timestamp yang interoperable. ([IETF Datatracker](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 6.1 Type Decision Table

| Use case | Java type | Example JSON | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Event happened at absolute time | `Instant` | `"2026-07-13T02:15:30Z"` | Best for audit/event |
| Time with explicit offset | `OffsetDateTime` | `"2026-07-13T09:15:30+07:00"` | Useful for user-facing local offset |
| Business date | `LocalDate` | `"2026-07-13"` | Contract date, due date, effective date |
| Time of day | `LocalTime` | `"09:30:00"` | Need timezone context |
| Local schedule | `LocalDateTime` | `"2026-07-13T09:30:00"` | Avoid unless timezone separately defined |

## 6.2 Recommended Field Names

| Field name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `createdAt` | Server creation timestamp |
| `updatedAt` | Last server update timestamp |
| `submittedAt` | Business submission timestamp |
| `approvedAt` | Business approval timestamp |
| `effectiveFrom` | Start date/time of validity |
| `effectiveTo` | End date/time of validity |
| `expiresAt` | Expiration timestamp |
| `deletedAt` | Soft delete timestamp; usually internal/admin only |

## 6.3 Policy

```text
[ ] Use Instant for audit/event timestamps.
[ ] Use LocalDate for business dates.
[ ] Avoid LocalDateTime for absolute events.
[ ] Always define timezone/offset behavior.
[ ] Never rely on server default timezone as contract.
[ ] Test serialization/deserialization of timestamp fields.
```

---

# 7. Money, Amount, Quantity & Numeric Policy

## 7.1 Money Amount

Recommended:

```java
public record MoneyDto(

        @NotNull
        @Digits(integer = 18, fraction = 2)
        @DecimalMin(value = "0.00", inclusive = true)
        BigDecimal amount,

        @NotBlank
        @Size(min = 3, max = 3)
        String currency

) {}
```

Or flattened:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency
) {}
```

Policy:

```text
Use BigDecimal for money.
Never use double/float for money.
Define scale and rounding policy.
Currency must be explicit if amount crosses currency boundary.
```

## 7.2 Quantity

For required quantity:

```java
public record OrderItemRequest(

        @NotNull
        @Min(1)
        Integer quantity

) {}
```

Why `Integer`, not `int`?

```text
Integer can distinguish missing/null from actual 0.
int defaults to 0 after deserialization in some cases if null/primitive handling is not strict.
```

## 7.3 Percentage / Rate

Be explicit:

```java
public record DiscountRequest(

        @NotNull
        @DecimalMin("0.00")
        @DecimalMax("100.00")
        BigDecimal discountPercent

) {}
```

Or:

```java
public record InterestRateRequest(

        @NotNull
        @DecimalMin("0.0000")
        @DecimalMax("1.0000")
        BigDecimal rate

) {}
```

Policy:

```text
Do not mix percent scale.
Choose either:
- 15.0 means 15%
- 0.15 means 15%

Field name should reveal it:
discountPercent vs discountRate.
```

---

# 8. Pagination, Sorting & Filtering Policy

## 8.1 Page-Based Pagination

```java
public record PageRequest(

        @Min(0)
        Integer page,

        @Min(1)
        @Max(100)
        Integer size

) {
    public int effectivePage() {
        return page == null ? 0 : page;
    }

    public int effectiveSize() {
        return size == null ? 20 : size;
    }
}
```

Policy:

```text
Choose 0-based or 1-based.
Document it.
Apply max size.
Use deterministic sort.
```

## 8.2 Cursor Pagination

```java
public record CursorPageRequest(

        @Size(max = 500)
        String cursor,

        @Min(1)
        @Max(100)
        Integer limit

) {}
```

Use cursor pagination when:

```text
- large datasets
- unstable offset due to concurrent writes
- infinite scrolling
- high-volume audit/event logs
```

## 8.3 Sorting

Avoid raw sort field.

Bad:

```java
String sort;
```

Better:

```java
public record SortRequest(
        SortField field,
        SortDirection direction
) {}

public enum SortField {
    CREATED_AT,
    UPDATED_AT,
    ORDER_NUMBER,
    STATUS
}

public enum SortDirection {
    ASC,
    DESC
}
```

Policy:

```text
Sort field must be allow-listed.
Never concatenate raw sort field into SQL.
Always define default sort.
For pagination, sort must be deterministic.
```

---

# 9. Metadata Field Policy

Metadata is useful but dangerous.

## 9.1 Controlled Metadata

```java
public record MetadataDto(

        @Size(max = 20)
        Map<
            @NotBlank @Size(max = 50) String,
            @NotBlank @Size(max = 200) String
        > values

) {}
```

Policy:

```text
Metadata must be bounded:
- max entries
- max key length
- max value length
- allowed key pattern
- PII/secret policy
```

## 9.2 When Not to Use Metadata

Do not use metadata for:

```text
- required business fields
- workflow state
- permission flag
- pricing logic
- audit authority
- tenant identity
```

If a metadata key becomes business-critical, promote it to a typed DTO field.

---

# 10. Audit Field Policy

Audit fields are usually server-owned.

```java
public record AuditInfoResponse(
        Instant createdAt,
        UUID createdBy,
        Instant updatedAt,
        UUID updatedBy
) {}
```

Policy:

| Field | Request allowed? | Response allowed? |
|---|---:|---:|
| `createdAt` | No | Yes |
| `createdBy` | No | Sometimes |
| `updatedAt` | No | Yes |
| `updatedBy` | No | Sometimes |
| `deletedAt` | No | Admin/internal only |
| `version` | Maybe for optimistic locking | Maybe |
| `auditTrail` | No | Admin/internal only |

For public/client-facing API:

```text
Do not allow client to set audit fields.
Actor should come from authentication/security context.
Timestamp should come from server clock.
```

---

# 11. Tenant, Actor & Security Context Field Policy

## 11.1 Tenant ID

Recommended:

```text
tenantId comes from:
- token claims
- session context
- mTLS/client identity
- server-side routing context

tenantId should not normally come from request body.
```

Anti-pattern:

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(
        UUID tenantId,
        UUID customerId
) {}
```

Better:

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(
        UUID customerId
) {}
```

Resource:

```java
public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request,
                       @Context SecurityContext securityContext) {
    TenantId tenantId = resolveTenant(securityContext);
    ...
}
```

## 11.2 Actor User ID

Policy:

```text
actorUserId is server-derived.
Do not trust actorUserId from client body.
Use client-supplied actor only for delegated/admin flows with explicit audit policy.
```

---

# 12. Correlation, Request & Trace Field Policy

## 12.1 Correlation ID

Header:

```text
X-Correlation-Id: req-123
```

Response error:

```json
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_FAILED",
  "message": "Request validation failed",
  "correlationId": "req-123",
  "errors": []
}
```

Policy:

```text
[ ] Accept incoming correlation ID only if valid.
[ ] Bound length, e.g. <= 100.
[ ] Restrict characters.
[ ] Generate if missing/invalid.
[ ] Echo in response header.
[ ] Include in error response.
[ ] Put in logs/MDC.
[ ] Clean MDC after request.
```

## 12.2 Request ID vs Correlation ID vs Trace ID

| Field | Scope | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | Single service request | Unique request handled by one service |
| `correlationId` | Business/request chain | Same logical operation across services |
| `traceId` | Distributed tracing system | Usually OpenTelemetry trace ID |
| `spanId` | Single trace span | One operation inside trace |

Policy:

```text
Do not invent semantics per service.
Align with observability platform.
```

---

# 13. Error Field Policy

RFC 9457 defines a standard “problem detail” format for HTTP API errors and obsoletes RFC 7807; even if a project uses a custom error envelope, the same principle applies: error payload should carry machine-readable details, not force every API to invent ambiguous error shapes. ([RFC Editor](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 13.1 Custom Error Envelope

```java
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors
) {}

public record FieldErrorResponse(
        String field,
        String code,
        String message
) {}
```

Policy:

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| `code` | Stable machine-readable code |
| `message` | Human-readable, not contract logic |
| `correlationId` | Always present |
| `errors` | Empty list if no field-specific errors |
| `errors[].field` | API field path |
| `errors[].code` | Stable field-level code |
| `errors[].message` | Human-readable field error |

## 13.2 Error Code Naming

Recommended style:

```text
VALIDATION_FAILED
INVALID_JSON
INVALID_XML
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
ORDER_NOT_FOUND
ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED
DUPLICATE_RESOURCE
VERSION_CONFLICT
FORBIDDEN
UNAUTHORIZED
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT
INTERNAL_ERROR
```

Policy:

```text
Use uppercase snake case.
Do not encode HTTP status into code unless needed.
Do not change error code casually.
Do not make client parse message.
```

HTTP status codes are defined as three-digit codes describing the result and semantics of a response; RFC 9110 groups them by first digit into status classes. ([IETF Datatracker](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 14. Field Naming Policy

## 14.1 JSON Field Naming

Recommended:

```text
camelCase
```

Examples:

```json
{
  "orderId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
  "orderNumber": "ORD-2026-000001",
  "submittedAt": "2026-07-13T02:15:30Z",
  "totalAmount": 100.00,
  "currency": "USD"
}
```

Policy:

```text
[ ] JSON fields use camelCase.
[ ] Java DTO record components match JSON fields unless explicit mapping exists.
[ ] Avoid abbreviations unless widely understood.
[ ] Avoid overloaded generic names like data, value, info.
[ ] Do not expose DB column naming style in JSON.
```

## 14.2 Boolean Naming

Prefer:

```java
Boolean active;
Boolean enabled;
Boolean primary;
```

Avoid ambiguous:

```java
Boolean isNotDisabled;
Boolean notCancelled;
Boolean hasNoIssue;
```

Policy:

```text
Avoid negative boolean names.
Avoid multiple booleans for lifecycle state.
```

---

# 15. Nullability & Optional Field Policy

## 15.1 Request DTO

| Situation | Recommended |
|---|---|
| Required field | wrapper type + `@NotNull` / `@NotBlank` |
| Optional field | nullable field with documented semantics |
| Optional collection | default empty or nullable, choose one |
| Patch field | distinguish absent/null/value if needed |
| Primitive field | avoid if missing/null matters |

Example:

```java
public record CreateOrderItemRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID productId,

        @NotNull
        @Min(1)
        Integer quantity

) {}
```

## 15.2 Response DTO

Policy:

```text
[ ] For list fields, prefer empty list over null.
[ ] For optional scalar fields, null is acceptable if documented.
[ ] Do not omit fields unpredictably unless null policy is documented.
[ ] Sensitive/internal fields must not appear at all.
```

---

# 16. Field Policy by Endpoint Type

## 16.1 Create Endpoint

```text
POST /orders
```

Allowed request fields:

```text
[OK] business input
[OK] external reference
[OK] idempotency key if supported
[NO] id unless client-generated ID is designed
[NO] createdAt
[NO] createdBy
[NO] tenantId unless trusted admin flow
[NO] status unless create state selection is allowed
```

## 16.2 Update Endpoint

```text
PUT /orders/{id}
```

Policy:

```text
[ ] Path ID is source of identity.
[ ] Body ID either forbidden or must match path ID.
[ ] Missing required field is error.
[ ] Full replace semantics must be documented.
```

## 16.3 Patch Endpoint

```text
PATCH /orders/{id}
```

Policy:

```text
[ ] Field absent means no change.
[ ] Field null semantics documented.
[ ] Protected fields rejected.
[ ] Domain invariant checked after patch.
[ ] Audit records changed fields if required.
```

## 16.4 Search/List Endpoint

```text
GET /orders?status=SUBMITTED&page=0&size=20
```

Policy:

```text
[ ] Pagination default and max size.
[ ] Sort allow-list.
[ ] Filter allow-list.
[ ] Tenant/security filter server-side.
[ ] Empty result returns 200 + empty list.
[ ] Deterministic ordering.
```

---

# 17. Example Standard DTO Set

```java
public record OrderSummaryResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt
) {}
```

```java
public record OrderDetailResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        Instant updatedAt,
        List<OrderItemResponse> items
) {}
```

```java
public record PageResponse<T>(
        List<T> items,
        PageMetadata page
) {}
```

```java
public record PageMetadata(
        int page,
        int size,
        long totalElements,
        int totalPages
) {}
```

```java
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors
) {}
```

---

# 18. Production Review Checklist

```text
Identity
[ ] ID fields are opaque and typed.
[ ] Business reference separated from technical ID.
[ ] External reference paired with source system.

Status / enum
[ ] Public enum separated from internal domain enum if needed.
[ ] Invalid input enum rejected.
[ ] Boolean flags not used as lifecycle state machine.

Temporal
[ ] Instant/OffsetDateTime for event timestamp.
[ ] LocalDate for business date.
[ ] No implicit server timezone contract.
[ ] Serialization test exists.

Money / numeric
[ ] BigDecimal for amount.
[ ] Currency explicit.
[ ] Quantity uses wrapper + validation if required.
[ ] Scale/range defined.

Pagination / sorting
[ ] Max page size.
[ ] Sort fields allow-listed.
[ ] Default sort deterministic.

Metadata
[ ] Metadata bounded.
[ ] Metadata not used for core business fields.
[ ] PII/secret rules defined.

Security context
[ ] tenantId server-derived.
[ ] actorUserId server-derived.
[ ] Audit fields server-owned.

Error
[ ] Error code stable.
[ ] Message not used as machine contract.
[ ] Correlation ID always present.
[ ] Field path normalized.

Patch
[ ] Absent/null/value semantics documented and tested.
[ ] Protected fields cannot be changed.
```

---

# 19. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Standardisasi ID dan reference fields
   ↓
2. Standardisasi enum/status/reason code
   ↓
3. Standardisasi date/time dan timezone
   ↓
4. Standardisasi money/amount/quantity/rate
   ↓
5. Standardisasi pagination/sorting/filtering
   ↓
6. Standardisasi metadata/audit/security context
   ↓
7. Standardisasi correlation/request/trace fields
   ↓
8. Standardisasi error code dan field error
   ↓
9. Tambahkan validation + serialization tests per field category
   ↓
10. Jadikan field policy sebagai PR checklist
```
