## Response:
7/13/2026, 3:56:20 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke API contract evolution dan backward compatibility. Saya akan kaitkan dengan perubahan yang paling sering merusak client: field, enum, validasi, error code, status code, dan versi endpoint.

# Cheatsheet - API Contract Evolution & Backward Compatibility di Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

API contract evolution adalah disiplin mengubah request/response/error API tanpa merusak client yang sudah berjalan.

Untuk aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, perubahan kontrak biasanya terjadi di:

```text
Request DTO
Response DTO
Enum/status
Validation rule
Serialization/deserialization policy
HTTP status
Error code
Endpoint path
Query parameter
Pagination/sorting
Authentication/authorization behavior
```

Prinsip dasarnya:

```text
Client lama tidak boleh rusak hanya karena server berubah,
kecuali perubahan itu memang breaking change yang sudah diberi versi, deprecation window, dan migration path.
```

HTTP sendiri mendefinisikan status code sebagai kode tiga digit yang menyatakan hasil request dan semantics response; karena itu perubahan status code bukan detail kecil, tetapi bagian dari contract client-server. ([RFC Editor](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) RFC 9457 juga mendefinisikan “problem details” untuk membawa error details yang machine-readable dalam response HTTP, walaupun project bisa tetap memakai custom envelope seperti `ApiErrorResponse`. ([RFC Editor](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9457/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Mental Model

```text
API change
   │
   ├─ Additive?
   │    ├─ tambah optional response field
   │    ├─ tambah optional request field
   │    └─ tambah endpoint baru
   │
   ├─ Behavioral?
   │    ├─ validation lebih ketat
   │    ├─ default berubah
   │    ├─ sorting berubah
   │    └─ status transition berubah
   │
   ├─ Structural?
   │    ├─ rename field
   │    ├─ remove field
   │    ├─ change type
   │    └─ change nesting
   │
   ├─ Semantic?
   │    ├─ field lama punya arti baru
   │    ├─ enum value punya arti baru
   │    ├─ HTTP status berubah
   │    └─ error code berubah
   │
   └─ Compatibility decision
        ├─ safe change
        ├─ risky but manageable
        ├─ breaking change
        └─ requires new version / migration
```

Rule singkat:

```text
Add, don't mutate.
Deprecate before remove.
Keep old meaning stable.
Version only when compatibility cannot be preserved.
Test old clients, not only new behavior.
```

Microsoft Azure API design guidance juga menekankan bahwa perubahan besar bisa direpresentasikan sebagai resource atau link baru, sedangkan penambahan content ke resource yang ada bisa saja bukan breaking change jika client tidak bergantung pada field tambahan tersebut. ([Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/best-practices/api-design?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) Zalando API guidelines memakai prinsip major version untuk incompatible API changes dan minor version untuk penambahan backward-compatible. ([Zalando Open Source](https://opensource.zalando.com/restful-api-guidelines/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Breaking risk | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field addition | Tambah field baru | Evolusi response/request | Rendah jika optional | Golden file + compatibility test |
| Field removal | Hapus field lama | Bersihkan contract lama | Tinggi | Deprecation window + version |
| Field rename | Ganti nama field | Rapikan naming | Tinggi | Alias sementara + dual write/dual read |
| Type change | String → number, number → object | Model lebih akurat | Tinggi | Field baru + migration |
| Nullability change | Nullable ↔ non-null | Contract tightening | Sedang/tinggi | Client impact review |
| Enum evolution | Tambah/ubah enum | Lifecycle/status berkembang | Sedang/tinggi | Open enum strategy / UNKNOWN handling |
| Validation tightening | Constraint makin ketat | Data quality | Tinggi untuk request | Warn/log first, staged rollout |
| Default behavior change | Default page size/sort/status | Runtime behavior berubah | Sedang | Explicit defaults + release notes |
| Error code change | Error taxonomy berubah | Client handling berubah | Tinggi | Error code registry |
| HTTP status change | 400 ↔ 409 ↔ 422, etc. | Client recovery berubah | Tinggi | Compatibility test |
| Serialization policy | Unknown field/date/null/enum | Wire-format behavior | Tinggi | Central config + contract tests |
| Endpoint versioning | URI/header/media type | Isolasi breaking change | Sedang | Clear lifecycle policy |
| Deprecation | Transisi client lama | Migration safety | Rendah jika dikelola | Sunset plan + telemetry |
| Consumer migration | Pindahkan client | Operasional rollout | Sedang | Compatibility matrix |

---

## 4. Change Classification Matrix

| Change | Safe? | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Tambah endpoint baru | Aman | Tidak mengubah contract lama |
| Tambah optional response field | Biasanya aman | Client harus ignore unknown fields |
| Tambah optional request field | Aman | Server harus punya default behavior |
| Tambah required request field | Breaking | Client lama tidak mengirim field |
| Hapus request field yang masih dikirim client | Risky/breaking | Bisa gagal jika unknown field strict |
| Hapus response field | Breaking | Client lama mungkin membaca field itu |
| Rename field | Breaking | Sama seperti remove + add |
| Change field type | Breaking | Parser/client model rusak |
| Change field format | Breaking | Contoh date format berubah |
| Change enum meaning | Breaking | Lebih buruk daripada tambah enum |
| Tambah enum value response | Risky | Client lama mungkin switch exhaustive |
| Tambah enum value request | Risky | Server/client harus agree |
| Tighten validation | Breaking-prone | Request lama bisa mulai gagal |
| Loosen validation | Biasanya aman | Tapi bisa merusak data quality |
| Change default sort | Risky | Client pagination bisa berubah |
| Change default page size | Risky | UI/performance bisa berubah |
| Change error code | Breaking | Client logic sering pakai code |
| Change HTTP status | Breaking-prone | Retry/recovery flow berubah |
| Change null omission policy | Risky | Client bisa membedakan absent vs null |
| Change unknown field policy | Risky | Client payload lama/baru bisa gagal |
| Change auth requirement | Breaking | Client lama bisa 401/403 |
| Change permission semantics | Breaking-prone | Workflow client berubah |

---

## 5. DTO Field Evolution

## 5.1 Tambah Optional Response Field

Biasanya aman:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,

        // New optional field
        Instant submittedAt
) {}
```

Syarat agar aman:

```text
[ ] Field baru optional untuk client.
[ ] Field lama tidak berubah.
[ ] Meaning field lama tetap sama.
[ ] Client lama mengabaikan unknown field.
[ ] Golden file/contract test diperbarui dengan sadar.
```

Catatan penting: untuk client yang memakai strict deserialization, tambahan response field bisa tetap merusak. Karena itu “safe” di server belum tentu safe untuk semua consumer.

---

## 5.2 Tambah Required Request Field

Breaking:

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(
        UUID customerId,
        List<CreateOrderItemRequest> items,

        // New required field
        @NotNull OrderPriority priority
) {}
```

Client lama tidak mengirim `priority`, sehingga mulai gagal.

Alternatif aman:

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(
        UUID customerId,
        List<CreateOrderItemRequest> items,

        // Optional first
        OrderPriority priority
) {}
```

Service:

```java
OrderPriority effectivePriority =
        request.priority() == null
                ? OrderPriority.NORMAL
                : request.priority();
```

Migration pattern:

```text
Phase 1: field optional + server default
Phase 2: telemetry client usage
Phase 3: warn clients missing field
Phase 4: announce requirement
Phase 5: make required in v2 or after agreed sunset
```

---

## 5.3 Rename Field

Jangan langsung rename:

```json
// old
{
  "orderNumber": "ORD-001"
}

// new
{
  "referenceNumber": "ORD-001"
}
```

Ini breaking.

Safer pattern untuk response:

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        String orderNumber,

        // new alias during migration
        String referenceNumber
) {}
```

Safer pattern untuk request:

```java
public record FindOrderRequest(
        String orderNumber,
        String referenceNumber
) {
    public String effectiveReference() {
        if (referenceNumber != null) {
            return referenceNumber;
        }
        return orderNumber;
    }
}
```

Deprecation policy:

```text
[ ] Field lama tetap diterima sementara.
[ ] Field baru mulai dikirim/didokumentasikan.
[ ] Jika keduanya dikirim dan konflik, rule jelas.
[ ] Usage field lama dimonitor.
[ ] Removal dilakukan hanya di major version/deprecation window.
```

---

## 5.4 Change Type

Breaking:

```text
amount: "100.00"  → amount: 100.00
customerId: "123" → customerId: UUID
status: "A"       → status: "APPROVED"
```

Safer pattern:

```java
public record PaymentResponse(
        // old field
        String amount,

        // new field
        BigDecimal amountValue,

        String currency
) {}
```

Atau versi baru:

```text
GET /api/v1/payments/{id}
GET /api/v2/payments/{id}
```

Rule:

```text
Do not mutate field type in-place.
Add a new field or new version.
```

---

## 6. Enum Evolution

Enum adalah salah satu sumber breaking change paling licin.

## 6.1 Closed vs Open Enum

Closed enum:

```text
Server menjamin hanya value yang terdokumentasi akan muncul.
Client boleh exhaustive switch.
Menambah enum value bisa breaking.
```

Open enum:

```text
Server boleh menambah value baru.
Client wajib punya fallback.
Client tidak boleh exhaustive failure.
```

Microsoft engineering guidance tentang enum API menyarankan mendokumentasikan enum sebagai open-ended dan client memperlakukan unrecognized value sebagai semacam “Other”, dibanding menambahkan `Other` sebagai nilai yang membingungkan. ([Microsoft for Developers](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20250217-00/?p=110873&utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 6.2 Response Enum Strategy

DTO:

```java
public enum OrderStatusDto {
    DRAFT,
    SUBMITTED,
    APPROVED,
    REJECTED,
    CANCELLED,
    UNKNOWN
}
```

Mapping:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderStatusMapper {

    default OrderStatusDto toDto(OrderStatus status) {
        if (status == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return switch (status) {
            case DRAFT -> OrderStatusDto.DRAFT;
            case SUBMITTED -> OrderStatusDto.SUBMITTED;
            case APPROVED -> OrderStatusDto.APPROVED;
            case REJECTED -> OrderStatusDto.REJECTED;
            case CANCELLED -> OrderStatusDto.CANCELLED;

            // internal states
            case INTERNAL_REOPEN_PENDING -> OrderStatusDto.UNKNOWN;
        };
    }
}
```

Use `UNKNOWN` only if API policy allows hiding/internal future states. Jangan pakai `UNKNOWN` untuk input command yang harus strict.

---

## 6.3 Input Enum Strategy

Request command harus strict:

```java
public record UpdateOrderStatusRequest(
        @NotNull OrderStatusDto status
) {}
```

Reject:

```json
{
  "status": "NOT_A_REAL_STATUS"
}
```

Reject numeric enum:

```json
{
  "status": 1
}
```

Policy:

```text
Response enum boleh open/fallback jika client harus forward-compatible.
Input enum sebaiknya strict agar client tidak mengirim command ambigu.
```

---

## 6.4 Enum Meaning Must Not Change

Breaking paling berbahaya:

```text
APPROVED dulu berarti "approved by reviewer"
APPROVED sekarang berarti "approved by system auto-rule"
```

Lebih aman:

```text
APPROVED
AUTO_APPROVED
MANUALLY_APPROVED
```

atau:

```json
{
  "status": "APPROVED",
  "approvalMode": "AUTOMATED"
}
```

---

## 7. Validation Evolution

Validation tightening sering terlihat “bug fix”, tapi bagi client bisa breaking.

## 7.1 Examples of Breaking Validation Changes

| Change | Why breaking |
|---|---|
| `note` max 1000 → max 500 | Client lama bisa gagal |
| `email` optional → required | Client lama gagal |
| `customerId` string bebas → UUID strict | Client lama gagal |
| Unknown fields tolerated → rejected | Client baru/lama bisa gagal |
| Empty list allowed → `@NotEmpty` | Client lama gagal |
| `status` nullable → `@NotNull` | Client lama gagal |
| New cross-field rule | Client payload lama bisa gagal |

## 7.2 Safer Tightening Pattern

```text
1. Observe
   Log/meter invalid-but-currently-accepted payload.

2. Warn
   Return warning header or response metadata if appropriate.

3. Communicate
   Announce upcoming validation requirement.

4. Soft enforce
   Enforce only for new clients/version/feature flag.

5. Hard enforce
   Reject after migration window.
```

Example header:

```text
Warning: 299 - "Field note will be limited to 500 characters after 2026-10-01"
```

Use carefully; not every internal API needs warning headers, but migration telemetry is very valuable.

---

## 8. Error Contract Evolution

Error code is contract.

## 8.1 Safe Error Changes

| Change | Risk |
|---|---|
| Add extra field to error response | Usually safe |
| Add new field-level error in `errors[]` | Usually safe |
| Make message clearer | Safe if clients do not parse message |
| Add new top-level error code for new scenario | Usually safe if clients have fallback |

## 8.2 Breaking Error Changes

| Change | Why breaking |
|---|---|
| Rename `VALIDATION_FAILED` to `INPUT_INVALID` | Client code handling breaks |
| Change 409 to 400 | Retry/UI conflict handling breaks |
| Remove `errors[].field` | Form highlight breaks |
| Change field path format | Client mapping breaks |
| Use message as code | Localization/refactor breaks |
| Return raw parser error | Security + contract break |

## 8.3 Error Code Deprecation

Keep old code temporarily:

```java
public enum ApiErrorCode {
    VALIDATION_FAILED,

    /**
     * @deprecated Use ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED.
     */
    @Deprecated
    ORDER_INVALID_STATE,

    ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED
}
```

Mapper can optionally emit both during transition:

```json
{
  "code": "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
  "legacyCode": "ORDER_INVALID_STATE",
  "message": "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
  "correlationId": "req-123",
  "errors": []
}
```

Use `legacyCode` only when consumers need migration help. Jangan tambah noise kalau tidak perlu.

---

## 9. HTTP Status Evolution

HTTP status bukan implementation detail. RFC 9110 mendefinisikan status code sebagai semantics response, jadi client boleh menggunakan status code untuk branching behavior. ([IETF Datatracker](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 9.1 Common Breaking Status Changes

| Old | New | Risk |
|---:|---:|---|
| 400 | 422 | Client validation handling bisa beda |
| 409 | 422 | Conflict retry/refresh handling berubah |
| 404 | 403 | Resource existence/security semantics berubah |
| 500 | 503 | Retry behavior berubah |
| 200 with error body | 4xx/5xx | Actually desirable, but breaking |
| 202 async | 200 sync | Client polling behavior berubah |
| 201 create | 200 create | Client created-resource flow berubah |

## 9.2 Recommended Stability

```text
Once an endpoint is public/consumed:
[ ] Keep success status stable.
[ ] Keep common failure status stable.
[ ] Add specific error code if more detail needed.
[ ] Do not change status just to be "more correct" without migration.
```

---

## 10. Serialization Policy Evolution

These are breaking-prone:

```text
[ ] Change unknown field from tolerant to strict.
[ ] Change null field output from included to omitted.
[ ] Change date from timestamp to ISO string.
[ ] Change enum case: submitted → SUBMITTED.
[ ] Change BigDecimal output formatting.
[ ] Change property naming: camelCase → snake_case.
[ ] Change JSON provider default from JSON-B to Jackson or vice versa.
[ ] Enable/disable scalar coercion.
```

Safer approach:

```text
1. Centralize ObjectMapper/JsonbConfig.
2. Add contract/golden tests.
3. Run compatibility tests before changing config.
4. Treat serializer config changes as API-impacting PRs.
```

---

## 11. Versioning Strategies

| Strategy | Example | Good for | Tradeoff |
|---|---|---|---|
| URI version | `/api/v1/orders` | Clear major breaking changes | Endpoint duplication |
| Header version | `X-API-Version: 2` | Cleaner URI | Harder debugging/caching |
| Media type version | `application/vnd.company.order.v2+json` | Strict content negotiation | More complex |
| Field-level evolution | optional/deprecated fields | Small changes | Needs strong governance |
| New resource | `/orders/{id}/lifecycle` | Semantic expansion | More API surface |
| Consumer-specific compatibility | feature flags/client profiles | Large enterprise clients | Operational complexity |

Practical default:

```text
Use additive field-level evolution for small compatible changes.
Use URI major version for large breaking changes.
Avoid versioning for every small optional addition.
```

---

## 12. Deprecation Policy

A useful deprecation record:

```text
Deprecated field: orderNumber
Replacement: referenceNumber
Deprecated since: 2026-07-13
Removal no earlier than: 2026-10-13
Affected clients: web-portal, partner-api
Telemetry: request/response usage dashboard
Owner: order-platform-team
Migration note: read referenceNumber; orderNumber remains populated during transition
```

For API docs/OpenAPI, mark deprecated fields explicitly:

```yaml
orderNumber:
  type: string
  deprecated: true
  description: Deprecated. Use referenceNumber.
```

Deprecation without telemetry is weak. Track usage.

---

## 13. Consumer-Safe Migration Pattern

```text
Phase 0 - Understand consumers
  Identify clients, payloads, fields, and error handling.

Phase 1 - Add new capability
  Add new optional field / endpoint / version.

Phase 2 - Dual support
  Accept old and new input.
  Return old and new output if needed.

Phase 3 - Instrument
  Log/metric old field usage and client identity.

Phase 4 - Communicate
  Announce migration deadline and examples.

Phase 5 - Prefer new path
  Docs and SDK use new field/version.

Phase 6 - Warn
  Optional warning header / dashboard / direct contact.

Phase 7 - Remove or hard fail
  Only after agreed sunset/version boundary.
```

---

## 14. Jersey/JAX-RS Implementation Patterns

## 14.1 Dual Read for Request Rename

```java
public record FindOrderRequest(
        String orderNumber,
        String referenceNumber
) {
    public String effectiveReferenceNumber() {
        if (referenceNumber != null && !referenceNumber.isBlank()) {
            return referenceNumber;
        }

        return orderNumber;
    }
}
```

Validation:

```java
@AtLeastOneReference
public record FindOrderRequest(
        String orderNumber,
        String referenceNumber
) {}
```

Conflict handling:

```java
if (hasText(orderNumber)
        && hasText(referenceNumber)
        && !orderNumber.equals(referenceNumber)) {
    throw new DomainException(
            "REFERENCE_FIELD_CONFLICT",
            "orderNumber and referenceNumber must refer to the same value",
            DomainErrorCategory.BUSINESS_RULE
    );
}
```

---

## 14.2 Dual Write for Response Rename

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        /**
         * @deprecated Use referenceNumber.
         */
        @Deprecated
        String orderNumber,

        String referenceNumber,

        UUID id,
        OrderStatusDto status
) {}
```

Mapper:

```java
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderResponseMapper {

    @Mapping(target = "orderNumber", source = "referenceNumber")
    @Mapping(target = "referenceNumber", source = "referenceNumber")
    OrderResponse toResponse(OrderResult result);
}
```

---

## 14.3 Versioned Resource

```java
@Path("/api/v1/orders")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class OrderResourceV1 {
    ...
}
```

```java
@Path("/api/v2/orders")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class OrderResourceV2 {
    ...
}
```

Avoid duplicating business logic:

```text
Resource V1/V2
  ↓
Version-specific DTO mapper
  ↓
Same application service command
  ↓
Domain/service
  ↓
Version-specific response mapper
```

---

## 15. Compatibility Test Matrix

| Scenario | Test |
|---|---|
| Old request still accepted | Submit old JSON fixture |
| New request accepted | Submit new JSON fixture |
| Old response still has old field | Golden file old client |
| New response has new field | Golden file new client |
| Both old/new request fields same | Accepted |
| Both old/new request fields conflict | Clear error |
| Deprecated field still populated | Response test |
| Deprecated field usage tracked | Metric/log test if applicable |
| Old error code still supported | Error compatibility test |
| New error code documented | Error registry test |
| Enum unknown handling | Client/server fallback test |
| Validation tightening rollout | Old invalid payload behavior test |

Fixture layout:

```text
src/test/resources/contracts/orders/v1/
  create-order.request.old.json
  create-order.response.old.json
  validation-error.old.json

src/test/resources/contracts/orders/v2/
  create-order.request.new.json
  create-order.response.new.json
  validation-error.new.json
```

---

## 16. Breaking Change Review Checklist

```text
[ ] Does this remove a request or response field?
[ ] Does this rename a field?
[ ] Does this change field type?
[ ] Does this change field format?
[ ] Does this make an optional field required?
[ ] Does this make validation stricter?
[ ] Does this change enum values or meanings?
[ ] Does this change HTTP status?
[ ] Does this change error code?
[ ] Does this change default pagination/sorting/filtering?
[ ] Does this change auth/permission behavior?
[ ] Does this change serialization config?
[ ] Does this change null/absent behavior?
[ ] Does this affect old clients/fixtures?
[ ] Is there a deprecation plan?
[ ] Is there telemetry?
[ ] Is there a versioning/migration plan?
```

If any answer is “yes”, treat the PR as API-impacting.

---

## 17. Decision Table

| Situation | Recommended action |
|---|---|
| Need new response data | Add optional field |
| Need new required request data | Add optional first + default, or create v2 |
| Need rename field | Dual read/write + deprecate |
| Need remove field | Deprecate + remove in major version |
| Need change field type | Add new field or v2 |
| Need add enum response value | Ensure clients support fallback or version |
| Need add enum input value | Server supports it, clients opt in |
| Need tighten validation | Stage rollout + telemetry |
| Need fix incorrect HTTP status | Consider compatibility; maybe new version |
| Need new error detail | Add field/code without removing old code |
| Need change serializer config | Run contract regression suite |

---

## 18. Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Why dangerous | Better |
|---|---|---|
| “It’s only DTO rename” | Rename is remove + add | Dual field + deprecation |
| “Clients should ignore fields” | Not all clients do | Consumer compatibility test |
| “Validation stricter is always good” | Breaks existing payloads | Staged rollout |
| “Enum addition is always safe” | Exhaustive switch can break | Open enum policy |
| “Error message can change” | Safe only if clients do not parse message | Stable error code |
| “Status code correction is harmless” | Client flow may depend on status | Version/migration |
| “No one uses this field” | Without telemetry, it’s a guess | Usage tracking |
| “Internal API doesn’t need compatibility” | Internal clients still break | Consumer inventory |
| “Serializer defaults are fine” | Defaults change across versions | Explicit config + tests |

---

## 19. Production Checklist

```text
Contract
[ ] Additive changes preferred.
[ ] Breaking changes identified explicitly.
[ ] Deprecated fields marked.
[ ] Migration guide exists for breaking changes.
[ ] Consumer impact reviewed.

DTO
[ ] Required fields not added silently.
[ ] Fields not renamed/removed without transition.
[ ] Types/formats stable.
[ ] Nullability stable.
[ ] Enum policy clear.

Validation
[ ] Tightening treated as API-impacting.
[ ] Old payload fixtures tested.
[ ] New constraints documented.
[ ] Validation error codes stable.

Error
[ ] Error codes stable.
[ ] HTTP status stable or migration approved.
[ ] Field error paths stable.
[ ] Message not used as machine contract.

Versioning
[ ] Version strategy chosen only when needed.
[ ] V1/V2 share domain service where possible.
[ ] Old version sunset policy defined.

Testing
[ ] Old request fixtures still pass if supported.
[ ] New request fixtures pass.
[ ] Golden response files updated intentionally.
[ ] Error contract tests cover old/new behavior.
[ ] Consumer-specific compatibility tested if needed.
```

---

## 20. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Pahami safe vs breaking API changes
   ↓
2. Kuasai DTO field evolution: add, rename, remove, type change
   ↓
3. Pelajari enum open vs closed strategy
   ↓
4. Treat validation tightening as breaking-prone
   ↓

   ↓

   ↓
7. Pilih versioning strategy hanya untuk breaking changes besar
   ↓

   ↓

   ↓
10. Jadikan API-impact review checklist di setiap PR
```

7/13/2026, 3:59:48 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke dokumentasi kontrak OpenAPI untuk Jersey/JAX-RS. Saya akan fokus pada schema DTO, constraints, examples, error catalog, versioning/deprecation, dan contract tests agar dokumentasi tidak drift dari implementasi.

# Cheatsheet - OpenAPI / Contract Documentation untuk Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

OpenAPI adalah **kontrak mesin + manusia** untuk HTTP API. Untuk aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, OpenAPI sebaiknya tidak hanya mendokumentasikan endpoint, tetapi juga:

```text
Resource path + HTTP method
Request body schema
Response body schema
Query/path/header parameter
Validation constraints
Error response catalog
Security scheme
Versioning
Deprecation
Examples
Backward compatibility notes
Contract tests
```

OpenAPI Specification mendefinisikan standard, language-agnostic interface description untuk HTTP API sehingga manusia maupun komputer bisa memahami kemampuan service tanpa membaca source code atau traffic langsung. Versi OAS **3.1.1** dipublikasikan 24 Oktober 2024 sebagai patch release untuk OAS 3.1.x. ([OpenAPI Initiative Publications](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Untuk Java/Jakarta REST, ada dua pendekatan umum:

| Approach | Cocok untuk | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| **Swagger Core annotations** | Jersey/JAX-RS app yang ingin generate OpenAPI dari annotation | Swagger Core punya integrasi JAX-RS/Jersey dan annotations. ([GitHub](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-core/wiki/Swagger-2.X---Integration-and-configuration?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) |
| **MicroProfile OpenAPI** | Runtime MicroProfile/Jakarta EE style | MicroProfile OpenAPI menyediakan cara menghasilkan dan expose dokumentasi OpenAPI untuk RESTful APIs; versi 4.1 final dirilis 2025. ([MicroProfile](https://microprofile.io/specifications/open-api/4-1/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) |
| **Static OpenAPI YAML** | API governance ketat, design-first, review kontrak sebelum code | Paling eksplisit, tetapi rawan drift jika tidak dites |
| **Hybrid** | Production enterprise | Generate dari code + static override + contract tests |

---

```text
                              │

└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    OpenAPI Contract                           │
│                                                              │
│  paths                                                        │

                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Governance / CI                            │
│                                                              │
│  lint spec                                                    │
│  diff old vs new contract                                     │
│  validate examples                                            │
│  run JerseyTest against examples                              │
│  verify error catalog                                         │
│  publish docs                                                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

# 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Yang harus didokumentasikan | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | API metadata | Identitas API | title, version, description, contact | Docs tidak jelas ownership |
| 2 | Server/base URL | Environment endpoint | dev/stage/prod URLs | Client hardcode URL salah |
| 3 | Path operations | Endpoint contract | method, path, operationId, tags | operationId tidak stabil |
| 4 | Request body | Input schema | DTO shape, required fields, examples | Docs tidak match DTO |
| 5 | Response body | Output schema | success schema, status codes, examples | Client salah parse response |
| 6 | Parameters | Path/query/header params | type, required, validation, examples | Pagination/filter tidak jelas |
| 7 | DTO schema | Object contract | field type, format, enum, nullable, deprecated | Schema terlalu longgar |
| 8 | Validation constraints | Input rules | min/max, pattern, required, size | Bean Validation tidak muncul di docs |
| 9 | Error catalog | Failure contract | error codes, HTTP status, field errors | Semua error “500” di docs |
| 10 | Security scheme | AuthN/AuthZ docs | bearer JWT, API key, OAuth2 scopes | Security behavior tribal knowledge |
| 11 | Versioning | API lifecycle | v1/v2, compatibility, sunset | Breaking change tidak terlihat |
| 12 | Deprecation | Migration signal | deprecated fields/operations + replacement | Field deprecated tanpa migration |
| 13 | Examples | Consumer usability | valid request/response/error samples | Example invalid atau outdated |
| 14 | Contract tests | Prevent drift | spec vs runtime behavior | Docs dan code beda |
| 15 | Compatibility diff | PR governance | breaking/non-breaking change detection | Client rusak diam-diam |

---

# 4. OpenAPI Structure yang Ideal

Minimal skeleton:

```yaml
openapi: 3.1.1
info:
  title: Order Management API
  version: 1.4.0
  description: API for order lifecycle operations.
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com
    description: Production
  - url: https://api-stage.example.com
    description: Staging

tags:
  - name: Orders
    description: Order lifecycle operations

paths:
  /orders:
    post:
      tags: [Orders]
      operationId: createOrder
      summary: Create an order
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateOrderRequest'
            examples:
              valid:
                $ref: '#/components/examples/CreateOrderRequestExample'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Order created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderResponse'
              examples:
                created:
                  $ref: '#/components/examples/OrderResponseExample'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'
        '409':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/DomainConflict'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/InternalError'

components:
  schemas: {}
  responses: {}
  examples: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
```

Prinsip:

```text
OpenAPI bukan hanya daftar endpoint.
OpenAPI harus menjadi contract:
- field
- validation
- error
- security
- versioning
- examples
- compatibility
```

---

# 5. DTO Schema Documentation

## 5.1 Request DTO Java

```java
public record CreateOrderRequest(

        @NotNull
        UUID customerId,

        @NotEmpty
        List<@Valid CreateOrderItemRequest> items,

        @Size(max = 500)
        String note

) {}
```

## 5.2 OpenAPI Schema

```yaml
CreateOrderRequest:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required:
    - customerId
    - items
  properties:
    customerId:
      type: string
      format: uuid
      description: Customer identifier.
      example: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
    items:
      type: array
      minItems: 1
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateOrderItemRequest'
    note:
      type: string
      maxLength: 500
      description: Optional order note.
      example: "Deliver during office hours."

CreateOrderItemRequest:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required:
    - productId
    - quantity
  properties:
    productId:
      type: string
      format: uuid
    quantity:
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      example: 2
```

Mapping rule:

| Java / Bean Validation | OpenAPI schema |
|---|---|
| `UUID` | `type: string`, `format: uuid` |
| `@NotNull` | add field to `required` |
| `@NotBlank` | `required` + `minLength: 1`, document non-blank |
| `@Size(max=500)` | `maxLength: 500` for string |
| `@NotEmpty List` | `required` + `minItems: 1` |
| `@Min(1)` | `minimum: 1` |
| `@Max(100)` | `maximum: 100` |
| `@Pattern` | `pattern` |
| `BigDecimal` | `type: string` or `number`, document precision policy |
| `Instant` | `type: string`, `format: date-time` |
| `LocalDate` | `type: string`, `format: date` |

Catatan: OpenAPI 3.1 selaras lebih dekat dengan JSON Schema dibanding 3.0, tetapi dokumentasi tetap harus eksplisit untuk semantic rule yang tidak bisa diekspresikan penuh di schema, misalnya “field A wajib jika field B = BUSINESS”. OAS 3.1.1 adalah standar deskripsi interface HTTP API dan OAS patch release 2024 menambahkan klarifikasi seputar schema/examples. ([OpenAPI Initiative Publications](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 6. Response DTO Schema

## Java

```java
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        List<OrderItemResponse> items
) {}
```

## OpenAPI

```yaml
OrderResponse:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required:
    - id
    - orderNumber
    - customerId
    - status
    - totalAmount
    - currency
    - submittedAt
    - items
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      format: uuid
    orderNumber:
      type: string
      example: "ORD-2026-000001"
    customerId:
      type: string
      format: uuid
    status:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderStatus'
    totalAmount:
      type: string
      format: decimal
      description: Monetary amount represented as decimal string to preserve precision.
      example: "100.00"
    currency:
      type: string
      minLength: 3
      maxLength: 3
      example: "USD"
    submittedAt:
      type: string
      format: date-time
      example: "2026-07-13T02:15:30Z"
    items:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderItemResponse'

OrderStatus:
  type: string
  description: Public order lifecycle status.
  enum:
    - DRAFT
    - SUBMITTED
    - APPROVED
    - REJECTED
    - CANCELLED
```

Rekomendasi untuk money: dokumentasikan presisi secara eksplisit. Jika ingin menghindari ambiguity parser number pada client, gunakan decimal sebagai string:

```yaml
totalAmount:
  type: string
  pattern: '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$'
  example: "100.00"
```

---

# 7. Error Contract Documentation

## Error DTO

```java
public record ApiErrorResponse(
        String code,
        String message,
        String correlationId,
        List<FieldErrorResponse> errors
) {}

public record FieldErrorResponse(
        String field,
        String code,
        String message
) {}
```

## OpenAPI Schema

```yaml
ApiErrorResponse:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required:
    - code
    - message
    - correlationId
    - errors
  properties:
    code:
      type: string
      description: Stable machine-readable error code.
      example: "VALIDATION_FAILED"
    message:
      type: string
      description: Human-readable message. Do not use as machine contract.
      example: "Request validation failed"
    correlationId:
      type: string
      description: Correlation ID for support and tracing.
      example: "req-2f8d7c9a"
    errors:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/FieldErrorResponse'

FieldErrorResponse:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required:
    - field
    - code
    - message
  properties:
    field:
      type: string
      example: "items[0].quantity"
    code:
      type: string
      example: "FIELD_MIN_VALUE"
    message:
      type: string
      example: "Quantity must be greater than or equal to 1"
```

## Reusable Responses

```yaml
responses:
  ValidationError:
    description: Request validation failed.
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApiErrorResponse'
        examples:
          validationFailed:
            value:
              code: VALIDATION_FAILED
              message: Request validation failed
              correlationId: req-2f8d7c9a
              errors:
                - field: customerId
                  code: FIELD_REQUIRED
                  message: Customer ID is required
                - field: items[0].quantity
                  code: FIELD_MIN_VALUE
                  message: Quantity must be greater than or equal to 1

  DomainConflict:
    description: Request conflicts with current resource state.
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApiErrorResponse'
        examples:
          orderCannotBeCancelled:
            value:
              code: ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED
              message: Order cannot be cancelled in current state
              correlationId: req-2f8d7c9a
              errors: []

  InternalError:
    description: Unexpected server error.
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApiErrorResponse'
        examples:
          internal:
            value:
              code: INTERNAL_ERROR
              message: Unexpected server error
              correlationId: req-2f8d7c9a
              errors: []
```

## Error Catalog Table

| HTTP | Code | Meaning | Client action |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 400 | `INVALID_JSON` | Payload cannot be parsed | Fix request body |
| 400 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` | Field constraints failed | Show field errors |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing/invalid token | Refresh/login |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Authenticated but not allowed | Stop or request permission |
| 404 | `ORDER_NOT_FOUND` | Order not found or not visible | Refresh data |
| 409 | `ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED` | State conflict | Refresh state |
| 422 | `BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION` | Semantic rule failed | Show business message |
| 503 | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | Temporary dependency/service issue | Retry later |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Unexpected server error | Show generic support message |

Error documentation harus menjelaskan **status code + stable error code**, bukan hanya “400 Bad Request”.

---

# 8. Parameter Documentation

## Path Parameter

```yaml
parameters:
  OrderId:
    name: id
    in: path
    required: true
    description: Order identifier.
    schema:
      type: string
      format: uuid
    example: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
```

## Query Parameters

```yaml
parameters:
  Page:
    name: page
    in: query
    required: false
    description: Zero-based page index.
    schema:
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      default: 0

  Size:
    name: size
    in: query
    required: false
    description: Page size. Maximum 100.
    schema:
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 100
      default: 20

  Sort:
    name: sort
    in: query
    required: false
    description: Sort expression. Allowed values are createdAt, updatedAt, orderNumber.
    schema:
      type: string
      example: "createdAt,desc"
```

Better sort contract:

```yaml
OrderSortField:
  type: string
  enum:
    - CREATED_AT
    - UPDATED_AT
    - ORDER_NUMBER
    - STATUS

SortDirection:
  type: string
  enum:
    - ASC
    - DESC
```

Parameter policy:

```text
[ ] Path IDs include format and example.
[ ] Pagination defines base: 0-based or 1-based.
[ ] Page size has default and max.
[ ] Sort fields are allow-listed.
[ ] Filters document enum values and semantics.
[ ] Query parameter validation is represented in schema.
```

---

# 9. Security Scheme Documentation

Bearer JWT example:

```yaml
components:
  securitySchemes:
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT

security:
  - BearerAuth: []
```

Operation-level security:

```yaml
paths:
  /orders/{id}/cancel:
    post:
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      summary: Cancel an order
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Order cancelled
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden'
```

Security docs harus menjawab:

```text
[ ] Apakah token wajib?
[ ] Scope/role/permission apa yang dibutuhkan?
[ ] 401 vs 403 kapan?
[ ] Apakah 404 dipakai untuk hidden resource?
[ ] Apakah tenant berasal dari token/context?
[ ] Apakah actorUserId boleh dikirim client? Biasanya tidak.
```

OpenAPI bisa mendeskripsikan security scheme dan requirement, tetapi object-level authorization seperti “user hanya boleh melihat order milik tenant-nya” tetap harus dijelaskan sebagai semantic rule dan diuji di implementation.

---

# 10. Deprecation Documentation

## Deprecated Field

```yaml
OrderResponse:
  type: object
  properties:
    orderNumber:
      type: string
      deprecated: true
      description: Deprecated. Use referenceNumber instead. Will be removed no earlier than 2026-10-13.
    referenceNumber:
      type: string
```

## Deprecated Operation

```yaml
paths:
  /orders/search:
    post:
      deprecated: true
      summary: Search orders
      description: Deprecated. Use GET /orders with query parameters.
```

OpenAPI schema objects and operations support a `deprecated` marker in common tooling/spec usage; use it with a clear replacement and removal timeline rather than only setting a boolean. OAS 3.1.1 is the current stable 3.1 patch release from the OpenAPI Initiative at the time of the cited spec. ([OpenAPI Initiative Publications](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Deprecation entry should include:

```text
Deprecated element:
Replacement:
Deprecated since:
Removal no earlier than:
Affected consumers:
Telemetry:
Migration example:
```

---

# 11. Versioning Documentation

## URI Version

```yaml
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/api/v1
    description: Version 1
```

Or:

```yaml
paths:
  /api/v1/orders:
    post:
      operationId: createOrderV1

  /api/v2/orders:
    post:
      operationId: createOrderV2
```

Version docs should state:

```text
[ ] What is the current version?
[ ] Which versions are supported?
[ ] What changed between v1 and v2?
[ ] What is the deprecation/sunset policy?
[ ] Are error codes compatible?
[ ] Are DTO fields compatible?
```

## Changelog Section

```yaml
info:
  title: Order Management API
  version: 2.0.0
  description: |
    ## Changelog

    ### 2.0.0
    - Breaking: renamed orderNumber to referenceNumber.
    - Breaking: amount is now represented as decimal string.

    ### 1.4.0
    - Added optional submittedAt field to OrderResponse.
```

---

# 12. Annotation-Based Documentation in Jersey

## Swagger Core Annotation Example

```java
@Path("/orders")
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Tag(name = "Orders", description = "Order lifecycle operations")
public class OrderResource {

    @POST
    @Operation(
            operationId = "createOrder",
            summary = "Create an order",
            description = "Creates an order and returns the created order representation."
    )
    @APIResponses({
            @APIResponse(
                    responseCode = "201",
                    description = "Order created",
                    content = @Content(
                            mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON,
                            schema = @Schema(implementation = OrderResponse.class)
                    )
            ),
            @APIResponse(
                    responseCode = "400",
                    description = "Validation error",
                    content = @Content(
                            mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON,
                            schema = @Schema(implementation = ApiErrorResponse.class)
                    )
            ),
            @APIResponse(
                    responseCode = "409",
                    description = "Domain conflict",
                    content = @Content(
                            mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON,
                            schema = @Schema(implementation = ApiErrorResponse.class)
                    )
            )
    })
    public Response create(
            @RequestBody(
                    required = true,
                    content = @Content(
                            schema = @Schema(implementation = CreateOrderRequest.class)
                    )
            )
            @Valid CreateOrderRequest request
    ) {
        ...
    }
}
```

Annotation-driven docs are convenient, but review carefully:

```text
[ ] Bean Validation constraints are correctly reflected.
[ ] Error responses are not forgotten.
[ ] Examples exist.
[ ] Deprecated fields are marked.
[ ] Security requirements are present.
[ ] Generated schema does not expose internal fields.
```

Swagger Core supports JAX-RS/Jersey integrations and annotations for producing OpenAPI definitions; its integration documentation notes Swagger Core 2.x produces OpenAPI 3.0 definition files. ([GitHub](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-core/wiki/Swagger-2.X---Integration-and-configuration?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 13. MicroProfile OpenAPI Option

If the runtime supports MicroProfile, MicroProfile OpenAPI is a standard Java/Jakarta way to expose OpenAPI docs. MicroProfile OpenAPI 4.1 is a final release in the MicroProfile ecosystem and is designed to generate/serve OpenAPI documentation for RESTful APIs. ([Eclipse Downloads](https://download.eclipse.org/microprofile/microprofile-open-api-4.1/microprofile-openapi-spec-4.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Conceptual annotation style:

```java
@Path("/orders")
@Tag(name = "Orders")
public class OrderResource {

    @POST
    @Operation(summary = "Create an order")
    @APIResponse(
            responseCode = "201",
            description = "Order created",
            content = @Content(
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = OrderResponse.class)
            )
    )
    @APIResponse(
            responseCode = "400",
            description = "Validation failed",
            content = @Content(
                    schema = @Schema(implementation = ApiErrorResponse.class)
            )
    )
    public Response create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest request) {
        ...
    }
}
```

Use MicroProfile OpenAPI when:

```text
[ ] Runtime already supports MicroProfile.
[ ] You want standard Jakarta-friendly annotations.
[ ] You want the service to expose OpenAPI at runtime.
[ ] Your platform governance accepts generated docs.
```

Use static OpenAPI when:

```text
[ ] API is design-first.
[ ] Contract review happens before implementation.
[ ] You need strict governance over breaking changes.
[ ] You want stable docs independent of runtime scanning.
```

---

# 14. Examples Strategy

Every important operation should have:

```text
[ ] valid request example
[ ] success response example
[ ] validation error example
[ ] domain conflict example
[ ] authorization error example if secured
[ ] not found example if resource lookup
```

Example component:

```yaml
examples:
  CreateOrderRequestExample:
    summary: Create order request
    value:
      customerId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
      items:
        - productId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
          quantity: 2
      note: "Deliver during office hours."

  OrderResponseExample:
    summary: Created order
    value:
      id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
      orderNumber: "ORD-2026-000001"
      customerId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
      status: "SUBMITTED"
      totalAmount: "100.00"
      currency: "USD"
      submittedAt: "2026-07-13T02:15:30Z"
      items: []
```

Rule:

```text
Examples are test assets, not decorative docs.
If examples are not validated in CI, they will drift.
```

---

# 15. Contract Tests

## 15.1 Spec Validation

CI should validate:

```text
[ ] openapi.yaml is syntactically valid.
[ ] All $ref resolve.
[ ] operationId unique.
[ ] schemas valid.
[ ] examples valid against schemas.
[ ] no undocumented 4xx/5xx for important endpoints.
[ ] deprecated items have replacement notes.
```

## 15.2 Runtime vs OpenAPI Test

Use JerseyTest to assert implementation matches spec examples.

Conceptual test:

```java
@Test
void createOrderExampleShouldBeAccepted() {
    String requestJson = ContractFiles.read(
            "openapi/examples/create-order.request.json"
    );

    when(orderService.create(any())).thenReturn(TestData.submittedOrder());

    Response response = target("/orders")
            .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .post(Entity.json(requestJson));

    assertEquals(201, response.getStatus());

    String actualJson = response.readEntity(String.class);

    JSONAssert.assertEquals(
            ContractFiles.read("openapi/examples/create-order.response.json"),
            actualJson,
            false
    );
}
```

## 15.3 Negative Contract Tests

```text
[ ] invalid JSON example returns INVALID_JSON
[ ] validation error example returns VALIDATION_FAILED
[ ] domain conflict example returns documented 409 code
[ ] not found returns documented 404 code
[ ] unauthorized/forbidden documented behavior matches runtime
```

---

# 16. Contract Diff / Breaking Change Detection

For PRs that modify `openapi.yaml`, run diff classification.

Breaking risk examples:

```text
[ ] Removed path
[ ] Removed method
[ ] Removed response field
[ ] Changed field type
[ ] Changed enum values
[ ] Added required request field
[ ] Tightened min/max/pattern
[ ] Changed status code
[ ] Changed error schema
[ ] Changed security requirement
```

Non-breaking or usually safe:

```text
[ ] Added optional response field
[ ] Added optional request field
[ ] Added new endpoint
[ ] Added examples
[ ] Improved description
```

But still review:

```text
Added enum response value can break clients with exhaustive switch.
Added optional response field can break strict clients.
Tightened validation can break existing payloads.
```

---

# 17. Documentation Governance Checklist

```text
API metadata
[ ] info.title clear
[ ] info.version correct
[ ] owner/contact defined
[ ] changelog updated

Operations
[ ] operationId stable and unique
[ ] summary concise
[ ] description explains business semantics
[ ] tags consistent
[ ] requestBody documented
[ ] all common responses documented

Schemas
[ ] DTO fields match implementation
[ ] required fields match Bean Validation
[ ] enum values match public contract
[ ] date/time format documented
[ ] numeric/money precision documented
[ ] additionalProperties policy explicit
[ ] deprecated fields marked

Errors
[ ] ApiErrorResponse schema documented
[ ] reusable error responses defined
[ ] error code catalog exists
[ ] field error examples exist
[ ] 401/403/404/409/422 documented where relevant

Security
[ ] auth scheme documented
[ ] scopes/roles/permissions documented
[ ] tenant/actor source explained
[ ] hidden-resource policy documented

Compatibility
[ ] deprecated elements have replacement
[ ] versioning policy clear
[ ] breaking changes flagged
[ ] old/new examples tested

Tests
[ ] OpenAPI lint/validate in CI
[ ] examples validated
[ ] runtime JerseyTest checks core examples
[ ] error contract tests aligned with docs
```

---

# 18. Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| OpenAPI hanya generate otomatis tanpa review | Schema bisa expose field internal | Manual governance + tests |
| Error response tidak didokumentasikan | Client tidak tahu recovery | Reusable error responses |
| Only 200 documented | Failure mode tribal knowledge | Dokumentasikan 400/401/403/404/409/422/500 |
| Example tidak dites | Example basi | Example-as-test |
| Required fields tidak match validation | Client salah implement | Bean Validation ↔ schema audit |
| Enum domain langsung muncul | Internal workflow bocor | DTO enum |
| Deprecation hanya boolean | Client tidak tahu migrasi | Replacement + timeline |
| operationId berubah | Generated client rusak | Stable operationId policy |
| Docs berbeda dari runtime | Trust turun | Contract tests |
| Security scheme global tapi permission tidak jelas | Authorization ambiguity | Operation-level security notes |

---

# 19. Definition of Done untuk OpenAPI PR

```text
[ ] openapi.yaml/generated spec valid.
[ ] operationId stable and unique.
[ ] Request schema matches DTO.
[ ] Response schema matches DTO.
[ ] Bean Validation constraints represented.
[ ] Error responses documented with examples.
[ ] Security scheme and permission notes documented.
[ ] Deprecated fields/operations include replacement and timeline.
[ ] Examples pass runtime tests.
[ ] Contract diff reviewed for breaking changes.
[ ] OpenAPI docs published or bundled with build artifact.
```

---

# 20. Roadmap Belajar Singkat

```text
1. Pahami struktur OpenAPI: paths, operations, components, schemas
   ↓
2. Dokumentasikan DTO request/response secara eksplisit
   ↓
3. Mapping Bean Validation constraints ke schema
   ↓
4. Standarkan ApiErrorResponse dan error catalog
   ↓
5. Tambahkan examples untuk success dan failure
   ↓
6. Dokumentasikan security scheme dan permission semantics
   ↓
7. Tambahkan deprecation dan versioning policy
   ↓
8. Tambahkan OpenAPI validation di CI
   ↓
9. Tambahkan example-as-test dengan JerseyTest
   ↓
10. Tambahkan contract diff check untuk breaking change
```

## Response:
7/13/2026, 4:04:06 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke governance dan CI pipeline untuk OpenAPI. Fokusnya: linting, validasi schema/example, diff breaking change, smoke test generated client, dan publishing docs sebagai quality gate.

# Cheatsheet - OpenAPI Governance & CI Pipeline untuk Jersey/JAX-RS Microservices

## 1. Introduction

OpenAPI governance adalah proses memastikan dokumen API bukan sekadar “docs”, tetapi **quality gate** untuk kontrak service. Tujuannya:

```text
Jersey/JAX-RS code
  ↓
OpenAPI contract
  ↓
lint + schema validation
  ↓
example validation
  ↓
breaking-change diff
  ↓
generated client smoke test
  ↓
published API docs
```

OpenAPI Specification mendefinisikan format deskripsi HTTP API yang bisa dipahami manusia dan mesin, sehingga dapat dipakai untuk dokumentasi, code generation, testing, dan governance. Versi resmi terbaru yang terlihat saat pengecekan adalah **OpenAPI 3.2.0**, dirilis September 2025; panduan OpenAPI juga menyatakan 3.2 tetap backward-compatible dengan 3.1. Namun, dalam enterprise pipeline, pilih versi yang **didukung penuh oleh toolchain internal**-sering kali 3.1.x masih lebih aman jika generator/linter belum matang untuk 3.2. ([OpenAPI Initiative Publications](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.2.0.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Practical skill/domain | Fungsi utama | Tooling umum | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | OpenAPI source strategy | Menentukan sumber kontrak | Static YAML, generated, hybrid | Docs drift dari code |
| 2 | Spec validation | Memastikan dokumen valid OAS | Redocly, Spectral, parser | YAML valid tapi bukan OAS valid |
| 3 | Linting / style guide | Menegakkan standar API | Spectral, Redocly rules | operationId kacau, error tidak standar |
| 4 | Bundling | Gabung multi-file spec | Redocly `bundle` | `$ref` rusak saat publish |
| 5 | Example validation | Memastikan example cocok schema | JSON Schema validator, test custom | Example basi/tidak valid |
| 6 | Breaking diff | Deteksi contract-breaking change | oasdiff, Optic, Redocly/other diff tools | Field dihapus tanpa sadar |
| 7 | Error catalog governance | Menjaga error code stabil | Custom registry + lint rule | Client parse message |
| 8 | Security docs governance | Auth scheme/scopes/roles jelas | OpenAPI securitySchemes | Endpoint secure tapi docs bilang public |
| 9 | Generated client smoke test | Membuktikan spec konsumsi-able | OpenAPI Generator | Spec valid tapi generated client gagal compile |
| 10 | Runtime contract test | Membuktikan code sesuai spec | JerseyTest | Docs dan runtime beda |
| 11 | Publishing | Membuat docs dapat diakses | Redocly build-docs, portal, static site | Spec hanya tersimpan di repo |
| 12 | Version/deprecation gate | Mengelola lifecycle API | changelog, lint, diff | Deprecation tanpa migration |
| 13 | CI enforcement | Blocking merge jika contract rusak | GitHub Actions/Jenkins/GitLab CI | Review manual terlewat |
| 14 | Artifact traceability | Menyimpan spec per release | build artifact, git tag | Tidak tahu versi spec production |

## 4. Recommended Repository Layout

```text
api-contract/
├── openapi.yaml
├── redocly.yaml
├── spectral.yaml
├── paths/
│   ├── orders.yaml
│   ├── customers.yaml
│   └── health.yaml
├── components/
│   ├── schemas/
│   │   ├── order.yaml
│   │   ├── error.yaml
│   │   └── pagination.yaml
│   ├── responses/
│   │   ├── errors.yaml
│   │   └── common.yaml
│   ├── parameters/
│   │   ├── pagination.yaml
│   │   └── correlation.yaml
│   └── examples/
│       ├── orders/
│       │   ├── create-order.request.json
│       │   ├── create-order.response.json
│       │   └── validation-error.response.json
│       └── errors/
├── scripts/
│   ├── lint-openapi.sh
│   ├── bundle-openapi.sh
│   ├── diff-openapi.sh
│   └── validate-examples.sh
└── generated/
    ├── openapi.bundle.yaml
    ├── openapi.bundle.json
    └── docs/
```

Untuk microservice kecil, satu `openapi.yaml` masih cukup. Untuk service besar, multi-file lebih maintainable, lalu di-*bundle* saat CI/publish. Redocly CLI mendukung command seperti `lint`, `bundle`, `split`, `join`, dan `stats`; `bundle` menggabungkan API description multi-file menjadi satu file YAML/JSON. ([Redocly](https://redocly.com/docs/cli/commands?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 5. CI Pipeline Stages

### Stage 1 - Validate OpenAPI Syntax

```bash
redocly lint api-contract/openapi.yaml
```

Atau:

```bash
spectral lint api-contract/openapi.yaml
```

Spectral adalah linter YAML/JSON generik yang membutuhkan ruleset; untuk OpenAPI, Spectral menyediakan built-in `spectral:oas` ruleset. ([Stoplight](https://docs.stoplight.io/docs/spectral/674b27b261c3c-overview?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

### Stage 2 - Bundle Spec

```bash
redocly bundle api-contract/openapi.yaml \
  --output build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml
```

Tujuan bundling:

```text
[ ] Semua $ref resolve.
[ ] Spec bisa dipakai oleh generator/client/docs.
[ ] Artifact tunggal bisa dipublish.
[ ] Contract per release bisa disimpan.
```

---

### Stage 3 - Lint Governance Rules

Contoh rule yang wajib:

```text
[ ] operationId wajib ada dan unique.
[ ] tags wajib ada.
[ ] summary wajib ada.
[ ] 4xx/5xx responses wajib pakai ApiErrorResponse.
[ ] 401/403 wajib ada untuk secured endpoint.
[ ] pagination parameter harus punya max size.
[ ] request schema harus additionalProperties: false untuk strict API.
[ ] error response harus punya code/message/correlationId/errors.
[ ] deprecated field harus punya replacement note.
```

Contoh `spectral.yaml` sederhana:

```yaml
extends:
  - spectral:oas

rules:
  operation-operationId:
    severity: error

  operation-tags:
    severity: error

  operation-summary:
    severity: warn

  no-trailing-slash:
    description: Paths should not end with trailing slash.
    given: $.paths[*]~
    severity: error
    then:
      function: pattern
      functionOptions:
        notMatch: /\/$/

  error-response-schema:
    description: Error responses should reference ApiErrorResponse.
    given: $.paths[*][*].responses[?(@property >= 400)].content.application/json.schema
    severity: error
    then:
      field: $ref
      function: truthy
```

---

### Stage 4 - Validate Examples

Setiap example request/response harus dites sebagai fixture.

```text
api-contract/components/examples/orders/create-order.request.json
api-contract/components/examples/orders/create-order.response.json
api-contract/components/examples/errors/validation-error.response.json
```

Validation yang dicari:

```text
[ ] Example JSON valid.
[ ] Example match schema.
[ ] Example bisa diterima JerseyTest.
[ ] Response example match runtime serialization.
[ ] Error example match ExceptionMapper output.
```

Pola yang bagus: **examples-as-tests**. Example bukan dekorasi dokumentasi; example adalah regression fixture.

---

### Stage 5 - Breaking Change Diff

Bandingkan contract PR dengan contract `main`.

```bash
oasdiff breaking \
  --base main-openapi.bundle.yaml \
  --revision build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml
```

Breaking changes yang harus block merge:

```text
[ ] Removed path.
[ ] Removed operation.
[ ] Removed response field.
[ ] Added required request field.
[ ] Changed field type.
[ ] Changed field format.
[ ] Removed enum value.
[ ] Changed response status.
[ ] Changed error schema.
[ ] Added security requirement to existing operation.
```

`oasdiff` adalah salah satu tool yang memang menargetkan review perubahan API contract dan breaking change pada PR. Gunakan tool apa pun yang cocok dengan platform tim, tetapi prinsipnya sama: **jangan rely hanya pada code review manual untuk breaking API changes**. ([Oasdiff](https://www.oasdiff.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

### Stage 6 - Generated Client Smoke Test

Generate client dari bundled spec, lalu compile.

Contoh OpenAPI Generator Maven plugin:

```xml
<plugin>
    <groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
    <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
    <version>${openapi.generator.version}</version>
    <executions>
        <execution>
            <goals>
                <goal>generate</goal>
            </goals>
            <configuration>
                <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml</inputSpec>
                <generatorName>java</generatorName>
                <library>native</library>
                <output>${project.build.directory}/generated-client</output>
            </configuration>
        </execution>
    </executions>
</plugin>
```

OpenAPI Generator menyediakan Java generator dan Maven plugin; plugin default-nya berjalan di fase `generate-sources` pada contoh dokumentasi resmi. ([OpenAPI Generator](https://openapi-generator.tech/docs/generators/java/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Smoke test minimal:

```text
[ ] Generated client source compiles.
[ ] Model class generated correctly.
[ ] Enum generated correctly.
[ ] ApiErrorResponse generated correctly.
[ ] Date/time type mapping acceptable.
[ ] BigDecimal/money mapping acceptable.
```

Generated client smoke test berguna karena spec bisa saja valid, tetapi buruk untuk consumer.

---

### Stage 7 - Jersey Runtime Contract Test

Contoh test:

```java
@Test
void createOrderExampleShouldMatchOpenApiContract() throws Exception {
    String requestJson = ContractFiles.read(
            "api-contract/components/examples/orders/create-order.request.json"
    );

    when(orderService.create(any()))
            .thenReturn(OrderTestData.submittedOrderResult());

    Response response = target("/orders")
            .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .header("X-Correlation-Id", "req-test-001")
            .post(Entity.json(requestJson));

    assertEquals(201, response.getStatus());

    String actual = response.readEntity(String.class);
    String expected = ContractFiles.read(
            "api-contract/components/examples/orders/create-order.response.json"
    );

    JSONAssert.assertEquals(expected, actual, false);
}
```

Runtime contract test harus membuktikan:

```text
[ ] Provider Jackson/JSON-B runtime sesuai spec.
[ ] Bean Validation runtime sesuai spec.
[ ] ExceptionMapper runtime sesuai error catalog.
[ ] Correlation ID muncul sesuai dokumentasi.
[ ] Response DTO serialization tidak drift.
```

---

### Stage 8 - Publish Docs

Contoh:

```bash
redocly build-docs build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml \
  --output build/openapi/docs/index.html
```

Redocly CLI dapat menghasilkan API reference documentation menjadi HTML melalui command `build-docs`. ([GitHub](https://github.com/Redocly/redocly-cli?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Artifact yang dipublish:

```text
[ ] openapi.bundle.yaml
[ ] openapi.bundle.json
[ ] HTML docs
[ ] changelog
[ ] breaking-change report
[ ] generated client artifact jika dipakai internal
```

---

## 6. GitHub Actions Example

```yaml
name: API Contract CI

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "api-contract/**"
      - "src/main/java/**"
      - "src/test/java/**"
      - "pom.xml"

jobs:
  openapi-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install OpenAPI tooling
        run: |
          npm install -g @redocly/cli @stoplight/spectral-cli

      - name: Lint OpenAPI with Redocly
        run: |
          redocly lint api-contract/openapi.yaml

      - name: Lint OpenAPI with Spectral
        run: |
          spectral lint api-contract/openapi.yaml

      - name: Bundle OpenAPI
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/openapi
          redocly bundle api-contract/openapi.yaml \
            --output build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml

      - name: Checkout main contract
        run: |
          git show origin/main:api-contract/openapi.yaml > /tmp/main-openapi.yaml || true
          redocly bundle /tmp/main-openapi.yaml \
            --output /tmp/main-openapi.bundle.yaml || true

      - name: Breaking change diff
        run: |
          if [ -f /tmp/main-openapi.bundle.yaml ]; then
            docker run --rm \
              -v "$PWD:/work" \
              -v "/tmp:/tmp" \
              tufin/oasdiff:latest breaking \
              /tmp/main-openapi.bundle.yaml \
              /work/build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml
          fi

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Maven verify
        run: |
          mvn clean verify

      - name: Build API docs
        run: |
          redocly build-docs build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml \
            --output build/openapi/index.html

      - name: Upload OpenAPI artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: openapi-contract
          path: |
            build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml
            build/openapi/index.html
```

Catatan penting:

```text
[ ] Jangan pakai docker image/tool version floating di pipeline production tanpa kontrol.
[ ] Pin versi tool untuk reproducibility.
[ ] Buat update tooling sebagai PR terpisah.
[ ] Breaking diff harus punya proses approval, bukan auto-ignore.
```

---

## 7. Maven-Oriented Pipeline

Untuk repo Java/Maven, pipeline bisa dibagi:

```text
validate
  ↓
openapi lint / bundle
  ↓
generate-sources
  ↓
openapi generated client smoke
  ↓
test
  ↓
JerseyTest
  ↓
verify
  ↓
integration tests / contract tests
  ↓
package docs artifact
```

Contoh profil Maven:

```xml
<profiles>
    <profile>
        <id>contract-tests</id>
        <build>
            <plugins>
                <plugin>
                    <groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                    <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                    <version>${openapi.generator.version}</version>
                    <executions>
                        <execution>
                            <id>generate-java-client</id>
                            <phase>generate-test-sources</phase>
                            <goals>
                                <goal>generate</goal>
                            </goals>
                            <configuration>
                                <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml</inputSpec>
                                <generatorName>java</generatorName>
                                <output>${project.build.directory}/generated-openapi-client</output>
                            </configuration>
                        </execution>
                    </executions>
                </plugin>
            </plugins>
        </build>
    </profile>
</profiles>
```

## 8. OpenAPI Governance Rules Catalog

| Rule | Severity | Rationale |
|---|---:|---|
| `operationId` required | error | Generated clients rely on stable method names |
| `operationId` unique | error | Avoid duplicate client methods |
| `tags` required | error | Docs navigation |
| `summary` required | warn/error | Human readability |
| `description` for business operation | warn | Domain clarity |
| `requestBody` examples required for write endpoints | error | Consumer usability |
| `2xx` response documented | error | Success contract |
| `4xx` response documented | error | Failure contract |
| `ApiErrorResponse` for all JSON error responses | error | Consistent error handling |
| `401/403` documented for secured endpoints | error | Auth semantics |
| `additionalProperties` explicit | error | Strict/tolerant decision visible |
| Pagination max size required | error | Prevent unbounded query |
| Sort fields allow-listed | error | Prevent unsafe raw sort |
| Deprecated field must include replacement | error | Migration clarity |
| Enum description required | warn | Avoid ambiguous lifecycle state |
| Money fields must document precision | error | Financial correctness |
| Date/time fields must document timezone | error | Temporal correctness |
| Correlation ID response header documented | warn/error | Supportability |

---

## 9. Breaking Change Classification

### Definitely breaking

```text
[ ] Remove path.
[ ] Remove HTTP method.
[ ] Remove response field.
[ ] Rename response field.
[ ] Change field type.
[ ] Change field format.
[ ] Add required request field.
[ ] Remove enum value.
[ ] Change enum meaning.
[ ] Tighten validation constraints.
[ ] Change authentication requirement.
[ ] Change error response schema.
[ ] Change stable error code.
```

### Risky

```text
[ ] Add enum value in response.
[ ] Add optional response field.
[ ] Change default pagination.
[ ] Change default sorting.
[ ] Change null omission policy.
[ ] Change unknown field policy.
[ ] Change HTTP status for known error.
```

### Usually safe

```text
[ ] Add new endpoint.
[ ] Add optional request field with default behavior.
[ ] Add optional response field if consumers ignore unknowns.
[ ] Improve description.
[ ] Add examples.
[ ] Add new reusable schema not referenced by old operations.
```

---

## 10. PR Approval Policy

| Change type | Required approval |
|---|---|
| Docs-only description/example | API owner |
| Add optional field | API owner + consumer check if public |
| Add endpoint | API owner + security review if secured |
| Add required request field | API owner + breaking-change approval |
| Remove/rename field | Breaking-change approval |
| Change enum/status | Domain owner + consumer impact review |
| Change error code/status | API owner + client owner approval |
| Change security scheme | Security owner |
| Change serializer config | Platform/API owner |
| Change OpenAPI version | Platform owner + tooling validation |

---

## 11. Contract Drift Detection

Drift muncul ketika:

```text
OpenAPI says:
  field required

Runtime says:
  field optional
```

atau:

```text
OpenAPI says:
  400 returns ApiErrorResponse

Runtime says:
  raw HTML / stack trace / different JSON
```

Drift prevention:

```text
[ ] JerseyTest reads OpenAPI examples.
[ ] Runtime response compared against examples/golden files.
[ ] Error mapper tests assert documented codes.
[ ] Generated client compiles.
[ ] OpenAPI diff runs in PR.
[ ] Spec artifact stored per release.
```

---

## 12. Generated Client Smoke Test Strategy

Smoke test is not full SDK testing. Minimal target:

```text
[ ] Client generation succeeds.
[ ] Generated code compiles.
[ ] Important DTOs generated.
[ ] Enum values generated.
[ ] ApiErrorResponse generated.
[ ] Date/time mapping acceptable.
[ ] BigDecimal/money mapping acceptable.
```

Example smoke test:

```java
@Test
void generatedClientModelsShouldCompileAndInstantiate() {
    OrderResponse response = new OrderResponse();

    response.setOrderNumber("ORD-2026-000001");
    response.setStatus(OrderStatus.SUBMITTED);

    assertEquals("ORD-2026-000001", response.getOrderNumber());
}
```

Why this matters:

```text
A spec can be syntactically valid but painful or broken for consumers.
Generated client smoke test catches consumer-facing schema problems early.
```

---

## 13. Publishing Strategy

Recommended artifacts per build:

```text
build/openapi/
├── openapi.bundle.yaml
├── openapi.bundle.json
├── index.html
├── changelog.md
├── breaking-diff-report.json
└── client-smoke-test-report.txt
```

Publish destinations:

| Destination | Use |
|---|---|
| Build artifact | Traceability per CI run |
| GitHub Pages / internal docs | Human docs |
| Artifact repository | Versioned contract |
| API portal | Consumer onboarding |
| Service image label | Trace deployed spec version |
| Release notes | API change communication |

Add metadata:

```text
service.name=order-service
service.version=1.12.0
openapi.version=1.12.0
openapi.spec=oas-3.1.1 or oas-3.2.0
git.sha=...
build.id=...
```

---

## 14. Version Pinning

Pin tooling versions.

Bad:

```bash
npm install -g @redocly/cli
```

Better:

```json
{
  "devDependencies": {
    "@redocly/cli": "2.27.1",
    "@stoplight/spectral-cli": "6.15.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "openapi:lint": "redocly lint api-contract/openapi.yaml && spectral lint api-contract/openapi.yaml",
    "openapi:bundle": "redocly bundle api-contract/openapi.yaml --output build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml",
    "openapi:docs": "redocly build-docs build/openapi/openapi.bundle.yaml --output build/openapi/index.html"
  }
}
```

Reason:

```text
[ ] CI reproducible.
[ ] Tool upgrade reviewed separately.
[ ] Generated output drift is intentional.
[ ] Breaking behavior in tooling does not surprise PRs.
```

Redocly’s changelog shows frequent patch releases and changes to behavior/output, so version pinning is practical for deterministic CI. ([Redocly](https://redocly.com/docs/cli/changelog?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 15. OpenAPI Quality Scorecard

| Category | Score question |
|---|---|
| Structural validity | Is the OAS valid and all refs resolved? |
| Operation quality | Does every operation have stable operationId, summary, tags? |
| Schema quality | Are DTO schemas strict, typed, and constraint-aware? |
| Error quality | Are all errors documented with standard schema and examples? |
| Security quality | Are auth schemes and permission semantics documented? |
| Example quality | Do examples validate and run against runtime tests? |
| Compatibility | Does diff detect breaking changes? |
| Consumer readiness | Does generated client compile? |
| Publishability | Is a bundled artifact and HTML doc produced? |
| Traceability | Is the spec version linked to build/release/git SHA? |

---

## 16. Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| OpenAPI only generated after code | Design issues found too late | Hybrid/design-first for public APIs |
| No lint rules | Contract style inconsistent | Spectral/Redocly rules |
| No breaking diff | Client breaks silently | Diff gate |
| Examples not tested | Docs rot | Examples-as-tests |
| Generated client never compiled | Consumer pain unseen | Client smoke test |
| Floating tool versions | CI nondeterministic | Pin versions |
| Error responses not documented | Client cannot recover | Error catalog |
| Deprecated without timeline | Client migration stalls | Deprecation policy |
| Publish docs manually | Docs stale | CI publishing |
| Spec not stored per release | No audit trail | Versioned artifact |

---

## 17. Production Checklist

```text
OpenAPI source
[ ] Source of truth defined: static, generated, or hybrid.
[ ] OpenAPI version chosen intentionally.
[ ] Tool support verified for chosen version.

Lint & validation
[ ] OAS validation passes.
[ ] Redocly/Spectral lint passes.
[ ] $ref resolution passes.
[ ] operationId unique.
[ ] error response rules enforced.

Examples
[ ] Request examples valid.
[ ] Response examples valid.
[ ] Error examples valid.
[ ] Examples run through JerseyTest.

Breaking change
[ ] Diff against main runs.
[ ] Breaking changes block merge.
[ ] Approved breaking changes documented.
[ ] Deprecated fields have migration plan.

Runtime
```

# Cheatsheet - End-to-End Reference Architecture Jersey/JAX-RS + MyBatis

## 1. Introduction

Karena stack kalian memakai **MyBatis**, boundary architecture-nya sebaiknya dipikirkan sebagai alur eksplisit dari **HTTP contract → DTO → validation → command/service → MyBatis mapper → PostgreSQL → result DTO → response/error contract**.

```text id="77aok7"
HTTP Request
  ↓
Jersey Resource
  ↓
JSON/XML Provider
  ↓
Request DTO
  ↓
Jakarta Bean Validation
  ↓
MapStruct DTO → Command
  ↓
Application Service / Transaction Boundary
  ↓
Repository / MyBatis Mapper Interface
  ↓
Mapper XML / SQL / PostgreSQL
  ↓
Result Object / Row DTO
  ↓
MapStruct Result → Response DTO
  ↓
Jersey Response / ExceptionMapper
  ↓
HTTP Response + OpenAPI Contract
```

MyBatis cocok untuk sistem yang butuh kontrol SQL eksplisit. Dokumentasi MyBatis menyebut `SqlSession` sebagai primary Java interface untuk menjalankan command, mendapatkan mapper, dan mengelola transaksi; `SqlSession` dibuat oleh `SqlSessionFactory`. MyBatis mapper XML juga menyediakan `resultMap`, yang didokumentasikan sebagai elemen paling kuat/kompleks untuk memetakan result set ke object. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/java-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
