## 3. Decomposition Map

| Layer | Komponen | Tanggung jawab | Jangan dilakukan di sini | Test utama |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HTTP boundary | Jersey Resource | Terima request, validasi DTO, panggil service | SQL langsung, business workflow berat | JerseyTest |
| Serialization | Jackson/JSON-B/XML provider | JSON/XML ↔ DTO | Mapper baru per request | Serialization contract test |
| DTO contract | Request/Response/Error DTO | Bentuk kontrak API | Entity persistence/domain object langsung | Golden file |
| Validation | Jakarta Bean Validation | Field/nested/cross-field rule stateless | Query DB/external API | Validator unit test |
| API mapper | MapStruct | DTO ↔ command/result/response | Business decision / DB call | Mapper unit test |
| Service | Application service | Use case, transaction, domain invariant | JSON parsing | Service test/integration |
| Repository | Repository wrapper | Persistence abstraction, exception wrapping | HTTP response | Repository integration test |
| MyBatis mapper interface | SQL operation contract | Method-level DB command/query | API DTO exposure langsung | Mapper integration test |
| MyBatis XML | SQL, `resultMap`, dynamic SQL | Query shape, joins, result mapping | Business branching kompleks | PostgreSQL Testcontainers |
| PostgreSQL | Data integrity | constraints, indexes, function/procedure | API error formatting | DB integration test |
| ExceptionMapper | Error normalization | Exception → HTTP error contract | Swallow error tanpa log | Error contract test |
| OpenAPI | API documentation | Schema, example, error catalog | Berbeda dari runtime | Contract diff + example-as-test |

MapStruct menghasilkan mapper implementation saat compile-time dengan plain Java method invocation, sehingga cocok sebagai boundary mapping guardrail yang type-safe. ([MapStruct](https://mapstruct.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) OpenAPI mendefinisikan deskripsi HTTP API yang language-agnostic agar manusia dan komputer bisa memahami capability service tanpa membaca source code. ([OpenAPI Initiative Publications](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.1.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 5. End-to-End Request Flow

## 5.1 Create Order Flow

```text id="f9yhfk"
POST /orders
  ↓
OrderResource.create(@Valid CreateOrderRequest)
  ↓
OrderApiMapper.toCommand(request)
  ↓
OrderService.create(command)
  ↓
TransactionManager.inTransaction(...)
  ↓
OrderRepository.insert(order)
  ↓
OrderSqlMapper.insertOrder(record)
  ↓
OrderSqlMapper.insertOrderItem(record)
  ↓
commit
  ↓
OrderResult
  ↓
OrderApiMapper.toResponse(result)
  ↓
201 Created + OrderResponse
```

## 5.2 Failure Flow

```text id="2zlfk3"
Malformed JSON
  → JsonExceptionMapper
  → 400 INVALID_JSON

DTO invalid
  → ConstraintViolationExceptionMapper
  → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED

Domain rule failed
  → DomainExceptionMapper
  → 409 / 422 / 404

PostgreSQL unique violation
  → MyBatis/Persistence exception wrapper
  → PersistenceExceptionMapper
  → 409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE

DB unavailable
  → PersistenceExceptionMapper
  → 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

Unexpected bug
  → UnhandledExceptionMapper
  → 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
```

([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/configuration.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 6.2 `SqlSessionFactory`

Untuk Jersey tanpa Spring, biasanya Anda perlu mengelola `SqlSessionFactory` sendiri.

```java id="u7rxyw"
public final class MyBatisSqlSessionFactory {

    private final SqlSessionFactory sqlSessionFactory;

    public MyBatisSqlSessionFactory(DataSource dataSource) {
        try (InputStream inputStream =
                     Resources.getResourceAsStream("mybatis/mybatis-config.xml")) {

            Environment environment = new Environment(
                    "production",
                    new JdbcTransactionFactory(),
                    dataSource
            );

            XMLConfigBuilder parser = new XMLConfigBuilder(inputStream);
            Configuration configuration = parser.parse();
            configuration.setEnvironment(environment);

            this.sqlSessionFactory =
                    new SqlSessionFactoryBuilder().build(configuration);

        } catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Failed to initialize MyBatis SqlSessionFactory",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    public SqlSession openSession() {
        return sqlSessionFactory.openSession(false);
    }
}
```

Rule:

```text id="qak1k6"
SqlSessionFactory → long-lived singleton
SqlSession        → short-lived, per transaction/request/use case
Mapper proxy      → obtained from SqlSession
```

MyBatis official Java API menjelaskan `SqlSessionFactory` membuat `SqlSession`, dan `SqlSession` dipakai untuk menjalankan statement, memperoleh mapper, serta commit/rollback transaction. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/java-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 7. Transaction Boundary

## 7.1 Manual Transaction Manager

```java id="wmhavm"
public final class TransactionManager {

    private final MyBatisSqlSessionFactory sessionFactory;

    public TransactionManager(MyBatisSqlSessionFactory sessionFactory) {
        this.sessionFactory = sessionFactory;
    }

    public <T> T inTransaction(Function<SqlSession, T> callback) {
        try (SqlSession session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            try {
                T result = callback.apply(session);
                session.commit();
                return result;
            } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
                session.rollback();
                throw exception;
            }
        }
    }

    public void inTransaction(Consumer<SqlSession> callback) {
        inTransaction(session -> {
            callback.accept(session);
            return null;
        });
    }
}
```

## 7.2 Service Uses Transaction Boundary

```java id="bb3g7j"
public final class OrderService {

    private final TransactionManager transactionManager;
    private final OrderRepositoryFactory repositoryFactory;

    public OrderService(
            TransactionManager transactionManager,
            OrderRepositoryFactory repositoryFactory
    ) {
        this.transactionManager = transactionManager;
        this.repositoryFactory = repositoryFactory;
    }

    public OrderResult create(CreateOrderCommand command) {
        return transactionManager.inTransaction(session -> {
            OrderRepository orderRepository =
                    repositoryFactory.create(session);

            Order order = Order.create(
                    command.customerId(),
                    command.items(),
                    command.note()
            );

            orderRepository.insert(order);

            return OrderResult.from(order);
        });
    }
}
```

Decision:

| Runtime model | Transaction recommendation |
|---|---|
| Plain Jersey + MyBatis | Explicit transaction manager around `SqlSession` |
| Jersey + Spring | Use Spring transaction + MyBatis-Spring |
| Jakarta EE container/JTA | Integrate with managed datasource/JTA carefully |
| Multiple DB/broker side effect | Prefer outbox/saga; avoid naive distributed transaction |

MyBatis-Spring documentation states that with MyBatis-Spring you do not need to use `SqlSessionFactory` directly because injected `SqlSession` participates in Spring transaction configuration and manages lifecycle automatically. Ini relevan kalau stack kalian ternyata memakai Spring di bawah Jersey; kalau tidak, manual lifecycle tetap perlu jelas. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/spring/sqlsession.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 8. Repository + MyBatis Mapper

## 8.1 Repository Interface

```java id="g3g1li"
public interface OrderRepository {

    void insert(Order order);

    Optional<Order> findById(UUID id);

    boolean existsByOrderNumber(String orderNumber);

    void updateStatus(UUID id, OrderStatus status, long expectedVersion);
}
```

## 8.2 MyBatis Repository Implementation

```java id="uogp19"
public final class MyBatisOrderRepository implements OrderRepository {

    private final OrderSqlMapper sqlMapper;
    private final OrderPersistenceMapper persistenceMapper;

    public MyBatisOrderRepository(
            SqlSession session,
            OrderPersistenceMapper persistenceMapper
    ) {
        this.sqlMapper = session.getMapper(OrderSqlMapper.class);
        this.persistenceMapper = persistenceMapper;
    }

    @Override
    public void insert(Order order) {
        OrderRecord orderRecord = persistenceMapper.toRecord(order);
        sqlMapper.insertOrder(orderRecord);

        for (OrderItemRecord item : persistenceMapper.toItemRecords(order)) {
            sqlMapper.insertOrderItem(item);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<Order> findById(UUID id) {
        OrderRecord record = sqlMapper.findById(id);

        if (record == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        List<OrderItemRecord> items = sqlMapper.findItemsByOrderId(id);

        return Optional.of(persistenceMapper.toDomain(record, items));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean existsByOrderNumber(String orderNumber) {
        return sqlMapper.existsByOrderNumber(orderNumber);
    }

    @Override
    public void updateStatus(UUID id, OrderStatus status, long expectedVersion) {
        int updatedRows = sqlMapper.updateStatus(id, status, expectedVersion);

        if (updatedRows == 0) {
            throw new PersistenceException(
                    "VERSION_CONFLICT",
                    "Order version conflict",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT
            );
        }
    }
}
```

---

## 8.3 MyBatis Mapper Interface

```java id="733r2t"
public interface OrderSqlMapper {

    void insertOrder(OrderRecord record);

    void insertOrderItem(OrderItemRecord record);

    OrderRecord findById(@Param("id") UUID id);

    List<OrderItemRecord> findItemsByOrderId(@Param("orderId") UUID orderId);

    boolean existsByOrderNumber(@Param("orderNumber") String orderNumber);

    int updateStatus(
            @Param("id") UUID id,
            @Param("status") OrderStatus status,
            @Param("expectedVersion") long expectedVersion
    );

    List<OrderRecord> searchOrders(OrderSearchCriteria criteria);
}
```

Rule:

```text id="cgb746"
Mapper interface = contract SQL operations.
Repository = domain-friendly persistence abstraction.
Service should not depend directly on Mapper XML details.
```

# 9. Mapper XML Blueprint

```xml id="0bjhjv"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper
        PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN"
        "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">

<mapper namespace="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderSqlMapper">

    <resultMap id="OrderRecordResultMap"
               type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderRecord">
        <id property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="orderNumber" column="order_number"/>
        <result property="customerId" column="customer_id"/>
        <result property="status" column="status"
                typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.OrderStatusTypeHandler"/>
        <result property="totalAmount" column="total_amount"/>
        <result property="currency" column="currency"/>
        <result property="submittedAt" column="submitted_at"
                typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler"/>
        <result property="version" column="version"/>
    </resultMap>

    <insert id="insertOrder"
            parameterType="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderRecord">
        INSERT INTO orders (
            id,
            order_number,
            customer_id,
            status,
            total_amount,
            currency,
            submitted_at,
            version
        ) VALUES (
            #{id},
            #{orderNumber},
            #{customerId},
            #{status},
            #{totalAmount},
            #{currency},
            #{submittedAt},
            #{version}
        )
    </insert>

    <insert id="insertOrderItem"
            parameterType="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderItemRecord">
        INSERT INTO order_items (
            id,
            order_id,
            product_id,
            quantity,
            unit_price,
            currency
        ) VALUES (
            #{id},
            #{orderId},
            #{productId},
            #{quantity},
            #{unitPrice},
            #{currency}
        )
    </insert>

    <select id="findById" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
        SELECT
            id,
            order_number,
            customer_id,
            status,
            total_amount,
            currency,
            submitted_at,
            version
        FROM orders
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </select>

    <update id="updateStatus">
        UPDATE orders
        SET
            status = #{status},
            version = version + 1,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = #{id}
          AND version = #{expectedVersion}
    </update>

</mapper>
```

MyBatis mapper XML supports top-level elements such as `select`, `insert`, `update`, `delete`, `sql`, `resultMap`, `cache`, dan `cache-ref`; `resultMap` adalah mekanisme utama untuk result set mapping yang kompleks. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 10. Dynamic SQL untuk Search/List

## 10.1 Criteria Object

```java id="rav6ba"
public record OrderSearchCriteria(
        UUID tenantId,
        OrderStatus status,
        UUID customerId,
        Instant submittedFrom,
        Instant submittedTo,
        int limit,
        int offset,
        String sortColumn,
        String sortDirection
) {}
```

## 10.2 Mapper XML

```xml id="51bvey"
<select id="searchOrders" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        customer_id,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at,
        version
    FROM orders
    <where>
        tenant_id = #{tenantId}

        <if test="status != null">
            AND status = #{status}
        </if>

        <if test="customerId != null">
            AND customer_id = #{customerId}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedFrom != null">
            AND submitted_at &gt;= #{submittedFrom}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedTo != null">
            AND submitted_at &lt; #{submittedTo}
        </if>
    </where>
    ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortDirection}
    LIMIT #{limit}
    OFFSET #{offset}
</select>
```

`ORDER BY ${...}` raw substitution **berbahaya** jika nilainya berasal langsung dari user. MyBatis dynamic SQL menyediakan elemen seperti `if`, `choose`, `trim`, `where`, dan `foreach` untuk membangun SQL dinamis; tetap bedakan `#{}` parameter binding vs `${}` string substitution. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/dynamic-sql.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 10.3 Safe Sort Allow-List

```java id="jovdjl"
public enum OrderSortField {
    CREATED_AT("submitted_at"),
    ORDER_NUMBER("order_number"),
    STATUS("status");

    private final String column;

    OrderSortField(String column) {
        this.column = column;
    }

    public String column() {
        return column;
    }
}
```

```java id="80p1dg"
public OrderSearchCriteria toCriteria(SearchOrderRequest request, UUID tenantId) {
    OrderSortField sortField = request.sortField() == null
            ? OrderSortField.CREATED_AT
            : request.sortField();

    SortDirection direction = request.direction() == null
            ? SortDirection.DESC
            : request.direction();

    return new OrderSearchCriteria(
            tenantId,
            request.status(),
            request.customerId(),
            request.submittedFrom(),
            request.submittedTo(),
            request.effectiveSize(),
            request.effectiveOffset(),
            sortField.column(),
            direction.name()
    );
}
```

Rule:

```text id="n7qd9e"
Use #{...} for values.
Use ${...} only for allow-listed SQL fragments controlled by server code.
Never pass raw client input into ${...}.
```

# 11. Persistence Record vs Domain vs API DTO

## 11.1 MyBatis Record

```java id="wt06sz"
public record OrderRecord(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatus status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        long version
) {}
```

## 11.2 Domain Object

```java id="mbdqk9"
public final class Order {

    private final UUID id;
    private final String orderNumber;
    private final UUID customerId;
    private OrderStatus status;
    private Money total;
    private long version;

    public void cancel(String reason) {
        if (!canBeCancelled()) {
            throw new DomainException(
                    "ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED",
                    "Order cannot be cancelled in current state",
                    DomainErrorCategory.CONFLICT
            );
        }

        this.status = OrderStatus.CANCELLED;
    }

    public boolean canBeCancelled() {
        return status == OrderStatus.SUBMITTED;
    }
}
```

## 11.3 API Response DTO

```java id="ibw4yk"
public record OrderResponse(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        OrderStatusDto status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt
) {}
```

Policy:

| Model | Purpose | Contains |
|---|---|---|
| API DTO | Wire contract | Public fields only |
| Command | Use-case input | Validated semantic input |
| Domain object | Business invariant/state | Methods/rules |
| MyBatis record | SQL row/projection | DB columns/result shape |
| Response DTO | Public output | Stable client contract |

# 12. Persistence Mapper

Gunakan MapStruct/manual mapper juga untuk domain ↔ persistence record, tapi jangan mencampur dengan API mapper jika complexity tinggi.

```java id="yplyas"
@Mapper(config = ApiMapperConfig.class)
public interface OrderPersistenceMapper {

    OrderRecord toRecord(Order order);

    List<OrderItemRecord> toItemRecords(Order order);

    Order toDomain(OrderRecord record, List<OrderItemRecord> items);
}
```

Untuk domain object yang constructor/invariant-nya kompleks, manual mapper sering lebih aman:

```java id="f37cqv"
public final class OrderPersistenceMapper {

    public OrderRecord toRecord(Order order) {
        return new OrderRecord(
                order.id(),
                order.orderNumber(),
                order.customerId(),
                order.status(),
                order.total().amount(),
                order.total().currency(),
                order.submittedAt(),
                order.version()
        );
    }

    public Order toDomain(
            OrderRecord record,
            List<OrderItemRecord> itemRecords
    ) {
        return Order.rehydrate(
                record.id(),
                record.orderNumber(),
                record.customerId(),
                record.status(),
                new Money(record.totalAmount(), record.currency()),
                itemRecords.stream().map(this::toDomainItem).toList(),
                record.version()
        );
    }
}
```

Rule:

```text id="wg3p57"
Use MapStruct for structural mapping.
Use manual mapper for invariant-rich rehydration.
Do not bypass domain factory/rehydrate rules accidentally.
```

# 13. TypeHandler Blueprint

## 13.1 Enum TypeHandler

```java id="d7qn5w"
public final class OrderStatusTypeHandler
        extends BaseTypeHandler<OrderStatus> {

    @Override
    public void setNonNullParameter(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int i,
            OrderStatus parameter,
            JdbcType jdbcType
    ) throws SQLException {
        ps.setString(i, parameter.name());
    }

    @Override
    public OrderStatus getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            String columnName
    ) throws SQLException {
        String value = rs.getString(columnName);
        return value == null ? null : OrderStatus.valueOf(value);
    }

    @Override
    public OrderStatus getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        String value = rs.getString(columnIndex);
        return value == null ? null : OrderStatus.valueOf(value);
    }

    @Override
    public OrderStatus getNullableResult(
            CallableStatement cs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        String value = cs.getString(columnIndex);
        return value == null ? null : OrderStatus.valueOf(value);
    }
}
```

## 13.2 Instant TypeHandler

```java id="8wk2er"
public final class InstantTypeHandler
        extends BaseTypeHandler<Instant> {

    @Override
    public void setNonNullParameter(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int i,
            Instant parameter,
            JdbcType jdbcType
    ) throws SQLException {
        ps.setObject(i, OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(parameter, ZoneOffset.UTC));
    }

    @Override
    public Instant getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            String columnName
    ) throws SQLException {
        OffsetDateTime value = rs.getObject(columnName, OffsetDateTime.class);
        return value == null ? null : value.toInstant();
    }

    @Override
    public Instant getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        OffsetDateTime value = rs.getObject(columnIndex, OffsetDateTime.class);
        return value == null ? null : value.toInstant();
    }

    @Override
    public Instant getNullableResult(
            CallableStatement cs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        OffsetDateTime value = cs.getObject(columnIndex, OffsetDateTime.class);
        return value == null ? null : value.toInstant();
    }
}
```

TypeHandler penting untuk menjaga:

```text id="x6sw0w"
[ ] enum DB representation
[ ] timestamp/timezone
[ ] JSONB
[ ] custom value object
[ ] PostgreSQL-specific type
```

# 14. Error Mapping MyBatis/PostgreSQL

## 14.1 Persistence Exception

```java id="y30rfs"
public final class PersistenceException extends RuntimeException {

    private final String code;
    private final String publicMessage;
    private final PersistenceErrorCategory category;

    public PersistenceException(
            String code,
            String publicMessage,
            PersistenceErrorCategory category,
            Throwable cause
    ) {
        super(publicMessage, cause);
        this.code = code;
        this.publicMessage = publicMessage;
        this.category = category;
    }

    public PersistenceException(
            String code,
            String publicMessage,
            PersistenceErrorCategory category
    ) {
        this(code, publicMessage, category, null);
    }

    public String code() {
        return code;
    }

    public String publicMessage() {
        return publicMessage;
    }

    public PersistenceErrorCategory category() {
        return category;
    }
}
```

```java id="nkp6c3"
public enum PersistenceErrorCategory {
    CONFLICT,
    NOT_FOUND,
    DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE,
    TIMEOUT,
    UNKNOWN
}
```

## 14.2 Translate PostgreSQL / MyBatis Exception

```java id="o7jfm4"
public final class PersistenceExceptionTranslator {

    public RuntimeException translate(RuntimeException exception) {
        Throwable root = rootCause(exception);

        if (root instanceof SQLException sqlException) {
            String sqlState = sqlException.getSQLState();

            if ("23505".equals(sqlState)) {
                return new PersistenceException(
                        "DUPLICATE_RESOURCE",
                        "Resource already exists",
                        PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT,
                        exception
                );
            }

            if ("23503".equals(sqlState)) {
                return new PersistenceException(
                        "REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND",
                        "Referenced resource was not found",
                        PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT,
                        exception
                );
            }
        }

        return new PersistenceException(
                "PERSISTENCE_ERROR",
                "Persistence operation failed",
                PersistenceErrorCategory.UNKNOWN,
                exception
        );
    }

    private Throwable rootCause(Throwable throwable) {
        Throwable current = throwable;

        while (current.getCause() != null) {
            current = current.getCause();
        }

        return current;
    }
}
```

Catatan:

```text id="z4j9t0"
SQLSTATE PostgreSQL:
23505 → unique_violation
23503 → foreign_key_violation
23514 → check_violation
40001 → serialization_failure
40P01 → deadlock_detected
```

Untuk SQLSTATE PostgreSQL, gunakan dokumentasi PostgreSQL resmi saat membuat translator final di project agar mapping-nya sesuai versi DB yang dipakai.

---

# 15. Persistence ExceptionMapper

```java id="0c7eqw"
@Provider
public final class PersistenceExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<PersistenceException> {

    private static final Logger log =
            LoggerFactory.getLogger(PersistenceExceptionMapper.class);

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(PersistenceException exception) {
        String correlationId = MDC.get("correlationId");

        log.warn(
                "Persistence error. code={}, category={}, correlationId={}",
                exception.code(),
                exception.category(),
                correlationId,
                exception
        );

        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                exception.code(),
                exception.publicMessage(),
                correlationId,
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(toStatus(exception.category()))
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private Response.Status toStatus(PersistenceErrorCategory category) {
        return switch (category) {
            case CONFLICT -> Response.Status.CONFLICT;
            case NOT_FOUND -> Response.Status.NOT_FOUND;
            case DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE -> Response.Status.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE;
            case TIMEOUT -> Response.Status.GATEWAY_TIMEOUT;
            case UNKNOWN -> Response.Status.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
        };
    }
}
```

Rule:

```text id="4bddaa"
Never expose:
- raw SQL
- SQL parameters
- table names
- connection string
- DB username
- stack trace
- PostgreSQL internal error detail

Client gets stable code + public message.
Logs get internal diagnostic with correlationId.
```

# 16. OpenAPI Contract Position

OpenAPI harus merepresentasikan API DTO dan error contract, bukan MyBatis record.

```yaml id="byqh1n"
OrderResponse:
  type: object
  additionalProperties: false
  required:
    - id
    - orderNumber
    - status
    - totalAmount
    - currency
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      format: uuid
    orderNumber:
      type: string
    status:
      $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderStatus'
    totalAmount:
      type: string
      example: "100.00"
    currency:
      type: string
      minLength: 3
      maxLength: 3
```

Jangan dokumentasikan:

```text id="2qde8a"
[NO] order.version jika hanya optimistic locking internal
[NO] tenant_id DB column
[NO] deleted_at soft delete internal
[NO] internal workflow state
[NO] MyBatis record fields yang bukan public API
```

Test penting untuk MyBatis:

| Test | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| Mapper XML load test | Namespace/method XML sesuai interface |
| Insert/select integration | SQL benar against PostgreSQL |
| `resultMap` test | Column → record mapping benar |
| Dynamic SQL test | Filter/sort/pagination benar |
| TypeHandler test | Enum/time/jsonb mapping benar |
| Transaction rollback test | Rollback saat service gagal |
| Constraint translation test | SQLSTATE → API error benar |
| Optimistic lock test | `updatedRows == 0` jadi conflict |
| N+1/performance smoke | Search/detail tidak query berlebihan |
| Migration test | Schema compatible dengan mapper XML |

# 18. Common Failure Modes Jersey + MyBatis

| Failure mode | Gejala | Penyebab | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SqlSession` dishare antar thread | Data/cache aneh | `SqlSession` dipakai singleton | session per transaction |
| Commit terlalu cepat | Rollback tidak jalan | autocommit/session lifecycle salah | transaction manager test |
| Mapper XML method mismatch | Runtime binding error | id XML beda dengan method interface | mapper XML load test |
| `resultMap` salah | Field null/tertukar | column alias/property mismatch | integration test |
| Raw `${}` injection | SQL injection via sort/filter | client input masuk SQL fragment | allow-list |
| Domain enum bocor ke API | client lihat internal states | response mapping langsung | DTO enum |
| SQL exception bocor | response berisi SQL detail | no exception translation | persistence mapper |
| N+1 query | detail endpoint lambat | select items per row | query plan/repository design |
| Lazy-ish session issue | object butuh session tertutup | mapper result tidak lengkap | explicit fetch |
| Wrong timestamp timezone | audit/event salah | timestamp mapping ambigu | TypeHandler + test |
| `BigDecimal` precision drift | amount salah | DB/JDBC/DTO mismatch | numeric integration test |
| Tenant leak | data tenant lain terlihat | tenant filter lupa di SQL | required tenant criteria test |

# 19. Review Checklist khusus MyBatis

```text id="2gwp2v"
Mapper interface/XML
[ ] Namespace XML sama dengan mapper interface.
[ ] Method id XML sama dengan method Java.
[ ] Parameter memakai @Param untuk multi-parameter.
[ ] resultMap eksplisit untuk query kompleks.
[ ] Column alias jelas.
[ ] Tidak ada raw ${} dari user input.
[ ] Dynamic SQL punya test untuk tiap branch penting.

Transaction
[ ] SqlSession short-lived.
[ ] Commit/rollback jelas.
[ ] Tidak ada SqlSession static/singleton.
[ ] Service boundary mengelola transaction.
[ ] Repository tidak commit sendiri jika dipanggil dalam service transaction.

PostgreSQL
[ ] Constraint DB align dengan domain rule.
[ ] Unique/FK/check violation diterjemahkan.
[ ] Timestamp/timezone dites.
[ ] Numeric/BigDecimal dites.
[ ] Locking/version conflict dites.

API boundary
[ ] API DTO tidak sama dengan MyBatis record.
[ ] Error SQL tidak bocor ke client.
[ ] OpenAPI tidak expose DB columns.
[ ] Response mapping melewati DTO mapper.
```

# Cheatsheet - MyBatis in Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Introduction

MyBatis adalah persistence framework yang memberi kontrol kuat atas SQL, stored procedure, dan advanced mapping; ini berbeda dari ORM penuh karena SQL tetap menjadi artefak utama yang Anda tulis dan review. Di aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS**, MyBatis sebaiknya ditempatkan di **infrastructure/persistence layer**, bukan langsung dipanggil dari resource. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="lwnq7l"
Jersey Resource
  ↓
Request DTO + Bean Validation
  ↓
MapStruct DTO → Command
  ↓
Application Service
  ↓
Transaction Boundary
  ↓
Repository
  ↓
MyBatis Mapper Interface
  ↓
Mapper XML / SQL
  ↓
PostgreSQL
```

Core mental model MyBatis:

```text id="3565dd"
SqlSessionFactory = long-lived factory
SqlSession        = short-lived database session / transaction context
Mapper Interface  = Java contract for SQL operations
Mapper XML        = SQL + result mapping
Repository        = application-friendly persistence abstraction
```

MyBatis Java API mendokumentasikan `SqlSession` sebagai primary interface untuk menjalankan command, memperoleh mapper, dan mengelola transaksi; `SqlSession` dibuat oleh `SqlSessionFactory`. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/java-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Yang dikuasai | Fungsi utama | Failure mode umum |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SqlSessionFactory` | Build dan konfigurasi MyBatis | Membuat `SqlSession` | Dibuat berulang-ulang per request |
| `SqlSession` lifecycle | open/commit/rollback/close | Unit of work DB | Session bocor atau dishare lintas request |
| Transaction boundary | Service-level transaction | Atomic use case | Repository commit sendiri-sendiri |
| Mapper interface | Java method untuk SQL | Type-safe-ish SQL entrypoint | Method tidak cocok dengan XML id |
| Mapper XML | SQL statement | Query/update eksplisit | SQL drift dari mapper interface |
| `resultMap` | Mapping result set → object | Mapping kompleks/join/nested | Field null/tertukar |
| Dynamic SQL | `if`, `choose`, `where`, `set`, `foreach` | Query dinamis aman | Raw string SQL injection |
| `#{}` vs `${}` | Parameter binding vs text substitution | SQL safety | User input masuk `${}` |
| `TypeHandler` | Custom Java ↔ JDBC type | Enum, `Instant`, JSONB, value object | Timezone/enum mapping salah |
| Repository wrapper | Domain-friendly persistence API | Decouple service dari MyBatis | Service tahu detail SQL |
| Error translation | SQL/MyBatis exception → domain/API error | Error contract aman | SQL/constraint detail bocor |
| Integration test | PostgreSQL nyata | Validate SQL/resultMap/transaction | Test mock lolos, runtime gagal |
| Query performance | Index, pagination, N+1, query plan | Production readiness | Endpoint lambat karena query buruk |

Prinsip boundary:

```text id="tfyb12"
API DTO          → public HTTP contract
Command          → use-case input
Domain object    → business invariant
MyBatis Record   → DB row/projection
Mapper XML       → SQL
Repository       → persistence abstraction
```

Jangan samakan `OrderResponse`, `Order`, dan `OrderRecord`. Kalau disamakan, API akan ikut bocor saat schema database berubah.

## 6. `mybatis-config.xml`

```xml id="yf524w"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration
        PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Config 3.0//EN"
        "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-config.dtd">

<configuration>
    <settings>
        <setting name="mapUnderscoreToCamelCase" value="true"/>
        <setting name="jdbcTypeForNull" value="NULL"/>
        <setting name="defaultStatementTimeout" value="30"/>
        <setting name="localCacheScope" value="SESSION"/>
    </settings>

    <typeAliases>
        <typeAlias alias="OrderRecord"
                   type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderRecord"/>
        <typeAlias alias="OrderItemRecord"
                   type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderItemRecord"/>
    </typeAliases>

    <typeHandlers>
        <typeHandler handler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.OrderStatusTypeHandler"/>
        <typeHandler handler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler"/>
    </typeHandlers>

    <mappers>
        <mapper resource="mybatis/mapper/OrderSqlMapper.xml"/>
    </mappers>
</configuration>
```

MyBatis configuration mendukung `settings`, `typeAliases`, `typeHandlers`, dan `mappers`. Dokumentasi resmi juga mencatat bahwa `TypeHandler` dapat dikonfigurasi untuk Java/JDBC type tertentu, tetapi MyBatis tidak selalu tahu tipe database sampai statement dieksekusi, sehingga mapping di parameter/result perlu eksplisit untuk kasus tertentu. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/configuration.html))

Checklist config:

```text id="yj8typ"
[ ] Statement timeout diset.
[ ] Mapper XML didaftarkan.
[ ] TypeHandler penting didaftarkan.
[ ] mapUnderscoreToCamelCase diputuskan eksplisit.
[ ] Environment/DataSource diset oleh aplikasi/runtime, bukan hardcode secret di XML.
```

---

## 7. `SqlSessionFactory` Lifecycle

Untuk plain Jersey tanpa Spring, buat `SqlSessionFactory` sebagai singleton application component.

```java id="mbdzsz"
public final class MyBatisSqlSessionFactory {

    private final SqlSessionFactory sqlSessionFactory;

    public MyBatisSqlSessionFactory(DataSource dataSource) {
        try (InputStream inputStream =
                     Resources.getResourceAsStream("mybatis/mybatis-config.xml")) {

            XMLConfigBuilder parser = new XMLConfigBuilder(inputStream);
            Configuration configuration = parser.parse();

            Environment environment = new Environment(
                    "default",
                    new JdbcTransactionFactory(),
                    dataSource
            );

            configuration.setEnvironment(environment);

            this.sqlSessionFactory =
                    new SqlSessionFactoryBuilder().build(configuration);

        } catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Failed to initialize MyBatis",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    public SqlSession openSession() {
        return sqlSessionFactory.openSession(false);
    }
}
```

`SqlSessionFactory` memang bertugas membuat `SqlSession` dari `Connection` atau `DataSource`, dan menyediakan beberapa varian `openSession(...)`. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/apidocs/org/apache/ibatis/session/SqlSessionFactory.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Practical rule:

```text id="xn1u5e"
SqlSessionFactory:
  - singleton
  - dibuat saat application startup
  - memakai DataSource/pool

SqlSession:
  - short-lived
  - dibuat per transaction/use case
  - commit/rollback eksplisit
  - selalu ditutup
```

---

## 8. Transaction Boundary

### 8.1 TransactionManager

```java id="h8sad4"
public final class TransactionManager {

    private final MyBatisSqlSessionFactory sessionFactory;
    private final PersistenceExceptionTranslator exceptionTranslator;

    public TransactionManager(
            MyBatisSqlSessionFactory sessionFactory,
            PersistenceExceptionTranslator exceptionTranslator
    ) {
        this.sessionFactory = sessionFactory;
        this.exceptionTranslator = exceptionTranslator;
    }

    public <T> T inTransaction(Function<SqlSession, T> callback) {
        try (SqlSession session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            try {
                T result = callback.apply(session);
                session.commit();
                return result;
            } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
                session.rollback();
                throw exceptionTranslator.translate(exception);
            }
        }
    }

    public void inTransaction(Consumer<SqlSession> callback) {
        inTransaction(session -> {
            callback.accept(session);
            return null;
        });
    }
}
```

MyBatis `SqlSession` API menyediakan operasi `commit`, `rollback`, dan `close`, sehingga transaction boundary bisa dibuat eksplisit bila tidak memakai framework transaction manager lain. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/java-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### 8.2 Service sebagai transaction owner

```java id="clw5p9"
public final class OrderService {

    private final TransactionManager transactionManager;
    private final OrderRepositoryFactory repositoryFactory;

    public OrderService(
            TransactionManager transactionManager,
            OrderRepositoryFactory repositoryFactory
    ) {
        this.transactionManager = transactionManager;
        this.repositoryFactory = repositoryFactory;
    }

    public OrderResult create(CreateOrderCommand command) {
        return transactionManager.inTransaction(session -> {
            OrderRepository repository = repositoryFactory.create(session);

            Order order = Order.create(
                    command.customerId(),
                    command.items(),
                    command.note()
            );

            repository.insert(order);

            return OrderResult.from(order);
        });
    }
}
```

Rule penting:

```text id="xkk9c4"
Transaction boundary sebaiknya di application service,
bukan di resource dan bukan di tiap repository method.
```

Alasannya: satu use case bisa butuh beberapa SQL operation yang harus commit/rollback bersama.

## 9. Repository Factory

```java id="6dg5sd"
public final class OrderRepositoryFactory {

    private final OrderPersistenceMapper persistenceMapper;

    public OrderRepositoryFactory(OrderPersistenceMapper persistenceMapper) {
        this.persistenceMapper = persistenceMapper;
    }

    public OrderRepository create(SqlSession session) {
        return new MyBatisOrderRepository(session, persistenceMapper);
    }
}
```

Repository interface:

```java id="99ut1j"
public interface OrderRepository {

    void insert(Order order);

    Optional<Order> findById(UUID id);

    boolean existsByOrderNumber(String orderNumber);

    void updateStatus(UUID id, OrderStatus status, long expectedVersion);
}
```

Repository implementation:

```java id="22a80z"
public final class MyBatisOrderRepository implements OrderRepository {

    private final OrderSqlMapper sqlMapper;
    private final OrderPersistenceMapper persistenceMapper;

    public MyBatisOrderRepository(
            SqlSession session,
            OrderPersistenceMapper persistenceMapper
    ) {
        this.sqlMapper = session.getMapper(OrderSqlMapper.class);
        this.persistenceMapper = persistenceMapper;
    }

    @Override
    public void insert(Order order) {
        OrderRecord record = persistenceMapper.toRecord(order);
        sqlMapper.insertOrder(record);

        List<OrderItemRecord> items = persistenceMapper.toItemRecords(order);
        for (OrderItemRecord item : items) {
            sqlMapper.insertOrderItem(item);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<Order> findById(UUID id) {
        OrderRecord record = sqlMapper.findById(id);

        if (record == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        List<OrderItemRecord> items = sqlMapper.findItemsByOrderId(id);

        return Optional.of(persistenceMapper.toDomain(record, items));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean existsByOrderNumber(String orderNumber) {
        return sqlMapper.existsByOrderNumber(orderNumber);
    }

    @Override
    public void updateStatus(
            UUID id,
            OrderStatus status,
            long expectedVersion
    ) {
        int affectedRows = sqlMapper.updateStatus(
                id,
                status,
                expectedVersion
        );

        if (affectedRows == 0) {
            throw new PersistenceException(
                    "VERSION_CONFLICT",
                    "Resource version conflict",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT
            );
        }
    }
}
```

## 10. Mapper Interface

```java id="st7yy0"
public interface OrderSqlMapper {

    void insertOrder(OrderRecord record);

    void insertOrderItem(OrderItemRecord record);

    OrderRecord findById(@Param("id") UUID id);

    List<OrderItemRecord> findItemsByOrderId(@Param("orderId") UUID orderId);

    boolean existsByOrderNumber(@Param("orderNumber") String orderNumber);

    int updateStatus(
            @Param("id") UUID id,
            @Param("status") OrderStatus status,
            @Param("expectedVersion") long expectedVersion
    );

    List<OrderRecord> searchOrders(OrderSearchCriteria criteria);
}
```

Guideline:

```text id="hnfcqt"
[ ] Pakai @Param untuk multi-parameter.
[ ] Nama method harus match id statement XML.
[ ] Return int untuk update/delete jika perlu optimistic locking.
[ ] Jangan return API DTO langsung dari MyBatis mapper.
[ ] Jangan expose mapper interface ke resource layer.
```

## 11. Mapper XML

```xml id="57hk15"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper
        PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN"
        "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">

<mapper namespace="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderSqlMapper">

    <resultMap id="OrderRecordResultMap"
               type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderRecord">
        <id property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="orderNumber" column="order_number"/>
        <result property="customerId" column="customer_id"/>
        <result property="status" column="status"
                typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.OrderStatusTypeHandler"/>
        <result property="totalAmount" column="total_amount"/>
        <result property="currency" column="currency"/>
        <result property="submittedAt" column="submitted_at"
                typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler"/>
        <result property="version" column="version"/>
    </resultMap>

    <insert id="insertOrder"
            parameterType="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderRecord">
        INSERT INTO orders (
            id,
            order_number,
            customer_id,
            status,
            total_amount,
            currency,
            submitted_at,
            version
        ) VALUES (
            #{id},
            #{orderNumber},
            #{customerId},
            #{status},
            #{totalAmount},
            #{currency},
            #{submittedAt},
            #{version}
        )
    </insert>

    <insert id="insertOrderItem"
            parameterType="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderItemRecord">
        INSERT INTO order_items (
            id,
            order_id,
            product_id,
            quantity,
            unit_price,
            currency
        ) VALUES (
            #{id},
            #{orderId},
            #{productId},
            #{quantity},
            #{unitPrice},
            #{currency}
        )
    </insert>

    <select id="findById" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
        SELECT
            id,
            order_number,
            customer_id,
            status,
            total_amount,
            currency,
            submitted_at,
            version
        FROM orders
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </select>

    <update id="updateStatus">
        UPDATE orders
        SET
            status = #{status},
            version = version + 1,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = #{id}
          AND version = #{expectedVersion}
    </update>

</mapper>
```

Mapper XML MyBatis memiliki elemen utama seperti `cache`, `resultMap`, `sql`, `insert`, `update`, `delete`, dan `select`. Dokumentasi MyBatis menyebut `resultMap` sebagai elemen paling rumit sekaligus kuat untuk memuat object dari database result set. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html))

## 12. `resultMap` Pattern

Gunakan `resultMap` ketika:

```text id="u7q6ih"
[ ] Nama column tidak langsung match property.
[ ] Ada join.
[ ] Ada nested object.
[ ] Ada constructor mapping.
[ ] Ada enum/custom type.
[ ] Ada one-to-many relation.
[ ] Butuh mapping eksplisit agar aman saat query berubah.
```

Contoh record:

```java id="9x7vtw"
public record OrderRecord(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatus status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        long version
) {}
```

Rule:

```text id="ce4n0e"
Simple query boleh resultType.
Query production penting lebih aman resultMap eksplisit.
Join dan projection kompleks hampir selalu lebih aman resultMap.
```

Anti-pattern:

```xml id="iu4bxm"
<select id="findById" resultType="OrderRecord">
    SELECT *
    FROM orders
    WHERE id = #{id}
</select>
```

Problem:

```text id="kbrzfw"
SELECT * membuat API persistence sensitif terhadap perubahan column.
Column order/naming bisa berubah.
Field internal bisa tidak sengaja ikut terbaca.
```

---

## 13. Dynamic SQL

MyBatis dynamic SQL XML menyediakan elemen seperti `if`, `choose`, `trim`, `where`, `set`, dan `foreach` untuk membangun statement bersyarat tanpa string concatenation manual. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/dynamic-sql.html))

### 13.1 Search Criteria

```java id="99czs8"
public record OrderSearchCriteria(
        UUID tenantId,
        OrderStatus status,
        UUID customerId,
        Instant submittedFrom,
        Instant submittedTo,
        int limit,
        int offset,
        String sortColumn,
        String sortDirection
) {}
```

### 13.2 Dynamic SELECT

```xml id="ojbl4z"
<select id="searchOrders" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        customer_id,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at,
        version
    FROM orders
    <where>
        tenant_id = #{tenantId}

        <if test="status != null">
            AND status = #{status}
        </if>

        <if test="customerId != null">
            AND customer_id = #{customerId}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedFrom != null">
            AND submitted_at &gt;= #{submittedFrom}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedTo != null">
            AND submitted_at &lt; #{submittedTo}
        </if>
    </where>
    ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortDirection}
    LIMIT #{limit}
    OFFSET #{offset}
</select>
```

### 13.3 Safe Sort Allow-List

`ORDER BY ${sortColumn}` hanya aman kalau nilainya **server-controlled allow-list**, bukan raw query param.

```java id="0us4dd"
public enum OrderSortField {
    SUBMITTED_AT("submitted_at"),
    ORDER_NUMBER("order_number"),
    STATUS("status");

    private final String sqlColumn;

    OrderSortField(String sqlColumn) {
        this.sqlColumn = sqlColumn;
    }

    public String sqlColumn() {
        return sqlColumn;
    }
}
```

```java id="kyg0tc"
public enum SortDirection {
    ASC,
    DESC
}
```

```java id="bbo3cw"
public OrderSearchCriteria toCriteria(
        SearchOrderRequest request,
        UUID tenantId
) {
    OrderSortField sortField = request.sortField() == null
            ? OrderSortField.SUBMITTED_AT
            : request.sortField();

    SortDirection direction = request.direction() == null
            ? SortDirection.DESC
            : request.direction();

    return new OrderSearchCriteria(
            tenantId,
            request.status(),
            request.customerId(),
            request.submittedFrom(),
            request.submittedTo(),
            request.effectiveSize(),
            request.effectiveOffset(),
            sortField.sqlColumn(),
            direction.name()
    );
}
```

Rule wajib:

```text id="mrfkdc"
#{...} = parameter binding, aman untuk value.
${...} = text substitution, hanya untuk SQL fragment allow-listed.
```

Dokumentasi MyBatis menjelaskan `#{id}` sebagai prepared statement parameter, mirip placeholder `?` pada JDBC `PreparedStatement`. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html))

---

## 14. Dynamic UPDATE dengan `<set>`

Untuk update parsial di persistence layer:

```xml id="iswo2s"
<update id="patchOrder">
    UPDATE orders
    <set>
        <if test="status != null">
            status = #{status},
        </if>
        <if test="note != null">
            note = #{note},
        </if>
        updated_at = now(),
        version = version + 1
    </set>
    WHERE id = #{id}
      AND version = #{expectedVersion}
</update>
```

MyBatis `<set>` membantu membangun dynamic update dan menghapus koma berlebih dari assignment yang kondisional. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/dynamic-sql.html))

Catatan penting:

```text id="yrq4b2"
Dynamic UPDATE di SQL bukan pengganti patch semantics.
Absent/null/value tetap harus diputuskan di API/service layer.
```

---

## 15. `foreach` untuk `IN (...)`

```xml id="8jfka7"
<select id="findByIds" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        customer_id,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at,
        version
    FROM orders
    WHERE id IN
    <foreach collection="ids"
             item="id"
             open="("
             separator=","
             close=")">
        #{id}
    </foreach>
</select>
```

MyBatis `foreach` bisa digunakan untuk iterasi collection, map, atau array, dan umum dipakai untuk membangun kondisi `IN`. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/dynamic-sql.html))

Checklist:

```text id="qhgvhl"
[ ] Batasi jumlah item IN.
[ ] Jangan menerima list sangat besar tanpa limit.
[ ] Untuk list besar, pertimbangkan temp table / join / batch strategy.
[ ] Test empty list behavior.
```

## 16. TypeHandler

### 16.1 Enum TypeHandler

```java id="ycswyg"
public final class OrderStatusTypeHandler
        extends BaseTypeHandler<OrderStatus> {

    @Override
    public void setNonNullParameter(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int i,
            OrderStatus parameter,
            JdbcType jdbcType
    ) throws SQLException {
        ps.setString(i, parameter.name());
    }

    @Override
    public OrderStatus getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            String columnName
    ) throws SQLException {
        return toStatus(rs.getString(columnName));
    }

    @Override
    public OrderStatus getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        return toStatus(rs.getString(columnIndex));
    }

    @Override
    public OrderStatus getNullableResult(
            CallableStatement cs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        return toStatus(cs.getString(columnIndex));
    }

    private OrderStatus toStatus(String value) {
        return value == null ? null : OrderStatus.valueOf(value);
    }
}
```

### 16.2 Instant TypeHandler

```java id="l7zloc"
public final class InstantTypeHandler
        extends BaseTypeHandler<Instant> {

    @Override
    public void setNonNullParameter(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int i,
            Instant parameter,
            JdbcType jdbcType
    ) throws SQLException {
        ps.setObject(i, OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(parameter, ZoneOffset.UTC));
    }

    @Override
    public Instant getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            String columnName
    ) throws SQLException {
        OffsetDateTime value =
                rs.getObject(columnName, OffsetDateTime.class);

        return value == null ? null : value.toInstant();
    }

    @Override
    public Instant getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        OffsetDateTime value =
                rs.getObject(columnIndex, OffsetDateTime.class);

        return value == null ? null : value.toInstant();
    }

    @Override
    public Instant getNullableResult(
            CallableStatement cs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        OffsetDateTime value =
                cs.getObject(columnIndex, OffsetDateTime.class);

        return value == null ? null : value.toInstant();
    }
}
```

Use TypeHandler untuk:

```text id="nn5d4n"
[ ] enum ↔ varchar/postgres enum
[ ] Instant ↔ timestamptz
[ ] LocalDate ↔ date
[ ] JSONB ↔ JsonNode / domain value object
[ ] custom value object ↔ scalar DB type
```

MyBatis `TypeHandler` dipakai dalam parameter dan result mapping untuk menentukan cara Java type diubah ke/dari JDBC type; untuk mapping tertentu, TypeHandler perlu disebut eksplisit di parameter/result mapping. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/configuration.html))

## 17. PostgreSQL Error Translation

PostgreSQL error memiliki SQLSTATE lima karakter. Dokumentasi PostgreSQL menyarankan aplikasi yang perlu mengetahui kondisi error untuk mengecek error code, bukan textual error message, karena error code lebih stabil dan tidak dipengaruhi lokalisasi pesan. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/errcodes-appendix.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Common SQLSTATE yang sering dipetakan:

| SQLSTATE | PostgreSQL condition | API mapping umum |
|---|---|---|
| `23505` | `unique_violation` | `409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` |
| `23503` | `foreign_key_violation` | `409 REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` atau domain-specific |
| `23514` | `check_violation` | `409/422 CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION` |
| `40001` | `serialization_failure` | retryable conflict / 409 / 503 sesuai policy |
| `40P01` | `deadlock_detected` | retryable conflict / 503 sesuai policy |
| `57014` | `query_canceled` | timeout/cancelled |

### Translator

```java id="18x781"
public final class PersistenceExceptionTranslator {

    public RuntimeException translate(RuntimeException exception) {
        Throwable root = rootCause(exception);

        if (root instanceof SQLException sqlException) {
            return translateSqlException(sqlException, exception);
        }

        return new PersistenceException(
                "PERSISTENCE_ERROR",
                "Persistence operation failed",
                PersistenceErrorCategory.UNKNOWN,
                exception
        );
    }

    private RuntimeException translateSqlException(
            SQLException sqlException,
            RuntimeException original
    ) {
        return switch (sqlException.getSQLState()) {
            case "23505" -> new PersistenceException(
                    "DUPLICATE_RESOURCE",
                    "Resource already exists",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT,
                    original
            );

            case "23503" -> new PersistenceException(
                    "REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND",
                    "Referenced resource was not found",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT,
                    original
            );

            case "23514" -> new PersistenceException(
                    "CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION",
                    "Persistence constraint was violated",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT,
                    original
            );

            case "40001", "40P01" -> new PersistenceException(
                    "CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION",
                    "Resource was modified concurrently",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT,
                    original
            );

            case "57014" -> new PersistenceException(
                    "QUERY_TIMEOUT",
                    "Database query timed out",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.TIMEOUT,
                    original
            );

            default -> new PersistenceException(
                    "PERSISTENCE_ERROR",
                    "Persistence operation failed",
                    PersistenceErrorCategory.UNKNOWN,
                    original
            );
        };
    }

    private Throwable rootCause(Throwable throwable) {
        Throwable current = throwable;

        while (current.getCause() != null) {
            current = current.getCause();
        }

        return current;
    }
}
```

Error response ke client harus stabil dan aman:

```java id="y4gi65"
@Provider
public final class PersistenceExceptionMapper
        implements ExceptionMapper<PersistenceException> {

    @Override
    public Response toResponse(PersistenceException exception) {
        ApiErrorResponse body = new ApiErrorResponse(
                exception.code(),
                exception.publicMessage(),
                MDC.get("correlationId"),
                List.of()
        );

        return Response.status(toStatus(exception.category()))
                .type(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_TYPE)
                .entity(body)
                .build();
    }

    private Response.Status toStatus(PersistenceErrorCategory category) {
        return switch (category) {
            case CONFLICT -> Response.Status.CONFLICT;
            case TIMEOUT -> Response.Status.GATEWAY_TIMEOUT;
            case DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE -> Response.Status.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE;
            case UNKNOWN -> Response.Status.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
        };
    }
}
```

Jangan expose:

```text id="9r4b8q"
[ ] raw SQL
[ ] SQL parameter
[ ] table/column internal
[ ] JDBC URL
[ ] DB username
[ ] stack trace
[ ] PostgreSQL detail message mentah
```

---

## 18. Integration Testing dengan PostgreSQL

Test MyBatis harus pakai PostgreSQL nyata untuk query penting, karena behavior SQL, type, JSONB, timestamp, locking, dan constraint sangat DB-specific.

### 18.1 Testcontainers skeleton

```java id="wz7sbm"
@Testcontainers
class OrderSqlMapperIT {

    @Container
    static PostgreSQLContainer<?> postgres =
            new PostgreSQLContainer<>("postgres:16")
                    .withDatabaseName("app_test")
                    .withUsername("test")
                    .withPassword("test");

    private static SqlSessionFactory sqlSessionFactory;

    @BeforeAll
    static void setup() {
        DataSource dataSource = buildDataSource(postgres);
        runMigration(dataSource);

        MyBatisSqlSessionFactory factory =
                new MyBatisSqlSessionFactory(dataSource);

        sqlSessionFactory = factory.unwrap();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldInsertAndFindOrder() {
        try (SqlSession session = sqlSessionFactory.openSession(false)) {
            OrderSqlMapper mapper =
                    session.getMapper(OrderSqlMapper.class);

            OrderRecord record = TestRecords.orderRecord();

            mapper.insertOrder(record);

            OrderRecord loaded = mapper.findById(record.id());

            assertNotNull(loaded);
            assertEquals(record.orderNumber(), loaded.orderNumber());

            session.rollback();
        }
    }
}
```

### 18.2 Test matrix

| Test | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| Mapper XML loads | namespace/id/parameter/result map valid |
| Insert/select | SQL dan resultMap benar |
| Update returns affected rows | optimistic locking bisa dideteksi |
| Dynamic search filters | semua branch `<if>` bekerja |
| Sort allow-list | tidak ada raw sort injection |
| `foreach` empty list | behavior jelas |
| TypeHandler enum | enum DB ↔ Java benar |
| TypeHandler instant | timezone tidak drift |
| Unique violation | SQLSTATE `23505` → `409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` |
| FK violation | SQLSTATE `23503` → error stabil |
| Transaction rollback | partial insert rollback |
| Pagination | limit/offset/order deterministic |
| Tenant filter | tidak bocor cross-tenant |

---

## 20. Transaction Rollback Test

```java id="1psdy3"
@Test
void shouldRollbackWhenSecondInsertFails() {
    UUID orderId = UUID.randomUUID();

    assertThrows(RuntimeException.class, () -> {
        transactionManager.inTransaction(session -> {
            OrderSqlMapper mapper =
                    session.getMapper(OrderSqlMapper.class);

            mapper.insertOrder(TestRecords.orderRecord(orderId));

            throw new RuntimeException("simulate failure");
        });
    });

    try (SqlSession session = sqlSessionFactory.openSession()) {
        OrderSqlMapper mapper = session.getMapper(OrderSqlMapper.class);

        OrderRecord loaded = mapper.findById(orderId);

        assertNull(loaded);
    }
}
```

Rollback test wajib untuk write flow penting.

---

## 21. Optimistic Locking Pattern

SQL:

```xml id="hecvqa"
<update id="updateStatus">
    UPDATE orders
    SET
        status = #{status},
        version = version + 1,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = #{id}
      AND version = #{expectedVersion}
</update>
```

Repository:

```java id="mqo5kn"
int affectedRows = sqlMapper.updateStatus(id, status, expectedVersion);

if (affectedRows == 0) {
    throw new PersistenceException(
            "VERSION_CONFLICT",
            "Resource version conflict",
            PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT
    );
}
```

Test:

```java id="gz7x5y"
@Test
void shouldDetectVersionConflict() {
    UUID id = insertSubmittedOrderWithVersion(1L);

    int updated = mapper.updateStatus(
            id,
            OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
            0L
    );

    assertEquals(0, updated);
}
```

Pattern ini cocok untuk endpoint update/cancel/approve yang rentan race condition.

---

## 22. Performance Review Checklist

| Area | Cek |
|---|---|
| Search/list | Ada index untuk filter/sort utama |
| Detail endpoint | Tidak N+1 query berlebihan |
| Pagination | Ada limit maksimum |
| Sort | Deterministic |
| Query timeout | Statement timeout diset |
| Result size | Tidak load dataset tak terbatas |
| Join | Column eksplisit, bukan `SELECT *` |
| Batch insert | Pertimbangkan batch untuk bulk |
| JSONB | Index strategy jelas jika query JSONB |
| Connection pool | Max pool sesuai DB limit |
| Slow query | Log/metrics tersedia |

MyBatis statement XML mendukung attribute seperti `timeout` dan `fetchSize` pada `select`; timeout adalah batas detik driver menunggu database mengembalikan request, sedangkan fetch size adalah hint untuk batch row retrieval dari driver. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html))

---

## 23. Security Checklist

```text id="sm8gmi"
SQL safety
[ ] User input selalu lewat #{...}.
[ ] ${...} hanya untuk allow-listed SQL fragment.
[ ] Sort/filter column allow-listed.
[ ] Tidak ada raw WHERE fragment dari client.

Data isolation
[ ] tenant_id selalu jadi filter server-side.
[ ] authorization bukan hanya di UI.
[ ] search/list tidak bocor cross-tenant.

Error safety
[ ] SQL exception tidak bocor ke response.
[ ] Parameter sensitif tidak dilog mentah.
[ ] Correlation ID ada untuk debugging.

Payload/query safety
[ ] page size dibatasi.
[ ] IN list dibatasi.
[ ] date range dibatasi jika query mahal.
```

---

## 24. Common Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| Resource langsung panggil MyBatis mapper | HTTP layer tercampur persistence | Resource → service → repository |
| `SqlSession` disimpan sebagai field singleton | Race/leak/session corruption | Open per transaction |
| Repository commit sendiri | Use case tidak atomic | Service-level transaction |
| API DTO = MyBatis record | DB schema bocor ke API | Separate DTO/record |
| `SELECT *` | Drift saat schema berubah | Explicit columns |
| `${sort}` dari query param | SQL injection | Enum allow-list |
| Semua SQL exception jadi 500 | Client tidak bisa handle conflict | SQLSTATE translation |
| No integration test | XML/resultMap bug runtime | PostgreSQL Testcontainers |
| `resultType` untuk join kompleks | Mapping rapuh | Explicit `resultMap` |
| Dynamic SQL tanpa test branch | Filter bug tersembunyi | Matrix test per filter |
| TypeHandler tidak dites | Timezone/enum bug | TypeHandler integration test |

---

Architecture
[ ] Resource tidak langsung depend ke MyBatis mapper.
[ ] Service adalah transaction boundary.

[ ] API DTO, domain object, dan MyBatis record terpisah.

SqlSession

Mapper XML

PostgreSQL

Testing

[ ] JerseyTest end-to-end untuk success/error.
