# Cheatsheet - MyBatis Query Design & Result Mapping Patterns  
## one-to-one, one-to-many, nested select vs nested result, pagination, search criteria, batch insert/update, stored procedure/function call, PostgreSQL-specific mapping

## 1. Introduction

Di stack **Jersey/JAX-RS + MyBatis + PostgreSQL**, desain query bukan sekadar “SQL jalan”. Yang perlu dijaga adalah:

```text id="tbfvf2"
API contract stabil
  ↓
Service/use-case transaction jelas
  ↓
Repository readable
  ↓
Mapper interface sinkron dengan Mapper XML
  ↓
SQL eksplisit, aman, dan performant
  ↓
resultMap benar
  ↓
PostgreSQL behavior dites nyata
```

MyBatis mapper XML mendukung statement seperti `select`, `insert`, `update`, `delete`, `sql`, dan `resultMap`; dokumentasi MyBatis juga menyebut `resultMap` sebagai elemen paling kuat sekaligus kompleks untuk mapping result set ke object. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Diagram Query Design

```text id="cw9bt9"
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Application Service                       │
│                                                              │
│  - use case orchestration                                    │
│  - transaction boundary                                      │
│  - domain invariant                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         Repository                           │
│                                                              │
│  - domain-friendly persistence API                           │
│  - calls MyBatis mapper                                      │
│  - translates DB errors                                      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    MyBatis Mapper Interface                   │
│                                                              │
│  OrderSqlMapper                                              │
│  - findById                                                  │
│  - searchOrders                                              │
│  - insertOrder                                               │
│  - updateStatus                                              │
│  - callProcedure                                             │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       Mapper XML                              │
│                                                              │
│  - resultMap                                                 │
│  - association                                               │
│  - collection                                                │
│  - dynamic SQL                                               │
│  - foreach                                                   │
│  - reusable sql fragment                                     │
│  - statementType=CALLABLE                                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        PostgreSQL                             │
│                                                              │
│  - table                                                     │
│  - view                                                      │
│  - index                                                     │
│  - constraint                                                │
│  - function                                                  │
│  - procedure                                                 │
│  - transaction / lock                                        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Skill utama | Kapan dipakai | Risiko utama |
|---|---|---|---|
| Simple `resultMap` | Column → record mapping | Query table/projection sederhana | Field null/tertukar |
| One-to-one `association` | Parent punya child tunggal | Order → Customer, Blog → Author | Join duplicate / nested select N+1 |
| One-to-many `collection` | Parent punya list child | Order → OrderItems | Row explosion / duplicate parent |
| Nested select | Load child via query lain | Detail lazy-ish atau child optional | N+1 query |
| Nested result | Join parent-child sekali query | Detail endpoint yang butuh graph | Mapping kompleks, duplicate rows |
| Search criteria | DTO criteria → SQL filter | List/search endpoint | SQL terlalu dinamis/tidak terindeks |
| Pagination | limit/offset atau keyset | List besar | Offset lambat / unstable page |
| Sorting | allow-listed SQL fragment | List/search | SQL injection via `${}` |
| Batch insert/update | Bulk operation | Bulk import, insert many items | Statement terlalu besar / transaction besar |
| Function call | `SELECT function(...)` | Return scalar/table/result set | Error mapping ambigu |
| Procedure call | `CALL procedure(...)` | Server-side operation | Transaction behavior perlu hati-hati |
| TypeHandler | Java ↔ JDBC custom type | enum, `Instant`, JSONB | Timezone/type drift |
| SQLSTATE translation | DB error → API error | unique/FK/check/deadlock | SQL detail bocor ke client |
| Integration testing | PostgreSQL nyata | Mapper XML/resultMap/dynamic SQL | Mock test tidak menangkap bug SQL |

---

# 4. Result Mapping Pattern

## 4.1 Simple `resultMap`

Gunakan `resultMap` eksplisit untuk query production penting.

```java id="yolfwq"
public record OrderRecord(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        UUID customerId,
        OrderStatus status,
        BigDecimal totalAmount,
        String currency,
        Instant submittedAt,
        long version
) {}
```

```xml id="6y8lcz"
<resultMap id="OrderRecordResultMap"
           type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderRecord">
    <id property="id" column="id"/>
    <result property="orderNumber" column="order_number"/>
    <result property="customerId" column="customer_id"/>
    <result property="status" column="status"
            typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.OrderStatusTypeHandler"/>
    <result property="totalAmount" column="total_amount"/>
    <result property="currency" column="currency"/>
    <result property="submittedAt" column="submitted_at"
            typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler"/>
    <result property="version" column="version"/>
</resultMap>
```

```xml id="vp1j6h"
<select id="findById" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        customer_id,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at,
        version
    FROM orders
    WHERE id = #{id}
</select>
```

Checklist:

```text id="ccp0qf"
[ ] Jangan SELECT * untuk query penting.
[ ] Semua column diberi alias jelas jika join.
[ ] Gunakan <id> untuk primary key di resultMap.
[ ] TypeHandler eksplisit untuk enum/time/jsonb.
[ ] Test resultMap dengan PostgreSQL nyata.
```

---

## 4.2 `resultType` vs `resultMap`

| Pattern | Kapan boleh | Kapan hindari |
|---|---|---|
| `resultType` | Query sangat sederhana, naming 1:1 | Join, nested object, custom type |
| `resultMap` | Production query, projection penting | Hampir tidak ada downside selain verbosity |
| Constructor mapping | Immutable object/record kompleks | Jika mapping sulit dibaca |
| Manual mapper | Rehydrate domain object dengan invariant | Jika mapping murni struktural |

Rule praktis:

```text id="c9eiyg"
Query API-critical → pakai resultMap.
Query join/nested → pakai resultMap.
Query yang schema-nya sering berubah → pakai explicit columns + resultMap.
```

---

# 5. One-to-One Mapping dengan `association`

Contoh: satu order punya satu customer summary.

## 5.1 Model

```java id="msweov"
public record OrderWithCustomerRecord(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        OrderStatus status,
        CustomerSummaryRecord customer
) {}

public record CustomerSummaryRecord(
        UUID id,
        String customerNumber,
        String displayName
) {}
```

## 5.2 Nested Result via Join

```xml id="ojtl5s"
<resultMap id="OrderWithCustomerResultMap"
           type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderWithCustomerRecord">
    <id property="id" column="order_id"/>
    <result property="orderNumber" column="order_number"/>
    <result property="status" column="order_status"
            typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.OrderStatusTypeHandler"/>

    <association property="customer"
                 javaType="com.company.app.infrastructure.customer.CustomerSummaryRecord">
        <id property="id" column="customer_id"/>
        <result property="customerNumber" column="customer_number"/>
        <result property="displayName" column="customer_display_name"/>
    </association>
</resultMap>

<select id="findOrderWithCustomer"
        resultMap="OrderWithCustomerResultMap">
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.order_number AS order_number,
        o.status AS order_status,
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.customer_number AS customer_number,
        c.display_name AS customer_display_name
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.id = #{id}
</select>
```

MyBatis `association` dipakai untuk relasi “has-one”; dokumentasi MyBatis menjelaskan association dapat diload dengan nested select atau nested results dari joined result. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 5.3 Nested Select

```xml id="6v3t0u"
<resultMap id="OrderWithCustomerNestedSelectMap"
           type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderWithCustomerRecord">
    <id property="id" column="id"/>
    <result property="orderNumber" column="order_number"/>
    <result property="status" column="status"/>

    <association property="customer"
                 column="customer_id"
                 select="findCustomerSummaryById"/>
</resultMap>

<select id="findCustomerSummaryById"
        resultType="com.company.app.infrastructure.customer.CustomerSummaryRecord">
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_number AS customerNumber,
        display_name AS displayName
    FROM customers
    WHERE id = #{id}
</select>
```

Gunakan nested select jika:

```text id="v65qxt"
[OK] child object jarang dibutuhkan
[OK] query child reusable
[OK] jumlah parent kecil
[OK] lazy loading sengaja digunakan dan dikontrol
```

Hindari nested select jika:

```text id="1g5c46"
[NO] list endpoint mengembalikan ratusan parent
[NO] child selalu dibutuhkan
[NO] query menjadi N+1
[NO] transaction/session lifecycle tidak jelas
```

---

# 6. One-to-Many Mapping dengan `collection`

Contoh: order punya banyak item.

## 6.1 Model

```java id="gqt348"
public record OrderDetailRecord(
        UUID id,
        String orderNumber,
        OrderStatus status,
        List<OrderItemRecord> items
) {}

public record OrderItemRecord(
        UUID id,
        UUID orderId,
        UUID productId,
        Integer quantity,
        BigDecimal unitPrice,
        String currency
) {}
```

---

## 6.2 Nested Result via Join

```xml id="9jux8l"
<resultMap id="OrderDetailResultMap"
           type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderDetailRecord">
    <id property="id" column="order_id"/>
    <result property="orderNumber" column="order_number"/>
    <result property="status" column="order_status"
            typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.OrderStatusTypeHandler"/>

    <collection property="items"
                ofType="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderItemRecord">
        <id property="id" column="item_id"/>
        <result property="orderId" column="order_id"/>
        <result property="productId" column="product_id"/>
        <result property="quantity" column="quantity"/>
        <result property="unitPrice" column="unit_price"/>
        <result property="currency" column="item_currency"/>
    </collection>
</resultMap>

<select id="findOrderDetailById" resultMap="OrderDetailResultMap">
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.order_number AS order_number,
        o.status AS order_status,

        i.id AS item_id,
        i.order_id AS item_order_id,
        i.product_id AS product_id,
        i.quantity AS quantity,
        i.unit_price AS unit_price,
        i.currency AS item_currency
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.id = #{id}
    ORDER BY i.created_at ASC, i.id ASC
</select>
```

`collection` dipakai untuk relasi one-to-many; MyBatis nested results menangani repeating subsets dari joined results untuk memetakan parent-child dari satu result set. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Catatan penting: gunakan `<id>` pada parent dan child agar MyBatis bisa mengidentifikasi object yang sama ketika row parent berulang akibat join.

---

## 6.3 Nested Select untuk Collection

```xml id="2ym3wz"
<resultMap id="OrderDetailNestedSelectMap"
           type="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderDetailRecord">
    <id property="id" column="id"/>
    <result property="orderNumber" column="order_number"/>
    <result property="status" column="status"/>

    <collection property="items"
                column="id"
                select="findItemsByOrderId"/>
</resultMap>

<select id="findItemsByOrderId"
        resultType="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderItemRecord">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id AS orderId,
        product_id AS productId,
        quantity,
        unit_price AS unitPrice,
        currency
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
    ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
</select>
```

Decision matrix:

| Situation | Better choice |
|---|---|
| Detail endpoint untuk satu order | Nested result atau two-query manual |
| List endpoint banyak order + item summary kecil | Hati-hati join row explosion |
| Child selalu dibutuhkan | Nested result |
| Child jarang dibutuhkan | Separate endpoint atau nested select |
| Data child besar | Separate endpoint/pagination child |
| Query parent harus tetap cepat | Jangan join semua child |
| Butuh kontrol performance | Manual two-query repository sering paling jelas |

---

# 7. Nested Select vs Nested Result

| Criteria | Nested Select | Nested Result |
|---|---|---|
| Cara kerja | Query child terpisah | Join dalam satu query |
| Risiko | N+1 query | Row duplication / resultMap kompleks |
| Cocok untuk | Child optional, parent sedikit | Detail graph yang selalu dibutuhkan |
| Debug SQL | Lebih mudah per query | Join lebih besar |
| Pagination parent | Lebih aman jika child diload setelah parent IDs | Join bisa merusak pagination |
| Performance | Bisa buruk jika banyak parent | Bisa berat jika one-to-many besar |
| Transaction/session | Perlu session masih hidup | Satu result set |
| Test | Perlu hitung query/branch | Perlu test duplicate parent mapping |

Rule praktis:

```text id="gbo1cr"
Detail by ID:
  nested result atau manual two-query.

Search/list:
  query parent dulu dengan pagination,
  lalu load child summary secara terkontrol jika perlu.

Large one-to-many:
  jangan embed semua child di list endpoint.
  gunakan detail endpoint atau child pagination.
```

---

# 8. Manual Two-Query Pattern

Sering lebih mudah, lebih predictable, dan lebih testable daripada nested mapping kompleks.

```java id="247sl8"
@Override
public Optional<Order> findById(UUID id) {
    OrderRecord order = sqlMapper.findById(id);

    if (order == null) {
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    List<OrderItemRecord> items = sqlMapper.findItemsByOrderId(id);

    return Optional.of(persistenceMapper.toDomain(order, items));
}
```

Kapan manual two-query bagus:

```text id="b79tki"
[OK] Detail endpoint by ID.
[OK] Domain rehydration punya invariant.
[OK] Parent-child mapping kompleks.
[OK] Ingin query parent dan child dites terpisah.
[OK] Ingin menghindari row duplication dari join.
```

Kapan kurang bagus:

```text id="28ws4z"
[NO] List endpoint banyak parent lalu child diload satu-satu.
[NO] Bisa menjadi N+1 jika tidak hati-hati.
```

Untuk list banyak parent, gunakan **batch load children by parent IDs**.

---

# 9. Batch Load Children by Parent IDs

## 9.1 Parent query

```xml id="1vsmwd"
<select id="searchOrders" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        customer_id,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at,
        version
    FROM orders
    <where>
        tenant_id = #{tenantId}
        <if test="status != null">
            AND status = #{status}
        </if>
    </where>
    ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT #{limit}
</select>
```

## 9.2 Child batch query

```xml id="2bkmt7"
<select id="findItemsByOrderIds"
        resultType="com.company.app.infrastructure.order.OrderItemRecord">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id AS orderId,
        product_id AS productId,
        quantity,
        unit_price AS unitPrice,
        currency
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN
    <foreach collection="orderIds"
             item="orderId"
             open="("
             separator=","
             close=")">
        #{orderId}
    </foreach>
    ORDER BY order_id, created_at, id
</select>
```

MyBatis `foreach` mendukung iterasi collection/array/map dan umum dipakai untuk membuat klausa `IN`. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Repository:

```java id="8i5kcs"
public List<OrderSummaryWithItems> searchWithItems(OrderSearchCriteria criteria) {
    List<OrderRecord> orders = sqlMapper.searchOrders(criteria);

    if (orders.isEmpty()) {
        return List.of();
    }

    List<UUID> orderIds = orders.stream()
            .map(OrderRecord::id)
            .toList();

    List<OrderItemRecord> items = sqlMapper.findItemsByOrderIds(orderIds);

    Map<UUID, List<OrderItemRecord>> itemsByOrderId = items.stream()
            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(OrderItemRecord::orderId));

    return orders.stream()
            .map(order -> persistenceMapper.toSummary(
                    order,
                    itemsByOrderId.getOrDefault(order.id(), List.of())
            ))
            .toList();
}
```

Checklist:

```text id="ejncsw"
[ ] Batasi jumlah parent IDs.
[ ] Test empty list.
[ ] Pastikan order deterministic.
[ ] Hindari IN list terlalu besar.
[ ] Pastikan index child.order_id ada.
```

---

# 10. Search Criteria Pattern

## 10.1 API Request DTO

```java id="9wmc10"
public record SearchOrderRequest(

        OrderStatusDto status,

        UUID customerId,

        Instant submittedFrom,

        Instant submittedTo,

        @Min(1)
        @Max(100)
        Integer size,

        String cursor,

        OrderSortFieldDto sortField,

        SortDirectionDto direction

) {
    public int effectiveSize() {
        return size == null ? 20 : size;
    }
}
```

## 10.2 Application Criteria

```java id="w13ghs"
public record OrderSearchCriteria(
        UUID tenantId,
        OrderStatus status,
        UUID customerId,
        Instant submittedFrom,
        Instant submittedTo,
        int limit,
        Instant cursorSubmittedAt,
        UUID cursorId,
        String sortColumn,
        String sortDirection
) {}
```

## 10.3 Dynamic SQL

```xml id="ztyz1x"
<select id="searchOrders" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        customer_id,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at,
        version
    FROM orders
    <where>
        tenant_id = #{tenantId}

        <if test="status != null">
            AND status = #{status}
        </if>

        <if test="customerId != null">
            AND customer_id = #{customerId}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedFrom != null">
            AND submitted_at &gt;= #{submittedFrom}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedTo != null">
            AND submitted_at &lt; #{submittedTo}
        </if>

        <if test="cursorSubmittedAt != null and cursorId != null">
            AND (
                submitted_at &lt; #{cursorSubmittedAt}
                OR (
                    submitted_at = #{cursorSubmittedAt}
                    AND id &lt; #{cursorId}
                )
            )
        </if>
    </where>
    ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT #{limit}
</select>
```

MyBatis dynamic SQL XML mendukung elemen seperti `if`, `choose`, `trim`, `where`, `set`, dan `foreach`; `where` membantu menambahkan `WHERE` hanya jika ada kondisi dan membersihkan prefix `AND`/`OR` yang tidak valid. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 11. Pagination Pattern

## 11.1 Offset Pagination

```xml id="x21jyo"
<select id="searchOrdersOffset" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        submitted_at
    FROM orders
    WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
    ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT #{limit}
    OFFSET #{offset}
</select>
```

Cocok untuk:

```text id="h6n7b7"
[OK] dataset kecil/sedang
[OK] admin UI sederhana
[OK] page number UX
[OK] low write concurrency
```

Risiko:

```text id="a1xg6r"
[NO] OFFSET besar lambat
[NO] data berubah saat user paging
[NO] duplicate/missing item jika sort tidak deterministic
```

---

## 11.2 Keyset / Cursor Pagination

```xml id="rv2llb"
<select id="searchOrdersCursor" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        submitted_at
    FROM orders
    <where>
        tenant_id = #{tenantId}

        <if test="cursorSubmittedAt != null and cursorId != null">
            AND (
                submitted_at &lt; #{cursorSubmittedAt}
                OR (
                    submitted_at = #{cursorSubmittedAt}
                    AND id &lt; #{cursorId}
                )
            )
        </if>
    </where>
    ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT #{limit}
</select>
```

Cocok untuk:

```text id="1n67wy"
[OK] data besar
[OK] feed/event/audit log
[OK] high write concurrency
[OK] infinite scroll
```

Checklist:

```text id="32ro9s"
[ ] Sort column deterministic.
[ ] Tie-breaker ID dipakai.
[ ] Index sesuai order/filter.
[ ] Cursor opaque untuk client jika perlu.
[ ] Tidak expose internal query details dalam cursor.
```

---

# 12. Sorting Pattern Aman

## 12.1 Jangan raw query param ke `${}`

Bahaya:

```xml id="shmlhn"
ORDER BY ${sort}
```

Jika `sort` berasal dari client, ini risk SQL injection.

## 12.2 Allow-list di Java

```java id="zqrv92"
public enum OrderSortField {
    SUBMITTED_AT("submitted_at"),
    ORDER_NUMBER("order_number"),
    STATUS("status");

    private final String sqlColumn;

    OrderSortField(String sqlColumn) {
        this.sqlColumn = sqlColumn;
    }

    public String sqlColumn() {
        return sqlColumn;
    }
}
```

```java id="hj4vxg"
public enum SortDirection {
    ASC,
    DESC
}
```

Mapper XML:

```xml id="olhmr5"
ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortDirection}, id DESC
```

Rule:

```text id="513b3z"
${sortColumn} aman hanya jika nilainya berasal dari enum server-side,
bukan langsung dari request string.
```

MyBatis membedakan parameter binding `#{...}` dan string substitution `${...}`; dokumentasi MyBatis mencontohkan `#{id}` sebagai prepared statement parameter untuk value. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 13. Reusable SQL Fragments

Gunakan `<sql>` untuk column list yang konsisten.

```xml id="j1z5v0"
<sql id="OrderColumns">
    id,
    order_number,
    customer_id,
    status,
    total_amount,
    currency,
    submitted_at,
    version
</sql>

<select id="findById" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        <include refid="OrderColumns"/>
    FROM orders
    WHERE id = #{id}
</select>
```

Gunakan dengan hati-hati:

```text id="v75e5d"
[OK] Shared column list
[OK] Shared WHERE tenant filter
[OK] Shared projection

[NO] SQL fragment terlalu pintar sampai query sulit dibaca
[NO] Reuse fragment yang membuat index/filter tidak jelas
```

---

# 14. Batch Insert Pattern

## 14.1 Multi-row insert dengan `<foreach>`

```xml id="5dus16"
<insert id="insertOrderItems">
    INSERT INTO order_items (
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        currency
    )
    VALUES
    <foreach collection="items"
             item="item"
             separator=",">
        (
            #{item.id},
            #{item.orderId},
            #{item.productId},
            #{item.quantity},
            #{item.unitPrice},
            #{item.currency}
        )
    </foreach>
</insert>
```

Cocok untuk list kecil/sedang.

Risiko:

```text id="ns6gx0"
[ ] SQL statement terlalu panjang.
[ ] Parameter terlalu banyak.
[ ] Batch besar membuat transaction lama.
[ ] Error satu row bisa menggagalkan semua.
```

---

## 14.2 JDBC Batch via MyBatis Executor

Jika bulk besar, pertimbangkan executor batch.

```java id="qg7eya"
try (SqlSession session = sqlSessionFactory.openSession(ExecutorType.BATCH, false)) {
    OrderSqlMapper mapper = session.getMapper(OrderSqlMapper.class);

    for (OrderItemRecord item : items) {
        mapper.insertOrderItem(item);
    }

    session.flushStatements();
    session.commit();
} catch (RuntimeException exception) {
    // rollback + translate
    throw exception;
}
```

MyBatis Java API menyediakan `ExecutorType.BATCH`; dokumentasi MyBatis menjelaskan executor type ini membatch update statements dan melakukan demarcation jika SELECT dieksekusi di antaranya. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/java-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Decision:

| Batch approach | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Multi-row `INSERT ... VALUES (...), (...)` | List kecil/sedang, single statement jelas |
| ExecutorType.BATCH | Banyak row, statement sama berulang |
| PostgreSQL COPY | Bulk load sangat besar |
| Temp table + merge | Upsert/matching kompleks |
| Stored procedure | Bulk business logic server-side |

---

# 15. Batch Update Pattern

## 15.1 Loop + ExecutorType.BATCH

```java id="xnnnkc"
public void updateStatuses(List<OrderStatusUpdateRecord> updates) {
    try (SqlSession session =
                 sqlSessionFactory.openSession(ExecutorType.BATCH, false)) {

        OrderSqlMapper mapper = session.getMapper(OrderSqlMapper.class);

        for (OrderStatusUpdateRecord update : updates) {
            mapper.updateStatus(
                    update.id(),
                    update.status(),
                    update.expectedVersion()
            );
        }

        session.flushStatements();
        session.commit();
    }
}
```

## 15.2 Single SQL update with `CASE`

Untuk batch kecil dan controlled:

```xml id="fsma0j"
<update id="bulkUpdateStatus">
    UPDATE orders
    SET status = CASE id
        <foreach collection="updates" item="u">
            WHEN #{u.id} THEN #{u.status}
        </foreach>
    END,
    updated_at = now()
    WHERE id IN
    <foreach collection="updates"
             item="u"
             open="("
             separator=","
             close=")">
        #{u.id}
    </foreach>
</update>
```

Checklist:

```text id="fg9smd"
[ ] Ada batas jumlah update.
[ ] Optimistic locking dipertimbangkan.
[ ] Partial failure behavior jelas.
[ ] Audit trail jelas.
[ ] Transaction timeout dipertimbangkan.
```

---

# 16. Upsert Pattern PostgreSQL

```xml id="o7636s"
<insert id="upsertOrderProjection">
    INSERT INTO order_projection (
        order_id,
        order_number,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        updated_at
    ) VALUES (
        #{orderId},
        #{orderNumber},
        #{status},
        #{totalAmount},
        #{currency},
        now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (order_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        order_number = EXCLUDED.order_number,
        status = EXCLUDED.status,
        total_amount = EXCLUDED.total_amount,
        currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
        updated_at = now()
</insert>
```

Policy:

```text id="t70vbm"
[ ] Upsert cocok untuk projection/cache/idempotent write.
[ ] Jangan pakai upsert untuk menyembunyikan duplicate business error jika duplicate harus 409.
[ ] Pastikan conflict target punya unique constraint/index.
[ ] Test insert path dan update path.
```

---

# 17. PostgreSQL Function Call

PostgreSQL function dipanggil dengan `SELECT`, bukan `CALL`; PostgreSQL documentation untuk `CALL` menyatakan bahwa function dipanggil menggunakan `SELECT`. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-call.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 17.1 Scalar Function

SQL function:

```sql id="l2svvz"
CREATE FUNCTION calculate_order_total(p_order_id uuid)
RETURNS numeric
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_total numeric;
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 0)
    INTO v_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id = p_order_id;

    RETURN v_total;
END;
$$;
```

MyBatis:

```xml id="62f9mg"
<select id="calculateOrderTotal" resultType="java.math.BigDecimal">
    SELECT calculate_order_total(#{orderId})
</select>
```

Interface:

```java id="xf4frt"
BigDecimal calculateOrderTotal(@Param("orderId") UUID orderId);
```

---

## 17.2 Table-returning Function

PostgreSQL:

```sql id="z8g1ju"
CREATE FUNCTION search_orders_for_customer(p_customer_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (
    id uuid,
    order_number text,
    status text,
    total_amount numeric,
    currency text,
    submitted_at timestamptz
)
LANGUAGE sql
AS $$
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id = p_customer_id;
$$;
```

MyBatis:

```xml id="ll3lkt"
<select id="searchOrdersForCustomer" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT *
    FROM search_orders_for_customer(#{customerId})
</select>
```

Rule:

```text id="v2m97t"
[ ] Function result columns harus stabil.
[ ] Hindari SELECT * jika function schema bisa berubah.
[ ] Dokumentasikan function sebagai DB contract.
[ ] Test function resultMap dengan migration.
```

---

# 18. PostgreSQL Procedure Call

PostgreSQL procedure dipanggil dengan `CALL`; dokumentasi PostgreSQL menyatakan `CALL` menjalankan procedure dan procedure bisa memiliki output parameter yang dikembalikan sebagai result row. Jika `CALL` dijalankan dalam transaction block, procedure yang dipanggil tidak boleh menjalankan transaction control. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-call.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 18.1 Procedure

```sql id="u6cf94"
CREATE PROCEDURE close_old_orders(p_cutoff timestamptz)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
    UPDATE orders
    SET status = 'CLOSED',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE status = 'SUBMITTED'
      AND submitted_at < p_cutoff;
END;
$$;
```

MyBatis:

```xml id="hsil61"
<update id="closeOldOrders" statementType="CALLABLE">
    CALL close_old_orders(#{cutoff})
</update>
```

Interface:

```java id="c9bx87"
void closeOldOrders(@Param("cutoff") Instant cutoff);
```

Use procedure carefully:

```text id="8n1nih"
[ ] Cocok untuk DB-side operation yang eksplisit.
[ ] Jangan sembunyikan business workflow yang seharusnya di application service.
[ ] Perhatikan transaction behavior.
[ ] Test dengan PostgreSQL nyata.
```

---

# 19. PostgreSQL JSONB Mapping

## 19.1 Store JSONB

Record:

```java id="f48v3r"
public record OrderMetadataRecord(
        UUID orderId,
        JsonNode metadata
) {}
```

TypeHandler concept:

```java id="bb6wr1"
public final class JsonbTypeHandler extends BaseTypeHandler<JsonNode> {

    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();

    @Override
    public void setNonNullParameter(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            int i,
            JsonNode parameter,
            JdbcType jdbcType
    ) throws SQLException {
        PGobject jsonObject = new PGobject();
        jsonObject.setType("jsonb");
        jsonObject.setValue(parameter.toString());
        ps.setObject(i, jsonObject);
    }

    @Override
    public JsonNode getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            String columnName
    ) throws SQLException {
        String value = rs.getString(columnName);
        return parse(value);
    }

    @Override
    public JsonNode getNullableResult(
            ResultSet rs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        String value = rs.getString(columnIndex);
        return parse(value);
    }

    @Override
    public JsonNode getNullableResult(
            CallableStatement cs,
            int columnIndex
    ) throws SQLException {
        String value = cs.getString(columnIndex);
        return parse(value);
    }

    private JsonNode parse(String value) throws SQLException {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return objectMapper.readTree(value);
        } catch (JsonProcessingException exception) {
            throw new SQLException("Invalid JSONB value", exception);
        }
    }
}
```

Mapper XML:

```xml id="0iatjp"
<result property="metadata"
        column="metadata"
        typeHandler="com.company.app.infrastructure.mybatis.typehandler.JsonbTypeHandler"/>
```

Policy:

```text id="4crd87"
[ ] JSONB untuk flexible metadata/projection, bukan core schema liar.
[ ] Key yang sering difilter perlu index strategy.
[ ] Validate JSON shape sebelum persist.
[ ] Jangan expose JSONB mentah sebagai public response tanpa DTO boundary.
```

---

# 20. PostgreSQL Array Mapping

Jika memang perlu array:

```java id="v48dqw"
public record OrderTagRecord(
        UUID orderId,
        List<String> tags
) {}
```

Practical policy:

```text id="gt09bo"
Array DB cocok untuk:
[OK] small tag-like values
[OK] no complex relation metadata

Gunakan table relasi jika:
[NO] perlu query join kompleks
[NO] perlu metadata per item
[NO] perlu referential integrity per item
```

Untuk TypeHandler array, test wajib dengan PostgreSQL nyata karena JDBC driver behavior penting.

---

# 21. Reusable Tenant Filter

Jika multi-tenant, tenant filter harus default, bukan optional.

```xml id="fdpvcm"
<sql id="TenantFilter">
    tenant_id = #{tenantId}
</sql>

<select id="findByIdForTenant" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        <include refid="OrderColumns"/>
    FROM orders
    WHERE <include refid="TenantFilter"/>
      AND id = #{id}
</select>
```

Repository API:

```java id="top4bn"
Optional<Order> findById(TenantId tenantId, UUID orderId);
```

Checklist:

```text id="12jcr7"
[ ] Semua query read/write tenant-scoped menerima tenantId server-derived.
[ ] tenantId tidak diambil dari request body biasa.
[ ] Integration test membuktikan tenant A tidak bisa membaca tenant B.
[ ] Index mempertimbangkan tenant_id + filter utama.
```

---

# 22. Query Design Review Checklist

## 22.1 SQL Shape

```text id="x492ua"
[ ] SELECT column eksplisit, bukan SELECT *.
[ ] WHERE clause memakai indexed/filterable columns.
[ ] ORDER BY deterministic.
[ ] LIMIT selalu ada untuk list.
[ ] OFFSET besar dipertimbangkan.
[ ] JOIN tidak membuat row explosion tidak sadar.
[ ] Query detail dan list dipisah jika shape berbeda.
```

## 22.2 MyBatis Mapping

```text id="m7t6b1"
[ ] Mapper XML namespace match interface.
[ ] Statement id match method.
[ ] Parameter multi-field pakai @Param atau criteria object.
[ ] resultMap eksplisit untuk query penting.
[ ] <id> dipakai di parent/child nested result.
[ ] TypeHandler eksplisit untuk enum/time/jsonb.
[ ] Dynamic SQL semua branch dites.
```

## 22.3 Security

```text id="h3gfls"
[ ] User input value pakai #{...}.
[ ] ${...} hanya dari enum/allow-list server-side.
[ ] Sort field allow-listed.
[ ] Filter field allow-listed.
[ ] IN list dibatasi.
[ ] Tenant filter mandatory.
[ ] SQL error tidak bocor.
```

## 22.4 Performance

```text id="6cizfc"
[ ] Query punya index sesuai filter/sort.
[ ] List endpoint tidak load graph besar.
[ ] N+1 dicegah.
[ ] Batch size dibatasi.
[ ] Statement timeout ada.
[ ] Slow query logging/metrics tersedia.
```

---

# 23. Test Matrix

| Pattern | Test wajib |
|---|---|
| Simple resultMap | Insert row → select → all fields match |
| One-to-one association | Join result maps child correctly |
| One-to-many collection | Parent tidak duplicate, child count benar |
| Nested select | Query count / parent size controlled |
| Batch load children | Empty parent list, multiple parent IDs |
| Search criteria | Each filter branch |
| Dynamic where | No invalid `WHERE AND` |
| Sort allow-list | Invalid sort rejected before SQL |
| Pagination offset | Limit/offset/order deterministic |
| Cursor pagination | Cursor returns next page correctly |
| Batch insert | Multiple rows inserted, rollback on failure |
| Batch update | Affected rows and conflict behavior |
| Function call | Return scalar/table mapped correctly |
| Procedure call | Procedure side effect correct |
| JSONB TypeHandler | Round-trip JSONB |
| Enum TypeHandler | Unknown DB enum handling |
| SQLSTATE translation | 23505/23503/40001 mapped correctly |
| Tenant isolation | Cross-tenant access impossible |

---

# 24. Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| `SELECT *` di mapper XML | Schema drift, field internal kebaca | Explicit columns |
| API DTO langsung dari MyBatis mapper | DB schema bocor ke API | MyBatis record → mapper → response DTO |
| Nested select untuk list besar | N+1 query | Batch load children |
| Join one-to-many untuk pagination parent | Parent duplicate/page kacau | Parent page first, child batch second |
| Raw `${sort}` dari request | SQL injection | Enum allow-list |
| Function/procedure untuk semua business logic | Logic tersembunyi di DB | Service/domain untuk workflow utama |
| Upsert untuk kasus duplicate bisnis | Duplicate tidak jadi 409 | Insert + translate unique violation |
| Dynamic SQL tanpa branch test | Query rusak di kombinasi tertentu | Matrix test per filter |
| Batch tanpa size limit | Transaction besar/timeout | Chunking |
| Error SQL mentah ke client | Security leak | SQLSTATE translator |

---

# 25. Production Checklist

```text id="0z2uas"
Result mapping
[ ] resultMap eksplisit untuk query penting.
[ ] <id> dipakai di resultMap.
[ ] Association/collection dites.
[ ] Tidak ada SELECT *.

Dynamic SQL
[ ] where/set/foreach digunakan benar.
[ ] Semua branch filter dites.
[ ] Sort/filter allow-listed.
[ ] Tidak ada raw user input di ${...}.

Pagination
[ ] Limit maksimum.
[ ] Sort deterministic.
[ ] Cursor pagination dipertimbangkan untuk data besar.
[ ] Index sesuai filter/order.

Batch
[ ] Batch size/chunk size jelas.
[ ] Rollback behavior dites.
[ ] Partial failure behavior jelas.
[ ] ExecutorType.BATCH atau multi-row insert dipilih sadar.

PostgreSQL-specific
[ ] Function/procedure call dites.
[ ] JSONB/array TypeHandler dites.
[ ] SQLSTATE translation ada.
[ ] Transaction behavior procedure dipahami.

Testing
[ ] PostgreSQL Testcontainers integration test.
[ ] Mapper XML load test.
[ ] resultMap test.
[ ] dynamic SQL matrix test.
[ ] SQLSTATE/error mapping test.
```

7/13/2026, 4:21:20 AM

Saya lanjutkan ke production patterns MyBatis + PostgreSQL. Fokusnya operasional: transaksi, isolation, locking, retry deadlock/serialization, timeout, pool, query plan, index-aware SQL, dan observability.

# Cheatsheet - MyBatis PostgreSQL Production Patterns  
## transaction isolation, locking, optimistic/pessimistic lock, deadlock retry, timeout, connection pool, query plan, index-aware SQL, observability

## 1. Introduction

Di production, masalah MyBatis + PostgreSQL biasanya bukan “SQL bisa jalan”, tetapi:

```text id="abzzxo"
transaksi terlalu lama
lock saling tunggu
deadlock
query lambat
index tidak kepakai
connection pool habis
timeout tidak konsisten
retry salah tempat
error DB bocor ke API
observability tidak cukup untuk root cause
```

Untuk aplikasi **Jersey/JAX-RS + MyBatis**, pola production yang sehat adalah:

```text id="s5jyfx"
Jersey Resource
  ↓
Application Service
  ↓
Transaction Boundary
  ↓
Repository
  ↓
MyBatis SqlSession
  ↓
PostgreSQL transaction / lock / query plan
  ↓
Error translation + metrics + logs
```

PostgreSQL documentation menekankan bahwa concurrency control harus dipahami oleh developer aplikasi ketika beberapa session mengakses data yang sama, karena tujuannya menjaga integritas data sambil tetap memberi akses efisien. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/mvcc.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Production Mental Model

```text id="7mueii"
Fast request
  → short transaction
  → bounded locks
  → predictable SQL
  → index-aware query
  → timeout configured
  → retry only when safe
  → metrics/logs/traces available
```

Rule utama:

```text id="mm5rrg"
1. Transaction harus pendek.
2. Lock harus disengaja.
3. Retry hanya untuk error yang memang retryable.
4. Query list harus bounded.
5. Connection pool bukan solusi untuk query lambat.
6. MyBatis XML harus dites dengan PostgreSQL nyata.
7. Observability harus bisa menjawab: query apa, lambat di mana, lock apa, connection pool penuh atau tidak.
```

---

## 3. Decomposition Map

| Area | Skill/domain | Tujuan | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| Transaction isolation | Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable | Konsistensi data saat concurrency | Lost update, serialization failure |
| Transaction boundary | Service-level transaction | Atomic use case | Commit/rollback tidak konsisten |
| Optimistic locking | Version column + affected rows | Detect concurrent update | Last write wins tanpa sadar |
| Pessimistic locking | `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` | Lock row sebelum update | Lock wait/deadlock |
| Deadlock handling | SQLSTATE `40P01` + retry policy | Recovery conflict | Retry non-idempotent operation |
| Serialization retry | SQLSTATE `40001` | Retry serializable conflict | Retry tanpa backoff |
| Timeout | statement/lock/idle timeout | Bound latency | Thread/connection menggantung |
| Connection pool | HikariCP sizing/metrics | Control DB connections | Pool exhaustion |
| Query plan | `EXPLAIN`, `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` | Validate planner choice | Sequential scan tak disadari |
| Index-aware SQL | Align filter/order/index | Fast query | Index tidak kepakai |
| MyBatis statement settings | timeout/fetchSize/resultSetType | Per-query behavior | Semua query pakai default |
| Observability | logs, metrics, traces, pg stats | Root cause production issue | “DB lambat” tanpa bukti |
| Error translation | SQLSTATE → API error | Stable error contract | SQL detail bocor |
| Testing | concurrency + integration | Prove production behavior | Race condition lolos |

---

# 4. Transaction Isolation

PostgreSQL mendukung beberapa isolation level; dokumentasi PostgreSQL menjelaskan behavior transaction isolation dan juga mencatat bahwa aplikasi dengan `Serializable` perlu siap menghadapi retry/rollback pada konflik tertentu. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/transaction-iso.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 4.1 Practical Isolation Table

| Isolation | Kapan dipakai | Catatan production |
|---|---|---|
| Read Committed | Default umum untuk OLTP | Cukup untuk banyak CRUD jika update aman |
| Repeatable Read | Butuh snapshot konsisten dalam transaksi | Bisa tetap butuh retry untuk konflik tertentu |
| Serializable | Butuh hasil setara serial execution | Harus handle `serialization_failure` / retry |
| Read Uncommitted | Di PostgreSQL diperlakukan seperti Read Committed | Jangan andalkan dirty read |

## 4.2 Default Recommendation

```text id="uuice7"
Default:
  Read Committed + optimistic locking + constraints

Naik ke explicit lock:
  jika harus reserve/update resource yang sama secara eksklusif

Naik ke Serializable:
  jika invariant lintas banyak row sulit dijaga dengan constraint/lock biasa
```

Jangan langsung memakai `Serializable` untuk semua transaksi tanpa memahami retry dan dampak contention. Jangan juga memakai explicit lock di semua tempat karena explicit locking dapat meningkatkan risiko deadlock. PostgreSQL documentation menyatakan explicit locking dapat meningkatkan kemungkinan deadlock ketika transaksi saling memegang lock yang dibutuhkan transaksi lain. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/explicit-locking.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 5. Transaction Boundary di MyBatis

## 5.1 Service sebagai owner transaksi

```java id="oojj80"
public final class OrderService {

    private final TransactionManager transactionManager;
    private final OrderRepositoryFactory repositoryFactory;

    public OrderResult cancel(CancelOrderCommand command) {
        return transactionManager.inTransaction(session -> {
            OrderRepository orderRepository =
                    repositoryFactory.create(session);

            Order order = orderRepository.findById(command.orderId())
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new DomainException(
                            "ORDER_NOT_FOUND",
                            "Order was not found",
                            DomainErrorCategory.NOT_FOUND
                    ));

            order.cancel(command.reason());

            orderRepository.update(order);

            return OrderResult.from(order);
        });
    }
}
```

## 5.2 TransactionManager

```java id="f4jrtg"
public final class TransactionManager {

    private final MyBatisSqlSessionFactory sessionFactory;
    private final PersistenceExceptionTranslator exceptionTranslator;

    public <T> T inTransaction(Function<SqlSession, T> callback) {
        try (SqlSession session = sessionFactory.openSession()) {
            try {
                T result = callback.apply(session);
                session.commit();
                return result;
            } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
                session.rollback();
                throw exceptionTranslator.translate(exception);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

MyBatis `SqlSession` menyediakan operasi transaksi seperti `commit`, `rollback`, dan `close`; `SqlSession` dibuat dari `SqlSessionFactory`, sehingga session harus short-lived dan dikelola eksplisit jika tidak memakai framework transaksi seperti Spring. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/java-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Production checklist:

```text id="1q9n1s"
[ ] Transaction dimulai sedekat mungkin dengan SQL pertama.
[ ] Transaction selesai secepat mungkin.
[ ] Tidak ada remote HTTP call di tengah transaction kecuali benar-benar perlu.
[ ] Tidak ada user interaction / long computation di tengah transaction.
[ ] SqlSession tidak dishare antar request/thread.
[ ] Repository tidak commit sendiri jika service mengelola use case.
```

---

# 6. Optimistic Locking Pattern

Optimistic locking cocok untuk update business entity seperti order, case, approval, task, workflow state.

## 6.1 Table

```sql id="xxvj2p"
CREATE TABLE orders (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    order_number text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status text NOT NULL,
    version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

## 6.2 Update SQL

```xml id="8y6lay"
<update id="updateStatus">
    UPDATE orders
    SET
        status = #{status},
        version = version + 1,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = #{id}
      AND version = #{expectedVersion}
</update>
```

## 6.3 Repository

```java id="4m9yvn"
public void updateStatus(
        UUID id,
        OrderStatus status,
        long expectedVersion
) {
    int rows = sqlMapper.updateStatus(id, status, expectedVersion);

    if (rows == 0) {
        throw new PersistenceException(
                "VERSION_CONFLICT",
                "Resource version conflict",
                PersistenceErrorCategory.CONFLICT
        );
    }
}
```

## 6.4 API behavior

```text id="ne20nq"
If version conflict:
  HTTP 409
  code = VERSION_CONFLICT
  client action = refresh resource and retry user action if still valid
```

Use optimistic locking when:

```text id="kcx9i6"
[OK] conflict relatively rare
[OK] user edits resource
[OK] last-write-wins is unacceptable
[OK] update can be retried by user/client
```

Avoid relying only on optimistic locking when:

```text id="5fg0km"
[NO] must reserve scarce resource immediately
[NO] high-contention counter/sequence
[NO] business operation must serialize access
```

---

# 7. Pessimistic Locking Pattern

Pessimistic locking berarti lock row saat dibaca agar transaksi lain tidak bisa update row itu sampai transaksi selesai.

PostgreSQL `SELECT` documentation menyatakan `FOR UPDATE`, `FOR NO KEY UPDATE`, `FOR SHARE`, dan `FOR KEY SHARE` mengunci row terpilih terhadap concurrent updates. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-select.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 7.1 Mapper XML

```xml id="dgvixf"
<select id="findByIdForUpdate" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        version,
        updated_at
    FROM orders
    WHERE id = #{id}
    FOR UPDATE
</select>
```

## 7.2 Service

```java id="vpi39o"
public OrderResult approve(ApproveOrderCommand command) {
    return transactionManager.inTransaction(session -> {
        OrderRepository repository = repositoryFactory.create(session);

        Order order = repository.findByIdForUpdate(command.orderId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new DomainException(
                        "ORDER_NOT_FOUND",
                        "Order was not found",
                        DomainErrorCategory.NOT_FOUND
                ));

        order.approve(command.actorUserId());

        repository.update(order);

        return OrderResult.from(order);
    });
}
```

Use `FOR UPDATE` when:

```text id="n2v27c"
[OK] state transition must serialize on one row
[OK] approve/cancel/claim task workflow
[OK] stock/reservation with strict consistency
[OK] conflict is expected and should wait/fail fast
```

Risiko:

```text id="qbjphk"
[ ] Lock wait.
[ ] Deadlock jika lock order tidak konsisten.
[ ] Long transaction membuat banyak transaksi menunggu.
[ ] Throughput turun pada hotspot row.
```

---

# 8. `NOWAIT` dan `SKIP LOCKED`

## 8.1 Fail fast dengan `NOWAIT`

```xml id="0mntlc"
<select id="findByIdForUpdateNowait" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        version
    FROM orders
    WHERE id = #{id}
    FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
</select>
```

Behavior:

```text id="tmt83b"
Jika row sedang locked:
  fail immediately
  map ke 409 RESOURCE_BUSY atau 423 LOCKED jika policy memakai 423
```

## 8.2 Work queue dengan `SKIP LOCKED`

```xml id="t586wh"
<select id="claimNextPendingJobs" resultMap="JobRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        payload,
        status,
        created_at
    FROM jobs
    WHERE status = 'PENDING'
    ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
    LIMIT #{limit}
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
</select>
```

Use case:

```text id="mvosxz"
[OK] worker queue
[OK] batch processor
[OK] concurrent job claiming
```

Caution:

```text id="9v2pc6"
SKIP LOCKED bagus untuk queue,
tetapi bukan pengganti business consistency biasa.
Row yang locked akan dilewati, sehingga fairness/order murni tidak dijamin sempurna.
```

# 9. Deadlock Prevention

PostgreSQL documentation untuk `LOCK` menyarankan semua transaksi memperoleh lock pada object yang sama dalam urutan yang sama untuk menghindari deadlock; jika beberapa lock mode terlibat, transaksi sebaiknya memperoleh mode paling restriktif lebih dulu. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-lock.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 9.1 Deadlock-prone pattern

```text id="s0jpal"
Transaction A:
  lock order 1
  lock order 2

Transaction B:
  lock order 2
  lock order 1

Potential deadlock.
```

## 9.2 Safer pattern

```java id="5ms1di"
List<UUID> sortedIds = orderIds.stream()
        .sorted()
        .toList();

for (UUID id : sortedIds) {
    repository.findByIdForUpdate(id);
}
```

SQL:

```xml id="m5otip"
<select id="findByIdsForUpdate" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        version
    FROM orders
    WHERE id IN
    <foreach collection="ids"
             item="id"
             open="("
             separator=","
             close=")">
        #{id}
    </foreach>
    ORDER BY id
    FOR UPDATE
</select>
```

Deadlock prevention checklist:

```text id="th6szj"
[ ] Lock objects in deterministic order.
[ ] Keep transaction short.
[ ] Avoid user/external call inside transaction.
[ ] Avoid locking more rows than needed.
[ ] Use appropriate index so SELECT FOR UPDATE finds rows directly.
[ ] Use lock_timeout if fail-fast is desired.
[ ] Retry only safe operations.
```

---

# 10. Retry Strategy untuk Deadlock dan Serialization Failure

PostgreSQL error code appendix mencantumkan SQLSTATE `40001` sebagai `serialization_failure` dan `40P01` sebagai `deadlock_detected`. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/errcodes-appendix.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 10.1 Retryable SQLSTATE

| SQLSTATE | Meaning | Retry? |
|---|---|---|
| `40001` | serialization_failure | Ya, jika operation idempotent/safe |
| `40P01` | deadlock_detected | Ya, biasanya safe jika transaction atomic |
| `57014` | query_canceled | Tergantung penyebab timeout/cancel |
| `23505` | unique_violation | Biasanya tidak retry; map ke conflict |
| `23503` | foreign_key_violation | Biasanya tidak retry; fix request/state |

## 10.2 Transaction retry wrapper

```java id="7sb1ha"
public final class RetryingTransactionManager {

    private final TransactionManager transactionManager;

    public <T> T inRetryableTransaction(Supplier<T> operation) {
        int maxAttempts = 3;

        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
            try {
                return transactionManager.inTransaction(session ->
                        operation.get()
                );
            } catch (PersistenceException exception) {
                if (!isRetryable(exception) || attempt == maxAttempts) {
                    throw exception;
                }

                sleepBackoff(attempt);
            }
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException("unreachable");
    }

    private boolean isRetryable(PersistenceException exception) {
        return exception.category() == PersistenceErrorCategory.RETRYABLE_CONFLICT;
    }

    private void sleepBackoff(int attempt) {
        try {
            long millis = 50L * attempt * attempt;
            Thread.sleep(millis);
        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new RuntimeException("Retry interrupted", exception);
        }
    }
}
```

## 10.3 Retry safety checklist

```text id="pb5qeg"
[ ] Operation idempotent atau punya idempotency key.
[ ] Transaction tidak mengirim email/event eksternal sebelum commit.
[ ] Side effect eksternal memakai outbox pattern.
[ ] Retry punya max attempts.
[ ] Retry punya jitter/backoff.
[ ] Retry metrics dicatat.
[ ] Final failure mapped ke 409/503 sesuai policy.
```

Jangan retry operasi yang sudah melakukan side-effect eksternal di tengah transaksi tanpa outbox/idempotency. Retry bisa menggandakan event/email/payment call.

---

# 11. Timeout Strategy

Timeout harus berlapis:

```text id="69d3bn"
HTTP client timeout
  ↓
Jersey server request timeout / async timeout
  ↓
connection pool acquisition timeout
  ↓
PostgreSQL lock_timeout
  ↓
PostgreSQL statement_timeout
  ↓
MyBatis statement timeout
```

PostgreSQL runtime config menyediakan timeout seperti `statement_timeout`, `lock_timeout`, dan `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout`; transaction isolation docs juga mengingatkan agar koneksi tidak dibiarkan “idle in transaction” terlalu lama dan menyebut `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout` sebagai guard. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/transaction-iso.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 11.1 PostgreSQL session-level setting

Set saat connection dibuat, misalnya via Hikari `connectionInitSql`:

```text id="86g88j"
SET statement_timeout = '5s';
SET lock_timeout = '1s';
SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '30s';
```

Atau per transaction:

```xml id="g177zi"
<update id="setLocalTimeouts">
    SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5s';
    SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '1s';
</update>
```

`SET LOCAL` hanya berlaku dalam transaksi saat ini.

## 11.2 MyBatis statement timeout

```xml id="4sx7ob"
<select id="searchOrders"
        resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap"
        timeout="5"
        fetchSize="100">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status
    FROM orders
    WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
    ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT #{limit}
</select>
```

MyBatis mapper XML menyediakan attribute `timeout` yang mengatur jumlah detik driver menunggu database mengembalikan request sebelum error, dan `fetchSize` sebagai hint untuk driver mengambil row dalam batch tertentu. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Timeout policy:

| Query type | Suggested timeout thinking |
|---|---|
| OLTP create/update | pendek, misalnya 1-5s |
| Search/list UI | pendek-menengah, misalnya 2-10s |
| Export/report | async job, bukan request sync panjang |
| Batch job | timeout lebih panjang tapi isolated |
| Lock wait | pendek jika user-facing |
| Worker queue | pendek + retry/backoff |

---

# 12. Connection Pool Pattern

HikariCP adalah pool umum di Java. HikariCP documentation menjelaskan setting seperti `connectionTimeout`, `idleTimeout`, `maxLifetime`, `keepaliveTime`, dan `maximumPoolSize`; `connectionTimeout` adalah waktu maksimum client menunggu connection dari pool. ([GitHub](https://github.com/brettwooldridge/hikaricp?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 12.1 Hikari config example

```java id="yjbf7r"
public DataSource dataSource(AppDatabaseConfig config) {
    HikariConfig hikari = new HikariConfig();

    hikari.setJdbcUrl(config.jdbcUrl());
    hikari.setUsername(config.username());
    hikari.setPassword(config.password());

    hikari.setMaximumPoolSize(20);
    hikari.setMinimumIdle(5);

    hikari.setConnectionTimeout(2_000);
    hikari.setValidationTimeout(1_000);
    hikari.setIdleTimeout(60_000);
    hikari.setMaxLifetime(1_800_000);

    hikari.setPoolName("order-service-pool");

    hikari.setConnectionInitSql("""
            SET statement_timeout = '5s';
            SET lock_timeout = '1s';
            SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '30s'
            """);

    return new HikariDataSource(hikari);
}
```

## 12.2 Pool sizing mental model

```text id="ul2x5u"
More pool connections ≠ faster system.

Jika DB CPU/IO sudah saturasi,
menambah pool justru menambah concurrency, lock contention, dan latency.
```

Checklist:

```text id="pv9160"
[ ] maximumPoolSize disesuaikan dengan DB max_connections dan jumlah pod/instance.
[ ] connectionTimeout pendek agar pool exhaustion cepat terlihat.
[ ] pool metrics diexpose.
[ ] maxLifetime lebih pendek dari timeout network/LB jika ada.
[ ] Tidak membuat DataSource/SqlSessionFactory per request.
[ ] Long-running report tidak memakai pool OLTP utama jika bisa dipisah.
```

---

# 13. Query Plan & EXPLAIN

PostgreSQL membuat query plan untuk setiap query, dan dokumentasi PostgreSQL menyatakan pemilihan plan yang cocok dengan struktur query dan property data sangat penting untuk performa; `EXPLAIN` memperlihatkan plan yang dibuat planner. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/using-explain.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 13.1 Basic EXPLAIN

```sql id="5uzjab"
EXPLAIN
SELECT
    id,
    order_number,
    status
FROM orders
WHERE tenant_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
  AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

## 13.2 EXPLAIN ANALYZE

```sql id="80n14k"
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT
    id,
    order_number,
    status
FROM orders
WHERE tenant_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
  AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

`EXPLAIN ANALYZE` benar-benar menjalankan statement dan menambahkan statistik runtime aktual, termasuk waktu dan row aktual per plan node; karena benar-benar dieksekusi, hati-hati saat digunakan pada `INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE` tanpa transaksi rollback. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-explain.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 13.3 What to inspect

```text id="wkm9xu"
[ ] Seq Scan vs Index Scan.
[ ] Estimated rows vs actual rows.
[ ] Sort method dan memory.
[ ] Buffers hit/read.
[ ] Nested Loop besar yang tidak diharapkan.
[ ] Filter rows removed.
[ ] Index condition vs filter condition.
[ ] Planning time vs execution time.
```

PostgreSQL documentation juga menyarankan menjalankan `ANALYZE` saat memeriksa index usage karena planner membutuhkan statistik distribusi data untuk membuat estimasi realistis. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/indexes-examine.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 14. Index-Aware SQL

## 14.1 List query

Query:

```sql id="zf3mc5"
SELECT
    id,
    order_number,
    status,
    submitted_at
FROM orders
WHERE tenant_id = ?
  AND status = ?
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT ?;
```

Index kandidat:

```sql id="g4fg77"
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_tenant_status_submitted_id
ON orders (
    tenant_id,
    status,
    submitted_at DESC,
    id DESC
);
```

## 14.2 Cursor pagination

Query:

```sql id="0q9hjf"
SELECT
    id,
    order_number,
    status,
    submitted_at
FROM orders
WHERE tenant_id = ?
  AND (
        submitted_at < ?
        OR (submitted_at = ? AND id < ?)
      )
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT ?;
```

Index kandidat:

```sql id="47uf8p"
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_tenant_submitted_id
ON orders (
    tenant_id,
    submitted_at DESC,
    id DESC
);
```

## 14.3 Index review checklist

```text id="4nvlf5"
[ ] Equality filters biasanya diletakkan di depan composite index.
[ ] Sort columns masuk index jika query sering ORDER BY + LIMIT.
[ ] Tie-breaker id dipakai untuk deterministic pagination.
[ ] Partial index dipertimbangkan untuk status tertentu.
[ ] Jangan membuat index untuk semua kombinasi filter tanpa bukti.
[ ] EXPLAIN membuktikan index membantu.
[ ] ANALYZE/statistics up-to-date.
```

# 15. MyBatis Query Configuration

## 15.1 Per-statement timeout/fetch size

```xml id="o6bg3d"
<select id="streamLargeExport"
        resultMap="OrderExportResultMap"
        fetchSize="500"
        timeout="60">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        submitted_at
    FROM orders
    WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
    ORDER BY submitted_at ASC, id ASC
</select>
```

## 15.2 Local cache scope

MyBatis `SqlSession` memiliki local cache; dokumentasi MyBatis menyebut local cache dibuat per session dan dibersihkan pada `update`, `commit`, `rollback`, dan `close`. ([MyBatis](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/java-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Production implication:

```text id="9yvx9p"
[ ] Session panjang bisa menyimpan banyak object di local cache.
[ ] Untuk batch/stream besar, hindari session terlalu panjang.
[ ] Pertimbangkan localCacheScope=STATEMENT untuk use case tertentu.
[ ] Jangan memakai satu SqlSession untuk request panjang/stream besar tanpa strategi memori.
```

# 17. Observability: PostgreSQL Side

PostgreSQL `pg_stat_statements` extension menyediakan tracking statistik planning dan execution untuk SQL statements yang dijalankan server. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/pgstatstatements.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) PostgreSQL cumulative statistics system juga mengumpulkan informasi aktivitas server seperti akses tabel/index, row count, vacuum/analyze, dan function timing jika diaktifkan. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/monitoring-stats.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 17.1 Useful views/tools

| Tool/view | Use |
|---|---|
| `pg_stat_activity` | Active queries, wait events, idle in transaction |
| `pg_locks` | Lock state and waiters |
| `pg_stat_statements` | Top queries by total time/calls/mean time |
| `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` | Query plan reality check |
| `auto_explain` | Log slow query plans automatically |
| PostgreSQL logs | timeout/deadlock/error diagnosis |

`pg_locks` memberikan akses ke informasi lock yang dipegang active processes dalam server database. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/view-pg-locks.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) `auto_explain` dapat log execution plans untuk query lambat; option `auto_explain.log_analyze` membuat output berupa `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`, tetapi ada overhead dan beberapa setting hanya superuser. ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/auto-explain.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 17.2 Diagnostic queries

Active long queries:

```sql id="oy89s7"
SELECT
    pid,
    usename,
    application_name,
    state,
    wait_event_type,
    wait_event,
    now() - query_start AS query_age,
    query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle'
ORDER BY query_age DESC;
```

Locks waiting:

```sql id="2volz9"
SELECT
    pid,
    locktype,
    relation::regclass,
    mode,
    granted
FROM pg_locks
ORDER BY granted, pid;
```

Top slow statements:

```sql id="vkw8ov"
SELECT
    query,
    calls,
    total_exec_time,
    mean_exec_time,
    rows
FROM pg_stat_statements
ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

---

# 18. Error Translation Matrix

PostgreSQL SQLSTATE harus diterjemahkan menjadi API error stabil. PostgreSQL documentation menyatakan aplikasi sebaiknya mengecek error code, bukan textual error message, karena error code lebih stabil dan tidak dipengaruhi lokalisasi. ([PostgreSQL](https://postgresql.kr/docs/8.3/errcodes-appendix.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| SQLSTATE | PostgreSQL condition | Retry? | API HTTP | API code |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `23505` | unique_violation | No | 409 | `DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` |
| `23503` | foreign_key_violation | No | 409/422 | `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| `23514` | check_violation | No | 409/422 | `CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION` |
| `40001` | serialization_failure | Yes | retry then 409/503 | `CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION` |
| `40P01` | deadlock_detected | Yes | retry then 409/503 | `DEADLOCK_RETRY_EXHAUSTED` |
| `57014` | query_canceled | Depends | 504/503 | `QUERY_TIMEOUT` |
| `08006` | connection_failure | Yes maybe | 503 | `DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE` |

Translator skeleton:

```java id="8bhu2i"
private RuntimeException translateSqlException(
        SQLException sqlException,
        RuntimeException original
) {
    return switch (sqlException.getSQLState()) {
        case "23505" -> conflict(
                "DUPLICATE_RESOURCE",
                "Resource already exists",
                original
        );
        case "23503" -> conflict(
                "REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND",
                "Referenced resource was not found",
                original
        );
        case "23514" -> conflict(
                "CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION",
                "Persistence constraint was violated",
                original
        );
        case "40001", "40P01" -> retryable(
                "CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION",
                "Resource was modified concurrently",
                original
        );
        case "57014" -> timeout(
                "QUERY_TIMEOUT",
                "Database query timed out",
                original
        );
        default -> unknown(original);
    };
}
```

# 19. Query Pattern Review

## 19.1 Search/list endpoint

```xml id="b2u8lb"
<select id="searchOrders"
        resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap"
        timeout="5"
        fetchSize="100">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        submitted_at
    FROM orders
    <where>
        tenant_id = #{tenantId}

        <if test="status != null">
            AND status = #{status}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedFrom != null">
            AND submitted_at &gt;= #{submittedFrom}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedTo != null">
            AND submitted_at &lt; #{submittedTo}
        </if>
    </where>
    ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT #{limit}
</select>
```

Checklist:

```text id="yk32aq"
[ ] tenant_id mandatory.
[ ] LIMIT mandatory.
[ ] ORDER BY deterministic.
[ ] Index supports WHERE + ORDER BY.
[ ] No raw user input in ${}.
[ ] Timeout set.
[ ] Test with realistic row count.
```

## 19.2 State transition endpoint

```xml id="mh7bb2"
<select id="findByIdForUpdate" resultMap="OrderRecordResultMap">
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        version
    FROM orders
    WHERE id = #{id}
    FOR UPDATE
</select>
```

Checklist:

```text id="2ojg0j"
[ ] Lock only needed row.
[ ] Transaction short.
[ ] Domain transition after row locked.
[ ] Deadlock prevention order documented.
[ ] lock_timeout configured.
[ ] SQLSTATE 40P01 handled.
```

---

# 20. Concurrency Test Patterns

## 20.1 Optimistic conflict test

```java id="v42wun"
@Test
void shouldRejectConcurrentUpdateWithStaleVersion() {
    UUID id = insertOrderWithVersion(1L);

    int first = mapper.updateStatus(id, OrderStatus.APPROVED, 1L);
    int second = mapper.updateStatus(id, OrderStatus.CANCELLED, 1L);

    assertEquals(1, first);
    assertEquals(0, second);
}
```

## 20.2 Pessimistic lock test concept

```java id="zhhunj"
@Test
void shouldFailFastWhenRowIsLockedWithNowait() throws Exception {
    UUID id = insertOrder();

    CountDownLatch locked = new CountDownLatch(1);
    CountDownLatch release = new CountDownLatch(1);

    Future<?> tx1 = executor.submit(() -> {
        transactionManager.inTransaction(session -> {
            mapper(session).findByIdForUpdate(id);
            locked.countDown();
            await(release);
            return null;
        });
    });

    locked.await();

    assertThrows(PersistenceException.class, () -> {
        transactionManager.inTransaction(session -> {
            mapper(session).findByIdForUpdateNowait(id);
            return null;
        });
    });

    release.countDown();
    tx1.get();
}
```

## 20.3 Retry test

```text id="w48xu3"
[ ] Simulate retryable PersistenceException.
[ ] Assert operation retried max N times.
[ ] Assert backoff called.
[ ] Assert non-retryable error not retried.
[ ] Assert external side effect not duplicated.
```

---

# 21. Production Incident Playbook

## Symptom: API latency naik

Check:

```text id="uug3wn"
[ ] Hikari pending threads naik?
[ ] Active connections penuh?
[ ] PostgreSQL CPU/IO tinggi?
[ ] pg_stat_activity banyak query active?
[ ] wait_event lock atau IO?
[ ] pg_stat_statements top query berubah?
[ ] recent deployment ubah SQL/index?
```

## Symptom: banyak 409 conflict

Check:

```text id="7vcsyb"
[ ] Optimistic lock conflict normal atau spike?
[ ] User/client retry storm?
[ ] Hotspot resource?
[ ] State transition terlalu sering ke row sama?
[ ] Need queue/serialization/work partition?
```

## Symptom: deadlock

Check:

```text id="41v09f"
[ ] Query/transaction mana lock object beda urutan?
[ ] Batch update lock order deterministic?
[ ] Foreign key/index menyebabkan lock tambahan?
[ ] Transaction terlalu panjang?
[ ] Retry policy ada?
```

## Symptom: pool exhausted

Check:

```text id="54drxk"
[ ] Query lambat menahan connection?
[ ] Transaction idle?
[ ] Connection leak?
[ ] Pool terlalu kecil atau pods terlalu banyak?
[ ] DB max_connections?
[ ] Report/export memakai pool OLTP?
```

---

# 22. Production Checklist

```text id="tf9vnx"
Transaction
[ ] Service-level transaction boundary.
[ ] Transaction pendek.
[ ] No external remote call inside DB transaction.
[ ] SqlSession short-lived.
[ ] idle_in_transaction timeout configured.

Locking
[ ] Optimistic locking for normal entity updates.
[ ] Pessimistic locking only when needed.
[ ] Lock order deterministic.
[ ] lock_timeout configured.
[ ] Deadlock/serialization retry policy defined.

Timeout
[ ] MyBatis statement timeout for important queries.
[ ] PostgreSQL statement_timeout configured.
[ ] PostgreSQL lock_timeout configured.
[ ] Connection acquisition timeout configured.
[ ] Long jobs moved to async path.

Pool
[ ] Hikari maximumPoolSize reviewed against DB capacity.
[ ] Pool metrics exposed.
[ ] No DataSource per request.
[ ] Long-running jobs isolated where possible.

Query performance
[ ] No SELECT * in production mappers.
[ ] List queries have LIMIT.
[ ] Sort deterministic.
[ ] EXPLAIN checked for critical queries.
[ ] ANALYZE/statistics considered.
[ ] Index aligns with filter/order.
[ ] pg_stat_statements enabled if allowed.

Error handling
[ ] SQLSTATE translated.
[ ] Retryable errors separated from non-retryable.
[ ] No raw SQL/DB detail in API response.
[ ] Correlation ID in logs and errors.

Testing
[ ] PostgreSQL integration tests.
[ ] Optimistic conflict test.
[ ] Pessimistic lock / NOWAIT test if used.
[ ] Transaction rollback test.
[ ] Timeout/retry tests.
[ ] Query plan review for critical queries.
```

---

# 23. Anti-Pattern

| Anti-pattern | Dampak | Alternatif |
|---|---|---|
| Menambah pool saat query lambat | DB makin saturasi | Fix query/index/transaction |
| Transaction mengandung HTTP call | Lock lama, pool habis | Outbox / call outside transaction |
| `SELECT FOR UPDATE` di semua read | Contention tinggi | Optimistic lock/read normal |
| Retry semua exception DB | Duplicate side effect | Retry only SQLSTATE tertentu |
| No lock order | Deadlock | Deterministic ordering |
| Offset pagination untuk data besar | Slow page | Cursor/keyset pagination |
| No statement timeout | Thread/connection stuck | Timeout berlapis |
| SQL error mentah ke client | Security leak | SQLSTATE translator |
| No pg_stat_statements | Sulit cari slow query | Enable extension jika allowed |
| `SELECT *` | Schema drift | Explicit columns/resultMap |

# Cheatsheet - MyBatis PostgreSQL Migration & Schema Governance  
## Flyway/Liquibase, mapper XML compatibility, resultMap drift, safe column changes, enum/status migration, index rollout, backfill, rollback strategy, contract testing

## 1. Introduction

Dalam stack **Jersey/JAX-RS + MyBatis + PostgreSQL**, migration bukan hanya urusan database. Setiap perubahan schema bisa berdampak ke:

```text id="0yiyqk"
Mapper XML
resultMap
TypeHandler
Repository
Domain object
MapStruct mapper
Response DTO
OpenAPI contract
Backward compatibility
```

Karena MyBatis memakai SQL eksplisit, perubahan column/table/index/function harus direview bersama mapper XML. MyBatis sendiri menempatkan `resultMap` sebagai elemen paling penting dan kuat untuk mapping `ResultSet` ke object; artinya perubahan schema sangat mungkin berdampak langsung pada `resultMap`. ([mybatis.org](https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Untuk tooling migration, dua pilihan umum:

| Tool | Model utama | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| **Flyway** | Versioned SQL migrations, repeatable migrations | SQL-first, PostgreSQL-heavy, simple governance |
| **Liquibase** | Changeset dengan metadata, rollback/precondition/context/label | Governance enterprise, multi-env control, rollback metadata |

Flyway mendeskripsikan database changes sebagai migrations; migrations bisa versioned atau repeatable. ([github.com](https://github.com/flyway/flywaydb.org/blob/gh-pages/documentation/concepts/migrations.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) Liquibase menggunakan **changeset** yang diidentifikasi oleh kombinasi `author`, `id`, dan changelog file path; changeset juga bisa memakai preconditions, contexts, labels, dan atribut lain untuk mengontrol kapan dijalankan. ([docs.liquibase.com](https://docs.liquibase.com/secure/user-guide-5-1/what-is-a-changeset?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

```text id="i10kcw"
│                                                              │
│  V20260713_001__add_order_priority.sql                       │
│  or Liquibase changeset                                      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         MyBatis Layer                         │
│                                                              │
│  Mapper XML                                                  │
│  resultMap                                                   │
│  TypeHandler                                                 │

└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Java Application Layer                     │
│                                                              │
│  Repository record                                           │
│  Domain model                                                │

└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       API Contract Layer                      │
│                                                              │
│  DTO                                                         │
│  Validation                                                  │
│  OpenAPI schema                                              │

│  Contract tests                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
