# 5. PR Review Checklist

## 5.1 API / DTO

```text
[ ] Request DTO and Response DTO are explicit.
[ ] Persistence record is not exposed as API response.
[ ] Domain object is not serialized directly.
[ ] Bean Validation exists for required fields.
[ ] Nested DTO uses @Valid.
[ ] Collection item validation exists.
[ ] Nullability semantics are clear.
[ ] Patch semantics distinguish absent/null/value if needed.
[ ] Response does not expose internal DB fields.
[ ] OpenAPI/golden files updated if contract changes.
```

---

## 5.2 Service / Domain

```text
[ ] Application service owns transaction boundary.
[ ] Business invariant lives in domain, not mapper XML.
[ ] Authorization/object-level permission is checked.
[ ] No external HTTP/broker call inside DB transaction.
[ ] Domain event is created from committed business fact, not raw request.
[ ] Domain has explicit create/rehydrate/state-transition methods.
[ ] Domain does not import JAX-RS, MyBatis, JDBC, or Jackson.
```

---

## 5.3 Repository

```text
[ ] Repository interface uses domain language.
[ ] Repository methods require tenant/security context where needed.
[ ] Repository hides MyBatis mapper from service layer.
[ ] Repository uses same SqlSession from service transaction.
[ ] Repository does not commit/rollback independently.
[ ] Persistence exceptions are translated.
[ ] Update/delete methods check affected rows where needed.
[ ] findByIdForUpdate only used inside transaction.
```

---

## 5.4 MyBatis Mapper XML

```text
[ ] Mapper namespace matches Java mapper interface.
[ ] Statement id matches mapper method.
[ ] SELECT columns are explicit, not SELECT *.
[ ] resultMap is explicit for important queries.
[ ] TypeHandler is specified for enum/time/jsonb/array/range.
[ ] tenant_id filter exists for tenant-scoped read/write.
[ ] List/search queries have LIMIT.
[ ] ORDER BY is deterministic.
[ ] Dynamic SQL branches are tested.
[ ] #{} used for all values.
[ ] ${} appears only for server-side allow-listed SQL fragments.
[ ] Mapper XML load test exists.
```

---

## 5.5 PostgreSQL Migration

```text
[ ] Migration is committed and ordered.
[ ] Migration applies from empty database.
[ ] Migration applies from previous version.
[ ] Large table operation is staged/batched.
[ ] Add NOT NULL follows add nullable → backfill → enforce.
[ ] Rename/drop uses expand-contract pattern.
[ ] Index rollout is safe for table size.
[ ] Function/procedure signature compatibility reviewed.
[ ] MyBatis resultMap and SQL updated with schema change.
[ ] Rollback/forward-fix strategy documented.
```

---

## 5.6 Security

```text
[ ] No user input enters ${}.
[ ] Sort/filter fields are allow-listed.
[ ] tenantId is server-derived.
[ ] Read/update/delete are tenant-scoped.
[ ] Cross-tenant tests exist.
[ ] DB runtime role is least privilege.
[ ] SQL error details are not returned to client.
[ ] Logs do not expose secrets/PII/raw sensitive SQL params.
[ ] RLS considered for high-risk multi-tenant data.
```

---

## 5.7 Performance

```text
[ ] Critical query has EXPLAIN reviewed.
[ ] Index matches WHERE + ORDER BY.
[ ] Projection used for list/search.
[ ] Full aggregate not loaded for summary list.
[ ] N+1 avoided.
[ ] Page size is bounded.
[ ] Cursor pagination considered for large/high-churn data.
[ ] Batch operation has chunk size.
[ ] Transaction is short.
[ ] Query timeout/statement timeout considered.
```

---

## 5.8 Testing

```text
[ ] Domain unit test exists.
[ ] Persistence mapper test exists.
[ ] Mapper XML load test exists.
[ ] resultMap test exists.
[ ] TypeHandler round-trip test exists if relevant.
[ ] Repository integration test uses PostgreSQL.
[ ] Migration test runs in CI.
[ ] Rollback test exists for multi-table write.
[ ] SQLSTATE translation test exists.
[ ] Tenant isolation test exists.
[ ] Jersey contract/error response test exists.
[ ] Outbox commit/rollback/claim test exists if events are involved.
```

# 6. Production Readiness Checklist

## 6.1 Runtime

```text
[ ] SqlSessionFactory is singleton.
[ ] SqlSession is short-lived.
[ ] SqlSession is not shared across threads.
[ ] TransactionManager uses try-with-resources.
[ ] Commit/rollback/close are guaranteed.
[ ] HikariCP pool configured intentionally.
[ ] Connection timeout is not too long.
[ ] Statement timeout exists for important queries.
[ ] lock_timeout considered for user-facing locks.
[ ] idle_in_transaction timeout configured if possible.
```

---

## 6.2 Database

```text
[ ] Primary keys and foreign keys exist.
[ ] Unique constraints enforce business uniqueness.
[ ] Check constraints enforce simple DB invariants.
[ ] Indexes support hot queries.
[ ] No redundant/excessive indexes without reason.
[ ] pg_stat_statements available if allowed.
[ ] Slow query diagnostics documented.
[ ] Backfill/cleanup jobs are batched.
[ ] Outbox table has pending/cleanup indexes.
```

---

## 6.3 Observability

```text
[ ] X-Correlation-Id supported.
[ ] MDC setup and cleanup implemented.
[ ] ApiErrorResponse includes correlationId.
[ ] Repository duration metrics exist.
[ ] DB error metrics by SQLSTATE exist.
[ ] HikariCP metrics exposed.
[ ] Outbox pending/failed/oldest age metrics exist.
[ ] Slow query logs include mapper method and duration.
[ ] Logs do not include secrets/PII by default.
[ ] Incident playbook exists.
```

---

## 6.4 Resilience

```text
[ ] SQLSTATE 40001/40P01 retry strategy defined if needed.
[ ] Retry only for idempotent/safe operations.
[ ] External publishing uses outbox.
[ ] Consumers are idempotent.
[ ] Failed outbox events can be requeued manually.
[ ] Stuck PROCESSING outbox events can be reset.
[ ] Query timeout maps to stable API error.
[ ] Pool exhaustion behavior is observable.
```

# 7. Test Matrix

| Layer | Test |
|---|---|
| Domain | Invariant, state transition, domain event |
| API Mapper | Request DTO → Command, Result → Response |
| Persistence Mapper | Domain ↔ Record |
| Migration | From empty DB, from previous version |
| MyBatis Config | `SqlSessionFactory` builds, mapper proxy loads |
| Mapper XML | Statement smoke test |
| resultMap | Fixture row → Java record |
| TypeHandler | enum/time/jsonb/array/range round-trip |
| Repository | save/load/update/search |
| Transaction | rollback, optimistic conflict |
| Constraint | unique/FK/check/exclusion SQLSTATE |
| Security | tenant isolation, unsafe sort rejected |
| Performance | query branch test, optional EXPLAIN review |
| Outbox | commit/rollback, claim, retry, stuck reset |
| Jersey | success response, validation error, domain error |
| Error Contract | stable `code`, `message`, `correlationId`, `errors` |
| Observability | correlation ID echoed, SQLSTATE metric/log |
| Contract | golden JSON, OpenAPI example-as-test |

---

# 8. Common Failure Modes

| Symptom | Likely cause | Where to check |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime “statement not found” | Mapper XML id/namespace mismatch | Mapper XML load test |
| Field null after query | resultMap column alias mismatch | resultMap test |
| Enum mapping crash | DB value not in Java enum | TypeHandler + migration |
| Timestamp shifted | timezone mapping wrong | Instant TypeHandler test |
| Duplicate returns 500 | SQLSTATE not translated | PersistenceExceptionTranslator |
| Tenant data leak | missing tenant filter | mapper XML + tenant tests |
| Slow list endpoint | no index / full aggregate / offset large | EXPLAIN + query review |
| Pool exhaustion | long query/transaction/leak | Hikari metrics + pg_stat_activity |
| Deadlock | inconsistent lock order | pg_locks + SQLSTATE 40P01 |
| Outbox pending grows | worker/broker/index/retry issue | outbox metrics |
| Duplicate event consumed | at-least-once delivery | consumer idempotency |
| App rollback fails | destructive migration too early | expand-contract review |
| API contract changed silently | DTO/golden/OpenAPI drift | contract tests |
| Unknown field accepted unexpectedly | ObjectMapper policy not strict | serialization tests |
| Patch clears wrong field | absent/null/value semantics unclear | patch tests |

# 9. Incident Playbook

## 9.1 API latency spike

```text
1. Check affected endpoint.
2. Grab correlation IDs.
3. Check repository duration metrics.
4. Check Hikari active/idle/pending.
5. Check pg_stat_activity for active queries.
6. Check wait_event: lock, IO, client, etc.
7. Check pg_stat_statements top total/mean time.
8. Run EXPLAIN for suspected query.
9. Review recent deployment/migration/index changes.
10. Add regression test after mitigation.
```

---

## 9.2 Pool exhaustion

```text
1. Check Hikari pending threads.
2. Check active connections near max.
3. Check connection acquisition timeout count.
4. Find long-running queries.
5. Find idle in transaction.
6. Check SqlSession close/transaction cleanup.
7. Check external call inside transaction.
8. Do not blindly increase pool.
9. Fix query/transaction first.
```

---

## 9.3 Deadlock / lock wait

```text
1. Check SQLSTATE 40P01 or lock timeout.
2. Use pg_locks + pg_stat_activity.
3. Identify blocked and blocking query.
4. Check transaction duration.
5. Check lock order consistency.
6. Check missing index causing too many rows locked.
7. Add deterministic lock order.
8. Add retry only if operation is safe.
```

---

## 9.4 Data leak suspicion

```text
1. Identify request/correlationId/user/tenant.
2. Check resource/service tenant resolution.
3. Check repository method signature includes TenantId.
4. Check mapper WHERE tenant_id.
5. Check list/count/export query too.
6. Check use of ${}.
7. Add failing cross-tenant test.
8. Consider RLS for defense-in-depth.
```

---

## 9.5 Outbox stuck

```text
1. Count PENDING/PROCESSING/FAILED.
2. Check oldest pending age.
3. Check worker running.
4. Check broker connectivity/auth.
5. Check last_error.
6. Reset stuck PROCESSING if worker crashed.
7. Requeue FAILED after fix if safe.
8. Verify consumer idempotency.
```

---

# 10. SQLSTATE Reference

| SQLSTATE | Meaning | Typical API mapping |
|---|---|---|
| `23505` | unique violation | `409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE` |
| `23503` | foreign key violation | `409/422 REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| `23514` | check violation | `409/422 CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION` |
| `40001` | serialization failure | retry then `409/503` |
| `40P01` | deadlock detected | retry then `409/503` |
| `57014` | query canceled / timeout | `504 QUERY_TIMEOUT` |
| `42501` | insufficient privilege | `403/500 DATABASE_PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| `08006` | connection failure | `503 DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE` |

Rule:

```text
Do not parse SQL error message text.
Use SQLSTATE.
Return stable public error code.
Log internal diagnostic with correlationId.
```

---

# 11. Mapper XML Quick Review

```xml
<select id="searchOrders" resultMap="OrderSummaryResultMap" timeout="5">
    SELECT
        id,
        order_number,
        status,
        total_amount,
        currency,
        submitted_at
    FROM orders
    <where>
        tenant_id = #{tenantId}

        <if test="status != null">
            AND status = #{status}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedFrom != null">
            AND submitted_at &gt;= #{submittedFrom}
        </if>

        <if test="submittedTo != null">
            AND submitted_at &lt; #{submittedTo}
        </if>
    </where>
    ORDER BY ${sortColumn} ${sortDirection}, id DESC
    LIMIT #{limit}
</select>
```

Checklist for this query:

```text
[ ] sortColumn comes from enum allow-list.
[ ] sortDirection comes from enum ASC/DESC.
[ ] tenantId comes from authenticated context.
[ ] limit is bounded by validation.
[ ] index exists for tenant/status/submitted_at/id if hot path.
[ ] all value inputs use #{}.
[ ] no full aggregate loaded for list response.
```

# 12. Migration Safety Patterns

## 12.1 Add required column safely

```text
1. Add nullable column.
2. Deploy app that writes it.
3. Backfill old rows.
4. Validate no null remains.
5. Add NOT NULL.
6. Update mapper/resultMap/tests.
```

## 12.2 Rename column safely

```text
1. Add new column.
2. Backfill from old column.
3. Dual write old + new.
4. Dual read or read new fallback old.
5. Switch app to new field.
6. Remove old field later after rollback window.
```

## 12.3 Drop column safely

```text
1. Stop reading column.
2. Stop writing column.
3. Deploy and observe.
4. Confirm no mapper/XML/function/view/reference.
5. Drop in later release.
```

---

# 13. Outbox Checklist

```text
[ ] Outbox row written in same transaction as business data.
[ ] Event has id, type, version, aggregateId, eventKey.
[ ] Payload schema documented.
[ ] Publish happens after commit.
[ ] Worker claim uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
[ ] Worker does not hold DB lock while publishing.
[ ] Mark PUBLISHED only after broker confirmation.
[ ] Retry uses backoff and max count.
[ ] FAILED events visible and requeueable.
[ ] Consumers dedupe by eventId.
[ ] Cleanup retention defined.
```

---

# 14. Performance Checklist

```text
Query shape
[ ] SELECT explicit columns.
[ ] WHERE selective and tenant-scoped.
[ ] ORDER BY deterministic.
[ ] LIMIT present.
[ ] Projection for list/search.
[ ] No N+1.

Index
[ ] Composite index matches equality filters + order.
[ ] Partial index justified for hot subset.
[ ] Expression index for JSONB/lower/etc. hot expression.
[ ] EXPLAIN confirms usage.
[ ] Index write overhead reviewed.

Pagination
[ ] Offset only for small/admin datasets.
[ ] Cursor/keyset for large/high-churn datasets.
[ ] Count query strategy defined.

Batch
[ ] Batch size bounded.
[ ] Large imports async.
[ ] ExecutorType.BATCH or multi-row insert chosen intentionally.
[ ] Flush/commit behavior tested.

Pool/transaction
[ ] Transaction short.
[ ] No remote call inside transaction.
[ ] Pool max accounts for number of pods.
[ ] Hikari metrics monitored.
```

---

# 15. Security Checklist

```text
SQL injection
[ ] #{} for values.
[ ] ${} only for allow-listed server fragments.
[ ] CI grep for ${}.
[ ] malicious sort/filter tests.

Tenant isolation
[ ] tenantId server-derived.
[ ] repository method requires TenantId.
[ ] read/update/delete tenant-scoped.
[ ] cross-tenant tests.

Authorization
[ ] object-level permission checked.
[ ] list/search visibility is server-derived.
[ ] empty permission scope returns empty result.

DB privilege
[ ] runtime role cannot DDL.
[ ] migration role separate.
[ ] app role not superuser.
[ ] function EXECUTE grants explicit.

Logging/error
[ ] no secrets/PII in logs.
[ ] no raw SQL detail in API response.
[ ] SQLSTATE logged internally.
```

# 17. Senior Engineer “Red Flags” to Catch in PR

```text
[CRITICAL] Resource directly calls MyBatis mapper.
[CRITICAL] Raw user input enters ${}.
[CRITICAL] Query by ID without tenant filter.
[CRITICAL] Update/delete without tenant filter.
[CRITICAL] DB migration drops column used by old app.
[CRITICAL] API returns persistence record/entity.
[CRITICAL] Business invariant implemented only in SQL mapper.
[CRITICAL] External message publish inside DB transaction.
[CRITICAL] No integration test for new mapper XML.
[CRITICAL] New list endpoint without LIMIT.
[CRITICAL] New hot query without index/EXPLAIN review.
[CRITICAL] SQL exception returned directly to client.
```

---

# 18. Final Mental Model

```text
For every endpoint, ask:

1. What is the public API contract?
2. What command/use case does it represent?
3. What domain invariant must hold?
4. What transaction boundary is needed?
5. What repository methods are called?
6. What mapper XML statements run?
7. Are all queries tenant-scoped?
8. What PostgreSQL constraints/indexes support this?
9. What happens on duplicate/FK/check/deadlock/timeout?
10. What tests prove this?
11. What metrics/logs help debug this in production?
12. What migration risk exists if schema changes?
```
